tgt: Mininzi imisitho ecetyelwe le nyanga yeThupha yokubhiyozela umgama osele uhanjwe nguMzantsi Afrika kwidabi lokuphucula ubomi babasetyhini baseMzantsi Afrika.

src: The main event on 9 August will take place in Durban.
tgt: Owona msitho mkhulu uza kuba ngomhla wesi-9 kweyeThupha uza kubanjelwa eThekwini.

src: The Department of Arts and Culture, as the lead department of Women’s Month, will l also launch the 20 Best Moments for Women during August.
tgt: ISebe lezobuGcisa neNkcubeko, njengesebe eliza kukhokela imibhiyozo yeNyanga yabaSetyhini, liza kuphehlelela eZona zakhe zaGqama zabaSetyhini kule nyanga yeThupha.

src: These key events mark achievements by exceptional local women and the gains made by all South African women.
tgt: Ezi ziganeko zibalulekileyo ziza kuphawula imisebenzi yabasetyhini abakhethekileyo beli kwakunye nendima esele ihanjwe ngabo bonke abasetyhini boMzantsi Afrika.

src: The details of these events will be announced in due course.2 President Jacob Zuma is scheduled to lead a delegation to participate in the United States-Africa Leaders’ Summit, under the theme: “Investing in the Next Generation”, from 5 to 6 August 2014.
tgt: Iinkcukacha ezithe vetshe ngezi ziganeko ziza kwaziswa kwalapha ethubeni.2 Kulindeleke ukuba uMongameli Jacob Zuma akhokele igqiza eliza kuthatha inxaxheba kwiNgqungquthela yeeNkokeli zaseMerika nezase-Afrika, phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukuphuhliswa kwesiZukulwana esiZayo”, eza kuqala ngomhla wesi-5 iye kowe-6 kweyeThupha kowama-2014.

src: The summit is expected to bring US and African business executives together to discuss investment and business opportunities in Africa.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela kulindeleke ukuba ihlanganise abalawuli nezikhulu zezoshishino kuxoxwe ngamathuba otyalo-mali nawoshishino e-Afrika.

src: There will also be side meetings for American and African Chief Executive Officers (CEOs) and an African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) Ministerial Meeting.
tgt: Kuza kubakho neentlanganiso eziza kubanjelwa emacaleni zamaGosa oLawulo aPhezulu aseMerika nawalapha e-Afrika kunye neNtlanganiso yaBaphathiswa yoMthetho woHlumo namaThuba we-Afrika (i-AGOA).

src: These meetings are aimed at strengthening relations between United States and Africa particularly on trade and investment.
tgt: Iinjongo zezi ntlanganiso kukuqinisa ubudlelwane phakathi kweMerika ne-Afrika ingakumbi ngezorhwebo notyalo-mali.

src: The envisaged outcomes are: the encouragement of regional integration on the continent support for various African Union economic development programmes, peace and security, including the extension of AGOA climate change and environment protection issues and assistance to meet the Africa 2063 vision goals.3 The Department of Science and Technology will launch the National Science Week (NSW) on 2 August 2014 under the theme: “Today’s science, tomorrow’s world”.
tgt: Iziphumo ezilindelekileyo zezi: ukukhuthazwa kwentsebenziswano phakathi kwemimandla kweli lizwekazi ukuxhaswa kweenkqubo ezahlukeneyo zophuhliso loqoqosho zeMbumba ye-Afrika, uxolo nokhuseleko, kuquka nokwandiswa kwe-AGOA ukuguqu-guquka kweemo zezulu nemibandela yokukhuselwa kwendalo kunye nenkxaso ukuze zifezekise imibono yeenjongo ze-Afrika 20.3 ISebe lezeNzululwazi nobuChwepheshe liza kuphehlelela iVeki yeNzululwazi yeSizwe (i-NSW) ngomhla wesi-2 kweyeThuba ngowama-2014 phantsi komxholo othi: “ INzululwazi yanamhlanje, ihlabathi langomso”.

src: The NSW 2014 will continue until 9 August 2014 across the country.
tgt: I-NSW yowama-2014 iza kuqhuba kude kube ngumhla wesi-9 kweyeThupha ngomawama-2014 kulo lonke ilizwe.

src: During that week there will be a number of science activities throughout the country.
tgt: Kula veki kuza kube kukho iintlanganiso zocweyo ezininzi kulo lonke eli.

src: These will entail exhibitions, science shows, workshops and lectures.
tgt: Ezi ntlanganiso ziquka imiboniso, iinkqubo zenzululwazi, iintlanganiso zocweyo kunye nezifundo.

src: Details of the activities will be announced in due course.
tgt: Iinkcukacha zezi ntlanganiso ziza kwaziswa kwalapha ethubeni.

src: Cabinet calls on parents, teachers, learners and South Africans in general to be part of the National Science Week Appointments Cabinet noted the extension of the term of office for the following members to the National Lotteries Board, while the process to appoint the third licensee is being concluded.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela abazali, ootitshala, abafundi kunye nabemi boMzantsi Afrika gabalala ukuba babe yinxalenye ye-NSW yowama-20.

src: a) ProfNtshengedzeni Alfred Nevhutanda (Chairperson),b) Ms Mathukana Mokoka,c) ProfGovin Reddy,d) Ms Zodwa Paulina Ntuli (the dti representative), ande) Ms Ndileka Eumera Portia Loyilane.2 Cabinet approved the appointment of the following Non-Executive Directors to the Board of the South African Maritime Safety Authority (SAMSA).
tgt: Izikhundla.1 IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukwandiswa kwesithuba sokuphatha sala malungu alandelayo kwiBhodi yokuNgcakaza yeSizwe, njengoko inkqubo yokonyulwa koza kufumana amaphepha okungcakaza isagqityezelwa.

src: Women’s Month/ National Women’s Day celebrations.
tgt: INyanga yooMama/ imibhiyozo yoSuku looMama leSizwe.1 IKhabhinethi iyazamkela izicwangciso zemibhiyozo yesizwe yoSuku loMama neminye imisitho ecetyiweyo eza kubanjwa kuyo yonke le nyanga yeThupha.

src: Cabinet welcomes plans for the national Women's Day celebrations and all activities planned throughout the month of August.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kube esisithethi sembeko kwitheko lesizwe eliza kubanjelwa kwiBala iKing Zwelithini, eMlazi, KwaZulu Natal ngomhla wesi-9 kweyeThupha kowama-2014 phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukubhiyozela imiNyaka engama-60 yoMqulu wooMama nemiNyaka engama-20 yoLawulo lwentando yesininzi: sibambisene siqhubela phambili uMzantsi Afrika ongenecalulo ngobuhlanga nangobuni”.Njengenxalenye yenyanga yoomama, urhulumente uza kusingatha imisitho eyahlukeneyo eza kuhlonipha oomama abasuka kumacandelo ahlukeneyo abonise ngomgama osele siwuhambile sisisizwe.

src: President Jacob Zuma will lead the national event to be held at King Zwelithini Stadium, in Umlazi, KwaZulu-Natal, on 9 August 2014 under the theme: “Celebrating the 60th Anniversary of the Women’s Charter and 20 Years of Freedom: together moving non-racial and non-sexist South Africa forward”.As part of the celebrations of women’s month, government will host several events to profile women in different sectors and showcase the achievements we have made as a country.
tgt: Eminye imisitho ecetyiweyo iquka iiMbasa zooMama kwezoKwakha (ngomhla we-14 kweyeThupha), iiMbasa zooMama abakwezeNzululwazi (ngomhla we-15 kweyeThupha), iiMbasa zoMlimi oGqwesileyo oBhinqileyo woNyaka (ngomhla wama-22 kweyeThupha) kunye neeMbasa zooMama abakwezaManzi (ngomhla wama-29 kweyeThupha).Njengenxalenye yale mibhiyozo, uMphathiswa wezokuHlaliswa koLuntu kunye nabaPhathiswa bamaPhondo kwintlanganiso ekhethekileyo ebibanjwe ngomhla we-4 kweyeKhala ngowama-2014, wamkele inkqubo eza kunikezela ngezindlu ezili-1 956 kwiphondo ngalinye kula alithoba.

src: Some of the events planned include the Women Awards in Construction, 14 August, Women in Science Awards, 15 August, Female Farmer of the Year Awards, 22 August and Women in Water Awards, 29 WEBTOKEN part of the celebrations, the Minister of Human Settlements together with the provincial MEC’s in the special meeting (MINMEC) held on 4 July 2014, approved a programme to deliver 1 956 houses in each of the nine provinces.
tgt: Le nkqubo ihlonipha oomama abathatha inxaxheba kumngcelele besiya kwiZakhiwo zoMdibaniso beqhankqalazela imithetho yamapasi ngowama-1956.Le nkqubo iphehlelelwe okokuqala kwiLokishi yaseRatanda, kuMasipala weNgingqi waseLesedi eGauteng ngomhla we-04 kweyeThupha ngowama-2014.

src: A total of 17 604 houses will be built by women and the beneficiaries will be women, the elderly and child headed households as stipulated by Human Settlements Minister Lindiwe Sisulu during her recent budget speech.
tgt: Izindlu ezingama-17 604 zizonke ziza kwakhiwa ngoomama kwaye ziza kufunyanwa ngoomama, abantu abadala kunye namakhaya aneentloko ezingabantwana njengoko kumiselwe nguMphathiswa wokuHlaliswa koLuntu uLindiwe Sisulu ngethuba esenza intetho yakhe yohlahlo-lwabiwo-mali.

src: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to support and participate in the Women’s Month programmes and activities throughout the month to ensure that women achievements are celebrated.
tgt: IKhabinethi imemelela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika bafake isandla bathathe nenxaxheba kwiinkqubo nemisitho yeNyanga yooMama eza kubanjwa kuyo le nyanga ukuqinisekisa ukuba imisebenzi yoomama iyakhunjulwa.

src: The National Women’s Month Programme is attached.
tgt: INkqubo yeSizwe yeNyanga yooMama nantsi ngezantsi.

src: Key programme implementationCabinet welcomes and appreciates the progress on implementation of key government programmes which reflect our commitment to moving South Africa forward.
tgt: UkuPhunyezwa kweNkqubo engundoqoIKhabhinethi iyayamkela kwaye iyithakazelela inkqubela ekuphunyezweni kweenkqubo ezingundoqo zikarhulumente nto leyo ibonakalisa ukuzimisela kwethu ekuqhubeleni uMzantsi Afrika phambili.

src: The opening of the R30-million Transnet Wagons Refurbishing Facility at De Aar, in the Northern Cape will boost the local economy and improve the living conditions of communities.
tgt: Ukuvulwa kweZiko lokuHlaziya amaKhareji kaloliwe bakaTransnet elixabisa izigidi ezingama-R30 eDiyala (De Aar), eMntla Koloni kuza kulunceda uqoqosho lwale ngingqi kuphucule neemeko abantu abaphila phantsi kwazo.

src: More than 100 direct jobs have already been created and a further 300 jobs are expected.
tgt: Imisebenzi engaphaya kwe-100 sele ivelile kulo ngqo kwaye kulindeleke eminye imisebenzi engama-300.

src: The Wagons Refurbishing Facility is part of Transnet’s R300 billion infrastructure plan to revamp and modernise the country’s rail, pipeline and ports network which will create 588 000 new jobs.
tgt: Eli Ziko lokuHlaziywa kwamaKhareji liyinxalenye yesicwangciso seziseko ezingundoqo esixabisa iibhiliyoni ezingama-R300 sikaTransnet sokuhlaziya nokuphucula iziporo zikaloliwe, imibhobho namazibuko eli lizwe nto leyo iza kudala imisebenzi emitsha engama-588 000.

src: Young people in the area will also benefit from the development of a Youth Multi-Purpose Precinct.
tgt: Ulutsha lwale ngingqi nalo liza kuxhamla kulwakhiwo lweZiko leMisebenzi eyohlukeneyo yoLutsha.

src: This project forms part of a number of government infrastructure projects coordinated through the Presidential Infrastructure Coordinating Committee.
tgt: Eli ziko liyinxalenye yala maphulo maninzi karhulumente olwakhiwo lweziseko ezingundoqo ezilawulwa yiKomiti kaMongameli yokuLungelelanisa ukwakhiwa kweZiseko ezingundoqo.

src: As part of government’s drive to expand the capabilities of the South African manufacturing industry, to increase the country’s industrial base and create the much needed jobs, an R80 million facility was launched in Epping Cape Town.
tgt: Njengenxaleye yephulo likarhulumente lokwandisa izakhono zecandelo lezemveliso, ukwandisa amashishini ukuze kudaleke imisebenzi enqongopheleyo, kuphehlelewe ngokusesikweni iziko elixabisa izigidi ezingama-R80 e-Epping, eKapa.

src: This 120 MW solar PV module production facility was officially launched on 6 August 2014 by Jinko Solar, a Chinese multinational company.
tgt: Eli ziko lokuvelisa uhlobo lesola i-PV enamandla angama-120 MW laphehlelelwa ngokusesikweni ngomhla we-6 kweyeThupha ngowama-2014 ngabakwa-Jinko Solar, inkampani erhweba namazwe ngamazwe yaseTshayina.

src: This is part of the roll-out of the South African Renewable Energy Independent Power Producers Programme (REIPPP).
tgt: Oku kuyinxalenye yokuqaliswa kweNkqubo yaBavelisi abaziMeleyo boMbane waMandla oHlaziyekayo yoMzantsi Afrika (i-REIPPP).

src: The facility is expected to produce 1 300 solar panels per day, with an expected R600 million turnover per year.
tgt: Eli ziko kulindeleke ukuba livelise amacangci esola ali-1 300 ngosuku kwaye kulindeleke ukuba libe nengeniso ezizigidi ezingama-R600 ngonyaka.

src: Since the inception of this programme, Jinko Solar has deployed over 300MW of solar PV panels, reaching approximately 30% market share.
tgt: Oko kwaqala le nkqubo, abakwaJinko Solar sebefakele isola eziluhlobo le-PV ezinamandla angaphaya kwama-300MW, ngolo hlobo bafikelela kumalunga nama-30% abathengi.

src: The plant, which is the newest and most modern of its type on the continent, is expected to produce 120 Megawatts by the end of the year.
tgt: Lo mzi-mveliso, nongowona umtsha nongowale mihla kweli lizwekazi, kulindele ukuba uvelise iimegawathi ezili-120 ukuphela kwalo nyaka.

src: This is part of government’s drive to expand the capabilities of the South African manufacturing industry, to increase the country’s industrial base and create the much needed jobs in Epping.
tgt: Oku kuyinxalenye yephulo likarhulumente lokwandisa izakhono zamashishini emveliso aseMzantsi Afrika, kwandiswe amashishini eli lizwe kudaleke nemisebenzi edingeka kakhulu e-Epping.

src: The Green Economy has been identified as a key focus area in the Industrial Policy Action Plan and provides significant opportunities for job creation, localisation and economic growth.
tgt: UQoqosho olungenabuNgozi kokusiNgqongileyo luchongwe njengommandla ekuza kugxilwa kuwo kwisiCwangciso sokuSebenza soMgaqo-nkqubo wezoShishino kwaye luvula namathuba amahle okudala imisebenzi, ukuthengwa nokusetyenziswa kwezinto zeli nohlumo loqoqosho.3 IKhabhinethi ichulumancile kukuphehlelelwa kweZiko lokuQeqesha laMandla aHlaziyekayo e-Upington, eMntla Koloni, elilelinye iphulo lokuqhubela uMzantsi Afrika phambili.

src: Cabinet is pleased with the launch of the Renewable Energy Centre of Excellence in Upington, Northern Cape which represents another initiative to move South Africa forward.
tgt: Eli ziko lisisiphumo sentsebenziswano entle phakathi kwamaziko emfundo ephakamileyo, amashishini abucala kunye necandelo lamandla ahlaziyekayo likarhulumente.

src: The centre is the result of strong collaboration among academia, the private sector, and government in the area of renewable energy.
tgt: Eli ziko liza kuncedisa kuphando, uphuhliso kunye noyilo kwezamandla, libe negalelo elimandla xa kuthathwa izigqibo ngemigaqo-nkqubo nasekuxhobiseni abantu ngezakhono.

src: The centre will support research, development and innovation in the energy sector, informing and influencing policy decisions and supporting human capital development.
tgt: Oku kuza kuba negalelo elikhulu ekwandiseni uhlobo loQoqosho olungenabungozi kokusiNgqongileyo, kwaye kuphucule nohlobo lwezakhono ezikhoyo kwela phondo nakula mmandla.

src: Cabinet welcomes the launch of the Hydrogen Fuel Cells (HFC) technology electrification project on 5 August 2014 which is the culmination of robust and productive deliberations between government and the Anglo-Ballard partnership.
tgt: Amandla ahlaziyekayo eza namathuba amahle kakhulu otyalo-mali, kubandakanya namaninzi okudala imisebenzi.4 IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuphehlelelwa kwephulo lobuchwephesha bokuvelisa umbane ngamanzi ekuthiwa yi-Hydrogen Fuel Cells (i-HFC) ngomhla we-05 kweyeThupha ngowama-2014 elisisiphumo seengxoxo ezazishushu nezakhayo phakathi kukarhulumente nabakwa-Anglo-Ballard.

src: This project to derive power from fuel cell technology is the world's first fuel cell mini-grid electrification field trial.
tgt: Eli phulo livelisa umbane ngokutshintsha ubuchwephesha beeseli zamafutha lililinge lophando lokuqala kwihlabathi eliqhutyelwa embaneni kanye lokuveliswa kombane ngeeseli zamafutha kwizikwana lombane elincinci.

src: Of particular interest is the pivotal role of the development and deployment of this technology in localisation of the energy value chain specifically the use of fuel cell technology as an alternative generation technology.
tgt: Okona kunika umdla kakhulu yindima ebalulekileyo yophuhliso nokusetyenziswa kolu hlobo lobuchwephesha kumbandela wokusetyenziswa kwezixhobo zalapha ekhaya kwabo basebenza ngamandla ingakumbi ukusetyenziswa kobuchwephesha beeseli zamafutha njengenye indlela yokuvelisa ubuchwephesha.

src: This project will deepen industrialisation of South Africa’s economy and enable us to reduce the carbon intensity of its economy and contribute significantly to employment creation.
tgt: Eli phulo liza kuza notshintsho kusetyenziswe oomatshini bale mihla kuqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika kwaye lusincede siphungule isisi somoya ongcolileyo kuqoqosho lweli kuncedise kakhulu nasekudaleni imisebenzi.

src: Cabinet approved South Africa’s initial transport sector offer under the Southern African Development Community (SADC) Trade in Services Negotiations.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabinethi ezingondoqo.1 IKhabhinethi isamkele isithembiso sokuqala secandelo lezothutho soMzantsi Afrika phantsi kweeNgxoxo zoThetha-thethwano ngoRhwebo ngeeNkonzo zeQumrhu loPhuhliso lamaZantsi e-Afrika.

src: This sector is critical to South Africa’s growth and job creation prospects, both as an intermediate input to merchandise trade and as a tradable service in its own right.
tgt: Eli candelo libalulekile kuhlumo loMzantsi Afrika nakumathuba okudala imisebenzi, njengengeniso enxibelelanisayo kurhwebo ngempahla nanjengenkonzo ekunokurhwetywa ngayo izimele ngokunokwayo yodwa.

src: Intra-regional integration of transport services can generate commercially valuable market opportunities for South African service suppliers as well as investment across the transport sectors in the region.
tgt: Ukudityaniswa nokusebenzisana kweenkonzo zothutho zemimandla kungadala amathuba angayinzuzo orhwebo kubanikezeli zinkonzo boMzantsi Afrika kwakunye notyalo-mali kuwo onke amacandelo ezothutho kulo mmandla.

src: As income is generated by exporting services within value chains, South African companies could obtain commercial benefits and simultaneously contribute to the development of the regional transport sector.
tgt: Njengeko kukho ingeniso eyenziwayo ngokunikezela ngeenkonzo kwamanye amacandelo asebenzisana nawezothutho, iinkampani zoMzantsi Afrika zingafumana amathuba okushishina kwaye ngaxeshanye zincedise kuphuhliso lwecandelo lezothutho lale ngingqi.2 IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngeziphumo zobalo lwemikhombe lowama-2013 ebeliqhutywa kumyezo i-Kruger National Park kwaye izamkele iziphakamiso ezizokungenelela ukusindisa imikhombe.

src: The Minister of Environmental Affairs will at a later stage conduct a separate media briefing on this matter.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezeNdalo uza kuba nenye intlanganiso nonoondaba ngalo umba ngelinye ixesha.

src: Cabinet approved the new Zimbabwean Dispensation process.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyamkele inkqubo entsha engemeko yeeMbacu zaseZimbabwe.

src: The Minster of Home Affairs will conduct a separate media briefing to announce details of this process.
tgt: UMphathiswa weMicimbi yezeKhaya uza kuqhuba enye intlanganiso nonoondaba anike iinkcukacha ngendlela eza kusebenza ngayo le nkqubo.4 IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuba kuphononongwe ngokupheleleyo amaZiko ezeMali oPhuhliso amaPhondo (ii-PDFI) ngokubhekisele kwiziphumo neziphakamiso ezivela kuphando olungenzulu obeluqhutywe nguNondyebo weSizwe ukuvavanya imeko yawo yezezimali nefuthe lawo kuphuhliso.

src: Cabinet approved that a full review be undertaken of Provincial Development Finance Institutions (PDFIs) based on the findings and recommendations from a desktop review, by National Treasury to assess current financial status and development effectiveness.
tgt: Uphononongo oluzeleyo lwee-PDFI liza kunceda ekuqinisekiseni ukuba amagunya abo ayalungelelana kwaye ayasebenza exhasa iinjongo zemigaqo-nkqubo yezentlalo noqoqosho kaRhulumente kwaye nokuqinisekisa ukuba iziseko zokusebenza zikaRhulumente zabiwa kwaye zisetyenziswe ngokubunono.

src: The full-scale review of the PDFIs will assist to ensure their mandates are coordinated and effective in support of Government’s social and economic policy objectives and also ensuring efficient allocation and use of Government resources.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela inkqubela kwisiCwangciso-qhinga sokuTshintsha izinto ukuze kwakhiwe ngokutsha iSebe lemiSebenzi kaRhulumente kunye neNgxelo yokuQukumbela yesiGaba sokuZinzisa.

src: Cabinet welcomed the progress on the Turnaround Strategy to rebuild the Department of Public Works and the Close-out Report of the Stabilisation Phase.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikholisekile ngumgama osele uhanjiwe kumsebenzi wokutshintsha izinto kweli sebe.

src: Cabinet is satisfied with progress recorded in turning around the department.
tgt: UMphathiswa wemiSebenzi kaRhulumente uza kubamba enye intlanganiso nonoondaba ukucacisa le ngxelo ngakumbi.

src: The Minister of Public Works will conduct a separate media briefing to explain the details of this report.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba egqubayo.1 IKhabhinethi iyawamkela uMthetho woLungelelwaniso kwezeNgqesho olungisiweyo oqale ukusebenzisa ngomhla woku-1 kweyeThupha ngowama-2014.

src: The amended Act promotes transformation, fairer labour practices and protects against unfair discrimination.
tgt: Lo Mthetho ulungisiweyo ukhuthaza iinguqu, iindlela zokusebenza ezilungileyo kwaye uyakuthintelwa ukucalulwa ngendlela enenkohlakalo.

src: It further strengthens implementation and enforcement mechanisms by, for example increasing fines for non-compliance.
tgt: Unika amagunya nangakumbi kwimithethwana yokuqinisekisa ukuba lo mthetho uyaphunyezwa kwaye uyalandelwa, umzekelo ngokunyusa isohlwayo kwabo bangawuthobeliyo.

src: Cabinet calls on employers to comply with the provisions of the Act and work with government to transform the workplace.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abaqeshi ukuba bawathobele amasolotya alo Mthetho kwaye basebenzisane norhulumente ukuzisa iinguqu emisebenzini.

src: Furthermore, the Department of Labour is conducting public road shows to educate the public about employment equity and its impact.
tgt: Ukongeza, iSebe lezabaSebenzi liqhuba iintlanganiso noluntu ngeenjongo zokubafundisa ngobulungisa kwezengqesho kunye neziphumo zabo.2 IKhabhinethi iliqhwabela izandla iQela loMzantsi Afrika ngendlela entle eliqhube ngayo kwiMidlalo yaMazwe ayasekubangamathanga eGlasgow, eSkotlane, elithe laphumelela iimbasa zegolide eli-13, ezesilivere ezili-10 nezebronzi ezili-17.

src: Cabinet congratulates Team South Africa on its outstanding performance during the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, Scotland which won them 13 gold, 10 silver and 17 bronze medals.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika ube kwindawo yesixhenxe kuluhlu lweembasa kwaye ube lelona lizwe liqhube kakuhle eliphuma kweli lizwekazi le-Afrika.

src: Cabinet calls on South Africans to honour and celebrate the achievements of our South African athletes on Friday, 8 August 2014, when open buses will be carrying the athletes from Olympic House in Johannesburg at 11h.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika kuba banike imbeko bevuyisana neembaleki zoMzantsi Afrika ngendlela eziqhuba ngayo ngomhla wesibhozo kweyeThupha kowama-2014 xa ibhasi engenamphezulu iza kube ilayishe ezi mbaleki zisuka e-Olympic House eRhawutini ngentsimbi ye-11h.3 IKhabhinethi yothulela umnqwazi iqela lesizwe leqakamba (ii-Protea) elikhokelwe nguKapteni wemiDlalo yoVavanyo uHashim Amla ngokuphumelele imidlalo yoVavanyo eSri Lanka ngolo hlobo laba kwindawo yokuqala kuluhlu lweBhunga laMazwe ngamazwe leQakamba leMidlalo yoVavanyo yeHlabathi.4 IKhabhinethi ivuyisana noZolani “Last Born” Tete ngokuphumelela isithsaba sodidi lwabasezantsi kwibhantam yoMbutho wezaManqindi weHlabathi eJapan.5 IKhabhinethi ithumela imiyalezo yovelwano kusapho nezihlobo zendoda ethe yaphulukana nobomi bayo ngenxa yenyikima ngoLwesibini kwaye inqwenelela abo banzokeleyo ukuba bachache ngokukhawuleza.

src: Cabinet also congratulates the national cricket team (Proteas) under the leadership of Test Captain Hashim Amla for winning the Test series in Sri Lanka and regaining the number one International Cricket Council World Test ranking.
tgt: Usebenza neZiko loLawulo lweeNtlekele leSizwe, urhulumente wenza konke anako ukunceda abo bachaphazelekileyo.5 Imisitho ezayo.1 UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kuzimasa iNgqungquthela eQhelekileyo yeeNtloko zeZizwe noRhulumente yeBhunga loPhuhliso laseMazantsi e-Afrika (i-SADC) yama-34 ngomhla we-17 nowe-18 kweyeThupha kowama-2014 eVictoria Falls, eZimbabwe.

src: Cabinet congratulates Zolani "Last Born" Tete for winning the International Boxing Federation (IBF) junior bantamweight title in Japan.
tgt: ISADC iyaqhubeleka isisikhokelo kumgaqo-nkqubo ngemiba yezangamaphandle kuphuhliso nentsebenziswano kule ngingqi.

src: Cabinet sends condolences to the family and friends of the man who lost his life as a result of the earthquake on Tuesday and wishes a speedy recovery to those who were injured.
tgt: Imiba ephambili eza kuxovulwa kule Ngqungquthela iquka ukuPhononongwa kweSicwangciso soPhuhliso seNgingqi esiBonisa iiNdawo zoPhuhliso eziBalulekileyo, uMbono 2050 weSADC, iNkundla ye-SADC kunye nesiCwangciso-qhinga sokuTya neSondlo kunye noMgaqo-nkqubo weNgingqi wezoLimo.2 ILekgotla yezeMigodi yokuqala iza kubanjwa ngomhla we-13 nowe-14 kweyeThupha ibanjelwa eGallagher Estate, eRhawutini phantsi komxholo othi: Sisebenzela phezu kwendima edlalwe yimigodi ukusukela oko sabona ulawulo lwentando yesininzi.

src: Through the National Disaster Management, government is attending to the affected communities.5 Upcoming events.1 President Jacob Zuma will attend the 34th Ordinary Summit of Southern African Development Community (SADC) Heads of State and Government on 17 and 18 August 2014 in Victoria Falls, Zimbabwe.
tgt: Siyazi ngembali yethu kodwa ngoku sijonge phambili.” Le ndibano iza kunika ithuba lokubonisana ngezithile phakathi kwabo bakwezemigodi eMzantsi Afrika kunye namanye amahlakani achaphazelekayo.

src: Implementation of key government programmesCabinet commends the launch of another Sexual Offences Court in Bethlehem, Free State by Minister Michael Masutha.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweeNkqubo ezinguNdoqo zikaRhulumenteIKhabhinethi ikuqhwabela izandla ukuphehlelelwa kwenye iNkundla yamaTyala ezeSondo eBethlehem, eFreystatha nguMphathiswa uMichael Masutha.

src: This forms part of government’s intervention programme in the fight against sexual violence against women, children and the vulnerable groups.
tgt: Oku kuyinxalenye yenkqubo karhulumente yokufaka isandla kwidabi lokulwa ukuxhatshazwa kwabasetyhini, abantwana nabantu abangenabani ngezesondo.

src: These dedicated courts are equipped to provide specialised victim-support services which in turn help to improve conviction rates.
tgt: Ezi nkundla zimiselwe oku zinazo izixhobo zoncedo zokunika inkxaso eyodwa kumaxhoba nto leyo iphinde incede ukunyusa izinga lokubanjwa kwezaphuli-mthetho.

src: Government remains resolute to strengthen the criminal justice system so as to deal decisively with the violation of the rights of women and children.
tgt: Urhulumente uzimisele nangakumbi kwiphulo lokwenza ngqingqwa inkqubo yezobulungisa ukuze ikwazi ukuba gadalala kumkhuba wokunyhashwa kwamalungelo oomama nabantwana.

src: Cabinet welcomes the launch by Minister Lindiwe Zulu of the Enterprise Development Academy based at the Gordon Institute of Business Science.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkelwa ukumiselwa kweZiko loQeqesho loPhuhliso lwamaShishini elikwiziko i-Gordon Institute of Business Science nguMphathiswa uLindiwe Zulu.

src: The Academy focuses on scholarship-based education and support to micro and small business owners by helping them grow sustainably to create further employment in the long term.
tgt: Eli ziko liza kugxininisa kwimfundo exhaswa yingxowa-mali yokufunda nasekuncediseni oosomashishini abancinci nabancinane ngokubanceda ukuba bakhule ngokuzinzileyo baze badale amanye amathuba emisebenzi kwixa elizayo.

src: The Academy is part of the solution to address youth unemployment and build a nation of entrepreneurs.
tgt: Eli ziko liyinxalenye yamacebo okusombulula ingxaki yentswela-ngqesho kulutsha nokwakha isizwe esikhuthaza oosomashishini abazisebenzelayo.

src: It aims to provide practical and relevant business education and leadership training to entrepreneurs, followed by a comprehensive structure of support services.
tgt: Eli ziko likwaneenjongo zokuxhobisa oosomashishini abasakhulayo ngemfundo efanelekileyo nenokusebenziseka kwezoshishino kunye noqeqesho ngobunkokheli, kuze oku kulandelwe luludwe olubanzi lweenkonzo zoncedo.

src: This ensures that academic learning is applied to the business environment and that impact is achieved.
tgt: Oku kuza kuqinisekisa ukuba okufundwe esikolweni kuyasetyenziswa emsebenzini kwaye kwenza nomahluko obonakalayo.

src: South Africa needs an entrepreneurial revolution in order to spark a shift in direction towards entrepreneurship and SMEs that will move the country forward.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika ufanelwe liphulo elibanzi lokukhuthaza oosomashishini abasakhulayo ukuze kubekho utshintsho kwindlela esiyihambayo, sijike sithande ushishino sikhuthaze amashishini amancinci naphakathi (ii-SME) aza kukwazi ukuqhubela eli lizwe phambili.

src: Government, big business and academic institutions need to collaborate when it comes to supporting job creation through enterprise development.
tgt: Urhulumente, amashishini amakhulu kunye namaziko emfundo ephakamileyo kufuneka basebenzisane kumbandela wokuxhasa iphulo lokudala imisebenzi ngophuhliso lwamashishini asakhulayo.

src: In order to flourish, business creation needs an enabling environment where entrepreneurs have access to funding, best-practice tools and skills development.
tgt: Ukuze amashishini aqhube kakuhle afuna iimeko ezikukhuthazayo oku apho oosomashishini abasakhulayo banako ukuyifumana inkxaso ngemali, izixhobo ezikumgangatho ophezulu kunye nophuhliso lwezakhono.

src: Key Cabinet decisionsCabinet approved the ratification of the signed Grand Inga Treaty between the Republic of South Africa and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) for tabling in Parliament.
tgt: Izigqibo ezingundoqo zeKhabhinethiIKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukuqinisekiswa ngokusesikweni kweSivumelwano i-Grand Inga esityikitywe nguMzantsi Afrika ne-Democratic Republic of Congo (i-DRC) nokuba sithiwe thaca ePalamente.

src: The Treaty provides the framework for the facilitation of power generation from Grand Inga Project and its delivery to the border between the DRC and Zambia.
tgt: Esi siVumelwano sinika isicwangciso-sikhokelo sokuqaliswa komsebenzi wokuveliswa kwamandla kwi-Grand Inga Project nokuba la mandla athuthelwe kumda ophakathi kwe-DRC neZambia.

src: Ratification of the Treaty enables development of Phase I of the Project, which will provide 2 500 Megawatts of electricity to South Africa and contribute to regional integration, energy security, access to energy and economic growth in an environmentally sustainable manner.
tgt: Ukuqinisekiswa ngokusesikweni kwesi siVumelwano kuza kunceda ukuba kwakhiwe isiGaba soku-I salo msebenzi, esiza kuzisa iimegawathi ezingama-2 500 zombane eMzantsi Afrika kwaye oku kuza kunceda nakwintsebenziswano kwingingqi, amandla, ukufumaneka kwamandla ombane kunye nakuhlumo loqoqosho ngendlela engenabungozi kokusingqongileyo.

src: The project has the potential to supply clean and affordable imported hydroelectric power to meet the needs of the DRC, South Africa and surrounding countries.
tgt: Lo msebenzi wolwakhiwo unganako ukuzisa amandla (ombane) acacokileyo aveliswa ngamanzi nafikelelekayo asuka ngaphandle ukuze anezise iimfuno zombane zase-DRC, ezaseMzantsi Afrika nezamazwe angabamelwane.

src: It entails the generation of approximately 40 000 Megawatt of hydropower on the Congo River, over seven phases.
tgt: Lo msebenzi wolwakhiwo uquka ukuveliswa kwamandla ombane wamanzi ozimegawathi ezimalunga nama-40 000 kuMlambo iCongo kwizigaba ezisixhenxe ezizayo.

src: The project holds the potential to fast-track Southern African Development Community (SADC) development alleviate energy poverty, stimulate economic growth and facilitate infrastructure development.
tgt: Lo msebenzi wolwakhiwo unganakho ukukhawulezisa uphuhliso lommandla we-SADC, ulwe ukunqongophala kwamandla, ukhuthaze uhlumo loqoqosho ukhokele nophuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo.

src: The Grand Inga project will seek to harness the power potential of the Congo River, sub-Saharan Africa's greatest waterway.
tgt: Lo msebenzi we-Grand Inga ujolise ekukhuseleni amandla oMlambo iCongo, ongowona mlambo mkhulu okwi-Afrika esemazantsi e-Sahara.

src: This represents one of the most ambitious projects ever undertaken on the African continent, and one which will long be a resounding symbol of the rise of Africa and her people.
tgt: Lo msebenzi wokwakha ungowona msebenzi mkhulu nofuna isibindi owakhe waqhutywa kweli lizwekwazi i-Afrika, kwaye uza kuba ngumzekelo oqaqambileyo obonisa ukuba i-Afrika nama-Afrika abafikanga bagalelekile.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the upcoming International Gender, Water and Development Conference.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngeNkomfa ezayo yaMazwe ngamazwe engoBuni, Amanzi noPhuhliso.

src: The conference will be hosted by the Department of Water and Sanitation, Water Research and its partners in the sector.
tgt: Le nkomfa iza kusingathwa liSebe lezaManzi noGutyulo, uPhando ngaManzi kwakunye namahlakani abo kwezamanzi.

src: The conference will be held from the 3 to 7 November in East London under the theme “The Untapped Connection”.
tgt: Le nkomfa iza kubanjwa ukusuka ngomhla wesi-3 ukuya kowesi-7 kweyoMnga ibanjelwa eMonti phantsi komxholo othi: “Imithombo Engakaphathwa”.Le nkomfa ilandela iingxoxo ezininzi ezaziqale emva kweNkomfa yaMazwe ngamazwe yoLawulo lwaManzi abalekayo eyayibanjwe ngeyoMnga kowama-2012.

src: The conference follows a number of ongoing dialogues that started after the International Freshwater Governance Conference that was held in November 2012.
tgt: Le nkomfa iza kuba liqonga lokukhuthaza intsebenziswano nobudlelwane obuza kusabela kwimiceli-mingeni ejamelene neli candelo.

src: It will also address the roll-out of the African Ministers Council on Water Gender Strategy.
tgt: Le nkomfa iza kunika kwanethuba lokuba kuqaliswe ngesiCwangciso-sikhokelo seBhunga labaPhathiswa base-Afrika ngoMbandela waManzi noBuni.

src: Cabinet’s Position on Current Issues	Cabinet was briefed by the Minister of Health, Mr. Aaron Motsoaledi, on developments around Ebola and interventions made by South Africa .
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwiMiba eGqubayoIKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi nguMphathiswa wezeMpilo, uGq-Aaron Motsoaledi, ngezamva nje ngombandela wesifo e-Ebola kwakunye namanyathelo asele ethathiwe nguMzantsi Afrika.

src: Cabinet wishes to reiterate that no person has been found positive with the disease.
tgt: IKhabinethi ifuna ukubethelela ukuba akukabikho mntu ofunyenwe enesi sifo kweli.

src: The country’s state of readiness and response on Ebola requires strengthen capacity in the SADC region and the rest of the continent which South Africa can offer.
tgt: Amaqulo namalungiselelo eli lizwe okulwa nesifo i-Ebola kufuneka abe ngawona angqingqwa kummandla we-SADC nakwilizwekazi jikele uMzantsi Afrika onawo.

src: South Africa remains committed to provide support through screening, training and laboratory services for the SADC region.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika usazimisele ukuncedisa ummandla we-SADC ngokuhlola, uqeqesho neenkonzo zelebhu.

src: Minister Motsoaledi will give a full briefing on this issue today at 14h.
tgt: uMphathiswa uMotsoaledi uza kunika ingcaciso egcweleyo ngalo mba nge-14:30 namhlanje.

src: Cabinet welcomes the plans by the South African Reserve Bank and a consortium of investors from the financial sector to restructure African Bank Limited (ABL).
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela izicwangciso zeBhanki enguVimba yoMzantsi Afrika kunye nequmrhu labatyali-zimali abaphuma kwicandelo lezezimali zokuhlangula i-African Bank Limited (i-ABL).

src: This will assist to appropriately safeguard retail depositors and minimise losses for investors in ABThis will also ensure the country’s financial sector remains strong and robust.
tgt: Oku kuza kunceda abo bagcinise imali zabo kuze kuphungule nelahleko yabo batyale imali kwa-ABOku, futhi, kuza kuqinisekisa ukuba icandelo lezezimali leli lizwe liluqilima kwaye lizinzile.

src: Cabinet emphasised, the importance of the financial services sector to economic growth and highlighted that government, through the National Treasury, will continue to strengthen the sector, its oversight, and improve regulatory coordination.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakugxininisa ukubaluleka kwecandelo lezezimali kuhlumo loqoqosho kwaye iyakubethelela nokuba urhulumente, ekhokelwa nguNondyebo weSizwe, uza kuqhubekeka elixhobisa kangangoko eli candelo, elikhuthaza kumsebenzi walo wokuba liliso kwaye aphucule nendlela esebenza ngayo imithetho elilawulayo.

src: Cabinet noted with concern the misinformation about the various reforms regarding retirement funds (pension and provident funds).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivile yaye ibuxhalaba lulwazi olulahlekisayo olungeengunqu ezahlukeneyo ezicetywayo kwiingxowa-mali zomhlala-phantsi (le umntu ayinikwa yonke isisixa xa ethatha umhlala-phantsi (i-providenti) okanye le anikwa isinye esithathwini sayo ize eshiyekileyo inkinkishwe ngezavenge ngenyanga (ipenshini)).

src: There is anecdotal evidence that some workers are resigning from work on fears that government will from next year prevent them from withdrawing their retirement savings when they change jobs, and that government wants to take over retirement funds.
tgt: Kukho amarhe athi abanye abasebenzi bayalahla emisebenzini kuba bexhalele ukuba urhulumente kulo nyaka uzayo uza kubalela ukuba bayifumane imali yabo yomhlala-phantsi xa betshintsha imisebenzi, nokuba urhulumente ufuna ukuzilawula ngokwakhe iingxowa-mali zomhlala-phantsi.

src: While government wants to encourage workers to preserve their savings until retirement, no laws have changed to stop withdrawal when workers change jobs.
tgt: Nangona urhulumente efuna ukubakhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba bayigcine imali yabo abayibekele umhlala-phantsi, akukho mthetho utshintshiweyo othintela abantu ukuba bangayikhuphi imali yomhlala-phantsi xa betshintsha imisebenzi.

src: By contrast, the various retirement reform proposals seek to:a) Encourage individuals to provide adequately for their own retirement and the needs of their dependents and to provide for retirement funding as part of the remuneration contractb) Make retirement funding arrangements cost-efficient, prudently managed, transparent and fair and c) Improve standards of fund governance, including standards of fund governance, including trustee knowledge and conduct, protection of members’ interest, accountability and disclosure of material information to members and contributors.
tgt: Endaweni yoko, ezi iziphakamiso zeenguqu zifuna:a) Ukukhathaza abantu ukuba batye bebeka ukulungiselela umhlala-phantsi wabo kunye neemfuno zabo baxhomekeke kubo nokuba kubekho imalanyana abayigcinayo yomhlala-phantsi kwimali yabo yomfuzo.

src: Cabinet wants to assure the public that people’s retirement savings remain safe.
tgt: b) Ukwenza ukuba amalungiselelo okufaka imali kumhlala-phantsi angabinalahleko kakhulu, alawulwe ngobunono, acace gca kwaye angakrokrisi.

src: There is no reason for any worker (both in the private and public sector) to resign so as to access their retirement savings.
tgt: c) Ukuphucula umgangatho wolawulo lwengxowa-mali yomhlala-phantsi, kuquka ulwazi nendlela abaziphethe ngayo abo balawula ingxowa-mali, ukukhuselwa kweemali zamalungu, ukuphendula nokudandalazisa ulwazi olululutho kumalungu nakwabo bahlawula imali.

src: It should also be noted that those cashing out their pension or provident funds before retirement will not only get less money than they would had they preserved, but they may be taxed on early withdrawals and no longer enjoy the tax advantages.
tgt: Makuqatshelwe ukuba abo bakhupha imali yabo yepenshini okanye yeprovidenti phambi kokuba lifike ixesha lokuthatha umhlala-phantsi abazukufumana mali incinci kuphela kunaleyo bebeza kuyifumana ukuba bebeyigcinile koko bangatsalelwa nerhafu ngenxa yokuba beyikhuphe phambi kwexesha kwaye abazikuxhamla kwizaphulelo zerhafu.

src: Upcoming eventsMinister Nathi Mthethwa will launch Heritage Month in Gauteng on 31 August under the theme: “Celebrating 20 Years of Democracy: Tell Your Story that Moves South Africa Forward”.
tgt: Imisitho ezayoUMphathiswa uNathi Mthethwa uza kuphehlelela iNyanga yaMafa eGauteng ngomhla wama-31 kweyeThupha phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukubhiyozela iMinyaka engama-20 yoRhulumente wentando yesininzi: Balisa iBali Lakho eliQhubela uMzantsi Afrika Phambili”.

src: Among the projects identified to advance the “Tell Your Story” campaign are the reburials of Nat Nakasa and Moses Kotane.
tgt: Phakathi kwamaphulo achongiweyo ukuba aza kusetyenziswa ukuqhubela phambili iphulo i-“Balisa iBali Lakho” kukufihlwa kwakhona kwamathambo kaNat Nakasa noMoses Kotane.

src: Repatriations of unsung heroes provide South Africans with an opportunity to learn more about their personal struggles, the circumstances that led to them living in exile and the impact they had on the liberation of our country.
tgt: Ukubuyiswa kwamagorha angazange anikwe ndumasi kunika uMzantsi Afrika ithuba lokuba ufunde banzi ngamahla-ndinyuka obomi bawo, iimeko ezabangela ukuba aye kuhlala elubhacweni kunye negalelo lawo kumzabalazo wenkululeko yeli lizwe.

src: Other events include: National Book Week from 1 to 7 September under the theme: “Going Places” focusing on the power of books and how they can ‘figuratively’ and ‘literally’ take South Africans to places.
tgt: Eminye imisitho iquka: iVeki yeSizwe yeeNcwadi ukusuka ngomhla woku-1 ukuya kowesi-7 kweyoMsintsi phantsi komxholo othi: “Siyakunqandwa Zinkwenkwezi”.

src: Events are planned in all the provinces and will include reading in indigenous languages, storytelling and motivational talks, word-a-thons, poetry sessions and book debates.
tgt: Yona iza kugxininisa kwifuthe leencwadi nendlela ezinokuqhubela ngayo uMzantsi Afrika emajukujukwini ngokwenyani nangokomzekelo.

src: Also, on 3 September South Africa will commemorate the 30th Anniversary of the Vaal Uprising during which the Vaal Triangle community protested against rent increases, poor service delivery and an illegitimate, and defunct local government.
tgt: Iindibano zicetyiwe kumaphondo onke kwaye ziza kuquka ufundo ngeelwimi zomthonyama, ukubalisa amabali neentetho zenkuthazo, ukhuphiswano ngesigama, izifundo ngemibongo kunye neengxoxo-mpikiswano ngeencwadi.

src: The Vaal Uprising introduced a new period of sustained protest that spread to large parts of the country, prompting the apartheid authorities to declare a state of emergency.
tgt: Ngomhla wesi-3 kweyoMsintsi uMzantsi Afrika uza kuba nesiKhumbuzo seMinyaka engama-30 seziDube-dube zaseLigwa apho uluntu lommandla woNxantathu weLigwa laliqhankqalazela ukunyuswa kwemali yerenti, ukungahanjiswa kweenkonzo ngokukuko kunye norhulumente wasekhaya ongekho mthethweni nongasebenziyo.

src: Minister Derek Hanekom will launch Tourism Month on 26 August at Maboneng Precinct, Johannesburg, under the theme: “Tourism Transforming Lives”, which is derived from World Tourism Day (27 September) and focuses on the social, cultural, political and economic value of tourism to the country.
tgt: IziDube-dube zaseLigwa zeza nohlobo lokuqhankqalaza oluzingileyo olaphela lugubungela iindawo ezininzi zeli lizwe, nto leyo yabangela ukuba abasemagunyeni kurhulumente wocalu-calulo bamisele imo yonxunguphalo.

src: South Africans are encouraged to travel within our country during Tourism Month and to familiarise themselves on the importance of tourism to the economy.
tgt: UMphathiswa uDerek Hanekom uza kuphehlelela iNyanga yoKhenketho ngomhla wama-26 kweyeThupha kuMasango aseMaboneng, eRhawutini, phantsi komxholo othi: “UKhenketho luphucula Impilo yabantu”, elisukela kuSuku loKhenketho lweHlabathi (olungomhla wama-27 kweyoMsintsi) kwaye liza kugxila kwixabiso lezokhenketho kwintlalo, ezenkcubeko, ezopolitiko nakuqoqosho lweli lizwe.

src: National Arbor Week will be celebrated from 1 to 7 September under the theme: “Forests and People: Investing in a sustainable future”.
tgt: IVeki yeSizwe yoTyalo-mthi iza kubhiyozelwa ukusuka ngomhla woku-1 ukuya kowesi-7 kweyoMsintsi phantsi komxholo othi: “Abantu naMahlathi: Ukutyalela ikamva eliqaqambileyo”.

src: South Africans are encouraged to plant the identified trees for 2014, either the Vepris lanceolata (commonly known as: White Ironwood/ Witysterhout/ Muruvula/ Muhondwa/ umZane/ umOzana) or the Heteropyxis Natalensis Harvey (commonly known as: Lavender Tree/ Laventelboom/ iNkunzi).
tgt: Abemi boMzantsi Afrika bayakhuthazwa ukuba batyale i-Vepris lanceolata (ebizwa ngokuba nguMzane) okanye i-Heteropyxis Natalensis Harvey (ebizwa ngokuba yiNkunzi), eyimithi ekhethiweyo kulo nyaka wama-2014.ISebe lezoLimo, amaHlathi nezokuLoba (i-DAFF), lisebenzisana nezokusiNgqongileyo noLawulo loLonwabo kunye nabakwa-Total South Africa, liza kubamba ukhuphiswano leMbasa yesiXeko yoTyalo-mithi leSizwe.

src: The purpose is to encourage Local Municipalities to green their areas of jurisdiction.
tgt: Injongo yoku kukukhuthaza ooMasipala baseMakhaya ukuba batyale uhlaza kwimimandla yabo.

src: National Arbor Week and the National Arbor City Award is conducted in line with the DAFF greening strategy which defines greening as an integrated approach to the planting, care and management of all vegetation in urban and rural areas.
tgt: IVeki yeSizwe yoTyalo-mithi kunye neMbasa yesiXeko yoTyalo-mithi leSizwe ziqhutywa ngokwesicwangciso-qhinga se-DAFF sokutyala uhlaza esichaza utyalo lohlaza njengendlela edityanisiweyo kutyalo-mithi, ukukhathalela nolawulo lwalo lonke uhlaza ezidolophini nasemaphandleni.

src: Appointments	Cabinet approved the following appointments:Mr Themba Stanley Kojana as Deputy Director-General: Teachers, Human Resource and Institutional Development, in the Department of Basic WEBTOKEN Clifford Abraham Appel as Chief Financial Officer at the Department of Social Development.
tgt: IzikhundlaIkhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuqeshwa kwaba balandelayo:UMnu Themba Stanley Kojana njengeSekela Mlawuli-Jikelele: OoTitshala, Abasebenzi kunye noPhuhliso lweZiko, kwiSebe leMfundo esiSiseko.

src: Cabinet concurred with the following appointments to serve as members of the National Public Transport Regulator:a) Mr Lesedi Dinte, andb) Ms Divhani Edzisani Tshivhase.
tgt: UMnu Clifford Abraham Appel njengeGosa eliPhezulu lezeziMali kwiSebe loPhuhliso loLuntu.

src: c) ProfNtombizozuko Dyani-MhangoCabinet approved the appointment of Semira Mohammed as a Non-Executive Member to the Board of the Cross-Border Road Transport Agency.
tgt: IKhabinethi nayo iyakuvuma ukuqeshwa kwaba balandelayo njengamalungu oMlawuli weSizwe weziThuthi zikaWonke-wonkea) UMnu Lesedi Dinte,b) UNksz Divhani Edzisani Tshivhase.

src: Implementation of Key Government Programmes.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweNkqubo eziNgundo zikaRhulumente.

src: Cabinet welcomes the official opening by President Zuma of the Dr Harry Surtie Hospital in Upington, Northern Cape, on 2 September 2014.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuvulwa ngokusesikweni nguMongameli uJacob Zuma kwesiBhedlele i-Dr Harry Surtie e-Upington, eMntla Koloni, ngomhla wesibini kweyoMsintsi kowama-2014.

src: This comes four days after another new hospital was opened by Minister of Health Dr Aaron Motsoaledi in Natalspruit, Gauteng.
tgt: Oku kwenzeke kwintsuku ezine emva kokuba esinye isibhedlele esitsha sivulwe nguMphathiswa wezeMpilo uGq.

src: These are amongst many important milestones in government’s national infrastructure programme which will see 43 hospitals and 213 clinics built over the next five years to meet the needs of the National Health Insurance system.
tgt: Le yeminye yemisebenzi ebalulekileyo kwinkqubo yesizwe karhulumente yeziseko ezingundoqo eza kukhokelela ukuba kwakhiwe izibhedlele ezingama-43 neekliniki ezingama-213 kule minyaka mihlanu izayo ukuze kwaneziswe iimfuno zenkqubo ye-Inshorensi yezeMpilo yeSizwe.2 IKhabhinethi ikuqhwabela izandla ukubanjwa nokuthinjwa ngephulo iProject Darling kunye nokubanjwa kwemigulukudu ekrokrelwa ngokuqweqedisa iiloli.

src: Cabinet commends the recent arrests and seizures under Project Darling and the arrest of a gang suspected of truck hijackings.
tgt: Iphulo iProject Darling likhokelele ukuba kufunywana iidayimani ezingekho mthethweni kunye nokuthathwa kwempahla exabisa izigidi ezingama-R50, izindlu ezili-15 kunye nemali yangaphandle ezizigidi ezingama-R. Ekupheleni kwale nyanga amapolisa aza kukhupha iinkcukacha-mani zolwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Project Darling resulted in the recovery of illegal diamonds and the seizure of R50 million in assets, 15 homes and R43 million in foreign currency.
tgt: La manani asekelwe kumanani okwenene amatyala amangalelwe emaPoliseni, kwaye aza kubonakalisa amaphulo abe yimpumelelo kunye nemingeni.

src: The publication of these figures allows us to engage in informed discussion on how to strengthen the partnerships with society around government’s comprehensive anti-crime strategic interventions.
tgt: Ukupapashwa kwala manani kuza kusinceda ukuba sikwazi ukuba sixoxe ngento esiyaziyo ngendlela zokuqinisa intsebenziswano esinayo noluntu malunga nephulo likarhulumente elibanzi lokulwa nolwaphulo-mthetho.

src: For the country to be successful in fighting crime, Cabinet urges communities to play their part in reporting crime and supporting community safety forums as the fight against crime calls for community-wide effort.
tgt: Ukuze eli lizwe lilwe ulwaphulo-mthetho ngempumelelo, iKhabhinethi icela uluntu ukuba nalo ludlale eyalo indima ngokuxela izenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho nokuxhasa imibutho yasekuhlaleni elwa nolwaphulo-mthetho njengokuba idabi lokulwa ulwaphulo lifuna kuphume wonke ubani ekuhlaleni.

src: Government condemns the brutal attacks we have seen against members of the South African Police Services while on duty.
tgt: Urhulumente uyazigxeka izenzo zokuhlasela ngolunya amalungu abeNkonzo yobuPolisa yoMzantsi Afrika besemsebenzini.

src: On Sunday, 7 September 2014 government will honour and pay tribute to these police officers who lost their lives in the line of duty.
tgt: NgeCawe, umhla wesi-7 kweyoMsintsi ngowama-2014 urhulumente uza kuhlonipha unike nembeko kula mapolisa aphulukene nobomi bawo esemsebenzini.

src: Cabinet invites the nation to pay tribute these officers who died while trying to enforce the law.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela isizwe ukuba naso sibonise imbeko kula mapolisa awe esemsebenzini ezama ukugcina umthetho.3 IKhabhinethi iyakwamkelwa ukwaziswa kweziko elixabisa iibhiliyoni ezi-R2 lokufuya ezaselwandle kuMmandla woPhuhliso lwamaShishini oseNgqurha eMpuma Koloni elibekele bucala iihektara ezingama-80 ukulungiselela ukukhulisa amangquba ngowama-2020 ize idale imisebenzi esisigxina engama-2 080.

src: This project is part of Operation Phakisa that seeks to unlock the economic potential of South Africa’s oceans.
tgt: Le projekthi iyinxalenye ye-Operation Phakisa enjongo zayo ikukukhangela ubutyebi obunokufunyanwa kwiilwandle zoMzantsi Afrika.

src: The project has a potential to contribute in the economy by about R177 billion and create up to one million jobs by 2033.
tgt: Le projekthi inakho ukugalela iibhiliyoni ezili-R177 kuqoqosho ize idale imisebenzi enokufika kwisigidi ngowama-2033.

src: Cabinet encourages more investors to partner with Government in new economic growth opportunities.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela nabanye abatyali-zimali ukuba bankampane noRhulumente kula mathuba matsha ohlumo loqoqosho.4 IKhabhinethi iyakubulela ubukho begqiza leengcaphephe zoogqirha loMzantsi Afrika kumazwe eziseNtshona ye-Afrika iGuinea, iSierra Leone kunye neLiberia ezincedisa kwidabi lokulwa nokunwenwa kweNtsholongwane i-Ebola.

src: Cabinet appreciates the presence of a team of South African medical experts in the West African States of Guinea, Sierra Leone, and Liberia who are helping to fight the spread of the Ebola Virus.
tgt: Eli gqiza leengcaphephe ezizingcungela linelebhu engumahamba-nandlwana kwaye oko bephaya kweziveki zidlulileyo zimbini (ezi-2) bencedisa kwiphulo lokuxilonga nokubona esi sifo kuwo wonke la Mmandla.5 IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukusungulwa kweSigaba 1A, seprojekthi ebizwa i-Pongolapoort Bulk Water Supply.

src: This team of highly trained specialists is equipped with a mobile laboratory and has been there for the past two (2) weeks assisting to diagnose the disease throughout that Region.
tgt: Le projekthi kuqikelelelwa ukuba iza kuxabisa ibhiliyoni e-R1,5 iza kukhokelela ukuba kunikezelwe ngamanzi aselwayo nokufakelwa kobuxhaka-xhaka bokucoca nokugcina amanzi asisixa ukulungiselela abantu abangama-134 864 kumakhaya angama-16 200.

src: The project will bring water to the community of Jozini Local Municipality, in KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Le projekthi iza kuzisela amanzi uluntu loMasipala waseJozini, KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Cabinet approved the release of the draft Integrated Urban Development Framework for consultation with key stakeholders and for intergovernmental interaction.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi ezingundoqo.1 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukukhutshwa kwesiCwangciso-sikhokelo esiHlanganisiweyo soPhuhliso lweDolophi esiseluyilo esiza kusetyenziselwa ukufakana indlebe namahlakani aphambili kunye nokwenzela intsebenziswa entle phakathi kwamaqoqo karhulumente.

src: This will seek consensus on the agenda for urban transformation in South Africa.
tgt: Oku kuza kunceda ukuba kuvisiswane ngomba weenguqu kwiidolophi zoMzantsi Afrika.

src: The Framework responds to President Jacob Zuma’s calls for a national integrated urban development framework to deal with the legacy of apartheid spatial patterns and to assist municipalities to effectively manage rapid urbanisation.
tgt: Esi siCwangciso-sikhokelo sisabela kwikhwelo likaMongameli uJacob Zuma sokuba makubekho isicwangciso-sikhokelo sesizwe esihlanganisiweyo sophuhliso lweedolophi ukuze kuliwe nomonakalo owenziwa ngurhulumente wocalucalulo owakha iidolophi ngokocalucalulo kunye nokunceda oomasipala bakwazi ukumelana ngokokuko nombandela wokuthontelana kwabantu ezidolophini.

src: The vision of the Framework is to promote livable, inclusive and resilient cities and towns.
tgt: Umbono wesi siCwangciso-sikhokelo kukuba izixeko needolophi kuyaphileka kuzo, azicaluli mntu kwaye zakhiwe ngokufanelekileyo.

src: It will address the legacy of spatial separation on racial and economic bases and create a more integrated, cohesive cities and towns.
tgt: Esi siCwangciso siza kulungisa le ndlela igwenxa kwakusakhiwa ngayo iidolophi yayicalula ngebala nangokufuma kweempokotho size sakhe izixeko needolophi ezinobumbano nezingacaluli bani.

src: Cabinet approved South Africa’s National Report on Housing and Urban Development which will be presented to the United Nation’s Conference (HABITAT III) in 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNgxelo yeSizwe ngezeZindlu noPhuhliso lweeDolophi eza kunikezelwa kwiNkomfa yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-Habitat III) ngowama-2016.

src: The first UN preparatory conference will be held on the 17th and 18th September 2014.
tgt: Inkomfa yeZizwe eziManyeneyo yokuqala yamalungiselelo iza kubanjwa ngomhla we-17 nowe-18 kweyoMsintsi ngowama-2014.

src: This report is expected to generate a ‘New Urban Agenda’ for the 21st century to deal with challenges confronting developing and developed countries, acknowledging the increasingly important role of cities in global issues such as climate change, disasters, economic development and human rights.
tgt: Le ngxelo kulindeleke ukuba izale i-Ajenda eNtsha yeeDolophi yenkulungwane yama-21 yokujongana nemingeni amazwe afumileyo nasakhulayo ajamelana nayo, yamkele indima eya isiba nkulu edlalwa zizixeko kwimiba edla ihlabathi efana nokutshintsha kwemozulu, iintlekele, uphuhliso loqoqosho kunye namalungelo oluntu.

src: Preparations for Habitat III come at a time when South Africa is developing its Integrated Urban Policy Framework and commencing preparations for our Green paper on Human Settlements.
tgt: Amalungiselelo e-Habitat III afika kanye ngexesha apho uMzantsi Afrika uxakekile ubhala isiCwangciso-sikhokelo soMgaqo-nkqubo oHlanganisiweyo sawo kwaye uqalisa ngamalungiselelo ePhepha logayo-zimvo lezokuHlaliswa koLuntu.3 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukusungulwa kwe-Arhente yokuLawula iiMpahla zeSizwe eza kujonga ulawulo lweempahla zikarhulumente.

src: Cabinet approved the establishment of the State Property Management Agency which will oversee the management of the government property.
tgt: Le arhente iza kuba liCandelo likaRhulumente eliphantsi kolawulo loMphathiswa weMisebenzi kaRhulumente.

src: This will be a Government Component entity under the custodianship of the Minister of Public Works.
tgt: UMphathiswa uNxesi uza kunika iinkcukacha ezithe vetshe ngalo umba.4 IKhabhinethi iwamkele uMgaqo-nkqubo olungisiweyo wokuqeshwa kwabaSebenzi bokuBhangisa eza kupapashwa ngesaziso kwiPhephandaba lakwaRhulumente.

src: The focus of the Policy is to promote consistency, fairness, transparency and the achievement of equality for persons previously disadvantaged by unfair discrimination.
tgt: Lo Mgaqo-nkqubo ujolise ekukhuthazeni ukungaqu-guquki, ubulungisa, nokudandalazisa elubala kunye nokuphumeza ulingwano kubantu ababehlelelekile ngaphambili ngokucalu-calulwa ngolunya.

src: The biggest change that is being introduced by the amendment is the removal of the system called Requisition with a view to advance transformation.
tgt: Olona tshintsho lukhulu luza nesi silungiso kukususwa kwenkqubo ebizwa ngokuba kukufaka iBango ngeenjongo zokuqhubela phambili neenguqu.

src: The policy will only apply to appointments made in terms of the Insolvency Act, the Companies Act and the Close Corporations Act.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo uza kusetyenziswa kuphela kwabo baqeshwe ngokoMthetho wokuBhangisa, uMthetho weeNkampani kunye noMthetho wamaQumrhu aQingqiweyo.

src: Cabinet approved that the Expropriation Bill, 2014 be tabled in Parliament.
tgt: ImiThetho esaYilwayo.1 IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba uMthetho osaYilwayo wokuThathwa koMhlaba, wowama-2014 uthiwe thaca ePalamente.

src: The Expropriation Act, 1975 predates the Constitution, 1996 making it imperative to align the overarching legislation governing the expropriation of property to the values and provisions of the Constitution.
tgt: UMthetho wokuThathwa koMhlaba wowama-1975 ngowaphambi koMgaqo-siseko wowama-1996 oko kwenze ukuba kufuneke kulungelelwaniswe imithetho ephambili elawula ukuthathwa komhlaba ngokwemimiselo nezibonelelo zoMgaqo-siseko.

src: Minister Nxesi will expand more on this issue.
tgt: UMphathiswa uNxesi uza kunika iinkcukacha ezithe vetshe ngalo umba.

src: Cabinet is encouraged by the positive economic growth recorded in the second quarter of the year in spite of difficult economic conditions in the country and abroad.
tgt: ULuvo lweKhabhinethi kwiMiba eGqubayo.1 IKhabhinethi iyakhuthazwa luhlumo oluncumisayo kuqoqosho kwikota yesibini yonyaka phantsi kweemeko zoqoqosho ezinzima kweli lizwe nakwihlabathi.

src: The pace of economic expansion remains too weak to address our challenges of poverty, inequality and unemployment.
tgt: Isantya sokukhula kokoqoqosho sisephantsi ukuba singamelana nemingeni yendlala, ukungalingani kunye nentswela-misebenzi.

src: Government is fast-tracking the implementation of the National Development Plan to address our structural challenges, increase permanently our growth potential and create jobs for our people.
tgt: Urhulumente uyakukhawulezisa ukufezekiswa kwesiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe ukukwazi ukulwa neengxaki ezondeleyo, lunyuse isantya esinokuhluma ngaso ngokusisigxina kudaleke nemisebenzi yabantu bakuthi.

src: In this regard, our investment in infrastructure – electricity, transport, water, roads, schools and hospitals - builds a platform for faster, more inclusive economic growth.
tgt: Malunga noku, iimali esizigalela kwiziseko ezingundoqo – umbane, ezothutho, amanzi, iindlela, izikolo nezibhedlele - zisisakhelo soqoqosho oluhluma ngokukhawuleza, nolubandakanya wonke ngakumbi.

src: The annual volume of capital investment by public enterprises has increased by more than 260 per cent in real terms over the past 10 years.
tgt: Umthamo wonyaka wemali etyalwa kwiiprojekthi ezinkulu lisebe lamashishini karhulumente unyuke ngaphezu kwama-260% ngokokwenyani kule minyaka ilishumi edlulileyo.

src: Local government’s annual infrastructure spending has doubled in real terms since the late 1990s.
tgt: Inkcitho yonyaka yoomasipala basemakhaya kwiziseko ezingundoqo ikhule ngokuphindwe kabini ngokokwenyani ukususela ekupheleni kweminyaka yeyawama-1990.

src: The public sector has invested over R1 trillion in infrastructure since 2009/10.
tgt: Urhulumente sele egalele imali engaphaya kwetriliyoni zeerandi kwiziseko ezingundoqo ukusukela ngowama-2009 nowama-2010.

src: We expect that growth in the second half of the year will be stronger as the mining and manufacturing sectors recover.
tgt: Silindele ukuba uhlumo kwisiqingatha sesibini sonyaka luza kuncumisa njengoko icandelo lemigodi nelezemveliso zibuyela kwimeko yesiqhelo.

src: And government will continue to work with business and labour to create an environment, which is conducive to investment and economic growth.
tgt: Kwaye urhulumente uza kuqhubekeka esebenzisana namashishini nemibutho yabasebenzi ukudala iimeko ezifanelekileyo zotyalo-mali nohlumo loqoqosho.2 IKhabhinethi iyazikhalimela izenzo neentetho zakutsha nje zokudala uqhushululu nto leyo ingahambisaniyo nomoya womgaqo-siseko kwaye inokusibuyisela emva sisizwe.

src: The recent spate of the vandalising of buses in the Western Cape is also condemned in the strongest terms.
tgt: Lo mkhwa mtsha wokutshiswa kweebhasi eNtshona Koloni nawo ugxekwa kabukhali.

src: Cabinet commends parents who took it upon themselves to ensure that children go back to school in the Northern Cape.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibothulela umnqwazi abazali abazixeleleyo ukuba bazakungenelela baqinisekise ukuba abantwana bayaya esikolweni eMntla Koloni.

src: Cabinet thanks parents for intervening on the future of their children and appeals that the interest of the children should never again be compromised or be used to bargain for community issues.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibamba ngazibini kubazali abathe bangenelela befuna ukuqinisekisa ukuba ikamva labantwana babo aliphazanyiswa kwaye ikwabongoza ukuba amalungelo abantwana angaze aphinde anyhashwe kwakhona okanye abantwana basetyenziswe kumadabi okuhlala.

src: Cabinet encourages South Africans to safeguard the country’s reputation on its ability to engage in constructive dialogue and to resolve issues irrespective of who is involved so as to move South Africa Forward.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabamemelela abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba balihloniphe igama leli lizwe lokukwazi ukuhlala etafileni kuboniswane ngendlela eyakhayo nokusombulula iimbambano nokuba zezikabani na ngolo hlobo siqhubuele uMzantsi Afrika Phambili.

src: Cabinet welcomes the decisive actions by the SADC organ on Peace and Security in the recent Lesotho political crises and reiterates its unconditional support for the SADC position that rejects all attempts to unconstitutional changes of government.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawamkela amanyathelo angqongqo athathwe licandelo loXolo noKhuseleko le-SADC kwizixholo-xholo zopolitiko zakutsha nje eLesotho kwaye iyakubethelela kwakhona ukuba iluxhasa ngokungagungqiyo uluvo lwe-SADC lokuzikhaba ngawo omane iinzame zokutshintsha umbuso ngokungekho mthethweni.

src: Cabinet therefore calls on all role players to work together to restore democratic order in Lesotho and fully implement the Road Map agreed with the SADC organ.
tgt: Ke ngoko iKhabhinethi imelelela bonke abachaphazelekayo ukuba basebenzisane ukubuyisela ulawulo lwentando yesininzi eLesotho kwaye ilandelwe imiqathango yesivumelwano necandelo le-SADC.4 IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukulahla emsebenzini kukaSihlalo weKomishini yoNyulo eziMeleyo, u-Advocate Pansy Tlakula.

src: Cabinet noted the resignation of the Chairperson of the Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), Advocate Pansy Tlakula.
tgt: Ukulahla kwakhe kulandela uNyulo lukaZwelonke lowama-2014 olaliyimpumelelo olalukhokelwe nguye.

src: Her resignation comes against the backdrop of a successful 2014 General Election which she managed.
tgt: Udlale indima enkulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuba ulawulo wentando yesininzi luluqilima.

src: Cabinet express its gratitude to the contribution made by Adv Tlakula and extends its thanks for her selfless contribution to our democracy and wishes her well.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalibulela igalelo elenziwe ngu-Advocate Tlakula kwaye iyambulela naye ngokuzinikela kumsebenzi wakhe wokuqinisa ulawulo lwentando yesininzi kwaye imnqwenelela okuhle kodwa.5 IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isigwebo esiwiswe yiNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko esingqina ukuba ulungile umgaqo-nkqubo karhulumente wokunikezelwa kwamathuba kwabo babehlelelekile.

src: Cabinet welcomes the judgment by the Constitutional Court which is an affirmation that the government’s affirmative action policy is correct.
tgt: Urhulumente umi akajiki kwinkqubo yakhe yokulungisa umonakalo wokungalingani ekuhlaleni ingakumbi emisebenzini.

src: Government remains steadfast in its programme to redress the social inequalities especially within the working environment.
tgt: Esi sigwebo sikwangqina nokuba okuyinenene inkqubo yokunika amathuba kwabo babahlelelekile ngaphambili kunye neminye imithetho yolungelelwaniso lwezengqesho ikhuthaza iinguqu kwaye ixhobisa abo babehlelelekile ngaphambili.

src: This ruling also confirms that indeed affirmative action together with other employment equity laws promote transformation and empower the previously disadvantaged.
tgt: Imisitho ezayo.1 ISebe lezeMfundo esiSiseko liza kuqhuba uHlolo loNyaka likaZwelonke (i-ANA) lesine ukusuka ngomhla we-16 ukuya kowe-19 kweyoMsintsi ngowama-2014 ukuvavanya indlela inkqubo yeziphumo zokufunda kubantwana abafunda kumaBanga eloku-1 ukuya kwele-6 kunye nabeBanga le-9 njengenxalenye yamalinge okuphucula umgangatho wemfundo.

src: The Department of Basic Education will conduct the fourth Annual National Assessments (ANA) from 16 to 19 September 2014 to track progress of learning outcomes among Grades 1 - 6 and Grade 9 as part of the efforts to improve the quality of education.
tgt: Kulo nyaka (wama-2014) iSebe lezeMfundo esiSiseko liza kuqalisa ngelinge lokuhlola abafundi abathile abakhethiweyo beBanga le-7 nele-8.

src: This year (2014) the Department of Basic Education will also pilot the assessment of a sample of learners in Grades 7 and 8 and the decision on this assessment will be taken in 2015.The ANA generates standardised evidence to monitor the success of various Government interventions to improve literacy and numeracy among learners and also enables teachers to identify areas that require additional support.
tgt: I-ANA isinika ubungqina obugcweleyo ukuze sikwazi ukulandelela sijonge ukusebenza ngempumelelo kwamanyathelo okungenela kaRhulumente okuphucula umgangatho wokukwazi ukufunda nokubhala kunye nezibalo kubafundi kwaye inceda nootitshala ukuba bazibone iindawo ezifuna ukugxininiswa ngakumbi.

src: Cabinet encourages parents and guardians to support their children and to ensure that the results are used to address any development areas.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abazali nabagcini-bantwana ukuba babancedise abantwana babo ukuze baqinisekise ukuba iziphumo zabo zingasetyenziswa ukujonga iindawo ababetheka kuzo abantwana.

src: The ANA timetable and resources for 2014 is on available on: WEBTOKEThe Minister of Rural Development and Land Reform Gugile Nkwinti will host the 2014 Land Tenure Summit at Birchwood Hotel and OR Tambo Conference Centre, Boksburg from 4 to 6 September 2014.
tgt: Imihla namaxesha okubhala e-ANA kunye nezixhobo eziza kufuneka ziyafumaneka kule webhusayithi: www.

src: Cabinet calls on South Africans to honour exceptional public servants or Government institutions by nominating them for the National Batho Pele Excellence Awards before the closing date of 30 September 2014.
tgt: za.2 UMphathiswa woPhuhliso lwamaPhandle noBuyekezo lweMihlaba uGugile Nkwinti uza kusingatha iNgqungquthela yoBunini boMhlaba yowama-2014 e-Birchwood Hotel nakwiZiko leeNkomfa i-OR Tambo, eBoksburg ukusuka ngomhla we-4 ukuya kowe-6 kweyoMsintsi ngowama-2014.

src: Heritage month is celebrated from 1 – 30 September 2014 under the theme “Celebrating 20 Years of Democracy: Tell Your Story that Moves South Africa Forward”.
tgt: Le Ngqungquthela iza kugxila kumanyathela neendlela zokujika zicime imisebenzi yeli lizwe yobukholoniyali nocalucalulo eyabangela ukuba ama-75% abantu abamnyama bazibone sebengenamihlaba, bengenazindlu, bengaxhotyiswanga ngazakhono benganawo namalungelo okuba nomhlaba ongowabo.

src: Cabinet encourages South Africans to celebrate our rich natural and cultural heritage, diverse beliefs and traditions as a people united in pursuit of a shared identity.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abachaphazelekayo ukuba basebenzisane noRhulumente baphumeze izivumelwano zokujongana nomba welungelo lokuba nomhlaba ongowakho.

src: This year’s Heritage Month takes place against the backdrop of our 20 Years of Freedom celebrations which also reinforces our collective memory of the struggle towards promoting a national identity.
tgt: Inkqubo yeNyanga yeeNkonzo zikaRhulumente ukusuka ngomhla woku-1 ukuya kowama-30 kweyoMsintsi kowama-2014 phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukutshintsha iNdlela abaSebenzi bakaRhulumente abaSebenza ngayo: Batho Pele “‘Khokelisa Abantu Phambili’”, iza kugxila kwiphulo lokuphucula nangakumbi indlela inkonzo ezihanjiswa ngayo ingakumbi ngabo basemehlweni abantu.

src: Cabinet encourages South Africans, in particular the youth to embrace South Africa's common heritage and use our diverse cultural heritage to foster nation building, inclusive citizenship and social cohesion.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika bahloniphe abo basebenzi bakarhulumente okanye amaziko kaRhulumente asebenze ngokuzinikela ngokungenisa amagama abo ukuze abe nokubandakanywa kwiMbasa zokuGqwesa zeSizwe zeBatho Pele phambi komhla wokuvala wama-30 kweyoMsintsi ngowama-20.4 Inyanga yamafa ibhiyozelwa ukusuka ngomhla woku-1 ukuya kowama-30 kweyoMsintsi ngowama-2014 phantsi komxholo othi “Ukubhiyozela imiNyaka engama-20 yoLawulo lweNtando yesininzi: Balisa iBali Lakho eliQhubela uMzantsi Afrika Phambili”.

src: Cabinet also supports the call by Parliament for all South Africans to protect our national heritage.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abemi boMzantsi Afrika, ingakumbi ulutsha ukuba luyamkele ngezandla ezishushu imbali yoMzantsi Afrika efanayo baze basebenzise amasiko ethu ahlukeneyo akhuthaze ukwakha isizwe, abemi abangabukulaniyo nemvano kuluntu.

src: Cabinet wishes the Bafana Bafana well ahead of the two crucial games against Sudan on 05 September in Khartoum which is a qualifier for next year’s continental showpiece and Nigeria on 10 September 2014 in Cape Town.
tgt: Abemi boMzantsi Afrika bayacelwa ukuba bonwabele ubutyebi nobuhle beli lizwe ngokundwendwela kwimiyezo yesizwe ekungenwa kuyo simahla ukusuka ngomhla we-8 ukuya kowe-12 kweyoMsintsi kowama-2014 njengenxalenye yeVeki yeMiyezo yeSizwe yoMzantsi Afrika (i-SANParks) yoNyaka yesiThoba.

src: Cabinet also congratulates Banyana Banyana and Amajita and wish them well ahead of the major tournaments they will be playing.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasixhasa naso isimemelelo sePalamente sokuba bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika bakhusele amafa esizwe sethu.5 IKhabhinethi inqwenelela aBafana Bafana okuhle kwimidlalo ebalulekileyo emibini ezayo abaza kuyidlala neSudan ngomhla we-5 kweyoMsintsi eKhartoum ongumdlalo wokuzibekela indawo kwimidlalo yokhuphiswano yeli lizwekazi kulo nyaka uzayo kunye nowe-Nigeria ngomhla we-10 kweyoMsintsi ngowama-2014 eKapa.

src: Banyana Banyana will be playing in the 9th edition of the African Women’s Championships which will be staged in Namibia during the month of October, and are also on the verge of qualifying for the 2015 FIFA Women’s World Cup in Canada.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwaqhwabela izandla aBanyana Banyana naMajita kwaye ibanqwelela okuhle phambi kweetumente ezinkulu abaza kuthatha inxaxheba kuzo.

src: While Amajita, the under 20 National team have qualified for the 2015 African champions in Senegal.
tgt: ABanyana Banyana baza kudlala kwimiDlalo yobuNtshatsheli yabaseTyhini yase-Afrika yesi-9 eza kubanjelwa eNamibia ngenyanga yeDwarha kwaye bakwasecicini lokufumana indawo kwiNdebe yeHlabathi yabaseTyhini ye-FIFA ngowama-2015 eCanada, wona Amajita, iqela lesizwe labaneminyaka engaphantsi kwama-20, sebeyifumene indawo yokudlala kwimidlalo yobuntshatsheli yase-Afrika ngowama-2015 eSenegal.

src: Cabinet urges South Africans to rally behind this teams in their quest for glory.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba baxhase la maqela njengoko esiya emadabini okulelwa ezi ndebe.

src: Cabinet welcomes participants from across the world who will be attending the 4th Kyokushin Karate World Cup tournament to be held on 6 September 2014 at the Luthuli International Convention Centre, Durban.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamnkela abo baza kuthatha inxaxheba besuka kwiimbombo zonke zomhlaba kwiTumente yeNdebe yeHlabathi yeKarate iKyokushin yesi-4 eza kubanjwa ngomhla we-6 kweyoMsintsi ngowama-2014 kwiZiko leNgqungquthela laMazwe ngamazwe iLuthuli, eThekwini.

src: The tournament will be officially opened by President Jacob Zuma and seeks to promote karate as a sport to the youth given its benefits in instilling self-discipline, self-defence, focus and also in promoting social crime prevention.
tgt: Le tumente iza kuvulwa ngokusesikweni nguMongameli uJacob Zuma kwaye injongo zayo kukukhuthaza ikarati njengohlobo lomdlalo wolutsha njengoko inceda ukukwenza isimilo, ukukwazi ukuzikhusela kwaye iza kunceda nakumaphulo okulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho.6 IKomishini yezoKhuphiswano iza kusingatha iNkomfa yoNyaka yesiBhozo neMbhiyozo weMinyaka eliShumi elinesiHlanu ukusuka ngomhla we-4 ukuya kowe-5 kweyoMsintsi kowama-2014.

src: The Competition Commission will convene the Eighth Annual Conference and Fifteen-Year Celebration from 4 – 5 September 2014.
tgt: Le nkomfa iza kuvulwa ngokusesikweni nguMphathiswa u-Ebrahim Patel amnkele abathunywa, kuquka nabo basuka kwi-arhente zezokhuphiswana kwi-Afrika iphela kunye ne-arhente enye yezokhuphiswano yengingqi, iKomishoni yezoKhuphiswano yeMimandla yoRhwebo eMinye yeMpuma namaZantsi e-Afrika.

src: The conference will be officially opened by Minister Ebrahim Patel welcoming delegates, including those from competition agencies around Africa and one regional competition agency, the Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa Competition Commission.
tgt: Izikhundla.1 IKhabhinethi iyavumelana nokuqeshwa kukaMnu Attwell Sibusiso Makhanya njengeGosa eliyiNtloko loLawulo loMhlathuze Water.

src: LesothoCabinet appreciated the initiative by President Zuma together with SADC to restore peace in Lesotho.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba egqubayo.1 ILesothoIKhabinethi iyawubulela umsebenzi kaMongameli Zuma ebambisene neCandelo loPhuhliso lwaMazwe e-Afrika eseMazantsi (i-SADC) wokuzama ukubiyisela uxolo eLesotho.

src: Cabinet supports the recent Summit’s resolutions which mandated the Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa, The Honourable Cyril Ramaphosa, supported by the Secretariat and a team of experts from Troika Member States, to act as SADC Facilitator to the Kingdom of Lesotho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazixhasa izigqibo zeNgqungquthela yakutsha nje eye yagunyazisa uSekela Mongameli weRiphablikhi yoMzantsi Afrika, oHloniphekileyo uCyril Ramaphosa, encediswa liQumrhu loLawulo kunye neqela leengcali eziphuma kuMazwe angaMalungu e-Troika, asebenze njengoMququzeleli we-SADC kwiLizwe laseLesotho.

src: The Deputy President, Secretariat and experts have clear Terms of Reference to facilitate the restoration of political and security stability in the Kingdom of Lesotho, in the short and long term.
tgt: USekela Mongameli, iQumrhu loLawulo kunye neengcali baneMiqathango yokuSebenza ecacileyo yokuququzelela iinzame zokubuyisela uzinzo lwezopolitiko nezokhuseleko kwiLizwe laseLesotho, kwixesha elifutshane nelide.2 Umboniso weenkampani zoMzantsi Afrika eRussiaIKhabhinethi iqhwabela izandla iinkampani zoMzantsi Afrika eziwongwe ngokuba nowona mboniso ugqwesileyo kumboniso i-World Food Show eMoscow.

src: South African companies exhibition in RussiaCabinet congratulates the South African companies that were awarded the best standing at the World Food Show in Moscow.
tgt: Zisebenzisana neSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino, Iimveliso zoKutya zalapha eMzantsi Afriika zithandiwe ngabarhwebi boKutya baseRussia abathenga ukutya okuveliswe kumazwe angaphandle.

src: Working with the Department of Trade and Industry South Africa’s local Food Products have been well received amongst Russian Food importers.
tgt: Eli wonga lehlabathi lifika kanye emva kokuba uMongameli uZuma ebetyelele kwiRiphablikhi yaseRussia kutsha nje.

src: This year 3 000 exhibitors showcased their produce.
tgt: Kulo nyaka bangama-3 000 abashishina ngokutya ebebonisa ngeemveliso zabo.

src: Under the Export Marketing and Investment Assistance (EMIA) scheme, 21 South African companies showcased the agro processing sector.
tgt: Iinkampani zoMzantsi Afrika ezingama-21, zixhaswa ngeNgxowa-mali yokuThengisa Abashishina naMazwe angaPhandle noTyalo-mali (i-EMIA), bezibonisa ngemisebenzi yecandelo lokucolwa nokusetyenzwa kweemveliso zolimo.3 Ukhuphiswano lwezincoko ngoNat Nakasa nosele sikuzuzile ngeNkululeko noLawulo lweNtando yesininziIKhabhinethi ibothulela umnqwazi abaphumelele ukhuphiswano lokuqala lwezincoko ebezingobomi bukaNat Nakasa, intatheli eyaziwayo amathambo ayo abuyiselwa ekhaya eMzantsi Afrika emva kweminyaka engama-50 ngomhla we-19 kweyeThupha ngowama-2014.

src: Essay competition on Nat Nakasa and Freedom and Democracy achievements Cabinet congratulates the winners of the inaugural essay competition on the life of Nat Nakasa, a prominent journalist whose remains returned to South Africa after fifty years on 19 August 2014.
tgt: Eli phulo leSebe lezobuGcisa neNkcubeko likhumbuza ulutsha lwakuthi ngomzabalazo wenkululeko kwaye lilubalisela ngembali yokubhala nobuntatheli eMzantsi Afrika.

src: This initiative by the Department of Arts and Culture reminds our young generation about our struggle for freedom and exposes them to the history of writing and journalism in South Africa.
tgt: Abafundi abafundela ubuntatheli, uSbongakonke Mbatha, uQiniso Mbili noNkamogeleng Lebeloane, emnye kubo, baphumelela ithuba lokufunda beqeqeshwa kunye nekhompyutha ephathwayo, i-laptop.

src: The journalism students Sbongakonke Mbatha, Qiniso Mbili and Nkamogeleng Lebeloane each won an internship placement and a laptop.
tgt: Olunye uhlobo lokhuphiswano ibiyingxoxo-mpikiswano yabafundi apho bebexovula umgama osele uhanjiwe ngeNkululeko noLawulo lweNtando yesininzi.

src: Another category was the learners’ debate which reflected on the achievements attained through Freedom and Democracy.
tgt: Iinjongo zolu khuphiswano ziquka ukufundisa ngendima yeentatheli ngethuba kusiliwa umzabalazo wenkululeko eMzantsi Afrika.

src: The winners Mfundo Radebe, Dumisa Nzama, Danielle Dallas, Olivia Habonimana, Faith Marthinussen and Cebisa Ncube each won a laptop.
tgt: Abaphumelelayo uMfundo Radebe, uDumisa Nzama, uDanielle Dallas, u-Olivia Habonimana, uFaith Marthinussen noCebisa Ncube bafumana ikhompyutha ephathwayo, i-laptop, emnye kubo.
