src: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.
tgt: IzikhundlaUkuqeshwa kuzo zonke izikhundla kuxhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwezifundo nokuba msulwa okufaneleyo.1 IBhodi yeLepelle Northern Watera) Obekekileyo uThovhele Tshivhase (USihlalo)b) UMnu.

src: Lepelle Northern Water Board:a) His Majesty Thovhele Tshivhase (Chairperson)b) Mr Matsebe Ivor Phasha (Deputy Chairperson)c) Ms Thandeka Thembekile Celiwe Hlongwa (member)d) Mr Boxing Phillemon Sebola (member)e) Mr Ntale Herold Matsepe (member)f) Ms Mankone Mabataung Ntsaba (member)g) Ms L Malamba (member)h) Ms Josephine Mampheri Letsoalo (member) andi) Ms Makgetsi Annabelle Mphahlele (member).
tgt: Matsebe Ivor Phasha (uSekela-sihlao)c) UMnu.

src: Implementation of key government programmes.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.

src: Cabinet welcomed the 2016 Budget Speech delivered by Finance Minister Pravin Gordhan on 24 February 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNtetho yoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali yowama-2016 ethe yenziwa nguMphathiswa wezeMali uPravin Gordhan ngomhla wama-24 kweyoMdumba yama-2016.

src: This budget demonstrates our resilience, commitment and resourcefulness as we navigate through this worst economic period in recent history.
tgt: Olu hlahlo lwabiwo-mali lubonakalisa ukomelela, ukuzinikela nokuba nobuchule njengoko sichankcatha kwelona xesha lakhe lanzima kwezoqoqosho ezimbalini.

src: The budget responds to what the country needs and creates confidence in the economy by placing the country on a credible, sustainable and viable inclusive economic growth path.
tgt: Olu hlahlo lwabiwo-mali luhlangabezana noko eli lizwe likudingayo kwaye lukwadala intembeko kwezoqoqosho ngokubeka eli lizwe kwindlela yohlumo lwezoqoqosho ethembakeleyo, ezinzileyo nedibene ngokuphilisayo.

src: Cabinet further welcomes the decisive cost-containment measures and commits to working together with all sectors in contributing towards a collective national effort to implement the course set by the budget.
tgt: Kwakhona iKhabhinethi iyawamkela amanyathelo abalulekileyo okugcina iindleko ziphantsi kwemo elawulekayo kwaye ikwazibophelela ekusebenzisaneni nawo onke amacandelo ekwenzeni igalelo kwilinge elidibeneyo lesizwe ukuphumeza umlima-ndlela omiselwe luhlahlo lwabiwo-mali.

src: Cabinet welcomes the launch of the Presidential Press Corps (PPC) by President Jacob Zuma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukumiselwa kweQela looNondaba likaMongameli (i-PPC) nguMongameli uJacob Zuma.

src: The PPC will comprise political editors, political correspondents, political reporters and economics journalists who have been accredited to cover The Presidency on a full-time and ongoing basis.
tgt: I-PPC izakuquka abahleli bezopolitiko, iintatheli zezopolitiko, oonondaba bezopolitiko neentatheli zezoqoqosho eziqinisekisiweyo ukuba zizo ezinegunya lokukhupha ingxelo nge-Ofisi kaMongameli ngokupheleleyo zihlale zisenza njalo rhoqo.

src: The purpose of the PPC is to provide improved access to information by the media.
tgt: Injongo ye-PPC kukubonelela amajelo eendaba ngokufikelela okuphuculiweyo kulwazi.

src: It will also improve access by the media to the President and The Presidency, in order to ensure that journalists also obtain background information and processes to enhance their understanding and reporting.
tgt: Iza kuphucula ukufikelela kwamajelo eendaba kuMongameli ne-Ofisi kaMongameli, khona ukuze iqinisekise ukuba iintatheli nazo zifumana ulwazi neenkqubo ezizeleyo ukuze kuphucuke indlela ababhala kunye nabazikhupha ngayo iindaba.

src: The press core members will also receive briefings from the Deputy President and any Minister that the President invites to share programmes of national importance.
tgt: Amalungu eliqelaloonondaba aza kuthatha inxaxheba kwiitlanganiso noSekela-Mongameli okanye nawuphi na uMphathiswa omenyiweyo nguMongameli ukuba babelane ngeenkqubo ezibalulekileyo kwisizwe.

src: Cabinet has expressed appreciation of the contribution that South Africa has made towards restoring peace in Burundi, in line with our foreign policy commitments to ensure a peaceful and stable WEBTOKEN further welcomed the outcomes of the inclusive Inter-Burundian Dialogue held during the visit by the African Union (AU) high-level delegation of Heads of State and Government to Bujumbura in Burundi, which was led by President Zuma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilincomile igalelo elenziwe nguMzantsi Afrika ekubuyiseleni uxolo eBurundi, ngokuhambelana nesibophelelo somgaqo-nkqubo wethu wezangaphandle ukuqinisekisa uxolo nozinzo kweli lizwekazi.

src: Cabinet welcomes the appointment of President Zuma by the United Nations (UN) Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon, to co-chair a High-Level Commission on Health Employment and Economic Growth with President François Hollande of the Republic of France.
tgt: Kwakhona izamkele iziphumo zoThethathethwano oluquka bonke abemi baseBurundi obelubanjwe ngethuba igqiza eliphezulu leeNtloko zemiBuso nooRhulumente leMbumba yase-Afrika (i-AU), ebelikhokelwa nguMongameli uZuma, belityelele eBujumbura eBurundi.

src: This is not the first time that President Zuma has been appointed by a world body to undertake work at a global stage.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuchongwa kukaMongameli uZuma nguNobhala Jikelele weZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) uBan Ki-moon, ukuba abe ngusihlalo wesibini kwiKhomishini ePhezulu yeNgqesho kwezeMpilo noHlumo lwezoQoqosho ebambisene noMongameli u-François Hollande weRhiphabliki yaseFrance.

src: This appointment is in recognition of the sterling leadership displayed by our President in the international arena.
tgt: Asikuko okokuqala ukuba uMongameli uZuma achongwe ngumbutho wehlabathi ukuba enze umsebenzi kwimibutho yehlabathi.

src: The commission will stimulate the creation of new employment opportunities in the health sector across all countries, especially in least developed ones.
tgt: Le khomishini iza kuvuselela ukudalwa kwamathuba amatsha emisebenzi kwicandelo lezempilo kuwo onke amazwe jikelele, ingakumbi kulawo aphuhliswe kancinci.

src: This also strengthens the implementation of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, which will go a long way to addressing the triple challenge of unemployment, poverty and inequality.
tgt: Oku komeleza nokuphunyezwa kwe-Ajenda yoPhuhliso oluZinzileyo yowama-2030, eza kunceda kakhulu ukuhlangabezana nemingeni entlantlu-ntathu yentswela-ngqesho, indlala nokungalingani.

src: Cabinet welcomes the launch of the 2016 National Community Survey in Mamelodi, Pretoria by the Minister in The Presidency Jeff Radebe and the Statistician-General Pali Lehohla.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukumiselwa koPhando lweSizwe loLuntu lowama-2016 eMamelodi ePitoli nguMphathiswa kwi-Ofisi kaMongameli uJeff Radebe noSonkcukhacha-manani Jikelele uPali Lehohla.

src: This year’s survey is being undertaken under the theme: “The South African I know, the home I understand” and is targeting more than 1,5 million households – the biggest so far compared to the one held five years ago that sampled only 300 000 households.
tgt: Uhlolo lwalo nyaka lwenziwa phantsi komxholo othi: “UMzantsi Afrika endiwaziyo, ikhaya endiliqondayo” kwaye lujongiswe kwimizi engaphezu kwe-1,5 sezigidi – lilolona lukhulu ukuza kutsho ngoku xa luthelekiswa nolo lwalwenziwe kwiminyaka emihlanu edlulileyo elafikelela nje kwimizi engaphezulu kwama-300 000.

src: The survey will be undertaken in April and the results made available by the end of June 2016.
tgt: Olu hlolo luza kwenziwe kwinyaga kaTshazimpuzi zize iziphumo zifumaneke ekupheleni kweyeSilimela yowama-2016.

src: Cabinet notes with concern the report presented by the World Health Organisation and the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development to the Health Market Enquiry headed by Justice Sandile Ngcobo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele ngenkxalabo ingxelo enikzelwe nguMbutho wezeMpilo weHlabathi kunye noMbutho weNtsebenziswano noPhuhliso lwezoQoqosho kuPhando lweCandelo llezeMpilo olukhokelwa yiJaji uSandile Ngcobo.

src: The reports indicate that South Africa provides the most expensive medical services when compared with other countries.
tgt: Le ngxelo ibonisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ubonelela ngezona nkonzo zezonyango zibiza kakhulu xa uthelekiswa namanye amazwe.

src: Cabinet will await the conclusion of the enquiry before pronouncing on this matter.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iza kulinda kuqukunjelwe olu phando phambi kokuba iphefumle ngalo mba.

src: Key Cabinet decisions.
tgt: Izigqibo ezingundoqo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Cabinet approved the publication of the Draft Strategy for Addressing Air Pollution in Dense Low-Income Communities of South Africa for public comment.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukupapashwakweDrafti yesiCwangciso-qhinga sokuLwa iNgxaki yoNgcoliseko loMoya kwiiNdawo eziXineneyo Ezihlala Abantu abaMkela iMivuzo ePhantsi eMzantsi Afrika ukwenzela uluntu ukuba luhlomle.

src: The strategy seeks to provide a dedicated focused approach to deal with high levels of pollution in some of the densely populated low-income communities.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sigxile ekuboneleleni ngendlela egxile ekuzinikeleni ukusebenza ngezinga eliphezulu longcoliseko kolunye loluntu oluhlala kwiindawo ezixineneyo nolwamkela imivuzo ephantsi.

src: It provides a coordinated approach to the implementation of efforts to reduce domestic fuel burning.
tgt: Sibonelela ngendlela elungeleleneyo ekuphumezeni amalinge okunciphisa ukuvutha kwezibaso emakhayeni.

src: The intervention is to ensure these areas comply with the National Ambient Air Quality Standards.
tgt: Olu ngenelelo lelokuqinisekisa ukuba le mimandla iyathobelana neMimiselo yoMgangatho weziRhangqo yeSizwe.

src: This focused strategy will support the existing national strategy to address air pollution in the country.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sigxilileyo siza kuxhasa isicwangciso-qhinga sesizwe esikhoyo ukuhlangabezana nongcoliseko lomoya kweli lizwe.

src: Cabinet approved the co-hosting of the 21st International AIDS Conference (AIDS 2016) between government and the International AIDS Society at the International Convention Centre (ICC) in Durban from 18 to 22 July 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuba urhulumente abe lelinye lamahlakani aza kusingatha iNgqungquthela yeZizwe-ngezizwe kaGawulayo yama-21 (i-AIDS 2016) ndawonye noNombutho eHlabathi kaGawulayo kwiZiko leNgqungquthela yeZizwe ngezizwe (i-ICC) eDurban ukususela ngomhla we-18 ukuya kowama-22 kweyeKhala yowama-2016.

src: Hosting the conference will advance our country’s HIV and tuberculosis response whilst impacting on one of the most important challenges in South Africa, the region and the world.
tgt: Ukusingatha le ngqungquthela kuza kuqhubela phambili indlela ilizwe lethu elihlangabezana ngayo neeNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (i-HIV) nesifo sephepha (i-TB) ngeli xesha kwangaxesha nye lisenza impembelelo komnye weyona mingeni iyeyona ibalulekileyo eMzantsi Afrika, kummandla welizwekazi nakwihlabathi.

src: This conference will provide a platform for researchers from across the world to share the latest scientific advances in the field, to learn from one another’s expertise and to develop strategies for advancing all facets of our collective efforts to treat and prevent HIBill.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela iza kubonelela abaphandi abavela kwiinkalo zonke zehlabathi ngeqonga lokwabelana ngeenkqubo zobunzululwazi zala maxesha kweli candelo, ukufunda kubuchule bomnye nomnye nokuphuhlisa ubuchule bokuqhubela phambili onke amacala kumalinge wethu ahlangeneyo okunyanga nokuthintela i-HIUmthetho oYilwayo.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the National Land Transport Amendment Bill of 2015 to Parliament, which amends the National Land Transport Act, 2009 (Act 5 of 2009).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukungeniswa koMthetho-siHlomelo wezoThutho zaseMhlabeni weSizwe wama-2015 ePalamente, ohlomela uMthetho wezoThutho zaseMhlabeni weSizwe, wama-2009 (uMthetho we-5 wama-2009).

src: The amendments to the National Land Transport Act of 2009 will further the process of transforming and restructuring the national land transport system.
tgt: Ezi zilungisoo zoMthetho wezoThutho zaseMhlabeni wama-2009 ziza kuqhubela phambili inkqubo yokuguqula nokumisela ngokutsha inkqubo yezothutho zasemhlabeni yesizwe.

src: This will contribute towards a safer, accessible, efficient and effective public transport service.
tgt: Oku kuza kwenza igalelo kwinkonzo yezothutho kawonkewonke ekhuselekileyo, efikelelekayo, enobuchule nesebenzayo.

src: The Bill provides for new developments in the public transport sector.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ubonelela ngophuhliso olutsha kwicandelo lezothutho kawonkewonke.

src: The Bill provides guidance in, amongst others, non-motorised transport e-hailing transport services and branding of public transport.
tgt: Ubonelela ngesikhokelo ekukho phakathi kwaso, izithuthi ezingezo moto iinkonzo zezothutho ezibizwa ngezixhobo zobuchwephetshe nokuphawulwa kwezithuthi zikawonkewonke ngokutsha ngokusebenza ngendlela ephucukileyo.

src: It further provides administrative clarity on the delegated powers and regulations in respect of the issuing of public transport operating licenses.
tgt: Ukwabonelela ngokucacisa ngengcaciso kwinkqubo yokudluliselwa kwamagunya nemimiselo ngokumayela nokukhutshwa kweelayisenisi zokuqhuba izithuthi zikawonkewonke.

src: This Bill will also enable the roll-out of the Integrated Public Transport Networks and it forms part of the National Infrastructure Plan and the Strategic Integrated Project 7, which focus on using coordinated development of urban and integrated transport networks to establish cities as engines of growth.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uza kubonelela ngokuqaliswa koThungelwano lwezoThutho lukaWonkewonke oluDibeneyo kwaye luyinxalenye yeProjekthi ye-7 yesiCwangciso seziSeko ezinguNdoqo seSizwe, sigxile ekusebenziseni uphuhliso olulungeleleyo ezidolophini nothungelwano lwezothutho oludibeneyo ukumisela izixeko njengonobangela wohlumo.

src: Upcoming events President Zuma will undertake a State Visit to the Federal Republic of Nigeria from 8 to 9 March 2016.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uza kuya luTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni kwiFederal Republic of Nigeria ukususela ngomhla we-8 ukuya kowe-9 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016.

src: The State Visit will enhance existing bilateral relations and further advance intra-regional trade.
tgt: Olu tyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni luza kuqinisa ubudlelwano obuphakathi kwalamazwe mabini nokuqhubela phambili urhwebo oluphakathi kwemimandla yala mazwe.

src: Human Rights Month in March 2016 will be celebrated under the theme: “South Africa united against racism.” The Department of Arts and Culture has put in place a month-long programme which includes a series of dialogues on working together to build a non-racial, non-sexist, equal and democratic society.
tgt: INyanga yamaLungelo oLuntu kweyoKwindla yowama-2016 iza kubhiyozelwa phantsi komxholo othi: “UMzantsi Afrika umanyene ukulwa nobuhlanga.” ISebe lezobuGcisa neNkcubeko limisele inkqubo ebude buyinyanga equka iintlanganiso ezimalunga nokusebenzisana ukuze kwakhiwe isizwe esingenabuhlanga, esingacaluli ngokwesini, esilinganayo nesilawulwa ngentando yesininzi.

src: Cabinet invites South Africans to comment on the National Action Plan to combat Racism, Racial Discrimination, Xenophobia and Related Intolerance (2016-2021) before 30 June 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bahlomle kwisiCwangciso sokuSebenza seSizwe sokulwa ubuHlanga, uCalucalulo ngokobuHlanga, iNtiyo yabaSuka kuMazwe angaPhandle kunye neminye imiKhuba yokungaNyamezelani (sowama-2016-2021) phambi komhla wama-30 kweyeSilimela yowama-2016.

src: The plan provides the basis for a public policy against racial discrimination that will assist in giving effect to our international human rights obligations.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso sibonelela ngesiseko somgaqo-nkqubo kawonkewonke wokulwa nocalucalulo ngokobuhlanga okuza kunceda ukunika impembelelo kwisibophelelo sethu samalungelo oluntu ezizwe-ngezizwe.

src: The Russia-Africa Anti-Drug Dialogue at the ICC in Durban from 8 to 9 March 2016 provides a platform to enhance the National Drug Master Plan (2013-2017).The fight against illicit drugs is in line with the National Development Plan and the dialogue is under the auspices of the AU in pursuit of the obligations in terms of the relevant UN Drug and Transnational Organised Crime Conventions, AU Plan of Action on Drug Control (2013-2017) and BRICS (Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa) resolutions.
tgt: INgqungquthela ye-Russia ne-Afrika yokuLwa neziYobisi kwi-ICC yaseDurban ukususela ngomhla we-8 ukuya kowe-9 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016 lubonelela ngeqonga lokuqinisa isiCwangciso esiyiNtloko seziYobisi seSizwe (sowama-2013-2017).Umlo wokulwa iziyobisi ezingekho mthethweni uyahambelana neSicwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe kwaye le ngqungquthela iphantsi kwemiqondiso emihle ye-AU ukusebenzela isibophelelo ngokwemimiselo efanelekileyo ye-UN yeziVumelwano zoLwaphulo-mthetho oluHleliweyo Phakathi kwaMazwe amaBini neziYobisi, isiCwangciso soMsebenzi se-AU (2013-2017 nezindululo zamazwe e-BRICS (i-Brazil, Russia, India, China noMzantsi Afrika).

src: The conference is a follow-up session of the Russia-Africa Anti-Drug Dialogue, which aims to present a consolidated position in how world leaders intend to tackle the international drug problem.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ilandela iNgqungqthela ye-Russia ne-Afrika yokuLwa iziYobisi, eligxile ekubonakaliseni imo edibeneyo yokuba iinkokheli zehlabathi zizimisele kangakanani ukuqubisana neengxaki yeziyobisi phakathi kwezizwe ngezizwe.

src: This will be tabled at the UN General Assembly Special Session in April 2016.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso siza kuthiwe thaca kwiNdibano eNkulu eKhethekileyo ye-UN kwekaTshazimpunzi yowama-2016.

src: Government – in partnership with the Commonwealth Secretariat, University of South Africa (UNISA) and the National Youth Development Agency – is hosting the 2nd Commonwealth Conference on Youth Work at the UNISA campus in Pretoria from 8 to 10 March 2016.
tgt: Urhulumente – ngokusebenzisana ne-ofisi kaNobhala wamaZwe aye ngamaThanga, iDyunivesithi yaseMzantsi Afrika (i-UNISA) ne-Arhente yoPhuhliso loLutsha yeSizwe – uza kusingatha iNgqungquthela yesibini2 yamaZwe ayesakuba ngamaThanga ngoMsebenzi woLutsha kwikhampasi yase-UNISA ePitoli ukususela ngomhla- we-8 ukuya kowe-10 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016.

src: The conference takes place under the theme: “Engaging Young People in Nation Building: The Youth Worker’s Role” and will re-examine the role of youth work practitioners and academics in engaging young people on the development of their countries.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela iqhubeka phantsi komxholo othi: “Bandakanya uLutsha eKwakheni iSizwe: iNdima yabaSebenzi abaluLutsha” nokuphinda kuhlolwe indima yamagcisa alulutsha olusebenzayo nabahlohli bamaziko emfundo ephakamileyo ekubandakanyeni ulutsha kuphuhliso lwamazwe walo.

src: Cabinet’s position on key issues in the environment Cabinet reiterates the message by President Zuma on the need to respect the institutions and processes created in terms of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996 and the law.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izeka mzekweni kumyalezo kaMongameli uZuma ngokudingeka kokuhlonitshwa kwamaziko neenkqubo ezidalwe ngokwemimiselo yomgaqo-siseko weRhiphabliki yoMzantsi Afrika yowe-1996 nomthetho.

src: President Zuma is dealing with the matter of the South African Revenue Service Commissioner and the Minister of Finance through the correct channels using correct legal prescripts.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uyasebenza ngemeko yoMkhomishinala weZiko loMzantsi Afrika leeNkonzo yezeRhafu yaseMzantsi Afrika noMphathiswa wezeMali ngokulandela iindlela ezifanelekileyo esebenzisa izikhokelo ezifanelekileyo zezomthetho.

src: The President is putting measures in place to address the issues responsibly and amicably for the benefit of all.
tgt: UMongameli umisele iinkqubo zokuhlangabezana nalo mba ngokufanelekileyo nangoxolo ukwenzela uncedo lwethu sonke.

src: Cabinet calls on all interested parties to exercise calm and restraint, and allow space for the matters to be resolved using correct channels.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza onke amaqela achaphazelekayo ukuba azole azibambe, aze anikeze ithuba lokuba lo mba usonjululwe ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezifanelekileyo.

src: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to register for the 2016 Local Government Elections on 5 and 6 March 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba babhalisele uNyulo looRhulumente baseKhaya lowama-2016 ngomhla we-5 nowe-6 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016.

src: Unlike with national elections, the local government elections require that you register in the ward that you reside WEBTOKEN is important to have an Identity Document (ID) – both the green bar-coded ID and Smart ID card will be accepted – and to check your registration status, ward number and voting-station location.
tgt: Unyulo loorhumente basekhaya, alufani nolwesizwe kuba koloorhulumente basekhaya kufanele ubhalise kwiwadi ohlala kuyo.

src: All Home Affairs offices will be open from 08:00 to 17:00 on 5 and 6 March 2016, which is in line with the operating hours of the Independent Electoral Commission for the two days.
tgt: Kubalulekile ukuba ube neNcwadi yeSazisi (i-ID) – ziza kwamkeleka zombini i-ID eluhlaza enebhakhodi kunye neKhadi-Sazisi – nokukhangela isimo sokuba ubhalisile na, iinombolo yewadi kunye nokuba simi phi isikhululo sakho sokuvota.

src: Cabinet calls on all young and first-time voters to register to vote.
tgt: Zonke ii-ofisi zeSebe lemiCimbi yezeKhaya ziza kuba zivuliwe ukususela ngentsimbi ye-08:00 ukuya kweye-17:00 ngomhla we-5 nowe-6 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016, oku kuhambelana kunye namaxesha okusebenza eKhomishini yoNyulo eziMeleyo kwezi ntsuku zimbini.

src: By casting your vote you have taken a step towards making your voice heard in the decisions that affect you and your community.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza lonke ulutsha kunye nabo baza kuqala ukuvota ukuba babhalisele ukuvota.

src: Cabinet condemns the violent student protests, which have disrupted studies at some universities and led to the destruction of property.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalugxeka uqhankqalazo olunobundlobongela lwabafundi, noluthe lwaphazamisa izifundo kwezinye iidyunivesithi laze lakhokelela ekutshatyalalisweni kwezakhiwo nempahla.

src: These protests deprive deserving students the opportunity to further their studies and impacts upon their right to higher education.
tgt: Aba baqhankqalazi bathintela abafundi abanelungelo ilungelo lokuqhuba ngezifundo zabo kwaye oko kunempembelelo engekho ntle kwilungelo labo lokufumana imfundo ephakamileyo.

src: Government has opened channels of communication with all higher-education stakeholders for discussions and dialogues.
tgt: Urhulumente uvulele bonke abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo kwezemfundo ephakamileyo iinkqubo zonxibelelwano ukwenzela iingxoxo nothethathethwano.

src: This has resulted in the restoration of normality and the promotion of social cohesion in our universities that seeks to find solutions to the medium- to long-term challenges linked to the transformation of the sector as described in the resolutions of the 2015 Higher Education Transformation Summit.
tgt: Oko kukhokelele ekubuyeleni kwisiqhelo nokukhuthazwa kwentalo-ntle kwiidyunivesithi zethu ezifuna ukufumana isisombululo kwimingeni yexesha eliphakathi ukuya kweyelide edibene nokudalwa kwenguqu kwelicandelo njengoko ichazwe kwizindululo zeMbizo yeNguqu kwezeMfundo ePhakamileyo yowama-2015.

src: Cabinet supports the efforts by law-enforcement agencies to ensure that the culture of learning is restored, and that property and the rights of individuals are protected.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawaxhasa amalinge awenziwe zi-arhente zogcino-mthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuba isithethe sokufunda sibuyiselwe, kunye nokukhuselwa kwempahla nesakhiwo namalungelo womntu ngamnye.

src: The rule of law is paramount and should be upheld at all times.
tgt: Ukulawula komthetho kubaluleke kakhulu kwaye kufanele kuhlonitshwe ngamaxesha onke.

src: Normality and calm must return in our universities so that the academic programmes can continue while the medium- to long-term challenges are addressed.
tgt: Ukubuyela esiqhelweni nenzolo kwiidyunivesithi kuyafuneka ukuze iinkqubo zezemfundo zikwazi ukuqhubeka ngeli xesha imingeni yexesha eliphakathi nelide kusazanywana nayo.

src: Cabinet applauded the students who stood united against racism and anti-white chauvinism, which serves as an example that we can all work together to build on the progress and gains made in the tertiary education sector in preparation for this academic year.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabancoma abafundi abathe bema kunye bemanyene ukulwa ubuhlanga kunye nokulwa abo bazidla ngokuba nobuhlanga ngokugqithisileyo bechasa abamhlophe, oku kube ngumzekelo wokuba singasebenzisana sisonke ukwakha kwinkqubela neenzuzo ezenzwe kwicandelo lezemfundo ephakamileyo ukulungiselela lo nyaka wemfundo sikuwo.

src: We must protect that progress and allow order to be restored and preserved at all our universities.
tgt: Kufuneka siyikhusele le nkqubela size sivumele ukubuya kocwangco nokululondoloza kuzo zonke iidyunivesithi zethu.

src: Cabinet also calls upon all stakeholders to work together so that our universities become leaders of inclusive engagement and transformation.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo ukuba basebenzisane ukuze iidyunivesithi zethu zibe ziinkokheli zomsebenzi oquka konke nenguqu.

src: Cabinet notes the proposed merger of three bottling operations for the Coca Cola Company in South Africa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukucetywa kokudibanisa iinkampani ezintathu ezenza iibhotile ukwenzela iNkampani ye-Coca Cola eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Cabinet notes the matter will be heard before the Competition Tribunal.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele ukuba lo mba uza kuxoxwa kwiNkundla yoKhuphiswano.

src: Cabinet expresses its concern at proposed job losses and reduction in employment in merger transactions.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa ukuxhalaba kwayo ngokulahleka kwemisebenzi okucetywayo nokuncitshiswa komsebenzi kwiintengiselwano zokudityaniswa kwazo.

src: In view of the high levels of unemployment, Cabinet calls on companies to ensure jobs are not lost and aggregate employment levels are maintained.
tgt: Ngenxa yezinga eliphezulu lentswela-ngqesho, iKhabhinethi ibongoza ezi nkampani ukuba ziqiniseke ukuba akukho kulahleka kwemisebenzi kwaye kuze kugcinwe izinga eliphakathi lengqesho.

src: Cabinet congratulates the South African Ambassador to the World Trade Organisation (WTO), Mr Xavier Carim, who has been elected to chair the Dispute Settlement Body of the WTO General Council.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana noNozakuzaku waseMzantsi Afrika kuMbutho woRhwebo weHlabathi (i-WTO), uMnu Xavier Carim, othe wonyulwa ukuba abe ngusihlalo weBhodi yokuLamla iMbambano yeBhunga Jikelele le-WTIBhunga Jikelele yeyona bhodi iphezulu ye-WTO yokuthatha izigqibo phakathi kweNgqungquthela yobuPhathiswa.

src: The appointment of Ambassador Carim is in part recognition of the important role South Africa plays in the WTO and in part testimony to Ambassador Carim’s qualities.
tgt: Ukuchongwa kukaNozakuzaku uCarim uyinxalenye yobungqina bokubaluleka kwendima edlalwa nguMzantsi Afrika kwi-WTO kwaye iyinxalenye yobungqina beempawu zikaNozakuzaku uCarim.

src: Cabinet noted Barclays PLC’s announcement of its intention to reduce its per cent shareholding in Barclays Africa Group Limited (BAGL) over the next two to three years.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isiqaphele isibhengezo seBarclays PLC sokuba nenjongo zokunciphisa ubunini-zabelo bayo zingama-62.3%i kwi-Barclays Africa Group Limited (i-BAGL) kule minyaka mibini ukuya kwemithathu ezayo.

src: Barclays PLC, in particular the CEO, has engaged both the National Treasury and the Reserve Bank in an open dialogue, and we welcome the company’s commitment to implement its new strategy in a way that will minimise the impact on the economies in which BAGL operates.
tgt: I-Baclays PLC, ngokukodwa iGosa eliyiNtloko yesiGqeba (i-CEO), lithetha kunye nabo bobabini uNdyebo weSizwe kunye ngeBhanka enguVimba kothethathethwano olungafihlekelanga, kwaye siyakkwamkela ukuzinikela kwale nkampani ukuba iphumeze isicwangciso-qhinga sayo esitsha ngendlela eza kunciphisa impembelelo kuqoqosho apho iBAGL isebenza khona.

src: The Reserve Bank will work with Barclays PLC and BAGL to ensure that any potential risks from the transaction are mitigated and appropriate measures will be taken to manage capital flows arising from the transaction.
tgt: IBhanka enguVimba iza kusebenza neBarclays PLC ne-BAGL ukuqinisekisa ukuba nayiphi na imingcipheko ekwintengiselwano iyathityazwa kuze kuthathwe amanyathelo afanelekileyo ukulawula ukungena nokuphuma kwemali kule ntengiselwano.

src: Cabinet salutes all the finalists and winners of the National Teaching Awards which took place on 27 February 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibothulela umnqwazi bonke abo bafikelele kumagqibela kankqoyi nabo bathe baphumelela iMbasa yokuFundisa yeSizwe.

src: These dedicated teachers move our country forward by ensuring that their classrooms produce motivated learners that will contribute towards the development of South Africa.
tgt: Aba titshala bakhutheleyo baliqhubela phambili ilizwe lethu ngokuqinisekisa ukuba amagumbi wabo okufundela avelisa abafundi abakhuthazekileyo abazokwenza igalelo ekuphuhliseni uMzantsi Afrika.

src: Cabinet congratulates the Market Theatre in Johannesburg for celebrating its 40th year of existence.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana neMarket Theatre eRhawutini ngokubhiyozela iminyaka engama-40 ikho.

src: During the apartheid era the theatre became a symbol of the Struggle by telling the true South African story.
tgt: Ngexesha lucalucalulo iMarket Theatre yaba luphawu lomzabalazo ngokubalisa ibali loMzantsi Afrika eliyinyaniso.

src: Cabinet congratulates music teacher, Mr Chad Hendricks, from Retreat in the Cape Flats for winning the prestigious Len van Zyl Conductors’ Competition in Cape Town.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nootitshala womculo, uMnu Chad Hendricks, wase-Retreat kwi-Cape Flats ngokuphumelela uKhuphiswano lwabaCulisi oludumileyo i-Len van Zyl eKapa.

src: His prize includes a three-month United States scholarship during which Mr Hendricks will study at the Philadelphia Orchestra and be trained by renowned Profssor Victor Yampolsky in Chicago.
tgt: Ibhaso lakhe liquka imali yokufunda yeenyanga ezintathu e-United States apho aza kufunda khona kwiPhiladelphia Orchestra aze aqeqeshwe ngodumileyo uNjingalwazi uVictor Yampolsky eChicago.

src: Cabinet congratulates film producer, Mr Anant Singh, for being awarded third place for the film Shepherds and Butchers in the Panorama Audience Award for Fiction Film at the Berlin International Film Festival.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nomvelisi wemidlalo-bhanyabhanya, uMnu Anant Singh, ngokufumana iwonga elikwindawo yesithathu ngomdlalo-bhanyabhanya i-uShepherds and Butchers kumsitho wokuWongwa ngabaBukeli wasePanorama woMdlalo Bhanyabhanya obuNtsomi kuMbiyozo woMdlalo Bhanyabhanya weSizwe-ngezizwe waseBerlin.

src: This is a major achievement as the film competed against 51 feature-length films from 33 countries.
tgt: Le yeyona mpumelelo inkulu njengoko lo mdlalo bhanyabhanya ubukhuphisana nemidlalo bhanyabhanya ingama-51 ebonisiweyo enobude bayo evela kumazwe angama-.

src: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.
tgt: IzikhundlaZonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo.

src: Extension of the contract for Mr Lionel October as the Director-General (DG) in the Department of Trade and Industry, for a period of five years.
tgt: Ukwandiswa kwesivumelwano sengqesho sikaMnu Lionel October njengoMlawuli-Jikelele (u-DG) kwiSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino, isithuba sexesha leminyaka emihlanu.

src: Appointment of Dr Mantlhake J Maboya as the Deputy DG (DDG): Curriculum Policy and Monitoring in the Department of Basic Education.
tgt: Ukuqeshwa kukaGq Mantlhake Mboya njengoSekela-Mlawuli-Jikelele: Umgaqo-nkqubo weKharityhulam noHlolo kwiSebe leMfundo esiSiseko.

src: Appointment of Ms Shamilla Chettiar as the DDG: Policy and Knowledge Services in the Department of Tourism.
tgt: Ukuqeshwa kukaNksz Shamilla Chettiar njenge-DDG: KwiiNkonzo zoMgaqo-nkqubo noLwazi kwiSebe lezoKhenketho.

src: Appointment of Mr Mbulelo Tshangana as the DG in the Department of Human Settlements.
tgt: Ukuqeshwa kukaMnu Mbulelo Tshangana njengoMlawuli-Jikelele kwiSebe lwezokuHlaliswa koLuntu.

src: Reappointment of Mr Kutoane Obed Kutoane as the Chief Executive Officer of the Export Credit Insurance Corporation of South Africa SOC Limited.
tgt: Ukuqeshwa kwakhona kukaMnu Kutoane Obed Kutoane njengeGosa eliyiNtloko lesiGqeba kwiQumrhu le-Inshorensi yamaTyala eMpahla eThunyelwa kuMazwe angaPhandle lwaseMzantsi Afrika .

src: Appointment of Mr Vuyo Mafata as the Compensation Commissioner: Compensation Fund in the Department of Labour.
tgt: Ukuqeshwa kukaMnu Vuyo Mafata njengoMkomishinala weMbuyekezo: KwiNgxowa-mali yeMbuyekezo kwiSebe lezabaSebenzi.

src: Appointment to the Takeover Regulation Panel for a period of five years:a) Ms Neo Phakama Dongwana (Chairperson)b) ProfStephanie Marie Luiz (Deputy Chairperson)c) ProfShirley Zinn (panel member)d) Adv Rory Voller (designate member)e) Ms Wendy Ndlovu (designate member)f) Ms Annalie de Bruyn (designate member) andg) Mr Nano Abram Matlala (panel member).
tgt: Ukuqeshwa kweQela lokuThatha iNtambo zoLawulo ixesha leminyaka emihlanu:a) Nksz Neo Phakama Dongwana (uSihlalo)b) Njing Stephanie Marie Luiz (uSekela-Sihlalo)c) Njing Shirley Zinn (ilungu leqela)d) Adv Rory Voller (ilungu elonyuliweyo)e) Nksz Wendy Ndlovu (ilungu elonyuliweyo)f) Nks Annalie de Bruyn (ilungu elonyuliweyo) kunyeg) noMnu Nano Abram Matlala (ilungu leqela).

src: Key Cabinet decisions.
tgt: Izigqibo ezingundoqo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Cabinet assessed the Third Quarter Outcomes Progress Reports for the period October to December 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlole iiNgxelo zeNkqubela yeziPhumo zeKota yesiThathu ukususela kweyeDwarha kuye kweyoMnga ngowama-2015.

src: The reports show significant progress in the implementation of government programmes that have a direct impact on improving the lives of South Africans.
tgt: Ezi ngxelo zibonakalisa inkqubela ethe vetshe ekusebenziseni iinkqubo zikarhulumente ezinefuthe elingqalileyo ekuphuculeni ubomi babemi boMzantsi Afrika.

src: The Outcomes Progress Reports provide evidence that government has made progress in achieving the targets set out in the Medium Term Strategic Framework 2014-2019.
tgt: Ezi Ngxelo zibubungqina bokuba urhulumente kukho inkqubela ayenzileyo ekuphumeleliseni izinto emakufikelelwe kuzo ngokwesiCwangciso-sikhokelo esibubuChule sesiGaba esiPhakathi sowama-2014-2019.

src: They also take us closer to realising Vision 2030, as articulated in the National Development Plan, which aims to tackle poverty, unemployment and inequality.
tgt: Zikwasisondeza ekufezekeni koMbono wama-2030, njengoko uthiwe thaca sisiCwangciso soPhuhliso lweSizwe, nonjongo wawo ikukuhlasela indlala, intswela-ngqesho nokungalingani.

src: Cabinet noted the reasonable progress that was made to achieve the key targets and outputs.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele inkqubela ebonakalayo eyenziweyo ukuphumelelisa izinto ezingundoqo emakufikelelwe kuzo kwakunye neziqhamo.

src: Cabinet has noted that while significant progress was made in respect of most of the indicators, there are still areas that require coordinated interventions by government.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele into yokuba noxa kukho inkqubela ebonakalayo eyenzekileyo malunga nenkoliso yezinto ezalatha oko, kusekho imiba efuna ukungenelela kukarhulumente ngokulungeleleneyo.

src: Implementation of key government programmes.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo ezingundoqo zikarhulumente.

src: Cabinet has expressed its gratitude to all South Africans who responded to the call by the Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) for people to register, check their registration status and update their details on the voters’ roll on the weekend of 5 and 6 March 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise umbulelo wayo kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika abalisabeleyo ikhwelo elenziwe yiKhomishini yoNyulo eZimeleyo (i-IEC) lokuba abantu babhalise, bajonge imeko yabo malunga nobhaliso kwaye bahlaziye iinkcukacha zabo ezikumqulu wabavoti.

src: About three million people visited polling stations countrywide and 544 552 of the new registrations (78.6%) were under the age of 30, which demonstrates the willingness by South Africans to participate in building our democracy.
tgt: Abantu ababalelwa kwizigidi ezithathu baya kwiindawo ekubhaliselwa uvoto kuzo kulo lonke eli, kwaye abangama- 544 552 kwabo ibingabhalisa okokuqala (i-78.6%) kwaye beneminya yobudala engaphantsi kwengama-30.

src: Cabinet calls on South Africans to exercise their democratic right by registering and urges those who have registered previously to verify their voter registration details as a number of factors have led to changes in the voters’ roll.
tgt: Loo nto ibonisa ukuzimisela kwabemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuthatha inxaxheba ekwakheni ulawulo lwethu lwentando yesininzi.

src: This will be the last opportunity for voters to register and update their registration details at their voting stations.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba balixhamle ilungelo labo lomgaqo-siseko ngokuthi babhalise, kwaye icela abo ababhalisa kwixesha elidluleyo ukuba baqinisekise iinkcukacha zabo zobhaliso njengoko kubekho izinto ezininzi ezikhokhelele ekutshintsheni komqulu wabavoti.

src: However, registration is ongoing at local IEC offices during office hours from Monday to Friday, until the voters’ roll for the 2016 Municipal Elections closes on the day the elections are promulgated.
tgt: Impelaveki yokugqibela yobhaliso iza kuba ngomhla we-9 ukuya kowe-10 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2016.

src: The outcomes from this engagement between two of the largest economies on the continent will integrate regional economies, thereby increasing the common market and elevating existing initiatives of economic growth and employment in Africa.
tgt: Olu qoqosho lolunye lwamacandelo amathathu e-Operation Phakisa kwaye lusondeza ilizwe eli ekuboniseni amandla eelwandlekazi zoMzantsi Afrika.

src: This demonstrates that South Africa remains a competitive investment destination despite a troubled global economy, and will result in job opportunities and skills development for South Africans.
tgt: Loo nto inganegalelo lemali engafikelela kwiibhiliyoni zeerandi ezili-177 kwimveliso yasekhaya iyonke, nto leyo enokudala imisebenzi emitsha engaphaya kwesigidi.

src: Cabinet noted that South Africa will be participating at the 60th Session of the United Nations (UN) Commission on the Status of Women (CSW60) taking place in New York, USA from 14 to 24 March 2016 under the theme: “Women’s empowerment and its link to sustainable development”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkela utyelelo olube yimpumelelo lwaseBurhulumenteni lukaMongameli Zuma kwiFederal Republic of Nigeria ukususela kumhla we-8 ukuya kowe- 9 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016.

src: It is important to note that since the democratic dispensation South Africa, among other things, participated in the 4th World Conference of Women in 1995, and signed the Beijing Declaration and Platform for Action in the same WEBTOKEN line with resolution E/RES/2013/18 of the UN Economic and Social Council, South Africa is committed to continue implementing the Beijing Declaration and Platform for Action, which is a blueprint for women’s empowerment and advancement.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuvuleleka koqoqosho lwaseNigeria kwiinkampani zaseMzantsi Afrika kumacandelo anjengobunjineli, eleziseko ezingundo zonxibelelwano, elezokwakha, elobuchule bokuhamba ngeenqwelo-moya, amajelo eendaba, ukubuka nokutenda iindwendwe, imiba yebhanki, ulonwabo, imihlaba nezindlu, intengiso kunye neenkonzo zokuphonononga nokuzingela i-oli negesi.

src: President Zuma – as co-chair with French President François Hollande of the High-Level Commission on Health Employment and Economic Growth – will attend its formal launch in Lyon, France on Wednesday, 23 March 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele into yokuba uMzantsi Afrika uza kuthatha inxaxheba kwiSeshoni yama-60 yeKomishini yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) ngeMeko yabaseTyhini (i-CSW60) eNew York, eMelika, ukususela ngomhla we-14 ukuya kowama-24 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016 phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukuxhotyiswa ngezakhono kwabasetyhini kunye nendlela okunxibelelana ngayo nophuhliso oluzinzileyo”.

src: This UN initiative is expected to increase health security worldwide and promote inclusive economic growth, which contributes to the implementation of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.
tgt: Kubalulekile ukuyiqaphela into yokuba oko kwathi kwabakho ulawulo lwentando yesininzi, phakathi kwezinye izinto, uMzantsi Afika wathabatha inxaxheba kwiNkomfa yeHlabathi yesi-4 yabaseTyhini ngowe-1995,waza watyikitya isiVumelwano saseBeijing kunye neQonga lokuSebenza kwangalo nyaka mnye.

src: President Zuma will undertake a State Visit to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia from 27 to 28 March 2016, which will strengthen existing relations between the two countries.
tgt: Uhambisana nesindululo E/RES/2013/18 seBhunga le-UN lezoQoqosho nezeNtlalo, uMzantsi Afrika uzinikezele ekuqhubeni ukusebenza kwesiVumelwano saseBeijing kunye neQonga lokuSebenza, nto leyo engumkhombandlela wokugunyaziswa kwabasetyhini kwanenkqubela yabo.

src: President Zuma will lead Human Rights Day celebrations at the Moses Mabhida Stadium in KwaZulu-Natal on Monday, 21 March 2016 under the theme: “South Africa united against racism.” As announced in the 2016 State of the Nation Address, this year’s Human Rights Day will lay the foundation for a long-term programme of building a non-racial society.
tgt: Izilungiso ziyenziwa kuMthetho wamaCandelo kaMasipala: uRhulumente weMimandla, wonyaka we-1998 (uMthetho uNombolo 117 wowe-1998), owaqalisa ukusebenza phambi konyulo lokuqala lorhulumente wemimandla kulawulo lwentando yesininzi olwalungomhla wesi-5 kweyoMnga ngowama-2000.Ezi zilungiso ziza kuphucula ulawulo lonyulo lukarhulumente wemimandla, kwaye phakathi kweenguqulelo ezikhoyo, ziza kwenza oku:a) ukulungisa imigaqo yoomasipala abakwiCandelo Ab) ukususa yonke into ebhekisa kwimimandla yolawulo lwezithilic) ukucacisa umhla wokuqalisa kokusebenza kocebad) ukumisela ukuba uMongameli abeke umhla wonyulo loomasipalae) ukuvumela ukuba lolulwe ixesha lokubhengeza iziphumo zonyulof) ukufuna ukuba umphathi kamasipala azise i-IEC ngezithuba ezikhoyo kwiiwadig) ukumisela ukuba iLungu leBhunga eliLawulayo limisele umhla wonyulo lwelungu olwenziwa phakathi kwexesha lolawulo lweBhungah) ukucacisa isininzi esifunekayo ukuze ibekho intlanganiso yebhungai) ukucacisa iimeko zokuvota koceba ochophele intlanganiso yebhungaj) ukunyusa ukutshintsha kwamanani abavoti kwiwadi nganye ngelixa lentlanganiso yebhungak) ukunyusa ukutshintsha kwamanani abavoti xa kucandwa ukuze kucaciswe ukunikwa koomasipala basekhaya izihlalo ezingaphaya.

src: Members of the Executive will interact with South Africans across the country during the National Imbizo Focus Week between 4 and 10 April 2016, under the theme: “Together we move South Africa forward: Grow South Africa.” The week coincides with the Parliamentary Constituency Week and the commemoration of Freedom Month.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma – njengobambisane isihlalo noMongameli waseFrance uFrançois Hollande, kwiKomishini ePhezulu kwezeNgqesho kwezeMpilo noHlulo loQoqosho – uza kuya ekuphehlelelweni ngokusesikweni kwale Komishini eLyon, eFrance ngoLwesithathu umhla wama-23 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016.

src: Cabinet encourages South Africans to actively participate in these events and to engage with political principals.
tgt: Ikhomishini le igxile kwisidingo seengcali zezempilo kumazwe anemivuzo ephakathi nephantsi.

src: The Imbizo Focus Week will highlight the implementation of the Nine-Point Plan that aims to boost economic growth and create much-needed jobs.
tgt: Eli linge le-UN kulindeleke ukuba linyuse ukhuseleko ngokwasempilweni elizweni liphela kwaye likhuthaze ukukhula koqoqosho okubandakanyayo, nto leyo enegalelo ekusebenzeni kweNkqubo yoPhuhliso oluZinzileyo lowama-2030.

src: It will also profile local government successes, including achievements yielded through the local government revitalisation plan – the Back-to-Basics approach.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uza kutyelela ngokwasebuRhulumenteni eSaudi Arabia ukususela ngomhla wama-27 ukuya kowama-28 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016, tyelelo olo oluza kuqinisa ubudlelwane obukhoyo phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.

src: The week will also coincide with the final registration weekend ahead of the 2016 Municipal Elections, further providing an opportunity for principals to galvanise and mobilise South Africans through voter education outreaches to register and verify their voting details.
tgt: UMongameli uza kuya kwiNgqungquthela yesi- 4 engoKhuseleko lweNyukliya eWashington, eMelika, ukususela ngomhla wama-31 kweyoKwindla ukuya kumhla woku-1 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2016.

src: Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa will open the 2nd Human Resource Development Council Summit taking place at the Gallagher Convention Centre in Midrand on 29 and 30 March 2016 under the theme: “Partnership for skills – A Call to Action”.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uza kukhokhela imibhiyozo yoSuku lwamaLungelo oLuntu kwiBala iMoses Mabhida kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal ngoMvulo, umhla wama-21 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016 phantsi komxholo othi: “UMzantsi Afrika umanyene ekulweni ubuhlanga”.

src: The summit brings together stakeholders from across the higher education sector to assist in its development and forge partnerships that create stronger industry-ready higher education institutions.
tgt: Njengoko kwakwazisiwe kwiNtetho engoBume beSizwe yowe-2016, olu Suku kulo nyaka luza kubeka isiseko senkqubo yexesha elide yokwakha isizwe esingacalulani ngobuhlanga.

src: National Water Week 2016 will take place from 14 to 22 March under the theme: “Water for people, water by people”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iza kusebenzisana nabemi boMzantsi Afrika kulo lonke eli ngelixa leVeki yeSizwe yokuGxininisa kwiiMbizo phakathi komhla wesi- 4 nowe-10 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2016, phantsi komxholo othi: “Sisonke siqhubela uMzantsi Afrika phambili : Sikhulisa uMzantsi Afrika.

src: The week will profile water as a human right by raising awareness of the plight of people who do not have access to clean drinkable water.
tgt: Loo veki ingqamana neVeki yePalamente yeeNqila zoVoto nokukhumbula iNyanga yeNkululeko.

src: The Department of Water and Sanitation is still in the process of eradicating the bucket system and has thus far eradicated 78.8% of the bucket system in formal settlements in South Africa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bathathe inxaxheba ngamandla kule misitho, kwaye bathethathethane neenkokeli zopolitiko.

src: Seven provinces have performed excellently with an average 90% eradication.
tgt: Le Veki yokuGxininisa kwiiMbizo iza kugqamisa ukusebenza kwesiCwangciso esinaManqaku aliThoba enjongo yaso ikukomeleza ukukhula koqoqosho nokudala amathuba emisebenzi afuneka kangangoko.

src: Those that have achieved total eradication in formal settlements are KwaZulu-Natal, North West, Mpumalanga and Gauteng.
tgt: Le veki yeeMbizo iza kuphinda itshile ngempumelelo yorhulumente wemimandla, kubandakanywa nempumelelo eze ngecebo lokuvuselela urhulumente wasekhaya- inkqubo yokuBuyela kuNdalashe.

src: Cabinet calls on all sectors to communicate all the positive programmes and interventions undertaken to safeguard our economy.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabacela abaqhankqalazi ukuba bazibambe kakhulu, kwaye izikhalazo zabo zilawulwe ngumthetho nanguMgaqo-siseko.

src: In this regard, Cabinet has also instructed the Inter-Ministerial Committee on Investment to fast track all key economic-related decisions.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izinikele ekuqinisekiseni okokuba izinga lethu kwezoqoqosho alithotywa..Olo tyelelo lunika urhulumente ithuba lokwabelana ngamalinge athile aliqela asetyenzisiweyo ukuhlangabezana nemingeni.

src: Cabinet reiterates that the resilience of the South African economy is built on sound economic fundamentals and practical policies.
tgt: Loo malinge aquka intsebenziswano ukuze ukukhula okubandakanyayo kukhawuleze, ukukhawulezisa amanyathelo okuqinisa imicimbi yemali kaRhulumente nokukhawulezisa ukusebenza kweNkqubo yoTyalo-mali kwiziSeko ezinguNdoqo exabisa iibhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-R870 kwakunye nenkqubela eyenziweyo ekusombululeni imiqathango yezamandla, kuquka ukusebenzisa amandla ahlaziyekayo.

src: Cabinet noted a court case brought by the Chamber of Mines for the Mining Charter to be declared unconstitutional and void.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela onke amacandelo ukuba athethe ngazo zonke iinkqubo ezakhayo nangokungenelela okwenziweyo ukukhusela uqoqosho lwethu.

src: Cabinet reiterates that the principles of the Mining Charter are aimed at transforming the mining industry to redress historical imbalances engendered by apartheid so that the industry is consistent with the changes in South Africa’s overall transformation of its social, political and economic landscape.
tgt: Kubalulekile ukuba onke amacandelo aqinisekise ukuba uqoqosho lwelizwe lomelele.

src: Community upliftment is also a key focus area to ensure that mining development does not exclude relevant communities.
tgt: Ngokuphathelele kulo mba, iKhabhinethi ikwayalele iKomiti yaBaphathiswa yezoTyalo-mali ukuba ikhawulezise zonke izigqibo ezingundoqo ezayamana noqoqosho.

src: Cabinet congratulates social justice activist Father Michael Lapsley for receiving the international 2016 Public Peace Prize in the category ‘Global Peace and Reconciliation – Internationally-Reputed Peacemaker’.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana nabo bonke abaphumelele iiMbasa zeSizwe zamaLungelo abaKhubazekileyo, msitho lowo owawubanjwe ngomhla we-11 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016.

src: Cabinet applauds Pieter du Preez for being nominated for the Laureus World Sportsperson of the Year with a Disability Award, following his outstanding performances in 2015.
tgt: Ezi mbasa zithulela umnqwazi abantu abakhubazekileyo kunye namatshantliziyo alwela amalungelo abantu abakhubazekileyo abagqwesileyo ngonyaka wama-2015.

src: Cabinet congratulates Wayde van Niekerk who made sprinting history by becoming the first man in history to run all three races: the 100m in under 10 seconds‚ the 200m in under 20 seconds and the 400m in under 44 seconds‚ as confirmed by the International Association of Athletics Federations.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithulela umnqwazi abo baphumelele kwiiMbasa zesiThathu zeSizwe zoNyaka zokuGqwesa zabeNkonzo yesiPolisa yoMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPS), eqhwabela izandla ukugqwesa kwamalungu e-SAPS, amapolisa ahleli ekhaya anokubizwa nanini na kwanamaqonga amapolisa abahlali.

src: Implementation of key government programmes.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.

src: Cabinet welcomes the achievements highlighted by President Jacob Zuma during his site visit to the Port of Port Elizabeth in the Eastern Cape, to assess progress made on the implementation of the Operation Phakisa: Oceans Economy initiative.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela izinto ezibe yimpumelelo ezithe zakhankanywa nguMongameli uJacob Zuma ngexesha lokutyelela iziko eliseBhayi eMpuma Koloni, ukuza kuhlola inkqubela esele yenziwe ekuphunyezweni kwephulo elibizwa i-Operation Phakisa: uQoqosho lwezaseLwandle.

src: Government has unlocked investments amounting to about R17 billion in the Oceans Economy.
tgt: Urhulumente uvule utyalo-mali olufikelela kwimali emalunga neebhiliyoni zeerandi ezili-17 kuQoqosho lwezaseLwandle.

src: Since its inception, over 4 500 jobs have been created in various sectors.
tgt: Ukususela ekusungulweni kwayo, kudalwe imisebenzi engaphezulu kwama-4 500 kumacandelo aliqela.

src: Two of the nine tugboats being built by the Southern African Shipyards for Transnet National Ports Authority (TNPA) in the Port of Durban are destined for the Port of Port Elizabeth.
tgt: Oodokolwana ababini kwabalithoba abakhiwa kuMzi weeNqanawa waseMazantsi e-Afrika, i-Southern African Shipyard, nesakhelwa uGunyaziwe waMazibuko eSizwe akwa-Transnet (i-TNPA) kwiZibuko laseDurban baza kuthunyelwa kwiZibuko laseBhayi.

src: President Zuma launched the first tugboat in Port Elizabeth, named the Mvezo, after the birthplace of former President Nelson Mandela.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma umisele ngokusesikweni udokolwana wokuqala eBhayi, obizwa uMvezo, nothiywe ngendawo awazalelwa kuyo owayesakuba nguMongameli uNelson Mandela.

src: The TNPA has allocated over R7 billion to improve our ports.
tgt: I-TNPA ibekele bucala imali engaphezulu kweebhiliyoni zeerandi ezisixhenxe yokuphucula amazibuko eli.

src: The President viewed the refurbished and reconstructed slipway and lead-in jetties within the Port of Port Elizabeth that will be able to accommodate 12 more vessels as compared to the current two.
tgt: UMongameli ukubona oku kuhlaziywa nokwakhiwa ngokutsha kwesangwana neebhulorho zokungena ekumisa kuzo iinqanawa kwiZibuko laseBhayi neziza kukwazi ukungenisa iinqanawa ezongezelelweyo ezili-12 xa kuthelekiswa nezo zimbini zikhoyo ngoku.

src: Cabinet thanks all taxpayers who have partnered with government in the 2015/16 financial year to take our revenue collection to R1 trillion for the first time.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyababulela abahlawuli berhafu abathe basebenzisana norhulumente kunyaka-mali wama-2015/16 ukwenza ukuba uqokelelo lwethu lwerhafu lufikelele okokuqala kwitriliyoni yeerandi.

src: This is a clear demonstration of the strength of our thriving economy even under difficult WEBTOKEN is through the tax contributions of compliant South Africans and the effective collection by the South African Revenue Service that government is better able to provide much-needed services that contribute to improving the lives of South Africans.
tgt: Lo ngumzekelo ocacileyo wamandla oqoqosho lweli oluphumelela naphantsi kweemeko ezinzima.

src: Cabinet welcomes President Zuma’s announcement of 3 August 2016 as the date for the 2016 Local Government Elections.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isibhengezo esenziwe nguMongameli uZuma sokuba umhla wesi-3 kweyeThupha yowama-2016 njengomhla woNyulo looRhulumente beeNgingqi lowama-2016.

src: Government is pleased that the two registration weekends on 5 – 6 March and 9 – 10 April saw large numbers of potential voters visiting the voting stations, especially first-time voters and the youth.
tgt: Urhulumente uxolile kukuba iimpela-veki ezimbini ezingumhla we-5 ukuya kowe-6 kweyoKwindla nomhla we-9 ukuya kowe-10 kuTshazimpuzi zokubhalisela unyulo kubonakale inani elikhulu labo baselungelweni lokuvota, ingakumbi abo baza kuvota okokuqala kunye nolutsha.

src: Cabinet thanks all those who responded to the call to register and check their details on the voters’ roll.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyababulela bonke abo bathe basabela kwikhwelo lokuya kubhalisa nokuya kukhangela iinkcukhacha zabo kuluhlu lwabavoti.

src: It is through our collective participation that our democracy moves from strength to strength.
tgt: Kungenxa yokusebenza ngokubambisana okubangela ukuba ulawulo lwethu lwentando yesininzi luye lusomelela ngakumbi.

src: Cabinet urges all citizens who have not yet registered or checked their details to visit offices of the Independent Electoral Commission in their local municipalities and update their details on the voters’ roll (provide addresses) and register to vote during the 3 August polls.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abemi abangekabhalisi okanye abangekazikhangeli iinkcukhacha zabo ukuba batyelele ii-ofisi zeKhomishini yoNyulo eziMeleyo koomasipala babo baze balungise iinkcukhacha zabo kumqulu woluhlu lwabavoti (banikezele ngeedilesi) baze babhalisele unyulo lomhla wesi-3 kweyeThupha.

src: Voters can also SMS their ID number to 3281.0 or call the contact centre on 0800 11 8000 to verify their status.
tgt: Abavoti basenokuthumela iinombolo zabo zeZazisi nge-SMS ku-3281.0 okanye baqhagamshelane neziko loqhagamshelwano ku-0800 11 8000 ukuqinisekisa ukuba buthini ubume babo.

src: Registration secures your name on the voters’ roll so that you can be able to vote.
tgt: Ubhaliso luqinisekisa ukuba igama lakho likhona kumqulu woluhlu lwabavoti ukuze ukwazi ukuvota.

src: Cabinet calls on citizens to exercise our hard won democratic right to vote in the 2016 Local Government Elections on 3 August 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abemi ukuba basebenzise ilungelo labo lomgaqo-siseko lokuvota nesalufumana nzima ngokuthi bavote kuNyulo looRhulumente beeNgingqi lowama-2016 ngomhla wesi-3 kweyeThupha yowama-2016.

src: Cabinet welcomes the official launch of the eChannel Pilot Project of the Department of Home Affairs (DHA) by President Zuma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukumiselwa ngokusesikweni kweProjekthi yokuLinga i-eChannel yeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya (i-DHA) nguMongameli uZuma.

src: This new innovative system allows citizens to apply for their Smart ID cards online and avoid long queues.
tgt: Le nkqubo yala maxesha intsha ivumela ukuba abemi bafake izicelo zabo zamakhadi-sazisi, i-Smart ID, kwi-intanethi ukuze baphephe imigca emide.

src: This collaboration with four major banks – ABSA, FNB, Nedbank and Standard Bank– to introduce an online application platform for Smart ID cards and passports will enable customers to visit DHA kiosks to submit their fingerprints and pictures after having made appointments and payments online.
tgt: Le yintsebenziswano kunye neebhanki zeli ezine ezinkulu – i-ABSA, i-FNB, i-Nedbank kunye ne-Standard Bank ukuvelisa iqonga lokufaka isicelo samakhadi-sazisi nepaspothi ngokusebenzisa i-intanethi kuza kuvumela abemi beli ukuba batyelele i-ofisana ze-DHA ukuya kunyathelisa iminwe nemifanekiso yabo emva kokwenza idinga baze bahlawula nge-intanethi.

src: eChannel is part of the department’s overall modernisation strategy to move services from paper to digital, a process which will include the cleaning of the population register.
tgt: I-eChannel iyinxalenye yesicwangciso-qhinga sokwenza eli sebe lihambelane nala maxesha xa lilonke ukutshintsha iinkonzo zisuke kwezokusetyenziswa kwamaphepha kusetyenziswa ubuchwepheshe bale mihla , inkqubo eza kuquka ukulungiswa kweziphene kuluhlu oluqulethe iinkcukacha zoluntu.

src: Cabinet welcomes the success of the recently held Imbizo Focus Week under the theme ‘Together we move South Africa forward’, which saw government officials interacting with communities throughout the country.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela iimpumelelo yokubanjwa kutsha nje kweVeki eGxile kwiiMbizo phantsi komxholo othi ‘Sisonke siqhubela uMzantsi Afrika phambili’, apho sibone khona amagosa karhulumente etyelela iindawo ezininzi zoluntu kweli jikelele.

src: Cabinet commends those South Africans who participated in over 36 programmes across the country, which ensured that government responded to identified community needs.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibothulela umnqwazi abo bemi boMzantsi Afrika bathe bathatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo ezingaphezulu kwama-36 kweli jikelele, nezithe zaqinisekisa ukuba urhulumente uyahlangabezana nezo mfuno zoluntu zichongiweyo.

src: The Imbizo Focus Week has empowered communities with information on government programmes.
tgt: Le Veki iGxile kwiMbizo iye yaxhobisa uluntu ngolwazi lweenkqubo zikarhulumente.

src: The Department of Human Settlements hosted a very successful United Nations (UN) conference dealing with informal settlements, emphasising the phenomenal rate of urbanisation and the growth of slums.
tgt: ISebe lezokuHlaliswa koLuntu lisingathe ingqungquthela yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) ebeyimpumelelo enkulu ebigxile kwimiba yeendawo ezingamatyotyombe, futhi igxininisa nakwisantya esiphezulu sokufudukela kwabantu ezidolophini nokukhula ngokukhawuleza kwemimandla yamatyotyombe.

src: Now one billion people in the world live in slums.
tgt: Ngoku ngabantu abayibhiliyoni ehlabathini jikelele abahlala kwimimandla yamatyotyombe.

src: South Africa has since 1994 built millions of houses as part of ensuring a better life for all.
tgt: Ukususela ngowe-1994 uMzantsi Afrika wakhe izigidi zezindlu njengenxalenye yokuqinisekisa ngobomi obungcono kumntu wonke.

src: BillsCabinet approved the following draft Bills:.
tgt: IMithetho eYilwayoIKhabhinethi iphumeze le Mithetho iYilwayo ilandelayo:.

src: Critical Infrastructure Protection Bill of 2016 to be published in the Government Gazette for public comment.
tgt: UMthetho oYilwayo ongokuKhuselwa kweZiseko ezinguNdoqo eziBaluleke kaKhulu wama-2016 oza kushicilelwa kwiPhephandaba loMbuso ukwenzela ukuba uluntu luhlomle kuwo.

src: The Bill repeals the National Key Points Act, 1980 (Act 102 of 1980), and seeks to align the process of identifying and declaring critical infrastructures in a transparent and accountable manner.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uguzula uMthetho waMaziko weSizwe anguNdoqo, we-1980 (uMthetho onguNombolo 102 we-1980, kwaye ugxile ekulungelelaniseni inkqubo yokuchonga nokubhengeza iziseko ezingundoqo ezibaluleke kakhulu ngendlela eselubala necacisekayo.

src: It will also further ensure that all critical infrastructures for the national security of the country are identified and adequately protected.
tgt: Kwakhona uza kuqinisekisa ukuba zonke iziseko ezingundoqo ezibaluleke kakhulu ziyachongwa zize zikhuselwe ngokufanelekileyo ukwenzela ukhuseleko lwesizwe.

src: The Bill provides for the setting up of an institutional framework to monitor and administer the protection of the critical infrastructures.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ukwabonelela ngokumiselwa kwenkqubo-sikhokelo yeziko ukwenzela ukuhlolwa nokwenziwa kokhuseleko lweziseko ezingundoqo ezibaluleke kakhulu.

src: It further defines the functions of the body that will advise the Minister of Police in the declaration of critical infrastructures.
tgt: Ukwacacisa imisebenzi kweziko eliza kucebisa uMphathiswa wezamaPolisa ekubhengezweni kweziseko ezingundoqo.

src: The Communal Property Associations Amendment Bill of 2016 to be published for public comment.
tgt: UMthetho-siHlomelo ongeMibutho yabaNikazi Mhlaba wowama-2016 uza kupapashwa ukwenzela ukuba uluntu lukwazi ukuhlomla kuwo.

src: The Bill amends the current Communal Property Associations Act, 1996 (Act 28 of 1996).The Bill will strengthen the democratic governance process of the existing Communal Property Associations or existing Trust entities that oversee communal land.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uyilwayo uhlomela uMthetho okhoyo ongeMibutho yabaNikazi Mhlaba, we-1996 (uMthetho uNombolo 28 we-1996).Lo Mthetho uYilwayo womeleza inkqubo yolawulo olulolwentando yesininzi yeMibutho yabaNikazi Mhlaba abaLuluntu okanye amaqumrhu eTrasti akhoyo athi ongamele umhlaba onabanikazi abaluluntu.

src: The amended Bill provides for the setting up of the Registrar in the Department of Rural Development and Land Reform, and defines the functions of this office.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhlonyelweyo uvumela ukuba kumiselwe i-ofisi yoMgcini-ncwadi kwiSebe loPhuhliso lwamaPhandle noBuyekezo lweMihlaba, kwaye uyayicacisa imisebenzi yale ofisi.

src: Once this Bill is passed into law, it will strengthen the regulation of governance institutions and enhance State support to WEBTOKEN will enable communities to acquire, hold and manage properties through effective statutorily established administration entities supported by government.
tgt: Xa sele upasisiwe lo Mthetho uYilwayo waba ngumthetho, uza komeleza imimiselo yamaziko olawulo uze uqinise inkxaso kaRhulumente kuwo.

src: The introduction of the International Arbitration Bill of 2016 to Parliament.
tgt: Ukuthiwa thaca koMthetho oYilwayo ongoLamlo weHlabathi wowama-2016 ePalamente.

src: The international arbitration process is an essential tool for doing business across the borders of the country.
tgt: Inkqubo yolamlo lwehlabathi sisixhobo esibalulekileyo sokwenza ushishino ngaphaya kwemida yeli lizwe.

src: It will improve access to justice services for companies doing business outside the country and foreign companies in South Africa.
tgt: Uza kwenza ukuba kube lula kwiinkampani ezenza ushishino kumazwe angaphandle kweli nezamazwe angaphandle ezishishina eMzantsi Afrika ukuba zifikelele kwiinkonzo zezobulungisa.

src: The Bill repeals the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards Act, 1977 (Act 40 of 1977) and also amends the current Protection of Business Act, 1978 (Act 99 of 1978).
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uguzula uMthetho wokwaMkelwa nokuSetyenziswa kokuNikezelwa koLamlo lwaMazwe angaPhandle, we-1977 (uMthetho uNombolo 40 we-1977) kwakunye nokuhlonyelwa koMthetho woKhuselo loShishino, we-1978 (uMthetho uNombolo 99 we-1978).Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhambelana noMthetho woMfuziselo ongoLamlo kuRhwebo lweHlabathi, owamkelwa yiKhomishini yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) kuMthetho woRhwebo lweHlabathi.

src: The proposed Bill aligns with the Model Law on International Commercial Arbitration, which has been adopted by the UN Commission on International Trade Law.
tgt: Ukupapashwa kwedrafti yoMthetho-siHlomelo weSiseko soPhando-nzulu seSizwe wowama-2016 kwiPhephandaba loMbuso ukwenzela ukuba uluntu luhlomle.

src: The Bill amends the National Research Foundation Act, 1998 (Act 23 of 1998).The Bill will improve South Africa’s competitiveness in research development and innovation through effective, adequate and coordinated management of public engagement with science, and improved research infrastructure provision and access.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhlomela uMthetho weSiseko soPhando-nzulu weSizwe, we-1998 (uMthetho uNombolo 23 we-1998).Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uza kuphucula isakhono soMzantsi Afrika sokukwazi ukumelana nokhuphiswano kuphuhliso lwezophando-nzulu nokuvelisa okutsha ngolawullo olusebenzayo, olwaneleyo noluququzelelweyo lokubandakanywa koluntu kwezenzululwazi, nobonelelo lweziseko ezingundoqo zophando-nzulu eziphuculilweyo nofikeleleko.

src: It will also improve the responsiveness and effectiveness of research development and innovation provision, to improve the quality of life of South Africans through better alignment with government priorities.
tgt: Kwakhona uza kuphucula indlela uphuhliso loPhando-nzulu olusabela nolusebenza ngokuvakalayo kwalo nokubonelela ukuveliswa kokutsha, ukuphucula umgangatho wobomi babemi baseMzantsi Afrika ngokuhambelana okungcono nemiba ephambili nengundoqo karhulumente.

src: Key Cabinet decisions.
tgt: Izigqibo ezingundoqo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Cabinet adopted the White Paper on Policing.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilamkele iPhepha leNgcaciso ngezobuPolisa.

src: The draft White Paper was first published for public comment in March 2015.
tgt: Idrafti yeli Phepha leNgcaciso lapapashwa okokuqala kwinyanga yoKwindla yowama-2015 ukwenzela ukuba uluntu luhlomle.

src: The paper provides for a police service that is biased towards active citizenry and responds to the existing policing environment.
tgt: Eli phepha libonelele ngenkonzo yezobupolisa ebacingela kakhulu abemi abasebenzayo ize ilandele neemeko ezikhoyo zezobupolisa.

src: It also provides for a South African Police Service and metro police that is accountable and professional.
tgt: Ikwabonelela ngeNkonzo yezobuPolisa yaseMzantsi Afrika neyamapolisa kamasipala ekwaziyo ukuphendula icacise futhi nesebenza ngobuchule nondiliseko.

src: The White Paper also calls for the establishment of a National Police Board which, amongst other tasks, will be responsible for setting up the objective criteria for the recruitment, selection and appointment of new recruits in the police services.
tgt: Eli Phepha leNgcaciso likwafuna ukuba kumiselwe iBhodi yezobuPolisa yeSizwe eza kuthi, phakathi kweminye yemisebenzi yayo, ijongane nokumiselwa kwemimiselo nemigaqo yokukhupha izithuba zemisebenzi, ukukhethwa nokuqeshwa kwamalungu amatsha kwiinkonzo zezobupolisa.

src: Cabinet adopted the White Paper on Safety and Security.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilamkele iPhepha leNgcaciso elingoKhuseleko noKhuselo.

src: The White Paper, which has already been out for public consultation in February 2015, focuses on an integrated and developmental approach to safety beyond policing.
tgt: Eli Phepha leNgcaciso, nebelikhutshwe kwinyanga yoMdumba yowama-2015 ukwenzela ukuba kufakwane imilomo noluntu malunga nalo, ligxile kwindlela edibeneyo neyophuhliso kukhuseleko ngaphaya kobupolisa.

src: It seeks to guide on preventative safety measures for communities.
tgt: Linika isikhokelo kumanyathelo okhuseleko loluntu oluthintelayo.

src: The White Paper identifies all the relevant departments and community-based organisations that contribute to the safety of communities.
tgt: Eli Phepha leNgcaciso lichonge onke amasebe afanelekileyo nemibutho yasekuhlaleni yoLuntu enegalelo kukhuseleko loluntu.

src: Cabinet approved the draft Policy on the Customary Practice of Initiation in South Africa and approved for the Department of Traditional Affairs to commence drafting national legislation on initiation.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele idrafti yoMgaqo-nkqubo woKwenziwa kweSiko loLwaluko eMzantsi Afrika yaza yakwamkela ukuba iSebe leMicimbi yeMveli maliqalise ukuyila umthetho wesizwe ongolwaluko.

src: The policy has already gone through an extensive public consultation process with relevant stakeholders.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo sele udlule kwinkqubo ebanzi yofakwano-mlomo loluntu kunye nabo bonke abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo.

src: The policy provides guidelines that ensure the protection of the traditional custom of the annual initiation of young boys without compromising their safety.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ubonelela ngesikhokelo esiqinisekisa ngokhuseleko lwesiko lemveli lolwaluko lwamakhwenkwe lwaminyaka le kungakhange kubekwe emngciphekweni ukhuseleko lwawo.

src: This forms part of the steps that government is taking to reinforce appropriate and acceptable customs.
tgt: Le yinxalenye yamanyathelo athathwa ngurhulumente ukuqinisa ukwenziwa kweli siko ngendlela efanelekileyo neyamkelekileyo.

src: It restores an acceptable level of accountability to those that run initiation schools and parents that send their children to these schools.
tgt: Ubuyisela izinga elamkelekileyo lokuphendula nokucacisa kwabo baphethe amabhoma nabazali abathumela abantwana babo kulo mabhoma.

src: Cabinet approved the recommendations made by the Committee of Inquiry on the feasibility of trading in rhino horns as one of the options to preserve the country’s rhino population.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izamkele izindululo ezenziwe yiKomiti yoPhando lokuba kunokwenzeka na ukuba kwenziwe kurhwetywe ngeempondo zemikhombe njengenye yeendlela zokusindisa imikhombe yeli lizwe ingabi semngciphekweni wokutshabalala.

src: The recommendations were endorsed by the Interdepartmental Technical Advisory Committee and the Inter-Ministerial Committee appointed to investigate the possibility of legalising commercial international trade in rhino horn.
tgt: Ezi zindululo ziye zaxhaswa yiKomiti yabaCebisi bezobuChwephetshe yamaSebe aHlukeneyo kunye neKomiti yabaPhathiswa echongelwe ukuba yenze uphando lokuba kungenzeka na lwenziwe olusemthethweni ushishino lwehlabathi lorhwebo lweempondo zemikhombe.

src: The recommendations endorse South Africa’s integrated strategic management approach to resolving the poaching of rhino and illegal trade in rhino.
tgt: Ezi zindululo zomeleze indlela yolawulo lobuchule edibeneyo uMzantsi Afrika oyiqwalasele ngayo lo mba ukusombulula ukuzingelwa kwemikhombe ngokungekho mthethweni nokurhweba ngemikhombe okungekhomthethweni.

src: The committee recommends that the current mode of keeping the country’s stock levels be kept as opposed to the trading in rhino horns.
tgt: Ikomiti icebisa ukuba le ndlela yangoku yokugcina izinga lomhlambi okhoyo ugcinwe unjalo kunokuba kushishinwe ngeempondo zemikhombe.

src: The country’s strategic approach entails security community empowerment biological management responsive legislative provisions that are effectively implemented and enforced and demand management.
tgt: Indlela yobuchule eliyisebenzisayo eli lizwe iquka ukhuselo ukuxhotyiswa koluntu ulawulo lwezenzulu-lwazi ngezilwanyana imithetho esabela ngqo kulo mngeni nesetyenziswa futhi inyanzeliswe ngokubonakalayo nolawulo lwezinga lokufunwa kweemveliso zemikhombe.

src: Cabinet approved the following 2016 commemorative coin designs:a) The National Geographic Coin Series – Big Cats Initiative: ‘The Cheetah’.b) The Sterling-silver crown and tickey coin series ‘South African inventions – ‘Dolosse’.The coin designs, together with their proclamations, will be printed in the Government Gazette, and will then be manufactured and sold through the normal channels.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuyilwa kweenkozo zemali zesikhumbuzo sowama-2016:a) UThotho lweeNkozo zeMali ze-National Geographic – Iphulo leeKati eziNkulu: ‘INgwenkala’.b) Uthotho lweeNkozo zeMali zesiThsaba sePonti neTiki sesilivere ‘izinto eziqanjwe eMzantsi Afrika’ – ‘i-Dolosse’Uyilo lweenkozo zemali, kunye nezibhengezo zazo, ziza kupapshwa kwiPhephandaba loMbuso, ize emva koko ziveliswe ize zithengiswe ngokweendlela zesiqhelo.

src: Upcoming events.
tgt: Imisitho ezayo.

src: President Zuma will between the 18 and 22 April 2016 undertake working visits to member states of the Southern Africa Custom Union (SACU) which include Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho and Swaziland.
tgt: Phakathi komhla we-18 nowama-22 kuTshazimpuzi uMongameli uZuma uza kuthatha utyelelo lwaseburhulumenteni kumazwe angamalungu oMbutho waseMazantsi e-Afrika waMazwe angaHlawulisani Rhafu yoRhwebo (i-SACU) noluza kuquka iNamibia, iBotswana, iLesotho neSwaziland.

src: The visits will enhance the important role that SACU plays in promoting regional integration and economic development of all its members.
tgt: Olu tyelelo luza kuqinisa indima ebalulekileyo edlalwa yi-SACU ekukhuthazeni ukudityaniswa kommandla nophuhliso lwezoqoqosho lwamazwe angamalungu wayo.

src: The President will undertake a State Visit to the Islamic Republic of Iran on 23 and 24 April 2016 to strengthen political and economic engagements between the two countries.
tgt: Ngomhla wama-23 nowama-24 kuTshazimpuzi wowama-2016 uMongameli uza kuthatha uTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni oluya kwi-Islamic Republic of Iran ukomeleza unxibelelwano lwezopolitiko nolwezoqoqosho phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.

src: The President will lead the National Freedom Day celebrations on 27 April 2016 in Limpopo, Giyani Stadium under the theme: “Together building better communities – Local Government is everyone’s business”.Cabinet calls on all South Africans and sectors to demonstrate their patriotism by participating in the various events commemorating Freedom Month.
tgt: UMongameli uza kukhokela imibhiyozo yoSuku lweSizwe lweNkululeko ngomhla wama-27 kuTshazimpuzi wowama-2016 eLimpopo, kumaBala eMidlalo aseGiyani phantsi komxholo othi: “Sisonke sakha uluntu olungcono – ooRhulumente beeNgingqi yingxaki yomntu wonke”.IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika namacandelo ukuba babonakalise ukuba ngabathandi-besizwe ngokuthatha inxaxheba kwimisitho emininzi yokubhiyozela iNyanga yeNkululeko.

src: During the upcoming weeks, Parliament will be holding departmental Budget Votes.
tgt: Kwezi veki zizayo, iPalamente izakuba iqhuba iiNgxoxo-mpikiswano zeVoti zoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lwamasebe karhulumente.

src: The respective departmental Executives will unpack their operational plans for the 2016/17 financial year.
tgt: Amalungu eKhabhinethi amasebe awohlukahlukeneyo aza kucacisa izicwangciso zawo zokusebenza zonyaka-mali wowama-2016/17.

src: Members of the public will be informed about service-delivery programmes of government.
tgt: Amalungu oluntu aza kwaziswa malunga neenkqubo zonikezelo-nkonzo zikarhulumente.

src: Cabinet’s position on key issues in the environment.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba esematheni.

src: Cabinet welcomed the response and subsequent apology by President Zuma to the Constitutional Court judgment relating to compliance with remedial actions set out in a report of the Public Protector.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela impendulo elandelwe kukucelwa koxolo nguMongameli uZuma kwisiGwebo seNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko ngokumalunga nokuthotyelwa kwamanyathelo okulungisa acaciswe kwingxelo yoMkhuseli woLuntu.

src: Cabinet is studying the judgment to establish if there are any other actions to be undertaken to strengthen the role of the Public Service.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isasiphonononga esi sigwebo ukuze iqonde ukuba akhona na amanye amanyathelo ekufuneka athathwe ukuqinisa indima kaRhulumente.

src: The Constitutional Court judgment reinforces and asserts South Africa’s constitutional democracy.
tgt: Isigwebo seNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko someleza sikwaqinisekisa ngolawulo lwentando yesininzi lwaseMzantsi Afrika olusekelwe kumgaqo-siseko.

src: Cabinet noted the actions by the four banks that gave notice to close the bank account of a company.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwaqaphele amanyathelo eebhanki ezine ezithe zakhupha izaziso zokuvala ii-akhawunti zenkampani.

src: Whilst Cabinet appreciate the terms and conditions of the banks, the acts may deter future potential investors who may want to do business in South Africa.
tgt: Ngeli xesha iKhabhinethi iyiqonda imiselo nemiqathango yeebhanki, la manyathelo asenokugxotha abo bebesenokuba ngabatyali-mali kwixesha elizayo abasenokufuna ukwenza ushishino eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Cabinet has endorsed that the Ministers of Finance, Labour and Mineral Resources should open a constructive engagement with the banks to find a lasting solution to this matter.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumelene ukuba uMphathiswa wezeMali, owezabaSebenzi noweMithombo yeziMbiwa ukuba baqale iingxoxo zokubonisana nokucweya kunye nezi bhanki ukufumana isisombululo esiyakuhlala simile ngalo mba.

src: Cabinet congratulated the Minister of Health, Dr Aaron Motsoaledi, who received the USAID-TB international award in recognition of his leadership in the global fight against tuberculosis (TB) as well as championing South Africa's and regional initiatives in the screening, treatment and prevention of TB TB/HIV co-infection and multi-drug resistant TCabinet welcomes the nomination of South Africa as the 2016 recipient of the Distinguished Diplomatic Service Award by the World Affairs Council in Washington, DAs the first African country to receive this award, it recognises the country’s outstanding commitment to global education, international affairs and global communications to advance our national interests.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana noMphathiswa wezeMpilo, uGq Aaron Motsoaledi, nothe wafumana imbasa yehlabathi i-USAID-TB ngenxa yendlela akhokele ngayo iphulo lehlabathi jikelele lokulwa isifo sephepha (i-TB) kwakunye nokuba nguvulindlela kumaphulo oMzantsi Afrika nawommandla ekuhlolweni, unyango nokuthintelwa kwe-TB usuleleko lwe-TB nayiNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (i-HIV) kunye ne-TB enganyangekiyo.

src: Cabinet commends the Minister of International Relations and Cooperation, Ms Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, for her contribution to South Africa’s international engagements, which are driven by the vision of a “united African continent that is peaceful, democratic, non-racial, non-sexist and prosperous, and which contributes to a just and equitable world.”.
