tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuphakanyiswa kwegama loMzantsi Afrika njengelizwe eliza kuwongwa ngeMbasa yeeNkonzo Zozakuzo ezikuDidi oluPhezulu liBhunga leMicimbi yeHlabathi eWashington DNjengelizwe lokuqala lase-Afrika ukufumana le mbasa, ingqina ukuzinikela okungathethekiyo kweli lizwe kwezemfundo yehlabathi jikelele, kwimicimbi yehlabathi nonxibelelwano nehlabathi ukuqhubela phambili iimfuno zethu zesizwe.

src: Cabinet welcomes the appointment by President Zuma of Advocate Jan Lekhoa Mothibi, as the Head of the Special Investigating Unit, and wishes him all the best in his new responsibilities of combating corruption and maladministration.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imothulela umnqwazi uMphathiswa woBudlelwane bamaZwe ngamaZwe neNtsebenziswano, uNksz Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, ngegalelo lakhe kunxibelelwano loMzantsi Afrika namazwe ngamazwe, noluqhutywa ngumbono “welizwekazi le-Afrika elimanyeneyo nelinoxolo, elilawulwa ngentando yesininzi, olungenabuhlanga, olungenacalucalulo ngokwesini nelihlumayo, nelithi lenze igalelo kwihlabathi elilungileyo nekulinganwayo kulo.”.

src: Cabinet conveys its heartfelt condolences to the Makwetu family and the Pan Africanist Congress on the passing of Mr Clarence Makwetu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuchongwa kuka-Advocate Jan Lekhoa Mothibi, njengentloko yeCandelo loPhando oluKhethekileyo (i-SIU) nguMongameli uZuma, kwaye imnqwenela okuhle kodwa kulo msebenzi wakhe umtsha wokulwa urhwaphilizo nolawulo olugwenxa.

src: Mr Makwetu will be remembered for his immense contribution and personal sacrifices to the liberation movement and the establishment of the new democratic South Africa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano kusapho lakwaMakwetu kunye nombutho i-Pan Africanist Congress ngokusweleka kukaMnu Clarence Makwetu.

src: The President declared a Special Provincial Official Funeral for the liberation struggle stalwart.
tgt: UMnu Makwetu uza kukhunjulwa ngegalelo lakhe elikhulukazi nokuzenza idini kumzabalazo wenkululeko nokusekwa koMzantsi Afrika omtsha wolawulo lwentando yesininzi.

src: Cabinet conveys its heartfelt condolences to the Naidoo family on the passing of Mr Kumaran Naidoo.
tgt: UMongameli ubhengeze iinkonzo yoMngcwabo oseSikweni oKhethekileyo wePhondo kweli qhawe lomzabalazo wenkululeko.

src: Mr Naidoo was the Acting Director-General of the Department of Economic Development.
tgt: UMnu Naidoo ebenguMlawuli-Jikelele oliBambela weSebe loPhuhliso lwezoQoqosho.

src: He previously served as the Chief Financial Officer of the Department of Trade and Industry.
tgt: Ngaphambili ebesebenza njengeGosa lezeZimali eliyiNtloko leSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino.

src: Mr Naidoo has contributed immensely in financial management within the Public Service.
tgt: UMnu Naidoo ube negalelo elikhulukazi kulawulo lwezezimali kwiNkonzo kaRhulumente.

src: Cabinet expressed its appreciation on the contribution made by Mr William Smith, who served as Cabinet Secretariat.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ombulelo kwigalelo elenziwe nguMnu William Smith, obesenza kwiQonga looNobhala leKhabhinethi.

src: Mr Smith retired at the end of March after serving the Public Service for 27 years.
tgt: UMnu Smith uthathe umhlala-phantsi ekupheleni kweyoKwindla emva kokuphangelela iNkonzo kaRhulumente iminyaka engama-27.

src: Cabinet wishes him well on his retirement.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imnqwenelela okuhle kodwa kumhlala-phantsi wakhe.

src: The Cabinet was briefed about the Report of the Commission of Inquiry into Allegations of Fraud, Corruption, Impropriety or Irregularity in the Strategic Defence Procurement Package (Arms Procurement Commission) which was released by the President this morning.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe malunga neNgxelo yeKhomishini yoPhando malunga neziTyholo zobuQhetseba, uRhwaphilizo, iMposiso okanye iziPhene kwiSivumelwano seNtengo yeziXhobo zoMkhosi zobuChule (iKhomishini yeNtengo yeziXhobo) ethe yakhutshwa nguMongameli kusasa nje.

src: The Report has found no evidence of wrongdoing, bribery, fraud or corruption in the arms procurement process, As Government we welcome the findings of the Commission.
tgt: Le Ngxelo ayifumanisanga bungqina bubonakalisa bugwenxa, kunyoba, buqhetseba okanye rhwaphilizo kwinkqubo yokuthengwa kwezixhobo.

src: We have been vindicated as we have stated over many years that there was no wrongdoing and that the procurement had been above board.
tgt: Liye lahlanjwa igama lethu njengokuba besisoloko sisitsho kwiminyaka emininzi edlulileyo ukuba akukho bugwenxa kwaye le nkqubo yokuthengwa ibimsulwa ingenamakhwiniba.

src: We trust that the findings will bring closure to this long drawn out matter.
tgt: Siyathemba ukuba ezi ziphumo ziza kuwuvala lo mba ubukade urhuqwa ixesha elide.

src: We join President Zuma in thanking Justice Willie Seriti and Judge Thekiso Musi, all the witnesses, including former President Thabo Mbeki, evidence leaders, legal teams, staff and those who contributed to making the work of the Commission a success.
tgt: Nathi njengoMongameli uZuma sibulela uJaji Willie Seriti noJaji Thekiso Musi, onke amangqina, kuquka nowayesakuba nguMongameli uThabo Mbeki, abetshutshisi ababegoca-goca amangqina ngemibuzo, amagqwetha, abasebenzi nabo bathe benza igalelo ekwenzeni ukuba umsebenzi wale Khomishini ube yimpumelelo.

src: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.
tgt: IzikhundlaZonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo.

src: Mr Siyabonga Gama as Group Executive and Mr Garry Pita as Group Chief Financial Officer of Transnet.
tgt: UMnu Siyabonga Gama njengosa leGosa eliPhezulu lesiGqeba soLawulo noMnu Gary Pita njengeGosa lezeZimali eliyiNtloko lwakwa-Transnet.

src: Implementation of Key Government Programmes.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.

src: Cabinet welcomes President Jacob Zuma’s State Visit of to the Islamic Republic of Iran, which escalates economic and trade relations between both countries, through the signing of several agreements and commitments.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalwamkela utyelelo lukaMongameli uJacob Zuma lwasebuRhulumenteni e-Islamic Republic of Iran, nolwandisa ubudlelwane bezoqoqosho norhwebo phakathi kwala mazwe omabini, ngokutyikitywa kwezivumelwano nezibhambathiso eziliqela.

src: President Jacob Zuma and President Hasan Rouhani strengthened cooperation in the fields of trade, education and skills development science and technology energy, including petrochemical gas exploration and refining capacity agriculture mining and mineral beneficiation infrastructure development and transport finance, banking and insurance and tourism.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma noMongameli uHasan Rouhani bayiqinisile intsebenziswano kumacandelo ezorhwebo, ezemfundo nophuhliso lwezakhono inzululwazi nobuchwepheshe ezamandla kuquka nokuhlolwa kwe-oli kunye namandla okucolwa kwayo ezolimo imigodi nezokuxhamlisa kwezemigodi uphuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo kunye nezothutho ezezimali, ezebhanki neze-inshorensi nokhenketho.

src: All of which contributes to the implementation of the National Development Plan.
tgt: Xa zizonke zenza igalelo ekuphunyezweni kwesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP).Kwimiba yezehlabathi, ezi nkokheli zimbini zivumelene ukuba makuqiniswe isimemo sokuhlaziywa nokuziza iinguqu kuMbutho weZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) ingakumbi iBhunga loKhuselo le-UN, ukuze lincede nezizwe ezinoqoqosho elisakhulayo.

src: On the international front, the two leaders agreed to intensify the call for the reform of the United Nations especially the UN Security Council, in the interests of the developing world.
tgt: Ezi ziphumo zomeleza uTyelelo lukaMongameli oluyiNxalenye yomsebenzi kwi-United Arab Emirates (i-AEU) apho omabini la mazwe ahlaziye khona isivumelwano sawo ekudibaniseni nasekuphakamiseni ubudlelwane benkululeko, ingakumbi kwezorhwebo, kwimiba yotyalo-mali neyezoqoqosho kubudlelwane bobuchule obudibeneyo.

src: These outcomes reinforced the President’s Working Visit to the United Arab Emirates (UAE) where both states renewed their commitment towards the consolidation and elevation of bilateral relations, particularly in the trade, investment and economic fields into a comprehensive strategic partnership.
tgt: Oku kwakhela phezu koTyelelo lukaMongameli uJacob Zuma lwasebuRhulumenteni lwenyanga yeNkanga yowama-2011 nolwakhokelela ekusekweni kweKhomishini eDibeneyo yoMzantsi Afrika ne-Unite Arab Emirates olwathi lwakhawulezisa isantya esipheleleyo sorhwebo phakathi kwala mazwe mabini ukususela kwiibhiliyoni zeerandi ezili-13 ngowama-2011 ukuya kwiibhiliyoni zeerandin ezingama-27 ngowama-2015.UMzantsi Afrika ne-United Arab Emirates ukwavumelene ngokwandisa intsebenziswano yokusebenzisa ithuba elivela kuQoqosho laseLwandle, ukuthumela kumazwe angaphandle, iimveliso zezolimo zaseMzantsi Afrika, iimveliso ezenziweyo kwaye ngokukodwa ukuthengwa kwezixhobo zokhuselo nobudlelwane.

src: This built on President Jacob Zuma’s State Visit in November 2011 which saw the establishment of the SA-UAE Joint Commission that accelerated total trade momentum between the two countries from R13 billion in 2011 to R27 billion in 2015.South Africa and the UAE also agreed to expand cooperation to take advantage of opportunities in the Ocean Economy, to promote the export of South African agricultural products, manufactured products and particularly defence procurement and partnerships.
tgt: Olu tyelelo lukwakhuthaza ukuxhotyiswa kolwakhiwo lweziseko ezingundoqo olugxile ekunikeni iinkampani zaseMzantsi Afrika amathuba kwi-EXPO 2020 eDubai, kwakunye nentsebenziswano kwicandelo lezoxolo, ukhuseleko nozinzo.

src: The visit also promoted South African infrastructure building capacity targeting opportunities for South African companies at EXPO 2020 in Dubai, as well as cooperation in the field of peace, security and stability.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwamkele amanyathelo angqongqo athe amiselwa nguMphathiswa wezeMidlalo noLonwabo uFikile Mbalula ngokusebenzisa uXwebhu lweNguqu ukwakha ngokutsha imbonakalo yezemidlalo nolonwabo eqhekekileyo nenocalucalulo olunzulu.

src: Cabinet welcomed the firm measures that have been put in place by the Minister of Sport and Recreation Fikile Mbalula to reconstruct the fragmented and deeply discriminatory sport and recreation landscape through its Transformation Charter.
tgt: Oku kuza kukhawulezisa inguqu ebhekisele kwinkqubo yezemidlalo emanyeneyo exhaswa yimigomo yolawulo lwentando yesininzi, umakulingwane, ukwenza elubala, ukuqinisekisa ukuba wonke ubani uthatha inxaxheba, ukufikelela nokwanda kokuthathwa kwenxaxheba ngokweenjongo ze-NDIKhabhinethi iyazamkela iingxoxo-mpikiswano zohlahlo lwabiwo-mali ezenziwa ngamasebe ngamasebe nengxelo ezingena nzulu ekucaciseni inkqubela eseyenziwe ukuphucula ubomi babemi baseMzantsi Afrika.

src: This will accelerate transformation towards a unified sport system underpinned by the principles of democracy, equity, transparency, demographic representation, access and increased participation in line with the aspirations of the National Development Plan.
tgt: Oku kubonakalisa ukufezekiswa kweNkqubo-sikhokelo yesiCwangciso-qhinga sesiGaba esiPhakathi nesisisondeza ekufezekisweni koMbono wama-2030 wesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso.

src: Cabinet welcomes the budget votes being presented by various departments with extensive reports outlining the progress made towards improving the lives of South Africans.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba bamamele futhi bazibukele ezi ngxoxo-mpikiswano zohlahlo lwabiwo-mali kuwo onke amajelo eendaba ukuze bayiqonde ngcono iNkqubo yokuSebenza kaRhulumente.

src: This demonstrates implementation of the Medium Term Strategic Framework which takes us closer to the realisation of Vision 2030 of the National Development Plan.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela ukuzibophelela okuqhubekayo ukwenza inguqu enentsingiselo emisebenzini ngenxa yeziphumo ezivela kwiNgxelo yoNyaka yeKhomishini ye-16 kaMakulingwane eMisebenzini kubo bonke abaqeshi abachongiweyo neyathi yamiselwa phantsi komxholo othi “Iinguqu zibalulekile”.

src: Cabinet calls on South Africans to follow the budget votes on various media platforms to better understand Government’s Programme of Action.
tgt: Le Ngxelo iyamnceda urhulumente ukuba abuqonde ubume bomakulingwane emisebenzini kweli lizwe nenkqubela yakhe ekwenziweni kwenguqu emisebenzini kunyaka wama-2015.

src: Cabinet calls for continued commitment to secure meaningful workplace transformation in view of the findings from the 16th Commission for Employment Equity Annual Report for all designated employers which was launched under the theme “Transformation does make business sense”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana neSebe lezokuHlaliswa koLuntu ngokunikezela ngezigidi eziyi-4,3 zezindlu namathuba ezezindlu ukususela mhla kwafika ulawulo lwentando yesininzi.

src: These opportunities include 2, 806 235 fully subsidized houses (BNG houses), 121 784 social/rental housing, 6329 Financial Linked Individual Subsidy Programme and 986 608 serviced sites.
tgt: La mathuba aquka izindlu zenkxaso epheleleyo ezingama-2, 806 235 (izindlu ze-BNG), izindlu zezentlalo/zokurenta ezingama-121 784, izindlu zeNkqubo yeNkxaso-mali yoMntu ngaMnye ezingama-121 784 kunye neziza ezifumana iinkonzo ezingundoqo ezingama-986 608.Le mpumelelo iyimbali ibonelele ngezindlu abantu abangaphezulu kwezigidi ezingama-20 kwaye ukubhiyozela le mpumelelo isebe limisele iphulo lesizwe lokubonakalisa le mpumelelo yesizwe.

src: This historic milestone has provided a roof for more than 20 million people and to celebrate this achievement the department has launched a national campaign to profile the country’s success.
tgt: Oku kumiselwa kwesizwe kwenzeke e-COSMO City, neyenye yeeprojekthi eziphambili ezidibeneyo kwilizwe jikelele nekwabhiyozela iminyaka elishumi yabakho.

src: The national launch took place in COSMO City, one of the integrated priority projects around the country which is also celebrating ten years of its existence.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibulela bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ngegalelo labo, lokuzinikela nokusebenza kwabo ngamandla ekuqinisekiseni ukuba isidima sabemi baseMzantsi Afrika abahlelelekileyo siyabuyiselwa ngezokuhlaliswa koluntu.

src: Cabinet thanked all South Africans for their contributions, dedication and hard work in ensuring that the dignity of South Africans in need is restored through human settlements.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamncoma uNobhala Jikelele weZizwe eziManyeneyo ngokuqhuba uMsitho wokuTyikitya okwiNqanaba eliPhezulu wesiVumelwano saseParis, nesithe samkelwa ngaMazwe angamaLungu ali-176 kweyoMnga yowama-2015.

src: Cabinet commends the United Nations Secretary-General for convening the High-Level Signing Ceremony of the Paris Agreement, which was adopted by 176 Parties in December 2015.
tgt: Ukutyikitywa kwesiVumelwano saseParis kuphawula inyathelo lokuqala ekuphunyezweni kwaso nokuzakukhokela amalinge ehlabathi ekunciphiseni ukukhutshwa kweegesi ezingcolisa umoya nokukwazi ukulwa imingeni ehambelana nako ebangelwa kukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu.

src: The signing of the Paris Agreement marked the first step in its implementation which will guide international efforts to limit greenhouse gas emissions and to meet all the associated challenges posed by climate change.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikulinde ngomdla ukuqukunjelwa kweenkqubo zokugunyaziswa zalapha ekhaya, ngawo onke, ukuvumela ukungena kwangexesha ukwenzela ukufezekiswa ngokupheleleyo kwesiVumelwano saseParis ngowama-2020.

src: Cabinet looks forward to the conclusion of the respective domestic ratification procedures, by all, to enable timely entry into force for full implementation of the Paris Agreement by 2020.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwaqaphela ukuba iSebe lezeNdalo lizibandakanye neSebe lezoKhenketho ekuqaliseni iilebhu zokubonelela ezinesihloko esithi “iLebhu yeNzululwazi ngeZilwanyana neziTyalo: Ikhulisa igalelo loqoqosho lwemithombo yobunzululwazi ngezilwanyana nezityalo yaseMzantsi Afrika” ukususela ngomhla we-10 kuTshazimpuzi ukuya kowe-13 kwekaCanzibe yowama-2016.Injongo kukuphumeza amandla oqoqosho lobutyebi bezenzululwazi ngezilwanyana nezityalo zaseMzantsi Afrika achazwe kuyilo lwesiCwangciso-qhinga soQoqosho lweNzululwazi ngeziLwanyana neziTyalo seSizwe esiphunyezwe yiKhabhinethi kweyeKhala yowama-2015 ukwenzela ukuthatha inxaxheba koluntu.

src: Key Cabinet decisions.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi ezingundoqo.

src: Cabinet approved the Industrial Policy Action Plan (IPAP) 2016/17 – 2018/19, which is a key pillar of the President’s Nine-Point Plan and contributes towards implementation of the National Development Plan.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isamkele isiCwangciso soMgaqo-nkqubo wokuSebenza kwezoShishino (i-IPAP) sowama-2016/17 – 2018/19, nesiyintsika engundoqo yesiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba sikaMongameli kwaye senza igalelo ekuphunyezweni kwesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso.

src: This is the eighth annual iteration of successive government industrialisation plans which builds on the achievements, policy platforms and programmes of previous iterations.
tgt: Oku kukuphindaphindwa kwaminyaka le kwesibhozo kwesicwangciso sikarhulumente semizi-mveliso esiyimpumelelo nesakhelwa kwiimpumelelo, amaqonga emigaqo-nkqubo neenkqubo zokuphindaphindwa kwangaphambili.

src: IPAP 2016/17 seeks to achieve a higher impact industrial policy in difficult economic circumstances.
tgt: I-IPAP yowama-2016/17 iinjongo zayo kukwenza impembelelo enkulu kumgaqo-nkqubo wezoshishino phantsi kweemeko ezinzima zezoqoqosho.

src: These include the on-going effects of the global economic recession including the steel crisis and commodity slump as well as the severe drought and other significant domestic constraints.
tgt: Ekukho phakathi kwazo impembelelo eqhubekayo yokudodobala kwezoqoqosho kwihlabathi jikelele kuquka iimeko emaxongo kurhwebo lwezesinyithi kunye nezimbiwa kwakunye nembalela enkulu neminye imiqobo ebalulekileyo yalapha ekhaya.

src: Achievements from the previous year include the saving of approximately 67 000 jobs and the creation of an estimated 7 000 new decent jobs in the Clothing and Textile Leather and Footwear sector.
tgt: Imisebenzi eyimpumelelo yonyaka ophelileyo iquka ukusindiswa kwemisebenzi emalunga nama-67 000 nokudalwa kwemisebenzi emitsha endilisekileyo ethelekelelwa kuma-7 000 kwicandelo leMpahla nelezeziKhumba neZihlangu.

src: The Agro-processing sub-sector is one of the largest domestic manufacturing sectors by employment, providing an estimated 216 090 jobs in 2015 compared to 208 822 in 2014.
tgt: Icandelwana elisebenza phantsi kokucolwa nokulungiswa kweemveliso zezolimo lelinye lamacandelo okuvelisa amakhulu apha ekhaya ngokwengqesho, abonelela ngemisebenzi ethelekelelwa kuma-216 090 ngowama-2015 xa kuthelekiswa nama-208 822 ngowama-2014.

src: Over R600 million worth of investment was attracted in 2015/16, laying the basis for strengthening enterprise development with a focus on rural communities.
tgt: Lutyalo-mali olungaphezulu kwezigidi ezingama-600 zeerandi athe atsalwe ngowama-2015/16, elusisiseko sokomeleza uphuhliso lwamashishini amancinci olugxile kuluntu lwasemaphandleni.

src: Cabinet approved the Final Integrated Urban Development Framework and 2016/19 Implementation Plan.
tgt: Khabhinethi iyamkele iNkqubo-sikhokelo yokuGqibela yoPhuhliso lweeDolophu oluDibeneyo nesiCwangciso sokuPhumeza sowama-2016/19.

src: The overall outcome of the Integrated Urban Development Framework is spatial transformation.
tgt: Iziphumo ezipheleleyo zeNkqubo –sikhokelo yoPhuhliso lweDolophu oludibeneyo yinguqu ngokwabala omhlaba.

src: This marks a new deal for South African cities and towns, which will steer urban growth towards a sustainable growth model of compact, connected and coordinated cities and towns, which are safer, resource efficient and good places to work and live in.
tgt: Oku kuza notshintsho olutsha kwizixeko needolophu zaseMzantsi Afrika, nokuza kuqhubela uhlumo lwasezidolophini kwindlela eluqilima yohlumo oluzinzileyo, iqhagamshelanise ize iququzelele izixeko needolophu, neziyindawo ekhuselekileyo, ezinemithombo esebenzayo futhi neziyindawo elungileyo ukuba umntu angasebenza ahlale kuzo.

src: This responds to the National Development Plan directive to develop an urban development policy that will ensure proper planning, infrastructure investments and management to support growth and unlock the economic potential of our cities and towns.
tgt: Oku kusabela kumyalelo wesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso wokuqulunqa umgaqo-nkqubo wophuhliso lwedolophu oza kuqinisekisa ngokucwangcisa okufanelekileyo, utyalo-mali kwiziseko ezingundoqo nolawulo lokuxhasa uhlumo nokuvulela amandla ezoqoqosho lwezixeko needolophu.

src: Cabinet approved publication of the Draft National Career Development Services Policy – Building an effective and Integrated Career Development Services System for South Africa, in the Government Gazette for public comment.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukupapashwa kweDrafti yoMgaqo-nkqubo weSizwe weeNkonzo zoPhuhliso lwamaKhondo – uKwakhela uMzantsi Afrika iNkqubo esebenzayo neDibeneyo yeeNkonzo zoPhuhliso lwamaKhondo, kwiPhephandaba loMbuso ukwenzela ukuba uluntu luhlomle.

src: The draft Policy once implemented will provide a coordinated approach to quality career development services for all citizens.
tgt: Le drafti yoMgaqo-nkqubo xa sele iphunyeziwe iza kubonelela ngendlela edibeneyo yeenkonzo zophuhliso lwamakhondo asemgangathweni kubo bonke abemi.

src: This will enable them to make informed career choices to obtain employment, contribute to society and build the South African WEBTOKEN Development Services plays a key role in helping labour markets work and education systems meet their goals.
tgt: Oku kuza kubenza bakwazi ukuthatha izigqibo zokukhetha amakhondo afanelekileyo ukuze bakwazi ukufumana imisebenzi, benze igalelo kuluntu nasekwakheni uqoqosho lwaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: This contributes towards the achievement of the National Development Plan recommendations of promoting economic growth and employment, matching of employed workers to jobs and increasing skills development and the number of university graduates.
tgt: IiNkonzo zoPhuhliso lwamaKhondo zidlala indima engundoqo ekuncedeni umsebenzi wokubonelela ngemisebenzi nenkqubo yezemfundo ukuba zifikelele kwiinjongo zazo ezijongise kuzo.

src: Cabinet was briefed on implementation of the National Evaluation System and approved the Annual report 2014/15 and the fifth National Evaluation Plan for 2016/17 to 2018/19, as part of the drive to improve service delivery,The National Evaluation System emanates from the National Evaluation Policy Framework which ensures that credible and objective evidence from evaluations is incorporated in processes of planning, budgeting, organisational improvement, policy review, as well as on-going programme and project management so as to improve performance.
tgt: Oku kwenza igalelo ekuphumezeni izindululo zesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso sokukhuthaza uhlumo lwezoqoqosho nemisebenzi, ukuthelekisa abasebenzi abaphangelayo nemisebenzi nokwandiswa kophuhliso lwezakhono kunye noninzi lwabo banezidanga zasedyunivesiti.

src: Forty-seven (47) evaluations have been completed or are underway, covering R75 billion of government expenditure.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngokuphunyezwa kweNkqubo yoVavanyo yeSizwe yaza yamkela iNgxelo yonyaka wama-2014/15 kunye nesiCwangciso soVavanyo seSizwe sesihlanu seminyaka yowama-2016/17 ukuya kowama-2018/19, njengenxalenye yendlela yokuphucula unikezela lweenkonzo.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the evaluation findings and approved recommendations with a view to increase impact from the implementation of the Expanded Public Works Programme Social Sector (EPWP-SS).This Programme plays an important social protection role for unemployed able bodied adults, by drawing them into productive work and receiving a monthly stipend of an average amount of R1 517.
tgt: INkqubo yoVavanyo yeSizwe ivela kwiNkqubo-sikhokelo yoMgaqo-nkqubo woVavanyo weSizwe oqinisekisa ukuba ubungqina bovavanyo obuthembakeleyo nobungakhethe-cala buyafakwa kwiinkqubo zokucwangcisa, ukwenza uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali, ukuphuculwa kweziko, uhlaziyo lomgaqo-nkqubo, kwakunye nolawulo lwenkqubo oluqhubekayo nolawulo lweprojekthi ukuze kuphuculwe indlela ekusetyenzwa ngayo.

src: The recommendations focus on improving implementation to reduce inefficiencies in decision-making, implementation (payments of stipends) and provision of training, as well as coordination.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngeziphumo zovavanyo nezindululo ezamkelweyo ngenjongo yokwandisa impembelelo yokuphunyezwa kweCandelo lezeNtlalo leNkqubo yeMisebenzi yoLuntu eNatyisiweyo (i-EPWP-SS).

src: Cabinet was briefed on the findings and endorsed the recommendations of the design and implementation evaluation of the Urban Settlement Development Grant and its Improvement Plan.
tgt: Le Nkqubo idlala indima ebalulekileyo kukhuseleko lwezentlalo lwabantu abadala abakwaziyo ukusebenza abangaphangeliyo, ngokubatsalela kumsebenzi onenkqubela baze bafumene ukuvuzwa kwenyanga okungumyinge we-R 1 517.

src: The findings support retaining the Urban Settlement Development Grant as a supplementary grant that funds a wider notion of sustainable and equitable human settlements for the benefit of poor and moderate income households.
tgt: Uninzi lweenkqubo zecandelo lezentlalo zibonelela ngeenkonzo ezikhethekileyo kuluntu oluhlelelekileyo noluhluphekayo.

src: This is instrumental in achieving the targets from the Medium Term Strategic Framework provision of 1 495 million housing opportunities in quality living environments by 2019.
tgt: I-EPWP-SS ikhule ngokuphindaphindeneyo phakathi kwesigaba sokuqala nesigaba sesibini, ukususela kwiinkqubo ezintlanu ukuya kwezi ngama-22 nezikhokelele ekubeni eli candelo lifikelele kumathuba emisebenzi engama-175 769 kwisigaba sokuqala namathuba emisebenzi engama-866 246 kwisigaba sesibini, ngaphezulu kakhulu kuma-750 000 ebesizimisele kuwo.

src: Cabinet approved the report on the Implementation and Impact Evaluation of the Technology and Human Resources for Industry Programme, the management response to the report and the improvement plan submitted by the Department of Trade and Industry.
tgt: Ezi zindululo zigxile ekuphuculeni ukuphunyezwa ukuze kunciphe ukungathathwa kakuhle kwezigqibo, ukuphunyezwa (iintlawulo nokuvuzwa) nokubonelelwa koqeqesho, kwakunye nokuququzelela.

src: This Programme was introduced by the Department of Trade and Industry in 1992 to strengthen skills development in science, engineering and technology.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngeziphumo yaza yazivuma izindululo zokuyilwa nokuphunyezwa kovavanyo lweSibonelelo soPhuhliso lezokuHlaliswa eziDolophini neSicwangciso sokuPhuculwa kwaso.

src: It contributes to job creation by producing a flow of highly skilled researchers and technology managers for industry and by improving the competitiveness of the participating business organisations.
tgt: Ezi ziphumo zixhasa ukugcinwa kweSibonelelo soPhuhliso lezokuHlaliswa eziDolophini njegesibonelelo soxabangelo nesiyinkxaso-mali yombono obanzi wezokuhlaliswa koluntu ozinzileyo nolinganayo ukwenzela ukuba kuxhamle abahluphekileyo namakhaya amkela imivuzo ephakathi.

src: The Programme is a valid, important and efficient element of innovation support that offers considerable value for money both in terms of technology development and developing human resources and industry-related skills.
tgt: Oku kuyanceda ekufikeleleni kummiselo ovela lwiNkqubo-sikhokelo yesiCwangciso-qhinga sesiGaba esiphakathi ukubonelela ngamathuba ezindlu azizigidi ezi-1 495 kwimeko yezokusingqongileyo yokuhlala okusemgangathweni ngowama-2019.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the findings of the Report by the Ministerial Task Team probe into the allegations of the ‘educator posts for sale’ involving individuals, teacher unions and officials of certain Provincial Education Departments.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele ingxelo engokuphunyezwa nokuVavanywa kweMpembelelo yezobuChwepheshe nemiCimbi yezaBasebenzi yeNkqubo yezoShishino, indlela abalawuli abayihlangabeza ngayo le ngxelo nesiCwangciso sokuphucula esifakwe liSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino.

src: Cabinet endorsed recommendations to deal systematically and pointedly with the WEBTOKEN its final Report the Ministerial Task Team provides a critique of the role played by all stakeholders in the process of the selection and recruitment of WEBTOKEN also notes the significant problems in the current system of appointments to posts in the basic education sector and provides recommendations to assist the Department of Basic Education and the basic education sector in general to address the identified challenges.
tgt: Le Nkqubo yaveliswa liSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino ngowe-1992 ukomeleza uphuhliso lwezakhono kwezenzulu-lwazi, ezobunjineli nobuchwepheshe.

src: Religious leaders and leaders of civil society formations will join government in praying for the further consolidation of democracy, national unity, social cohesion as well as successful and peaceful 2016 Local Government Elections.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhlomela uMthetho wezamaHlathi weSizwe, we-1998 (uMthetho onguNombolo 84 we-1998).Ukuphunyezwa kwezi zihlomelo kuza kuphucula ulawulo lwezamahlathi oluzinzileyo kukhuthaze nokuthatha inxaxheba kwabahlelelekileyo, abaxhomekeke kwezamahlathi ukuze baphila, bathathe inxaxheba kwiBhunga leeNgcebiso lezamaHlathi leSizwe.

src: President Jacob Zuma will launch Africa Month on the National Day of Prayer on 29 April WEBTOKEN 2016 Africa Month will focus on women and youth development initiatives, while we commemorate the 60th year of the Women’s March and the 40th year of the Youth Uprisings in Soweto.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kuzimasa umsitho wokubekwa esihlalweni nokufungiswa kukaMongameli uYoweri Museveni wase-Uganda eKampala ngomhla we-12 kuCanzibe wama-2016.

src: South Africans are urged to participate in the multi-disciplinary programme that involves a wide range of activities including visual arts, theatre, music, lectures and colloquia as well as the 10th anniversary of the African World Heritage Fund.
tgt: Olu tyelelo luphumayo luza kuqhubeka ukomeleza ubudlelwane bala mazwe mabini, uMzantsi Afrika ne-Uganda.

src: Africa Month serves as a platform to reconnect and recommit ourselves to Pan Africanism and African Renaissance in bringing the people of the continent closer.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kukhokela uSuku loMthandazo leSizwe eliza kubanjelwa kumaBala ase-ABSA eDurban ngomhla wama-29 kuTshazimpuzi wama-2016.

src: On 20 May 2016 government will lead the national celebration of the centenary of the University of Fort Hare at the Alice campus in the Eastern Cape.
tgt: Iinkokheli zakwaLizwi kunye neenkokheli zemibutho yoluntu ziza kuzibandakanya norhulumente ekuthandazeleni ukuqhubeka komanyano lwentando yesininzi, umanyano lwesizwe, intlalo- ntle kwakunye noNyulo looRhulumente beeNgingqi lowama-2016 oluza kuba noxolo futhi lube yimpumelelo.

src: In preparation for the main celebration, President Jacob Zuma has established an Inter-Ministerial Committee (IMC) to plan and coordinate the historic centenary celebration.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngezicwangciso zeSebe lezobuGcisa neNkcubeko zokusingatha iNyanga ye-Afrika kuCanzibe yowama-2016 phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukwakha i-Afrika eNgcono neHlabathi eliNgcono” njengenxalenye yemibhiyozo yelizwekazi yokusekwa koMbutho weManyano ye-Afrika (i-OAU), ngoku ebizwa ngokuba yiMbumba yaMazwe ase-Afrika (i-AU) kunye nemisebenzi eyenzileyo.

src: This historic learning institution served as a beacon during our struggle for freedom and is also known as the “crucible of African leadership” with it being the alma mater of anti-apartheid struggle figures such as the great ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukwe, Oliver Tambo and Govan Mbeki.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kumphehlelela iNyanga ye-Afrika ngoSuku loMthandazo leSizwe ngomhla wama-29 kuTshazimpuzi yowama-2016.Ngowama-2016 iNyanga ye-Afrika iza kugxila kumalinge wophuhliso lwabantu basetyhini nolutsha, ngeli xesha siza kube sibhiyozela unyaka wama-60 woMngcelele wooMama nonyaka wama-40 woVukelo loLutsha eSoweto.

src: It is the only Southern African university to have produced five heads of state: Nelson Mandela of South Africa, Yusuf Lule of Uganda, Robert Mugabe of Zimbabwe, Ntsu Mokhehle of Lesotho and Sir Seretse Khama of WEBTOKEN part of the University of Fort Hare’s centenary celebrations Cabinet calls on the Alumni and members of the public to share their Fort Hare memories for the Tell Your Story campaign using the hashtag #MyFortHare.
tgt: Abemi baseMzantsi Afrika bayabongozwa ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kule nkqubo iqulathe iindidi ngeendidi zemisitho nemibhiyozo equka eyobugcisa obubonwayo, izifundo ngedrama, umculo, izifundo neentetho eziqhelekileyo kwakunye ngesikhumbuzo seminyaka eli-10 yeNgxowa-mali yamaFa eHlabathi ase-Afrika.

src: Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa will lead the South Africa delegation to the 26th World Economic Forum (WEF) Africa in Rwanda between 11 and 13 May 2016.
tgt: Le Nyanga ye-Afrika isebenza njengeqonga lokuqhagamshelanisa ngokutsha nokuzibophelela kwethu ngokutsha kuko konke okusenza sibe ngama-Afrika neBuyambo yase-Afrika ngokudibanisa abantu belizwekazi basondelelane.

src: The forum is hosted under the theme: “Connecting Africa’s Resources through Digital Transformation”.Government through its Nine-Point Plan is advancing the country’s own digital transformation.
tgt: Ngomhla wama-20 kuCanzibe wama-2016 urhulumente uza kukhokela umbhiyozo wesizwe wokugqiba kweDyunivesithi iFort Hare iminyaka elikhulu yabakho kwiziko layo eliseDikeni eMpuma Koloni.

src: It is rolling out the first phase of its broadband initiative that will connect more than 5 000 government facilities in eight district municipalities over a three-year period.
tgt: Ukulungiselela umsitho omkhulu wokubhiyoza, uMongameli uJacob Zuma umisele iKomiti yabaPhathiswa (i-IMC) ukuba yenze izicwangciso ize iququzelele lo mbhiyozo wenkulungwane uyimbali.

src: INDABA 2016 at the Inkosi Albert Luthuli Convention Centre in Durban from 7 to 9 May 2016, is a Pan-African platform that will promote our tourism products to international buyers.
tgt: Eli ziko lemfundo liyimbali belisebenza njengenqaba yethemba ngexesha lomzabalazo wethu wenkululeko kwaye laziwa “njengeziko lokupheka iinkokeli ze-Afrika” libe liyidyunivesithi ekwakufundwa kuyo ziinkokheli ezazikumzabalazo wokulwa ucalucalulo ezifana neengqanga oo-ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukhwe, Oliver Tambo noGovan Mbeki.

src: Tourism, as one of the six pillars of economic growth of the National Development Plan, contributed R357 billion to our GDP in 2014 and supported 9 per cent of total employment in South Africa.
tgt: Kuphela kwedyunivesithi yaseMazantsi e-Afrika evelise iintloko zoorhulumente ezintlanu: uNelson Mandela waseMzantsi Afrika, uYusuf Lule wase-Uganda, uRobert Mugabe waseZimbabwe, uNtsu Mokhehle waseLesotho no-Sir Seretse Khama waseBotswana.

src: The World Travel and Tourism Council estimates that tourism will contribute R560 billion to our GDP by 2025 and will support over two million jobs.
tgt: Njengenxalenye yemibhiyozo yenkulungwane iDyunivesithi iFort Hare iKhabhinethi imema bonke abantu ababefunda kule dyunivesithi noluntu jikelele ukuba babalisane ngeenkumbulo zabo ngedyunivesithi iFort Hare nephulo likaBalisa iBali Lakho ngokusebenzisa i- #MyFortHare.

src: Growing the Tourisms impact in the Oceans Economy is a critical pillar of the Nine-Point Plan, informed by the untapped potential of our oceans, which can contribute to economic growth.
tgt: USekela-Mongameli uCyril Ramaphosa uza kukhokela igqiza loMzantsi Afrika ukuya kwingqungquthela yama-26 yeQonga lezoQoqosho leHlabathi (i-WEF) e-Afrika e-Rwanda phakathi komhla we-11 nowe-13 kuCanzibe yowama-2016.

src: The oceans economy and tourism provide tremendous opportunities for economic growth and job creation.
tgt: Eli qonga lisingathwe phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukuqhagamshelanisa iMithombo ye-Afrika ngeNguqu yezebuChwepheshe”.Urhulumente uqhubela phambili inguqu kwezobuchwepheshe yeli lizwe ngesiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba.

src: In commemoration of Workers’ Day on 1 May 2016, Cabinet reiterates the country’s commitment to protect worker rights through our progressive labour legislation.
tgt: INDABA YOWAMA-2016 ebanjelwe kwiZiko leNgqungquthela Inkosi Albert Luthuli eDurban ukususela kumhla we-7 ukuya kowe-9 kuCanzibe yowama-2016, liqonga lokuzingca ngako konke okusenza sibe ngama-Afrika eliza kukhuthaza iimveliso zokhenketho kubathengi behlabathi.

src: Since 1994 government has through legislation such as the Labour Relations Act, the Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Employment Equity Act and Occupational Health and Safety advanced workers’ rights.
tgt: Ukhenketho, njengenye yeentsika ezintandathu zohlumo lwezoqoqosho kwisiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso, lenze igalelo eliyimali ezibhiliyoni ezingama-357 kwiSambuku seMveliso yeSizwe (i-GDP) ngowama-2014 laza laxhasa i-9% kwingqesho epheleleyo yaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Cabinet urges Grade 12 learners to start downloading application forms or apply online to institutions of higher learning as part of the Apply Now/ Khetha Career Guidance Campaign.
tgt: IBhunga lezoHambo eHlabathini noKhenketho lithelekelela ukuba ukhenketho lenze igalelo elizibhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-560 kwi-GDP yethu ngowama-2015 kwaye luza kuxhasa imisebenzi engaphezulu kwezigidi ezibini.

src: The Campaign undertaken annually by the Department of Higher Education and Training, will run nationally until September 2016 and assists learners in making informed choices when applying to institutions of higher learning.
tgt: Ukukhulisa impembelelo yezoKhenketho kuQoqosho lwaseLwandle yintsika ebaluleke kakhulu kwisiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba, ngokubangelwa ngamandla akhoyo kumalwandle wethu, nanokuba negalelo kuhlumo loqoqosho.

src: The draft reviewed Mining Charter further integrates government’s transformation policies and legislation to enhance the ease of doing business, create regulatory clarity, predictability and certainty.
tgt: Uqoqosho lwaselwandle nokhenketho lubonelela ngamathuba angumangaliso ohlumo lwezoqoqosho nokudala imisebenzi.

src: This includes an agreed commitment by the company to spend R1 billion over the next five years to promote small-scale farming and local supplier development, new enterprises, energy and water efficiency technologies and youth development.
tgt: Eli phulo liqhutywa rhoqo ngonyaka liSebe lezeMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho, liza kuqhutya esizweni jikelele kude kube yinyanga yoMsintsi yowama-2016 kwaye linceda abafundi ekukhetheni ngokufanelekileyo xa befaka izicelo kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo.

src: The commitment on jobs including an undertaking to avoid involuntarily retrenchment of workers as a result of the merger and to maintain employment levels at the company for the next five years, are part of a ground-breaking agreement between the company and government to support industrialisation, small business development and job creation.
tgt: Abafundi bayakhuthazwa ukuba baqhagamshelane neZiko leNkonzo zoPhuhliso lwaMakhondo ngokuthumela i-SMS okanye u-“please call me” kua-072 204 5056 okanye 086 999 0123, i-imeyili: EMAILTOKEN, kwikhasi lika-Facebook kwa: WEBTOKEN okanye basebenzise i-Twitter kwa: WEBTOKEN Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba esematheni.

src: In a separate development, Cabinet notes the coming into effect of provisions of the Competition Amendment Act that makes it a criminal offence for directors and management to collude in the fixing of prices, tenders or markets.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo abachaphazelekayo ukuba bahlomle kwidrafti ehlaziyiweyo yoXwebhu lwamaLungelo ngokuXhotyiswa kwabaNtsundu kwezoQoqosho ngokuBanzi (i-BBBEE) kuShishino lwezeMigodi neziMbiwa zaseMzantsi Afrika, lowama-2016 nolwapapashwa kwiPhephandaba loMbuso.

src: These provisions are part of the measures to step up the fight against cartels that damage the economy and impose high prices on consumers.
tgt: Le draftio ihlaziyiweyo yoXwebhu lwezeMigodi ibandakanya imigaqo-nkqubo yenguqu karhulumente nemithetho ngakumbi.

src: We call on businesses in South Africa to compete based on lower prices, more innovation, improved quality of goods offered or superior service to customers rather than on collusion.
tgt: Ikwahambelana namasolotya oMthetho wokuXhotyiswa kwabaNtsundu kwezoQoqosho ngokuBanzi, wama-2003 (uMthetho onguNombo 53 wama-2003) kunye neKhowudi yokuSebenza kaKuhle (iiKhowudi zakwa-DTI).

src: Cabinet noted how highly regulated the banking sector is in South Africa - and globally, and the need for South Africa to comply with international standards like Basel III and Anti-money laundering regulations of the Financial Action Task Force (FATF), which have been previously approved by Cabinet, and supported by underlying legislation approved by Government.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela indlela ekuvunyelwene ukuba mawuphathwe ngayo lo mba nguMphathiswa woPhuhliso lwezoQoqosho ne-AB InBev umaqumrhu okhuphiswano kuluhlu lwemiba ehambelana neemfuno zoluntu.

src: The Twin Peaks system will also regulate market conduct in the banking and broader financial sector.".
tgt: Isivumelwano esenziwe yile nkampani siza kusebenza njengesikhokelo, kwimiba ebalulekileyo kuluntu, nakwezinye iinkampani ezithenga okanye ezizimanya nezinye phantsi kweemeko ezikwafanayo.

src: Cabinet welcomes the outcomes from the WEBTOKENternational Monetary Fund and World Bank Groups Spring Meeting which took place under the theme “Global Challenges, Global Solutions”.
tgt: Oku kuquka isibhambathiso ekuvunyelwene ngaso yile nkampani sokuchitha imali eyibhiliyoni yeerandi kule minyaka mihlanu izayo ukukhuthaza amafama afuyela ukuziphilisa efuya ngomyinge omncinci nophuhliso lababoneleli-zinkonzo balapha ekhaya, amashishini amatsha asakhulayo, ezamandla nobuchwepheshe bokusebenzisa kakuhle amanzi nophuhliso lolutsha.

src: A three-pronged approach to ignite growth at a global level was proposed, encouraging countries to use all policy levers to spur growth, i. e. monetary, fiscal and structural reforms.
tgt: Isibophelelo ngokwemisebenzi siquka ukuthintela ukudendwa ngenkani kwabasebenzi ngenxa yendibanisela yeenkampani nokugcina izinga lengqesho kule nkampani kule minyaka mihlanu ilandelayo, oko yinxalenye yesivumelwano sokuhlahla indlela phakathi kwale nkampani norhulumente ukuxhasa ukwanda kwemizi-mveliso, uphuhliso lwamashishini amancinci nokudala imisebenzi.

src: Countries with monetary and fiscal space were encouraged to do more to boost demand however, implementation of structural reforms was critical for all.
tgt: Komnye omba, iKhabhinethi iqaphela ukuba ukuqalisa ukusebenza kwamasolotya oMthetho-siHlomelo woKhuphiswano owenza ukuba kungabikho mthethweni ukuba abalawuli nabaphathi basebenzisane ukwenze iyelenqe lokunyusa amaxabiso, kwiziniki-maxabiso okanye kurhwebo.

src: This is needed to secure your name on the voters’ roll which will enable eligible voters to exercise their democratic right on 3 August 2016.Cabinet urges eligible voters to ensure that they meet the requirement of providing their address to their local Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) office.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele ukuba icandelo leebhanki lilawulwa ngokwezinga eliphezulu eMzantsi Afrika – nasehlabathini jikelele, kunye nemfuneko yokuba uMzantsi Afrika uhambelane nemigangatho yehlabathi efana ne-Basel III nemithetho yeQela lezemiSebenzi yezeZimali (i-FATF) yokulwa ukuthutyeleziswa kwemali, neyayamkelwe ngaphambili yiKhabhinethi, yaxhaswa yimithetho engundoqo eyayamkelwe ngurhulumente.

src: Cabinet congratulates Transnet, National Prosecuting Authority, SABC and the Departments of Higher Education and Training, International Relations and Cooperation, and Justice and Constitutional Development for being ranked “Most Attractive Employers” in South Africa by employer branding company, UNIVERSUCabinet commends Minister of Science and Technology, Naledi Pandor, who received an Order of Merit from the Federal Republic of Germany for her contribution to the development of science globally.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela iziphumo zeNgxowa-mali yeMali yeHlabathi yowama-2016 neNdibano yaseNtlakohlaza yamaQela eeBhanki zeHlabathi eqhubeke phantsi komxholo othi “IMingeni yeHlabathi, iziSombululo zeHlabathi”.

src: The merit has been awarded to people from around the world for their achievements in political, social or intellectual spheres.
tgt: Kuphakanyiswe indlela embaxa yokuvuselelwa kohlumo kwinqanaba lehlabathi, kukhuthazwa amazwe ukuba asebenzise onke amandla okunyusa akwimigaqo-nkqubo yawo ukukhuthaza uhlumo, oko kuthetha olungokwemali, olungokwemali kaRhulumente nokulungiswa kwezakhiwo.

src: Cabinet congratulates the Environmental Affairs Director-General Nosipho Ngcaba for receiving the 2015/16 Lifetime Achievement Eco-Logic Award from environment publication, The Enviropaedia.
tgt: Amazwe anesithuba ngokwemali nangokwemali kaRhulumente akhuthazwa ukuba enze ngakumbi ukuphucula imfuneko noxa kunjalo, ukuphunyezwa kokulungiswa kwezakhiwo kubaluleke kakhulu kunako konke okunye.

src: Cabinet applauds artist Kemang Wa Lehulere for becoming "Artist of the Year" for 2017 which is supported by Deutsche Bank.
tgt: Kuninzi oku kuquka utyalo-mali kwiziseko ezingundoqo, ubuchule bokuvelisa izinto ezintsha nokuphucula ukusebenza kolawulo, phakathi kokunye.

src: Wa Lehulere, who explores the relevance of the artistic gesture in post-Apartheid South Africa, will present his first institutional solo exhibition in Germany at the Deutsche Bank KunstHalle in Berlin next year.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuza bonke abo bangabavoti abaselungelweni abangekabhalisi baqinisekise nangeenkcukhacha zabo ukuba bangakwenza oko ngokutyelela ii-Ofisi zeKhomishini yoNyulo eziMeleyo (i-IEC) ezikufutshane kubo.

src: Cabinet congratulates golfer Branden Grace for winning his first PGA Tour at the RBC Heritage in Hilton Head, UCabinet is saddened by the death of Bertie Lubner who made significant contributions to the development of South Africa as a business leader, philanthropist and honorary life chairman of the SA Jewish Board of Deputies.
tgt: Oku kuyadingeka ukuqinisekisa ngokubakho kwegama lakho kuluhlu lwabavoti okuza kwenza ukuba abavoti abaselungelweni bakwazi ukusebenzisa ilungelo labo lomgaqo-siseko ngomhla we-3 kweyeThupha yowama-2016.IKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abavoti abaselungelweni ukuba baqinisekise ukuba banazo zonke izinto ezifunekayo zokunikezela ngeedilesi zabo kwi-ofisi yeKhomishini yoNyulo eziMeleyo (i-IEC).

src: Cabinet extends its deepest condolences to the friends and families of the ten victims (Tiisetso Tselo, Sesi Mtshali, Sana Sibeko, Mphikeleli Malindi, Gugulethu Sithole, Vusi Nkabinde, Daphney Linda, Sicelo Kheswa, Sphamandla Gedle and Simphiwe Nhlapo) of a tragic bus crash while they were returning from the ANC Manifesto Rally in Port Elizabeth.
tgt: Imibuzo ngonyulo ingabhekiswa kwiziko loqhagamshelwano le-IEC kwa-0800 11 8000, elivula ngoMvulo ukuya kuLwesihlanu, ukusukela ngentsimbi yesi-7 kusasa ukuya kweye-9 ngokuhlwa.

src: Cabinet conveyed its condolences to the family and friends of Dr Herman Nditsheni Netshidzivhani, South Africa’s first black fertility specialist.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nabakwa-Transnet, iGunyabantu lezoTshutshiso, iZiko lezoSasazo loMzantsi Afrika (i-SABC) neSebe lezeMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho, iSebe lezoBudlelwane baMazwe ngamazwe neNtsebenziswano, kunye neSebe lezobuLungisa noPhuhliso loMgaqo-siseko ngokuthi anikwe iwonga lokuba kudidi lokuba “Ngabona baQeshi banoMtsalane” eMzantsi Afrika yinkampani esebenza ngamagama abaqeshi, i-UNIVERSUIKhabhinethi yothulela umnqwazi uMphathiswa wezeNzululwazi nobuChwepheshe, uNaledi Pandor, othe wafumana imbasa i-Order of Merit kwiFederation Republic of Germany ngegalelo lakhe kuphuhliso lwezenzululwazi ehlabathini jikelele.

src: As a founder of the fertility clinic in the Park Lane Hospital in Johannesburg, Netshidzivhani helped many South Africans start their own families.
tgt: Eli wonga belinikezelwa kubantu behlabathi jikelele ngeempumelelo zabo kwinqanaba lezepolitiki, lezentlalo okanye kwelobungqondi.

src: Cabinet conveyed condolences to the family and friends of Dene Smuts, former Democratic Alliance Member of Parliament.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana noMlawuli-Jikelele weSebe lezeNdalo uNosipho Ngcaba ngokufumana imbasa ebizwa i-Lifetime Achievement Eco-Logic Award evela kwimagazini yezendalo, i-The Enviropeadia.

src: Cabinet salutes her sterling contribution to the development of our constitutional democracy.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqhwabela izandla igcisa uKemang Wa Lehulere ngokuba “Ligcisa loNyaka” lowama-2017 elixhaswa yi-Deutsche Bank.

src: Cabinet joins President Jacob Zuma in wishing Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela a speedy recovery and urges that the privacy of the family be respected during this time.
tgt: UWa Lehulere, ophonononga imisebenzi yobugcisa emva koCalucalulo eMzantsi Afrika, uza kwenza umboniso wakhe wokuqala eyedwa eGermanu kwiholo eDeutsche Bank KunstHalle eBerlin kulo nyaka uzayo.

src: Winnie Mandela is widely respected for her role in our struggle for freedom which contributed to ending oppressive policies and bringing democracy to South Africa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana neSebe lezoKhenketho ngokuphumelela ibhaso lokuba Yelona Nkonzo kaRhulumente inoMgaqo-nkqubo/Nkxaso eNgcono kwiMbasa yoKhenketho oluFanelekileyo e-Afrika lowama-2016.

src: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.
tgt: Eli wonga linikezelwa kwisebe lecandelo laseburhulumenteni, ugunyaziwe okanye iqumrhu elithe labonakalisa ukuzinikela okucacileyo negalelo lokuqhubela phambili ukhenketho.

src: Paul Steenkamp to the National Advisory Council on Innovation.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nomdlali wegalufa uBranden Grace ngokuphumelela imbasa yakhe yokuqala,i-PGA Tour e-RBC Heritage e-Hilton Head, e-U IKhabhinethi ilusizi ngokushiywa kwethu nguBertie Lubner nothe wenza igalelo elincomekayo kuphuhliso loMzantsi Afrika njengenkokeli kwezoshishino, umthandi wabantu nowawongelwa ukuba abe ngusihlalo ubomi bakhe bonke we-SA Jewish Board of Deputies.

src: Clarinda Elizabeth Simpson as the Chief Financial Officer of SENTECLumko Caesario Mtimde as the Chief Executive Officer of the Universal Services and Access Agency of South Africa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa uvelwano olunzulu kubahlobo nosapho lwamaxhoba alishumi (uTiisetso Tselo, uSesi Mtshali, uSana Sibeko, uMphikeleli Malindi, uGugulethu Sithole, uVusi Nkabinde, uDaphney Linda, uSicelo Kheswa, uSphamandla Gedle noSimphiwe Nhlapo) engozi yebhasi emasikizi eyenzeke ngethuba ebebuya kwiNgqungquthela yoMqulu weziThembiso ye-ANC eBhayi.

src: Implementation of Key Government Programmes.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.

src: Cabinet took note of the report-back by the Minister of Finance to the President, on the progress of Government’s consultations with the private sector and labour on the economy.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele ingxelo eyenziwe nguMphathiswa wezeMali kuMongameli, ngenkqubela yokufakana imilomo kukarhulumente naboshishino lecandelo labucala kunye nemibutho yabasebenzi ngoqoqosho.

src: The President mandated the Minister to lead engagements with these social partners to map out a strategy and come up with measures for growing the economy and preserving the country’s credit rating.
tgt: UMongameli ebegunyazise uMphathiswa ukuba akhokele ezi ndibano zokufakana imilomo nala mahlakani ezentlalo ukuba kuboniswane ngesicwangciso-qhinga kunye nokuveza amalinge okukhulisa uqoqosho nokugcina indawo ilizwe elibekwa kuyo ngokwezoqoqosho.

src: Cabinet is pleased that this work has culminated in concrete initiatives that will improve the country’s economic prospects.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inovuyo lokuba lo msebenzi uphele ekuveliseni amanyathelo okuqala aluqilima aza kuphucula amathemba kumbono wezoqoqosho weli lizwe.

src: The President announced several priority initiatives on Monday, which include: (1) a joint private and public sector fund for Small Business Support, (2) addressing constraints to increasing investment in order to accelerate inclusive growth, (3) government and private sector co-investment in infrastructure drawing on experience of the successful Independent Power Producer Programme and (4) strengthening State Owned Enterprises to ensure their financial sustainability and reinforcing their role in driving development.
tgt: NgoMvulo uMongameli ubhengeze amaphulo aphambili aliqela, aquka: (1) ingxowa-mali edibeneyo yabezoshishino labucala norhulumente yeNkxaso yamaShishini amaNcinane, (2) ukuhlangabezana neengxaki eziphazamisa utyalo-mali olwandayo khona ukuze kukhawuleziswe uhlumo oluquka wonke umntu, (3) utyalo-mali oludibeneyo lukarhulumente nabezoshishino labucala kwiziseko ezingundoqo kusetyenziswa umzekelo weNkqubo yabaVelisi baMandla oMbane abaZimeleyo ebe yimpumelelo kunye (4) nokomeleza amaShishini kaRhulumente ukuqinisekisa uzinzo lwawo lwezezimali nokomeleza indima yawo ekuqhubemi uphuhliso.

src: These announcements are testament to what this country can achieve when all social partners come together to work towards the same goal.
tgt: Ezi zibhengezo zibubungqina bokuba yintoni enokwenziwa leli lizwe xa onke amahlakani ezentlalo edibene esebenzisana kwaye ejongise kwinjongo enye.2 IKhabhinethi ihleli iqinisekile ukuba uhlengahlengiso olumandla lwezoqoqosho, ukuqokelela kweNkonzo yezeRhafu yaseMzantsi Afrika (i-SARS) imali efikele kwitriliyoni yeerandi okokuqala ezimbalini kwakunye nokubhengezwa kwakutsha nje kwamanyathelo okungenelela amahlanu exesha elifutshane, zonke nje zongeza kwisicwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba ngeenjongo zokuqinisekisa ngokwenzeka kwenguqu kuqoqosho lweli lizwe.

src: Cabinet remains confident that government’s aggressive fiscal consolidation, the historic R1 trillion collection by the South African Revenue Service and the recently announced five short-term interventions, all complement the Nine Point plan so as to ensure a turn-around in our economic fortunes.
tgt: Ukwanda kwerhafu eqokelelweyo ngabakwa-SARS kuza kongeza ukwenza ukuba uRhulumente anikezele iinkonzo eziza kuphucula umgangatho wobomi babo bonke abemi beli.

src: The increased revenue collection by SARS will further enable Government to deliver services that will improve the quality of lives of all its citizens.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isibhengezo esenziwe yi-arhente yokuhlela, iMoody’s Investor Services, ethe kwezi veki zimbini zidlulileyo yaphinda yaliqinisekisa inqanaba eli lizwe elibekwa kulo kwezoqoqosho engamanqanaba amabini ngaphezulu kwenqanaba elilelona liphantsi nelamnkelekileyo kubatyali-zimali.

src: Cabinet welcomes the announcement by ratings agency, Moody’s Investor Services, which over the past week reaffirmed the country’s credit rating at two notches above sub-investment grade.
tgt: Ekungqineni eli nqanaba, abakwaMoody’s baphawule okokuba uMzantsi Afrika uya uyiguqula imeko emva kweminyaka yohlumo olubuthathaka kwaye amanyathelo okuhlengahlengisa nokomeleza uqoqosho owama-2016 aza komeleza ityala likarhulumente kwiSambuku seMveliso yeLizwe (i-GDP) kulo nyaka.

src: All parties are agreed that collaborative efforts need to be strengthened to give impetus to the economic recovery.
tgt: Onke amaqela ayangqinelana ukuba amalinge entsebenziswano adinga ukomelezwa ukunika amandla ekuphucukeni koqoqosho.

src: We also note that the Minister of Finance’ work with social partners includes a credit ratings workstream that will identify potential reforms and interventions to preserve South Africa’s strong capital markets and investment grade credit rating.4 The President appreciates the Budget Votes by respective Ministers which address the needs of all South Africans.
tgt: Sikwaqaphela ukuba umsebenzi woMphathiswa wezeMali kunye namahlakani ezentlalo ukwaquka umsebenzi oluthotho wohlolo lwemali ilizwe elinayo oza kuchonga uhlaziyo olunokwenziwa nongenelelo lokugcina urhwebo olomeleleyo lwemali eyinkunzi yaseMzantsi Afrika nomlinganiselo wohlolo lwemali yotyalo-mali.4 UMongameli uyazibulela iiVoti zoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali ezenziwa ngabaPhathiswa ngokwahlukeneyo nezithi zihlangabezane neemfuno zabo bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika.

src: The progress reports and plans emanating from the Departmental Budget Votes demonstrates that South Africa is a nation at work, with government leading the way, in building a better life for all.
tgt: Iingxelo zenkqubela nezicwangciso eziphuma kwezi Voti zoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali zamaSebe zibonakalisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika usisizwe esisebenzayo, apho urhulumente akhokelayo khona, ekwakheni ubomi obungcono kumntu wonke.

src: Concrete measures have been put in place to reduce the negative impact of the global economic downturn on our economy, and to prepare for robust growth when the economic cycle turns positive.
tgt: Kumiselwe amanyathelo aluqilima ukunciphisa impembelelo embi yokudodobala koqoqosho ehlabathini jikelele kuqoqosho lweli lizwe, nokulungiselela uhlumo lwezoqoqoqsho oludlamkileyo xa uqoqosho seluguquke lwathembisa.

src: We are also working hard to remove domestic impediments to growth.
tgt: Sikwasebenza ngamandla ukususa imiqobo yalapha ekhaya kwezohlumo.

src: The budget votes also demonstrate that government, labour and business are working together, more than any other time, to find ways of re-igniting growth and building a better life for all.
tgt: Ezi voti zohlahlo lwabiwo-mali zikwabonakalisa ukuba urhulumente, imibutho yabasebenzi nabezoshishino basebenzisana, kakhulu kunangaphambili, ukufumanisa ngeendlela zokuvuselela uhlumo nokwakha ubomi obungcono kumntu wonke.

src: This includes vigorous implementation of the Nine Point Plan, announced by President Jacob Zuma in his 2015 State of the Nation Address as well as Operation Phakisa, designed to fast track implementation of solutions to critical development areas.
tgt: Oku kuquka ukufezekiswa ngamandla kwesiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba, esathi sabhengezwa nguMongameli uJacob Zuma kwiNtetho engoBume beSizwe yowama-2015 kwakunye nephulo i-Operation Phakisa, elamiselwa ukukhawulezisa ukufezekiswa kwezisombululo kwimimandla apho uphuhliso ludingeka ngamandla khona.

src: These programmes address critical issues from the National Development Plan, such as reducing poverty and unemployment.
tgt: Ezi nkqubo zihlangabezana nemiba ebaluleke kakhulu kwisiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP), efana nokuncitshiswa kwendlala nentswela-ngqesho.5 IKhabhinethi iqinisekisa kwakhona abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba iimeko yentswela-ngqesho kweli lizwe kuhlangatyezwana nayo ngokufezekiswa kwesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP) seli lizwe, ngongenelelo lwezoqoqosho lwesiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba esenzelwe ukuvuselela uhlumo size sikhulise imisebenzi kumacandelo angundoqoqo kuqoqosho lwethu.

src: Cabinet reassures South Africans that the country’s unemployment situation is being addressed through the implementation of the country’s National Development Plan (NDP) through the Nine Point Plan economic intervention which seeks to ignite growth and boost jobs in key sectors of our economy.
tgt: Intsebenziswano yecandelo lezoshishino labucala ibaluleke kakhulu ukuze kufumaneke iziphumo ezihle.

src: Government is using all available initiatives including its Industrial Policy Action Plan (IPAP) to create more labour absorbing production and services sectors to address unemployment which has been further impacted by the difficult global and local economic conditions.
tgt: Urhulumente usebenzisa onke amaphulo akhoyo kuquka nesiCwangciso sokuSebenza koMgaqo-nkqubo wezoShishino (i-IPAP) ukudala iimveliso eziza kuthatha abasebenzi abongezelelekileyo namacandelo eenkonzo ukuhlangabezana nentswela-ngqesho ethe yaphinda yongezwa bubunzima beemeko zezoqoqosho zehlabathi jikelele nezalapha ekhaya.

src: Minister of Trade and Industry, Rob Davies launched the eighth annual iteration of the IPAP 2016/17 to 2018-19 on 9 May 2016 at a 100% black-owned casting and machining foundry in Gauteng.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezoRhwebo noShishino uRob Davies umisele owesibhozo umfuziselo wonyaka we-IPAP2016/17 ukuya kowama-2018-19 ngomhla we-9 kuCanzibe wowama-2016 kwinkampani yokunyibilikisa isinyithi negilasi enabanikazi abaNtsundu ngokupheleleyo eGauteng.

src: Government emphasizes the importance of developing close cooperation with cutting-edge local industrial companies involved not just in infrastructure development, transport and logistics, but across a wide range of technologically sophisticated, export ready and labour intensive sectors of the South African economy as a totality.
tgt: Urhulumente ugxininisa ukubaluleka kokwakhiwa kwentsebenziswano emandla neenkampani zezoshishino zalapha ekhaya ezigqwesileyo nezisebenzisa ubuchule bale mihla ezingabandakanyeki nje kuphuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo, ezothutho nezolungiselelo kodwa zibandakanyeke kuthotho lwezinto zobuchwepheshe ezinzima, ezilungele ukuthunyelwa kumazwe angaphandle necandelo elifuna kakhulu abasebenzi loqoqosho laseMzantsi Afrika liphela.

src: While the Quarterly Labour Force Survey for the first quarter of 2016 recorded an increase in unemployment to per cent on a quarter on quarter basis, 2016 employment levels are higher by 204 000 employed people when compared with the first quarter of 2015.
tgt: Ngeli xesha uPhando olungabaSebenzi lweKota ebelwenziwe kwikota yokuqala yowama-2016 lubonakalise ukwanda kwintswela-ngqesho okufikelela kuma-26.7% ngokwekota nekota, ngowama-2016 izinga lemisebenzi linyuke ngama-204 000 ekuqesheni abantu xa lithelekiswa nekota yokuqala yowama-20.6 IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukunikezelwa kweZiko loLutsha laseBhobhofolo eNtshona Koloni nguMongameli uJacob Zuma, elibonelela ulutsha ngoncedo lobuchule, apho lunokuzixhobisa.

src: Cabinet welcomes the handover of the Beaufort West Youth Hub, in Western Cape by President Jacob Zuma, which provides a facility to the youth, where they can empower themselves.
tgt: Eli Ziko lineendidi ngeendidi zoncedo lobuchule olubonelela ngophuhliso olugabalala lwabantu abatsha noluntu ngokubanzi.

src: The Hub has a mix of facilities that provide for holistic development of young people and for the community at large.
tgt: Olu ncedo lobuchule lukhoyo kweli ziko lolutsha luza kubonelela abantu abatsha abasuka kuluntu oluhluphekileyo ngamathuba okuthatha ngcono inxaxheba nokwenza igalelo elihle kuluntu lwalo nakwilizwe.

src: The facilities available in this youth hub will provide young people from poor communities with opportunities to better participate and contribute positively to their communities and to the country.
tgt: IZiko lezaKhono elixhotyiswe ngokupheleleyo neliqhutywa yiKholeji yaseMzantsi Koloni iza kubonelela ngoqeqesho kulawulo lwezoshishino, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nophuhliso lwabantwana abazintsana ukuya kutsho kubathathi-nxaxheba abangama-200 beQela leNkonzo yoManyano lwamaShishini oLutsha lwaseMaphandleni leSizwe (i-NARYSEC) ngonyaka.

src: The fully equipped Skills Centre that is being operated by South Cape College will provide training in business administration, end user computing and early childhood development to 200 National Rural Youth Service Corps (NARYSEC) participants per year.
tgt: I-NARYSEC yinkqubo yexesha elide apho igxile, ikwagaya ulutsha lwasemaphandleni kuphela nenesivumelwano sexesha leminyaka emibini.

src: NARYSEC is a long-term programme where only rural youth are targeted, recruited and contracted for a period of two years.
tgt: Kugaywa ulutsha oluminyaka iphakathi kwe-18 nama-25 ubudala luze lubhaliselwe uqeqesho kwizakhono ezahlukahlukeneyo eziza kuluxhobisa ngokufanayo kulwazi ngeengcingane nangokuphathwayo ukudala imisebenzi okanye bona ngokwabo nabanye abantu badale imisebenzi kuluntu lwabo.

src: Youth between the ages of 18 and 25 years old are recruited and then enrolled for training in various skills that will equip them, both with theoretical and practical knowledge, to create employment for themselves and other people in their communities.
tgt: Eli Ziko loLutsha luyiprojekthi esaLingwayo kwaye iyeyokuqala elolu hlobo kwaye liza kudluliselwa kwamanye amaphondo.7 Khabhinethi iyayamkela iNtlanganiso yoMmandla we-Afrika yoBudlelwane bobuRhulumente obuVulelekileyo yowama-2016 ebibanjwe phantsi komxholo othi “UbuRhulumente obuVulelekileyo boPhuhliso obuZinzileyo e-Afrika” ukususela ngomhla we-5 ukuya kowe-6 kuCanzibe wowama-2016.Le ndibano iza emva kweenyanga ezisixhenxe uMzantsi Afrika wathi waba nguSihlalo oKhokelayo woBudlelwane bobuRhulumente obuVulelekileyo.

src: Open government principles are crucial for achieving a much broader range of sustainable development goals, linking openness to governance for the improvement of the vulnerable and poor around the world.
tgt: Imigomo yoburhulumente obuvulelekileyo ibaluleke kakhulu ekuphumezeni uludwe olubanzi lweenjongo eziphambili zophuhliso oluzinzileyo, ukuqhagamshelanisa okuvulekileyo kulawulo loorhulumente ukwenzela ukuphuculwa kwabahlelelekileyo nabahluphekileyo ehlabathini jikelele.

src: The Open Government Partnership and Open Government is also a key enabler that will assist the global community to achieve the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.
tgt: UBudlelwane bobuRhulumente obuVulelekileyo nobuRhulumente obuVulelekileyo bukwangundoqo ekuncedeni uluntu lwehlabathi ukuba lukwazi ukuphumeza i-Ajenda yowama-2030 yoPhuhliso oluZinzileyo.

src: This Regional Summit was the biggest Open Government Partnership (OGP) Regional summit ever organised by the OGP with very substantive outcomes coming out of each session throughout the WEBTOKEN keeping with governments commitment to partnership and good governance, this summit attracted participants from various Civil Society Organisations (CSO) from around the world that are rooted in communities across different sectors outside the traditional CSO’s that have always been part of the partnership.8 Cabinet notes the approval of the merger of three bottling plants to form the continent's largest bottling plant, Coca-Cola Beverages Africa.
tgt: Le Ngqungquthela yoMmandla ibe yeyona inkulu kwiingqungquthela zoMmandla zoBudlelwane bobuRhulumente obuVulelekileyo (i-OGP) kwezakhe zaququzelelwa yi-OGP eneziphumo ezincomeka kakhulu kwisigaba ngasinye yade yayokuphela le ngqungquthela.

src: Cabinet welcomes the agreement on public interest conditions for the merger between government and the Coca-Cola Beverages Africa merger parties that can support our efforts for greater industrialisation in the South African economy.
tgt: Ukugcina isibophelelo sikarhulumente kubudlelwane nolawulo lukarhulumente olungcono, le ngqungquthela ibe nomtsalane kubathathi-nxaxheba abavela kwiMibutho yoLuntu (i-CSO) evela ehlabathini jikelele emilisele kuluntu olukumacandelo awohlukahlukeneyo olungaphandle kwe-CSO yesiqhelo esoloko iyinxalenye yobu budlelwane.

src: The agreement safeguards aggregate employment levels in the company for a period of three years, protects workers in the bargaining unit from merger-related retrenchments, supports localisation of the supply chain and commits to develop historically disadvantaged farmers and suppliers to the company.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukwamkelwa kwesivumelwano sokudibanisa amaziko amathathu kutha ebhotileni ukwenza elona ziko lokutha ebhotileni lakwaCoca- Cola Beverages Africa lakhe lasikhulu kweli lizwekazi.

src: Furthermore, R400 million has been committed to fund enterprise development in the agricultural value chain and another R400 million incremental investment to develop downstream distribution and retail capabilities with associated skills development and training.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isivumelwano kwiimeko zeemfuno zoluntu kule ndibanisela phakathi kukarhulumente kunye noCoca-Cola Beverages Africa amaqela endibanisela anokuxhasa amalinge wethu wokuvulwa kwemizi-mveliso okukhulu kuqoqosho lwaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: The agreement opens fridge space in coolers owned or supplied by Coca-Cola to smaller retailers: ten percent of fridge space will be available to rival products from smaller producers in retail establishments where only Coca-Cola supplied coolers are available.
tgt: Esi sivumelwano sisikhuselo sabo bakwinqanaba lengqesho ekumyinge ophakathi kule nkampani ixesha elingangeminyaka emithathu sikhusela abasebenzi abakwinqanaba elisezantsi ukuba bangabi ngamaxhoba okudendwa okuhambelana nendibanisela, sixhasa ukusetyenziswa kwezinto zasekhaya kwinkqubo yokuthenga nokuthengisa nokuzibophelela ekuphuhliseni amafama aye sakuhleleleka nababoneleli-zinkonzo kule nkampani.

src: This opens the market to new entrants and small bottlers, helping to avoid restrictive business practices that keep small and medium-sized businesses out of WEBTOKEN addition, the company's long term investment in the country's economic and socialdevelopment will be enhanced through the establishment of the merged entity's headquarters in South Africa.
tgt: Ukongeza apho, imali ezizigidi ezingama-400 zeerandi iza kubonelela ukuxhasa ngezimali uphuhliso lwamashishini amancinane ekuqaleni kwemveliso yezolimo ide ibe yimveliso egqibeleleyo ize enye imali ezizigidi ezingama-400 eerandin aye ekunyusweni kutyalo-mali ukuphuhliswa ukubonelelwa kwemveliso abasebenzisi bayo kunye namandla eevenkile nophuhliso lwezakhono ezibandakanyekayo noqeqesho.

src: The agreement follows a recent similar agreement entered into with Annhauser Beush InBev relating to the purchase of SAB Miller.
tgt: Imveliso ye-Appletiser esele isaziwa kakhulu iseza kuqhubeka iveliswa eMzantsi Afrika.

src: In particular, in their emphasis on employment, localisation and small business development, these agreements point to the importance of balancing corporate mergers with public interest issues and set a standard for companies contemplating similar mergers or acquisitions.
tgt: Esi sivumelwano sivulela indawo kwizikhenkcezi zakwaCoca-Cola kwiivenkile ezincinci: indawo eyi-10% ingasetyenziselwa ukufaka iimveliso ezikwafanayo ezivela kwivenkile ethengisa ngemiyinge emincinci kweli candelo leevenkile apho kukho khona izikhenkcezi zakwaCoca-Cola.

src: Cabinet noted the launch of the Mpact Polymers R350 million bottle-to-bottle plant in partnership with Coca-Cola.
tgt: Oku kuvulela urhwebo kwinkampani ezintsha kunye neenkampani ezincinci zokutha ezibhotileni, ukuncedisa ukuphepha imimiselo yezoshishino enemiqathango ethintelayo nethi igcine amashishini amancinci naphakathi engaphandle korhweboUkongeza apho, utyalo-mali lwexesha elide lale nkampani kuphuhliso lwezoqosho nolwezentlalo kweli lizwe liza kuxhotyiswa ngokumiselwa kondlunkulu wequmrhu lendibaniselwano eMzantsi Afrika.

src: The plant is a first of its kind on the African continent diverting 29 000 tonnes (polyethylene terephthalate) PET waste bottles with an estimated saving of 186 000 cubic metres of landfill space and will contribute to reduction of Carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions of approximately 53 000 tonnes per annum.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukumiselwa kweziko elixabise izigidi ezingama-350 zeerandi sokutha ebhotileni ngabakwa--Mpact Polymers besebenzisana nabakwaCoca-Cola.

src: The Industrial Development Corporation (IDC) provided a R210 million loan facility as well as R30m for its 21% equity stake and the Department of Trade and Industry granted a section 12(I) tax incentive.
tgt: Eli phulo liyimpendulo kwinkqubo-sikhokelo kaRhulumente esemthethweni lisebenza ngenjongo ephambili yesiCwangciso-qhinga soLawulo lweNkunkuma lweMicimbi yezokusiNgqongileyo yeSizwe ukukhuthaza amashishini amancinane ukuba asebenzise kwakhona imveliso esele isetyenzisiwe ukuze isetyenziswe kwakhona.

src: The recycling plant provides jobs to 80 employees and 1 000 jobs to waste collectors.
tgt: Esi sikhululo sesokuqala ezilolu hlobo kwilizwekazi le-Afrika lijike ama-29 000 eetoni (i-polthylene terephthalate) iibhotile ezophukileyo ze-PET nokonga okuthelekelelwa kwi-186 000 zeetyhubhiki-mitha zesithuba ezigcwalise umhlaba kwaye siza kuba negalelo ekunciphiseni ukukhutshwa komoya ongcolileyo (i-CO2) omalunga nama-53 000 eetoni ngonyaka.

src: Partnerships like this are an important engine for economic growth, creating thousands of jobs in the recycling economy that is worth about R50 billion.
tgt: IQumrhu loPhuhliso lwamaShishini (i-IDC) ibonelele ngoncedo lwemali-mboleko ezizigidi ezingama-210 zeerandi kwakunye nezigidi ezingama-30 zeerandi ukwenzela izabelo zenzala yayo engama-21% laza iSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino labonelela ngembuyekezo yerhafu yeCandelo le-12(1).

src: Currently, plastic recycling alone provides income opportunities for more than 60 000 waste pickers.
tgt: Isikhululo sokusebenzisa kwakhona imveliso esele isetyenzisiwe ukuze isetyenziswe kwakhona sibonelela ngemisebenzi kubasebenzi abangama-80 kunye nemisebenzi eli-1000 kubaqokeleli benkunkuma.

src: Mpact Polymers, state of the art recycling plant complies with EU food safety specifications and is the first such factory in Africa which also meets Coca-Cola’s full certification protocol for PET bottles.10 Cabinet welcomes the report-back on the Integrated Strategic Management of Rhinoceros which has shown that South Africa has turned the tide on rhino poaching.
tgt: Isikhululo sokuvelisa ngokutsha imveliso eseyisebenzile sakwa-Mpact Polymer esikumgangatho wehlabathi, sihambelana nemigaqo yokhuselo lokutya yeManyano yaMazwe ase-Yurobhu (i-EU) kwaye ngumzi-mveliso wokuqala ololu hlobo e-Afrika kwaye ukwafikelela kwemimiselo yokuqinisekiswa yakwaCoca-Cola yeebhotile ze-PET.10 IKhabhinethi iyayamkela ingxelo yesiCwangciso-qhinga esiDibeneyo soLawulo lweMikhombe esiubonakalise ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ukulwa ngempumelelo ukuzingelwa kwemikhombe ngokungekho mthethweni.

src: Since the beginning of this year alone 206 alleged poachers have been arrested.
tgt: Ukususela ekuqaleni kwalo nyaka kuphela kubanjwe abatyholwa ngokuzingela imikhombe ngokungekhomthethweni abangama-206.Indlela yokuHlangabezana nesiCwangciso-qhinga soLawulo oluDibeneyo yamkelwa yiKhabhinethi kwinyanga yeThupha yowama-2014 nokwakhokelela ekubeni iNtlanganisela yoKhuselo iphumeze amanyathelo okungenelela azindidi ezahlukeneyo, nolwamacandelo ahlukeneyo ukukhusela imikhombe eMzantsi Afrika.11 IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana neli lizwe ngokusingatha ngokuyimpumelelo iNgqungquthela yezoKhenketho yowama-2016 eDurban kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal, nethe yaqukunjelwa ngoMvulo umhla we-9 kuCanzibe wowama-2016 neqela lokubandakanyeka olube yimpumelelo phakathi kwababonisi abali-1 047 abavela kumazwe ase-Afrika ali-18 kunye nabathengi abali-1 856 abavela ehlabathini jikelele.

src: This year, INDABA hosted 3000 more meetings than last year.
tgt: Kulo nyaka, Ie Ngqungquthela ibambe iintlanganiso ezingama-3 000 ngaphezulu kunakulonyaka uphelileyo.

src: In total 14 000 business meetings took place over the three days of INDABA, presenting a significant economic benefit potential.
tgt: Ziintlanganiso zezoshishino ezingama-14 000 ezithe zahlala zizonke kwezi ntsuku zintathu zale Ngqungquthela, zinikeza ithemba lokuxhamla kuqoqosho oluncomekayo.

src: The event was also attended by 575 national and international journalists.
tgt: Lo msitho ubukwazinyaswe nazintatheli zesizwe nezehlabathi ezingama-575.Le Ngqungquthela igxile kumashishini amancinci aphakathi nakhulayo (ii-SMME) ebonisa ngeemveliso neenkonzo zamashishini ehambo amancinci athembisayo.

src: The INDABA focussed on the industry's small, medium and micro enterprises (SMMEs) showcasing products and services from promising small travel businesses.
tgt: ngamashishini amancinci angama-70 axhamle kwiintlanganiso zocweyo zokuba angafikelela njani kurhwebo lentengiso ukuze akhule.

src: SMMES have the potential to become big business.
tgt: Ii-SMME zinamandla okuba ngamashishini amakhulu.

src: The INDABA has bolstered the role SMMEs play in the economic development of both developed and developing countries, in growing the tourism sector.
tgt: Le Ngqungquthela iyomelezile indima edlalwa zi-SMME kuphuhliso loqoqosho lamazwe aphuhlileyo nasaphuhlayo, ekukhuliseni icandelo lezokhenketho.

src: Unlocking the potential of SMMEs is one of the critical job drivers in the Nine-Point Plan that will grow and transform the economy and create jobs.
tgt: Ukuveza amandla ee-SMME yenye yeendlela ezibaluleke kakhulu ekuveliseni imisebenzi kwisiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba eza kukhulisa ize iguqule uqoqosho idale nemisebenzi.

src: Key Cabinet decisions.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi ezingundoqo.

src: Cabinet discussed the implementation on the Truth and Reconciliation Commission’s (TRC) recommendations and proposed options for the implementation of the Community Rehabilitation Projects.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ixoxe ngokufezekiswa kwezindululo zeKhomishini yeNyani noXolelwaniso (i-TRC) nezinye iindlela ezicetyisiweyo zokufezekiswa kweeProjekthi zokuBuyiselwa koLuntu kwiMo yesiQhelo.

src: Realisation of Community Rehabilitation Projects redress the injustices of the past through the rehabilitation of 128 communities that were subjected to acts of violence and destruction during the conflict period (1 March 1960-10 May 1994).The Department of Justice and Constitutional Development will solicit contributions from relevant stakeholders (public and private) in order to secure adequate resources to bring about holistic interventions in these 128 communities, identified by the TRC on a case by case basis that might differ in value but to a maximum value of R30 million.
tgt: UkuQondwa kweeProjekthi zokuBuyiselwa koLuntu kwiMo yesiQhelo zilungisa intswela-bulungisa yangaphambili ngokubuyiselwa kwemo yesiqhelo kwiindawo zoluntu ezili-128 ezazingamaxhoba ezenzo zobundlobongela nokutshatyalaliswa ngexesha longquzulwano (ukususela kumhla woku-1 kweyoKwindla yowe-1960 ukuya kowe-10 kuCanzibe wowe-1994).ISebe lezobuLungisa noPhuhliso loMgaqo-siseko liza kucela amagalelo avela kubadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo abachaphezelekayo (kurhulumente nakwabezoshishino labucala) khona ukuze kufumaneke imithombo eyaneleyo yokuzisa ungenelelo olupheleleyo kwezi ndawo zoluntu zili-128, nezathi zachazwa yi-TRC ngokwetyala ngalinye elinokwahluka ngokwexabiso kodwa ukuya kutsho kwelona xabiso liphezulu liyimali engama-30 ezigidi zeerandi.

src: This will ensure that Projects are feasible and sustainable in order to realise community aspirations.
tgt: Oku kuza kuqinisekisa ukuba iiProjekthi zinokwenzeka kwaye zizinzile khona ukuze kufezekiswe iminqweno yoluntuOku kunegalelo ekufezekisweni kwesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP) ngokwandisa intlalo-ntle nomanyano, ukulungisa ukungalingani kwangaphambili nokufezekiswa kombuso ophuhlayo, onakho nonenkathalo ophatha abemi ngesidima.2 IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngeziphumo zeNgqungquthela yonxibelelwano lukanomathotholo yeHlabathi (i-WRC-15) ebibanjwe ukususela ngomhla wesi-2 ukuya kowama-27 kweyeNkanga yowama-2015 eGeneva, eSwitzerland.

src: This contributes to the realisation of the National Development Plan through broadening social cohesion and unity, redressing the inequalities of the past and the realisation of a developmental, capable and ethical state that treats citizens with dignity.2 Cabinet was briefed on the outcomes of the World Radiocommunications Conference (WRC-15) which was held from 2 to 27 November 2015 in Geneva, Switzerland.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika ubukhokela iQela lase-Afrika kuthethathethwano olukhokelele ekubeni lo mmandla ufumane ububanzi obongezelelweyo bamaza othungelwano lweminxeba ephathwayo kwaye i-Afrika ikwazile ukukhusela ububanzi baseMzantsi be-UHF boomabonakude bedijithali behlabathi jikelele.
