tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uxhase ukwamkelwa kweNkqubo eNtsha yoPhuhliso lweDolophu waza emva koko wayizalisekisa ngeNkqubo-sikhokelo yelizwe eDityanisiweyo yoPhuhliso lweDolophu (i-IUDF).

src: The IUDF aims to guide the development of inclusive, resilient and liveable urban settlements.
tgt: I-IUDF ijolise ekukhokeleni uphuhliso lweendawo zokuhlala ezisezidolophini ezibandakanyayo, ezikwaziyo ukuzimela nekuhlalekayo kuzo.

src: The progress report was compiled in consultation with national, provincial and local spheres of government, and relevant NGOs.
tgt: Ingxelo yenkqubela-phambili yaqulunqwa ngokubonisana norhulumente wesizwe, wephondo nowengingqi, kunye neeNGO ezifanelekileyo.

src: Integrated Youth Development Strategy (IYDS).
tgt: ISicwangciso esiHlangeneyo soPhuhliso loLutsha (i-IYDS).

src: Cabinet approved the IYDS for implementation.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele i-IYDS ukuba iphunyezwe.

src: The strategy gives effect to the National Youth Policy 2020-2030.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga siphumeza uMgaqo-nkqubo woLutsha weSizwe wowama-2020-2030.

src: It outlines the actions, projects and programmes to be undertaken by various stakeholders from youth formations.
tgt: Ichaza amanyathelo, iiprojekthi kunye neenkqubo eziza kwenziwa ngabathathi-nxaxheba abohlukeneyo abavela kumaqumrhu olutsha.

src: It also deals with minimising the duplication of government interventions and guides how civil society and the private sector can support young people from accessing opportunities.
tgt: Ikwajongene nokuncitshiswa kokuphindwa kongenelelo lukarhulumente kwaye ikhokele indlela uluntu kunye necandelo labucala abanokuxhasa ngayo abantu abatsha ekufikeleleni kumathuba.

src: The compilation of the strategy involved diverse inputs from various sectors of society.
tgt: Ukuqulunqwa kwesi sicwangciso kubandakanye amagalelo ahlukeneyo avela kumacandelo ngamacandelo oluntu.

src: Draft White Paper on Conservation and Sustainable Use of South Africa’s Biodiversity.
tgt: IPhepha leNgcaciso eYilwayo yoLondolozo kunye noSetyenziso oluZinzileyo lweZityalo eZiphilayo zaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Cabinet approved the draft White Paper on Conservation and Sustainable Use of South Africa’s Biodiversity for public comments.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iluvumile uyilo lwePhepha leNgcaciso yoMgaqo-nkqubo ngoLondolozo kunye noSetyenziso oluZinzileyo lweZityalo eZiphilayo zaseMzantsi Afrika ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: South Africa's biodiversity provides an important basis for economic growth and development, and is critical to people’s livelihoods.
tgt: Iintlobo-ntlobo zezityalo nezilwanyana zaseMzantsi Afrika zibonelela ngesiseko esibalulekileyo sokukhula koqoqosho nophuhliso, kwaye zikwa balulekile nakubomi babantu.

src: This White Paper gives effect to the recommendations made by the High-Level Panel of Experts appointed in 2019 to review our current policies, legislation and practices on matters relating to iconic species.
tgt: Eli Phepha leNgcaciso yoMgaqo-nkqubo lenza ukuba zisebenze izindululo ezenziwe liGqiza leeNgcali elikwiNqanaba eliPhezulu elalonyulwe ngowama-2019 ukuba lihlole imigaqo-nkqubo yethu yeli xesha, imithetho kunye nezenzo kwimiba enxulumene neentlobo zezilwanyana ezidumileyo.

src: The report recommended the development of an overarching policy on conservation and sustainable use of the country’s biodiversity.
tgt: Le ngxelo icebise ngokuqulunqwa komgaqo-nkqubo obanzi wolondolozo nokusetyenziswa ngokuzinzileyo kwezityalo nezilwanyana zelizwe.

src: The policy will be implemented across all spheres of government.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo uza kuphunyezwa kuwo onke amanqanaba karhulumente.

src: Conservation is important for the country’s drive to accelerate economic growth and job creation.
tgt: Ulondolozo lubalulekile kwiphulo lelizwe lokukhawulezisa ukukhula koqoqosho nokudala imisebenzi.

src: Game Meat Strategy Cabinet approved the publication of the draft Game Meat Strategy for public comments.
tgt: Isicwangciso-qhinga esimalunga nenyama yenyamakazi.

src: The strategy seeks to formalise and transform the game meat industry.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kwesiCwangciso-qhinga esisayilwayo seNyama yenyamakazi ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: It also seeks to contribute towards food security in a sustainable manner.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sijonge ukuvumela ngokusesikweni kunye nokuguqula ishishini lenyama yenyamakazi.

src: The game meat industry is predominately an informal industry that operates in a fragmented manner.
tgt: Ishishini lenyama yenyamakazi ubukhulu becala lishishini elingekho sikweni elisebenza ngendlela engafaniyo.

src: The proposed strategy provides an implementation plan that will formalise and strengthen the sector as both a provider of food security and an economic growth sector that can help create job opportunities.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sicetywayo sibonelela ngesicwangciso somiliselo esiza kumisela ngokusesikweni kwaye someleze eli candelo njengababoneleli bokutya kunye necandelo lohlumo loqoqosho elinokunceda ekudaleni amathuba emisebenzi.

src: BILLS Traditional Affairs General Amendment Bill of 2022.
tgt: UMthetho osaYilwayo oLungisiweyo weMicimbi yezeMveli wowama-2022.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the Traditional Affairs General Amendment Bill of 2022 to Parliament for further processing.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa koMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo weMicimbi yezeMveli wowama-2022 ePalamente ukuze uqhubeke nokuqhutywa.

src: The amendments seek to revise the Traditional and Khoi-San Leadership Act, 2019 (Act 3 of 2019), which came into effect on 1 April Protection of Constitutional Democracy Against Terrorist and Related Activities Amendment Bill of 2022.
tgt: Ezi zihlomelo zifuna ukuhlaziya uMthetho wobuNkokheli beMveli nobu-Khoi-San, wowama-2019 (uMthetho wesi-3 wama-2019), oqale ukusebenza ngomhla woku-1 kuTshazimpuzi ngowama-20.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the Protection of Constitutional Democracy Against Terrorist and Related Activities Amendment Bill of 2022 to Parliament for further processing.
tgt: Umthetho osaYilwayo Wokukhuselwa kweNtando yesininzi yoMgaqo-siseko ngokuchasene nabanqolobi kunye neMisebenzi eNxulumene nabo wama-2022.

src: Once adopted, the Bill will amend the current Protection of Constitutional Democracy Against Terrorist and Related Activities Act, 2004 (Act 33 of 2004).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho osaYilwayo wokuKhuselwa kweNtando yesininzi yoMgaqo-siseko ngokuchasene nabanqolobi kunye neMisebenzi eNxulumeneyo nabo wama-2022 ukuba iqhutywelwe phambili.

src: The Bill went through an extensive public consultation process after it was approved by Cabinet in May 2021.
tgt: Emveni kokuba uvunyiwe lo mthetho usayilwayo yiKhabhinethi kuCanzibe wama-2021, uye waba kwinkqubo yokubonisana noluntu ngokubanzi.

src: The amendments seek to align the country’s domestic instruments of fighting terrorism with the global measures that have been put in place.
tgt: Ezi zihlomelo zifuna ukulungelelanisa iindlela zokusebenza zeli lizwe zokulwa nobunqolobi kunye nemilinganiselo yehlabathi esele ibekiwe.

src: They have also addressed the clauses that were deemed unconstitutional by the Constitutional Court.
tgt: Kwakhona kuphinde kwajongwana namagatya ayethe athathwa njenga magatya angekho kumgaqo-siseko yiNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko.

src: As a signatory to the UN Security Council, South Africa is duty-bound to domesticate the international laws that seek to strengthen measures to combat global terrorism.
tgt: Nanjenge lizwe elityikitye kwiBhunga loKhuseleko le-UN, uMzantsi Afrika ubophelelekile ukuba ube nemithetho yamazwe ngamazwe ezama ukomeleza amanyathelo okulwa nobunqolobi behlabathi.

src: UPCOMING EVENTS 14th Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa (BRICS) Summit.
tgt: INkomfa ye-14 yase-Brazil, i-Russia, i-India, i-China noMzantsi Afrika (i-BRICS).

src: President Ramaphosa will lead South Africa’s participation in the virtual 14th BRICS Leaders’ Summit hosted by the People’s Republic of China from Thursday, 23 to Friday, 24 June 2022.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa uza kukhokela uMzantsi Afrika ekuthatheni inxaxheba kwiNkomfa ye-14 yeeNkokheli ze-BRICS ebanjwe yiRiphablikhi yase-China ukusuka ngoLwesine, umhla wama-23 ukuya kuLwesihlanu, umhla wama-24 kweyeSilimela ngowama-2022.

src: Our BRICS membership continues to benefit the country.
tgt: Ubulungu bethu be-BRICS busaqhubeka bunceda ilizwe.

src: Last year over 17 percent of South Africa’s exports were destined to other BRICS countries, and over 29 percent of our total imports came from these countries.
tgt: Kulo nyaka uphelileyo ngaphezulu kwe-17% yempahla ethunyelwa ngaphandle yaseMzantsi Afrika ithunyelwe kwamanye amazwe e-BRICS, kwaye ngaphezulu kwama-29% empahla engene kweli lizwe isuka kula mazwe.

src: The value of this trade continues to grow, with total South African trade with other BRICS countries reaching R702 billion in 2021, up from R487 billion in 2017.
tgt: Ixabiso lolu rhwebo liyaqhubeleka nokukhula, urhwebo loMzantsi Afrika lulonke namanye amazwe e-BRICS lufikelele kwiibhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-R702 ngowama-2021, lusuka kwiibhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama- R487 zonyaka wama-2017.

src: Collaboration within BRICS members in various areas such as health and enhanced trade has grown our local industry, and benefited all BRICS members.
tgt: Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwamalungu e-BRICS kwiinkalo ezahlukeneyo ezifana nezempilo kunye norhwebo olwandisiweyo kukhulise ishishini lethu lasekhaya, kwaye kwanceda onke amalungu e-BRICUtyalo-mali lwethu kwiiprojekthi zophuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo kunye neenzame zokunciphisa imiqathango esetyenziswayo xa sisenza ushishino lujolise ekwandiseni ukuthunyelwa kwempahla kumazwe angaphandle angamahlakani ethu e-BRICISikolo esiqhutywa ngexesha laseBusika soLawulo loQoqosho.

src: Our investment in infrastructure development projects and efforts to reduce red tape when doing business aim to increase exports to our BRICS partners.
tgt: ISikolo sikaRhulumente seSizwe (i-NSG) siza kubamba iNkqubo yaso yesithathu yaseBusika yoLawulo lwezoQoqosho yaBaphathi bezoPolitiko eRhawutini ukusuka ngomhla wama-27 kweyeSilimela ukuya kowoku-1 kweyeKhala kulo nyaka wama-2022.

src: It will be attended by Ministers from Côte d'Ivoire South Sudan and South Africa and Directors-General from Lesotho, Zambia, Democratic Republic of Congo, Tanzania and Ghana.
tgt: Iza kube izinyaswe ngabaPhathiswa abavela e-Côte d'Ivoire i-South Sudan noMzantsi Afrika kunye nabaLawuli-Jikelele abavela e-Lesotho, e-Zambia, e-Democratic Republic of Congo, e-Tanzania nase-Ghana.

src: South African mayors, as well as members of mayoral committees and executive councils, will also attend.
tgt: Oosodolophu boMzantsi Afrika, kwakunye namalungu eekomiti zosodolophu namabhunga alawulayo, nabo baza kuba yinxalenye yesi sikolo.

src: The political executives from different countries are expected to share ideas and lessons from different scenarios that they experience in their day-to-day work.
tgt: Abaphathi bezopolitiko abavela kumazwe ahlukeneyo kulindeleke ukuba babelane ngezimvo kunye nezifundo kwiimeko ezahlukeneyo abazifumanayo kwimisebenzi yabo yemihla ngemihla.

src: The NSG designed the annual programme for members of the executive in 2020, as part of its support to government’s commitment to build a capable state.
tgt: I-NSG iyile inkqubo yonyaka yamalungu esigqeba ngo-2020, njengenxalenye yenkxaso yayo ekuzinikeleni kukarhulumente ekwakheni urhulumente okwaziyo ukusebenza.

src: It seeks to, among other things, equip executives within the three spheres of government with enhanced leadership and oversight capabilities to be able to re-examine governance challenges that constrain inclusivity and sustainable economic growth.
tgt: Phakathi kwezinye izinto, ijonge ukuxhobisa abalawuli abakumanqanaba amathathu karhulumente ngobunkokeli nobuchule bokubeka iliso ukuze bakwazi ukuphonononga imingeni yolawulo ethintela ubandakanyo kunye nohlumo kwezoqoqosho oluzinzileyo.

src: Nelson Mandela International Day This year’s Nelson Mandela International Day on Monday, 18 July 2022 will be celebrated under the global theme: “Do what you can, with what you have, wherever you are”.
tgt: Kulo unyaka uSuku luka-Nelson Mandela lweHlabathi oluzakube lungoMvulo, umhla we-18 kweyeKhala ngowama-2022 luza kubhiyozelwa phantsi komxholo wehlabathi jikelele othi: “Yenza onako, ukwenza ngoko onako, naphi na apho ukhoyo”.

src: It is a clarion call for people to support and participate in the campaign by contributing sustainable interventions with a lasting impact.
tgt: Likhwelo elicacileyo lokuba abantu baxhase kwaye bathathe inxaxheba kwiphulo ngokufaka igalelo kungenelelo oluzinzileyo olunefuthe elizakuhlala lihleli.

src: One such sustainable intervention is the annual Nelson Mandela Youth Dialogue and Ethical Leadership Programme focusing on topical issues concerning young people in South Africa and across the globe.
tgt: Olunye ungenelelo oluzinzileyo yiNkqubo yaminyaka le yeNgxoxo yoLutsha kunye neNkqubo yobuNkokheli bokuziphatha egxile kwimiba engumxholo ephathelene nolutsha eMzantsi Afrika nakwihlabathi liphela.

src: Tax Season The 2022 tax filing season will open from 1 July to 24 October 2022.
tgt: Ixesha lokufakwa kwerhafu yama-2022 liya kuvulwa ukususela ngomhla woku-1 kweyeKhala ukuya kowama-24 kweyeDwarha 2022.

src: Taxpayers are encouraged to file their returns on eFiling (WEBTOKEN) or on the South African Revenue Service (SARS) MobiApp.
tgt: Abahlawuli berhafu bayakhuthazwa ukuba bafake imbuyekezo yabo yerhafu apha ku-eFiling (WEBTOKEN) okanye kwi-MobiApp yeNkonzo yeRhafu yoMzantsi Afrika (i-SARS).

src: This year SARS will continue with the auto-assessment of individual taxpayers, which is a pre-populated income tax return to help simplify the submission process.
tgt: Kulo nyaka i-SARS iza kuqhubeka nenkqubo yovavanyo oluzenzekelayo lomrhafi ngamnye, olu vavanyo luyimbuyekezo yengeniso esele ibekwe ngaphambili oku kwenzelwa ukunceda ukwenza lula inkqubo yokungeniswa.

src: In 2021 more than three million taxpayers were auto-assessed.
tgt: Ngowama-2021 babangaphezulu kwezigidi ezithathu abahlawuli berhafu abathi bavavanywa ngale nkqubo yokuzenzekela.

src: The timely and accurate submission of tax returns not only ensures taxpayers remain compliant, but it also helps government to deliver services to South Africans who need them most.
tgt: Ukungeniswa kwangethuba nangokuchanekileyo kweengxelo zerhafu akuqinisekisi nje kuphela ukuba abahlawuli berhafu bahlala bethobela umthetho, kodwa kukwanceda urhulumente ukuba akwazi ukunikezele ngeenkonzo kubemi boMzantsi Afrika abazidinga kakhulu.

src: MESSAGES CongratulationsCabinet extended its congratulations and well-wishes to: Judge Owen Lloyd Rogers following his recent appointment as Judge of the Constitutional Court of South Africa.
tgt: UkuvuyisanaIkhabhinethi igqithisa amazwi okuvuyisana kunye neminqweno emihle: KwiJaji u-Owen Lloyd Rogers emva kokuchongwa kwakhe njenge Jaji leNkundla yaseMzantsi Afrika yoMthethosisekelo.

src: Cabinet joined President Ramaphosa in wishing former President Thabo Mbeki a Happy 80th Birthday, which he celebrated on 18 June 2022.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi idibane noMongameli ivuyisana nalowo wayesakuba ngumongameli u- Thabo Mbeki imnqwenelela imini yokubhiyozela ukuzalwa kwakhe, ebhiyozela iminyaka engama-80 esatya amazimba ngomhla wama-18 kweyeSilimela 2022.

src: Mr Mbeki envisioned a bright and prosperous future for all South Africans.
tgt: U-Mnu Thabo Mbeki wabeka abemi beli loMzantsi Afrika kwikamva eliqaqambileyo nelinempumelelo.

src: APPOINTMENTSAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.
tgt: Izithuba zengqesho Zonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo.

src: Non-executive directors of the South African Civil Aviation Authority Board:a. Mr Ernest Khosab.
tgt: Abalawuli abangengabo abesigqeba seBhodi yoGunyaziwe woPhapho loLuntu loMzantsi Afrika:a. UMnu Ernest Khosab.

src: Ms Bulelwa Koyanac.
tgt: Nksz Bulelwa Koyanac.

src: Mr Surendra Sooklal andd.
tgt: Mnu Surendra Sooklal kunyed.

src: Ms Rejoice Edith Phewa.
tgt: Nksz Rejoice Edith Phewa.

src: Members of the Office of Disclosure of the Home Loan and Mortgage Disclosure: a. Ms Kenosi Pearl Louisa Selane (Chairperson)b. Ms Catharina Maria Van der Sandtc.
tgt: Amalungu e-Ofisi yokuBhengeza iMali-mboleko yeKhaya:a. Nksz.

src: Mr Errol Vincent Magermand.
tgt: Kenosi Pearl Louisa Selane (Usihlalo)b. Nksz.

src: Mr Matsobane Gabriel Mellof.
tgt: Errol Vincent Magermand.

src: Update on the Coronavirus Disease (COVID-19).
tgt: Ezintsha malunga neSifo seNtsholongwane ye-Corona (i-COVID-19).

src: Cabinet commended all people in South Africa who chose to vaccinate and observe all COVID-19 protocols that resulted in the country averting rising numbers of new cases during the fifth wave of the pandemic.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyababulela bonke abantu eMzantsi Afrika abathe bakhetha ukuzigonya nokuthobela imiqathango ye-COVID-19 into leyo ebangele ukuba eli lizwe likwazi ukunqanda ukunyuka kwamanani abantu abasolulelwa okokuqala yi-COVID-19 ngethuba lomsinga wesihlanu walo bhubhane.

src: However, we must not be complacent as COVID-19 is still in our midst.
tgt: Noko kunjalo, kufuneka singayekeleli umxakatho njengoko i-COVID-19 isagquba.

src: Although the country recently scrapped the compulsory wearing of masks in public, people with comorbidities and those who are ill are encouraged to continue wearing a mask.
tgt: Nangona eli lizwe likuphelisile ukunxitywa ngokunyanzelekileyo kwesifonyo esidlangalaleni, abantu abanezifo ezinganyangekiyo kunye nabo bagulayo bayakhuthazwa ukuba baqhubeleke nokunxiba izifonyo.

src: We must also continue to wash or sanitise our hands, and observe social distancing and proper ventilation.
tgt: Futhi kufuneka siqhubeleke nokuhlamba izandla okanye nokuzifefa ngesibulala-ntsholongwane, futhi singasondelelani zize neendawo esikuzo zibethe umoya.

src: Vaccination remains the scientifically proven defence against COVID-19 and Cabinet encourages all unvaccinated people to vaccinate without delay and vaccinated people to get their booster shots at their nearest vaccination sites, for free.
tgt: Ugonyo lixhadi esinalo elikuphela kwalo eliqinisekisiweyo zinzululwazi lokulwa i-COVID-19 kwaye iKhabhinethi ikhuthaza bonke abantu abangagonywanga ukuba baye kugonya ngokukhawuleza baze bona abo sele begonyiwe baye kufumana ichiza elisimahla lokomeleza amajoni omzimba kumaziko akufutshane okugonya.

src: Monkeypox.
tgt: Isifo i-Monkeypox.

src: Cabinet was updated on the latest developments in the spread of Monkeypox disease in the country following the recent confirmation of a second case in the country.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe ingxelo malunga nezintsha ngokunwenwa kwesifo se-Monkeypox kweli lizwe emva kokufunyanwa komntu wesibini onesi sifo kweli lizwe.

src: The affected persons are isolating at home and contact tracing is being conducted to detect others who may have been exposed.
tgt: Aba bantu bafunywenwe banesi sifo kungokunje bazivalele bodwa kumawabo kwaye kusalandelelwa kubo bonke abantu abadibene nabo ukukhangela ukuba ingaba bakhona na abanye abantu abosulelwe sesi sifo.

src: The Department of Health and the National Institute for Communicable Diseases are collaborating with the World Health Organisation to assess the risk for local transmission in line with the International Health Regulations.
tgt: ISebe lezeMpilo kunye neZiko leSizwe leziFo ezoSulelayo (i-NICD) basebenzisana noMbutho wezeMpilo weHlabathi (i-WHO) ukujonga amathuba okunwenwa kwesi sifo kweli njengoko isitsho iMigaqo yezeMpilo yeHlabathi.

src: The monkeypox virus is not easily spread and usually only occurs after close contact such as kissing, cuddling or touching parts of the body with monkeypox lesions.
tgt: Intsholongwane ye-monkeypox ayosuleli lula, yosulela xa abantu bethe basondelelana kakhulu besenza izinto ezifana nokuphuzana, ukucofa-cofana okanye ukubamba-bambana amalungu omzimba anamaqhakuva esi sifo.

src: People without monkeypox symptoms cannot spread the virus to others.
tgt: Abantu abangenazimpawu ze-monkeypox abayisasazi le ntsholongwane.

src: Cabinet advised people who experience symptoms of fever, general flu-like signs, followed by a blister-like rash to report to their nearest healthcare facility for early detection and treatment.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icebisa abantu ababonakalisa iimpawu zomkhuhlane ezithi zilandelwe ngamaqhakuva angathi ngamadyunguza ukuba baye kwiziko lezempilo elikufutshane ukuze baxilongwe baze banyangwe.

src: East London tavern tragedy.
tgt: Inyhikityha enyenzeke kwibhari yaseMonti.

src: The devastating tragedy at the Enyobeni Tavern in East London in the Eastern Cape on Sunday, 26 June 2022 that claimed the lives of 21 teenagers, has shattered our entire country.
tgt: Inyhikityha embi eyenzeke e-Enyobeni eMonti kwiphondo laseMpuma Koloni ngeCawe, umhla wama-26 kweyeSilimela 2022 apho kusweleke abantu abatsha abangama-21, ilishiye eli lizwe lidandathekile.

src: It is hard to imagine the anguish of families who lost their children in such a tragic manner.
tgt: Ayinakulinganiswa intlungu azibona ekuyo la makhaya ashiywe ngabantwana bawo kabuhlungu kangaka.

src: Cabinet expressed its condolences to the families who lost their loved ones and thanked everyone for their humanitarian support to the grieving families during this difficult time.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithi akuhlanga lungehliyo kwiintsapho eziphantsi kwelifu elimnyama kwaye ibulela wonke umntu othe wanikezela ngoncedo lwezentlalontle kwezi ntsapho zisentlungwini.

src: It is concerning that children as young as 13 were allowed to enter the venue and consume alcohol.
tgt: Iyaxhalabisa into yokuba iimveku ezineminyaka eli-13 zivunyelwe ukuba zingene kule ndawo yentselo zize zivunyelwe nokuba zisele utywala.

src: We call on communities to play their part in keeping our children safe at all times.
tgt: Sicela uluntu ukuba nalo luncedise ludlale indima yalo ngokuthi luqinisekise ukuba abantwana bakhuselekile ngalo lonke ixesha.

src: Children under the age of 18 are not allowed to enter taverns, shebeens, pubs and bottle stores.
tgt: Abantwana abaneminyaka engaphantsi kwe-18 abavumelekanga ukuba bangene kwiithaveni, izimokolo, iipotsoyi zotywala nasezibharini.

src: Liquor traders who are found to be contravening any of these laws must be criminally charged and have their operating licences revoked.
tgt: Oosomashishini botywala abafunyaniswe besophula nawuphi na kule mithetho baza kubekwa ityala zize iilayisenisi zabo zotywala zithathwe.

src: Outcomes from the Group of Seven (G7) Leaders’ Summit.
tgt: Iziphumo zeNgqungquthela yeeNkokeli zamaZwe aTyebileyo asi-7 (i-G7).

src: President Cyril Ramaphosa participated in the G7 Leaders’ Summit which took place in Bavaria, Germany on Monday, 27 June 2022.
tgt: UMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa uthabathe inxaxheba kwiNgqungquthela yeeNkokheli ze-G7 ebibanjelwe e-Bavaria, e-Germany, ngomhla wama-27 kweyeSilimela 2022.

src: The President – who participated in working sessions where climate, energy, health, global food security and gender equality issues were discussed – was invited by the host, Chancellor Olaf Scholz.
tgt: UMongameli – othathe inxaxheba kwiintlanganiso ebezigwadla imiba enxulumene nemozulu, ezamandla, ezempilo, amaphulo okuqinisekiswa ukuba kukho ukutya okwaneleyo kwihlabathi kunye nolingwano ngokwesini – ebemenywe yiNgqonyela u-Olaf Scholz, ebinguye ebesingathe le Ngqungquthela.

src: The G7 is an intergovernmental political forum consisting of Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, the United Kingdom and the United States.
tgt: I-G7 liqumrhu lezopolitiko loorhulumene abahlukeneyo eliquka i-Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, United Kingdom kunye ne-United States.

src: Cabinet Decisions.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Draft Legal Sector Code (Draft LSC).
tgt: ImiGaqo eYilwayo yeCandelo lezoMthetho (i-LSC eYilwayo).

src: Cabinet approved the publication of the Draft LSC for public comment.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba ipapashwe i-LSC eYilwayo ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: The objectives of these codes are to facilitate the transformation of the legal sector to achieve representation as per the country’s demographics.
tgt: Iinjongo zale migaqo kukukhokela amaphulo okwenza iinguqu kwicandelo lezomthetho ukuze zonke iintlanga zeli lizwe zikwazi ukuthatha inxaxheba kulo ngokulinganayo.

src: The code will also ensure the development of the body that will produce well-trained and competent providers of legal services.
tgt: Le migaqo iza kuqinisekisa nokuba kuswekwa iqumrhu eliza kuvelisa iingcali zezomthetho eziqeqeshwe zacokiswa futhi nezinezakhono ezigqibeleleyo.

src: The development of the Draft LSC was overseen by the Legal Practice Council, a statutory body established in terms of Section 4 of the Legal Practice Act, 2014 (Act 28 of 2014) and guided by the Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Act (B-BBEE), 2013 (Act 46 of 2013).
tgt: Inkqubo yokuqulunqa le-LSC iYilwayo ibikhokelwa liBhunga leCandelo lezoMthetho, eliliqumrhu elisemthethweni elisekwe ngokweCandelo 4 loMthetho weCandelo lezoMthetho, wowama-2014 (uMthetho uNombl 28 wowama-2014) likhokelwa nguMthetho woPhuhliso oluBanzi lwabaMnyama ngezoQoqosho (i-B-BBEE), wowama-2013 (uMthetho uNombl 46 wowama-2013).

src: The B-BBEE Act of 2013 provides for the Minister of Trade, Industry and Competition to issue codes of good practice on black economic empowerment in the specific sectors.
tgt: UMthetho we-B-BBEE wowama-2013 ugunyazisa uMphathiswa wezoRhwebo, uShishino noKhuphiswano ukuba akhuphe imigaqo yokuziphatha ngokufanelekileyo ngokumayelana nokuphuhliswa kwabamnyama ngezoqoqosho kumacandelo athile.

src: Members of the legal profession currently do not have a sector code to guide them in addressing the imbalances and inequalities in the legal profession.
tgt: Amalungu ecandelo lezomthetho kungokunje awanayo imigaqo yokuziphatha yecandelo ezakuwakhokhela kumalinge okulungisa nokungalingani nokungaxhamli ngokulinganayo kwicandelo lezomthetho.

src: The Draft LSC will be published in the Government Gazette for 60 days to allow for public comments.
tgt: I-LSC eYilwayo iza kupapashwa kwiGazethi kaRhulumente iintsuku ezingama-60 ukwenzela ukuba uluntu luhlomle.

src: Biannual performance progress reports Cabinet approved the biannual performance progress reports for the period covering October 2021 to March 2022.
tgt: Iingxelo zonyaka-mbini zenkqubo yomsebenzi.

src: The reports form part of the Medium Term Strategic Framework (MTSF) 2019-2024.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izivumile iingxelo zikanyaka-mbini zenkqubo yomsebenzi zesithuba esisuka kwinyanga yeDwarha yowama-2021 ukuya kweyoKwindla wowama-2022.

src: The MTSF 2019-2024 is the implementation plan and monitoring framework for achieving the National Development Plan: Vision 2030 priorities for the sixth administration of government.
tgt: Ezi ngxelo ziyinxalenye yesiCwangciso-sikhokelo esiQiqisiweyo saPhakathi koNyaka (i-MTSF) sowama-2019-2014.

src: The reports focused on the seven priorities of government, namely (1) Economic transformation and job creation (2) Education, skills and health (3) Consolidating the social wage through reliable and quality basic services (4) Spatial integration, human settlements and local government (5) Social cohesion and safe communities (6) A capable, ethical and developmental state and (7) A better Africa and world, and related interventions of the sixth administration.
tgt: I-MTSF yowama-2024 sisicwangciso sokuphumeza kunye nesikhokelo sokuhlola ukuze kufezekiswe izinto ezikhokeliswe phambili zalo mbuso uthathe iintambo zolawulo ngowama-2018 zesiCwanciso soPhuhliso seSizwe (i-NDP): uMbono wama-2030.

src: Cabinet welcomed areas of progress on the determined targets for the period under review.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayibulela inkqubela eyenziwe kwezo ndawo zithile ngokweenjongo ebezibekiwe zeli xesha kubhekiswa kulo.

src: Cabinet also noted areas that required interventions so as to address delays which were negatively impacted by the COVID-19 pandemic.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivile nangendawo ezifuna ukuba kungenelelwe ukuze kulungiswe ezi zinto zibangele ulibaziseko ebeziphazanyiswe ngubhubhane we-COVID-19.

src: Dr Zwanani Titus Mathe as Chief Executive Officer of the South African National Energy Development Institute.
tgt: Dr Zwanani Titus Mathe as Chief Executive Officer of the South African National Energy Development Institute.

src: Part-time members of the National Energy Regulator of South Africa: a. Mr Thembani Bukula (Chairperson)b. Ms Zandile Mpungose (Deputy Chairperson) c. Ms Precious Sibiyad.
tgt: Part-time members of the National Energy Regulator of South Africa: a. Mr Thembani Bukula (Chairperson)b. Ms Zandile Mpungose (Deputy Chairperson) c. Ms Precious Sibiyad.

src: Ms Thembeka Semane ande.
tgt: Ms Thembeka Semane ande.

src: Mr Fungai Sibanda (reappointment).
tgt: Mr Fungai Sibanda (reappointment).

src: Chairperson and member of the Council for Mineral Technology Board:a. Dr Thibedi Ramontja (Chairperson) andb.
tgt: Chairperson and member of the Council for Mineral Technology Board:a. Dr Thibedi Ramontja (Chairperson) andb.

src: Economy Cabinet welcomed the slight decline in the country’s unemployment rate, which dropped by percent, from 34.5% in the first quarter to percent in the second quarter of 2022.
tgt: Uqoqosho IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuhla kancinci kwezinga labantu abangaphangeliyo kweli lizwe, nelihle nge-0.6%, lisuka kuma-34.5% kwikota yokuqala laya kutsho kuma-33.9% kwikota yesibini yowama-2022.

src: The figures published in the Quarterly Labour Force Survey by Statistics South Africa show that the biggest job gains were recorded in Community and Social Services (276 000), Trade (169 000), Finance (128 000) and Construction (104 000).
tgt: Amanani apapashwe kwiiNkcukacha-manani zoMzantsi Afrika zoPhando lweKota lwezaBasebenzi abonisa ukuba eyona nzuzo inkulu ibonakale kwiiNkonzo zoLuntu nezeNtlalo (276 000), kuRhwebo (169 000), kwezeMali (128 000) kunye nakuLwakhiwo (104 000).

src: The total number of employed persons stood at 15, 6 million in the second quarter of 2022, and the number of unemployed persons increased by 132 000 to 8, 0 million in the second quarter of 2022 compared to the previous quarter.
tgt: Inani labantu abasebenzayo bebonke limi kwi-15.6 lezigidi kwikota yesibini ka-2022, kwaye inani labantu abangasebenziyo linyuke nge-132 000 ukuya kwisi-8.0 sezigidi kwikota yesibini ka-2022 xa kuthelekiswa nekota yangaphambili.

src: These modest yet impressive gains show that the concerted efforts by government and its social partners to grow the economy and create much-needed jobs are beginning to bear fruit.
tgt: Ezi nzuzo zincinci kodwa zincomekayo zibonisa ukuba iinzame ezidityanelweyo zikarhulumente kunye namahlakani akhe kwezentlalo okukhulisa uqoqosho nokudala imisebenzi efuneka ngamandla ziyaqalisa ukuvelisa iziqhamo.

src: This is a testament to the fact that if we all work together by harnessing our collective strengths, we can overcome the challenges facing our economy.
tgt: Obu bubungqina bokuba xa sinosebenzisana sisonke sisebenzise amandla ethu ahlangeneyo, singayoyisa imingeni ejongene noqoqosho lwethu.

src: Cabinet understands the frustrations of South Africans as they struggle to go about their daily lives owing to the cost of living and high unemployment rate.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawuqonda umsindo wabemi boMzantsi Afrika njengoko besokola ukuqhubeka nobomi babo ngenxa yeendleko zokuphila kunye nentswela-ngqesho ephezulu.

src: As a caring government, we remain determined and committed to working together with our social partners to build a better tomorrow for everyone.
tgt: Njengorhulumente okhathalayo, sizimisele ukusebenzisana namahlakani ethu kwezentlalo ukwakha ingomso elingcono lomntu wonke.

src: Government remains committed to supporting local businesses by buying local goods and services.
tgt: Urhulumente usazimisele ukuxhasa amashishini asekuhlaleni ngokuthenga iimpahla kunye neenkonzo zalapha ekhaya.

src: Public infrastructure.
tgt: Iziseko zophuhliso zoluntu.

src: Cabinet condemned the destruction of infrastructure by Tongaat residents in KwaZulu-Natal during a protest over access to water.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugxekile ukutshatyalaliswa kweziseko zophuhliso ngabahlali base-Tongaat KwaZulu-Natal ngexesha loqhankqalazo befuna amanzi.

src: Cabinet called for calm and patience as work is underway to restore the Tongaat Water Treatment Works.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlabe ikhwelo lokuzola kunye nomonde njengoko uqhuba umsebenzi wokubuyisela iMisebenzi yokuCocwa kwaManzi ase-Tongaat.

src: Cabinet understands the frustrations of residents who have had to use water tankers for an extended period since the flooding earlier this year.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawuqonda umsindo wabahlali ekuye kwafuneka ukuba basebenzise iitanki zamanzi ukusukela oko kwabakho izikhukula ebutsheni balo nyaka.

src: However, violence and anarchy are not a solution, and the destruction of public infrastructure only hurts local communities.
tgt: Nangona kunjalo, ubundlobongela kunye neziphithiphithi azisosisombululo, kwaye ukutshatyalaliswa kweziseko zophuhliso kulimaza kuphela uluntu.

src: Local Government Municipal Systems Amendment Act of 2022.
tgt: UMthetho oLungisiweyo kwiiNkqubo zikaMasipala kuRhulumente wamaKhaya wama-2022.

src: Cabinet welcomed the signed into law the Local Government Municipal Systems Amendment Act, 2022 (Act 3 of 2022) by President Cyril Ramaphosa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwamkele uMthetho oYilwayo weeNkqubo zooMasipala kuRhulumente wamaKhaya, wama-2022 (uMthetho 3 wama-2022) otyikityiweyo nguMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa.

src: The Act aims to improve the capacity and ethical standards of local government.
tgt: Lo Mthetho ujolise ekuphuculeni amandla kunye nemigangatho yeendlela zokuziphatha zikarhulumente wamakhaya.

src: The law forms part of government’s efforts to professionalise the Public Service and ensure the sustainable provision of services to the people, as a basic right enshrined in the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.
tgt: Lo mthetho uyinxalenye yamalinge karhulumente okwenza iNkonzo kaRhulumente yenziwe ngobuchule kwaye iqinisekise ukubonelela ngeenkonzo okuzinzileyo ebantwini, njengelungelo elisisiseko eliqulathwe kuMgaqo-siseko weRiphablikhi yoMzantsi Afrika we-1996.

src: The Act specifies the processes to be followed for senior position appointments.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uchaza iinkqubo emazilandelwe xa kuqeshwa kwizikhundla eziphezulu.

src: It now prevents senior public officials from holding political office in political parties.
tgt: Ngoku uthintela amagosa aphezulu karhulumente ekubeni abe nezikhundla zopolitiko kumaqela ezopolitiko.

src: Also with this Act in place, vacant municipal manager posts are expected to be advertised nationally to attract a wide pool of suitable candidates.
tgt: Kananjalo kulo Mthetho ukhoyo, izithuba zoomanejala boomasipala ezingenabantu kulindeleke ukuba zipapashwe kuzwelonke ukutsala iqela elibanzi labagqatswa abafanelekileyo.

src: Cabinet is confident that these changes will ensure that those who are appointed or elected into these positions will be able to deliver on their promises so that we can achieve a better life for all.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekile ukuba olu tshintsho luza kuqinisekisa ukuba abo banyuliweyo okanye abanyulwe kwezi zikhundla baya kukwazi ukuphumeza izithembiso zabo ukuze wonke umntu azuze ubomi obungcono.

src: Crime Cabinet commended the South African Revenue Service’s customs officials for seizing 785 kg of crystal meth with a street value of R236 million at the OR Tambo International Airport on Sunday, 28 August 2022.
tgt: IKhabhinethi income amagosa eNkonzo yeRhafu yoMzantsi Afrika ngokuthimba i-785 kg ye-crystal meth enexabiso lasesitratweni lezigidi ezingama-R236 kwisikhululo seenqwelomoya i-OR Tambo International ngeCawe, umhla wama-28 kweyeThupha wama-2022.

src: The drug bust will send a clear warning to criminal syndicates that our ports of entry and exit are well protected and our officers are working hard to stamp out any criminality.
tgt: Ukubhaqwa kweziyobisi kuya kuthumela isilumkiso esicacileyo kumaqela abophuli-mthetho ukuba amazibuko ethu okungena kunye nawokuphuma akhuselwe kakuhle kwaye amagosa ethu asebenza nzima ukuphelisa naluphi na ulwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Cabinet decisions.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Report of the Council on Higher Education (CHE) Enquiry into the Remuneration of University Vice Chancellors and Senior Executive Managers in South Africa.
tgt: Ingxelo yeBhunga leMfundo ePhakamileyo (i-CHE) ngoMvuzo weeSekela-Tshansela zeeYunivesithi kunye naBaphathi abaPhezulu abaLawulayo eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the outcomes of the CHE enquiry that was commissioned in 2020 by the Minister of Higher Education, Science and Innovation, Dr Blade Nzimande, to examine the remuneration levels and trends of the university executives over the 15-year period from 2005 to 2019.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngeziphumo zophando lwe-CHE olwagunyaziswa ngowama-2020 nguMphathiswa wezeMfundo ePhakamileyo, ezeNzululwazi kunye noKusungulwa Kwezinto Ezintsha, uGq Blade Nzimande, ukuze kuphononongwe amanqanaba emivuzo kunye neendlela zabaphathi beeyunivesithi kwisithuba seminyaka eli-15 ukusuka ngowama-2005 ukuya kutsho kowama-2019.

src: The investigation was to establish the sustainability, viability and development of the universities or higher education sector in the country.
tgt: Uphando ibikukumisela uzinzo, ukusebenza kunye nophuhliso lweeyunivesithi okanye icandelo lemfundo ephakamileyo kweli lizwe.

src: This report outlines the key findings together with proposed remedial recommendations.
tgt: Le ngxelo ichaza iziphumo eziphambili kunye nezindululo zokulungisa.

src: The recommendations propose, amongst others, a strengthened and more transparent remuneration process.
tgt: Izindululo ziphakamisa, phakathi kwezinye izinto, inkqubo yomvuzo eqinisiweyo kunye nephandle.

src: The setting up of an external and independent oversight structure to oversee the decision-making process of remunerations.
tgt: Ukusekwa kwesigqeba sokujonga sangaphandle kwaye nesizimeleyo ukojonga inkqubo yokwenziwa kwezigqibo zemivuzo.

src: It also proposes the strengthening of the performance evaluation systems in the institutions.
tgt: Zikwaphakamisa nokuqiniswa kweenkqubo zovavanyo lomsebenzi kumaziko.

src: The study has also taken into account the various sizes of these institutions and it also did international benchmarking.
tgt: Uphononongo lukwathathele ingqalelo ubungakanani bala maziko kwaye lwenza nokulinganisa lujonga kumazwe ngamazwe.

src: The Minister of Higher Education, Science and Innovation is expected to discuss this report with the university leadership as a measure to strengthen these academic institutions.
tgt: UMphathiswa weMfundo ePhakamileyo, iNzululwazi noKusungulwa Kwezinto Ezintsha kulindeleke ukuba axoxe ngale ngxelo neenkokeli zeyunivesithi njengenyathelo lokomeleza la maziko emfundo.

src: The report will thereafter be published in the Department of Higher Education and Training’s website: WEBTOKEAccelerated Transformation of the Research and Teaching Capacity in the Higher Education Sector.
tgt: Ingxelo iya kuthi emva koko ipapashwe kwiwebhusayithi yeSebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho: WEBTOKEINguqu eKhawulezayo yoPhando kunye neSakhono sokuFundisa kwiCandelo leMfundo ePhakamileyo.

src: Cabinet supported the recommendations of the two studies that were commissioned to advise on the measures to be put in place so as to accelerate the transformation of research and teaching capacity in the institutions of higher learning.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izixhasile izindululo zamaphononongo amabini awayegunyaziswe ukuba acebise ngamanyathelo aza kuthathwa ukuze kukhawuleziswe inguqu yophando kunye nesakhono sokufundisa kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo.

src: The first report was done by the Ministerial Task Team which investigated the blockages that prevent the recruitment, retention and progression of black South African academics.
tgt: Ingxelo yokuqala yenziwe liQela laBaphathiswa eliSebenzayo elaphanda ngemiqobo ethintela ukuqeshwa, ukugcinwa kunye nokuqhubela phambili kwezifundiswa ezimnyama zaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: The second report – commissioned by the Department of Science and Innovation and the National Research Foundation – was done by Universities South Africa, the umbrella body representative of the 26 public universities in the country.
tgt: Ingxelo yesibini – egunyaziswe liSebe lezeNzululwazi noKusungulwa Kwezinto Ezintsha kunye neSiseko soPhando lweSizwe – yenziwe yi-Universities South Africa, iqumrhu elimele iiyunivesithi zoluntu ezingama-26 kweli lizwe.

src: Both these reports proposes intervention strategies to accelerate transformation in five broad areas, namely in postgraduate pineline staff participation institutional culture and practice policy and the strategy, and limited resources.
tgt: Zombini ezi ngxelo zinikeze ngamacebo ongenelelo ukuze kukhawuleziswe inguqu kwimimandla emihlanu ebanzi, esebefumene isidanga sokuqala ukuthatha inxaxheba kwabasebenzi inkcubeko kunye nokusebenza kweziko umgaqo-nkqubo nesicwangciso, kunye nezibonelelo ezingqongopheleyo.

src: International Treaty on Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (the Treaty).
tgt: ISivumelwano saMazwe ngaMazwe ngeMithombo Yemfuza yeZityalo zoKutya kunye nezoLimo (iSivumelwano).

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the Treaty to Parliament for accession.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa kweSivumelwano ePalamente.

src: This will enable South Africa to form part of the parties to this Treaty, which guides the member countries in conserving and ensuring the sustainable usage of the plant genetic resources for food and agriculture.
tgt: Oku kuya kwenza ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ube yinxalenye yamaqela esi Sivumelwano, nesikhokela amazwe angamalungu ekulondolozeni kunye nasekuqinisekiseni usetyenziso oluzinzileyo lwemithombo yemfuza yezityalo ekutyeni nakwezolimo.

src: Acceding to this Treaty will also strengthen the country’s commitment towards conservation and sustainable use of plant genetic resources, and provide support to rural communities.
tgt: Ukungena kwesi siVumelwano kuya komeleza ukuzibophelela kwelizwe ngokubhekiselele kulondolozo kunye nokusetyenziswa ngokuzinzileyo kwemithombo yemfuza yezityalo, kwaye sinike inkxaso kuluntu lwasemaphandleni.

src: Just Transition Framework for South Africa.
tgt: ISicwangciso-nkqubo seNguqu eluLungileyo soMzantsi Afrika.

src: Cabinet approved the Just Transition Framework for implementation.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume iSicwangciso-nkqubo seNguqu eluLungileyo ukuba iphunyezwe.

src: The framework presents a shared vision for an equitable, climate-resilient South Africa.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-nkqubo sibonisa umbono okwabelwana ngawo woMzantsi Afrika olinganayo, nokwaziyo ukumelana nemozulu.

src: It defines the principles and policy areas to achieve this.
tgt: Sichaza imigaqo kunye neendawo kumgaqo-nkqubo zokuphumeza oku.

src: The transition framework will impact everyone in South Africa, and provides an opportunity to address historical inequities and creates an economy that benefits all.
tgt: Isicwangciso-nkqubo senguqu siza kuchaphazela wonke umntu waseMzantsi Afrika, sinike ithuba lokulungisa ukungalingani okwenziwa yimbali kwaye sidale uqoqosho oluxhamlisa wonke umntu.

src: The Presidential Climate Commission conducted an extensive consultation process with social partners and received broad support for the framework.
tgt: IKomishoni kaMongameli yeMozulu iqhube inkqubo yothethathethwano ebanzi kunye namahlakani ezentlalo yaze yafumana inkxaso ebanzi ngesi sicwangciso-nkqubo.

src: Cabinet affirmed that the shift to a net-zero carbon economy by 2050 must support national development aspirations, including decent work for all, social inclusion and the eradication of poverty.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekisile ukuba inguqu eya kuqoqosho olungenayo ikhabhoni ngowama-2050 kufuneka ixhase iminqweno yophuhliso lwesizwe, kuqukwe imisebenzi endilisekileyo kumntu wonke, ubandakanyo lwentlalo kunye nokupheliswa kwentlupheko.

src: Cabinet has called on all social partners to rally behind and embrace this framework.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlabe ikhwelo kuwo onke amahlakani ezentlalo ukuba axhase aze amkele esi sicwangciso-nkqubo.

src: A detailed implementation plan for the framework will be developed, and it will be integrated into the government planning and budgeting system.
tgt: Isicwangciso esineenkcukacha zokuphumeza esi sicwangciso-nkqubo siya kuphuhliswa, kwaye sidityaniswe kwinkqubo yocwangciso kunye neyohlahlo lwabiwo-mali karhulumente.

src: New South African Driving Licence Card.
tgt: Ikhadi elitsha leLayisenisi yokuQhuba yoMzantsi Afrika.

src: Cabinet approved the replacement of the current Driving Licence Card to a one with more secure design features.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukutshintshwa kweKhadi leLayisensi yokuQhuba elikhoyo ngoku lize lifakwe kwelinye elineempawu ezikhuselekileyo.

src: The current system has been in operation since 1998.
tgt: Le nkqubo yangoku oko yayisebenza ukusukela ngo-1998.

src: The technology has since evolved and it is becoming expensive to maintain the current infrastructure.
tgt: Ubuchwephesha ukusukela ngoko sebatshintsha kwaye kuya kuxabisa kakhulu ukugcina iziseko zophuhliso ezikhoyo .

src: The new proposed card will make the country’s driving licence compatible with the International Information Technology Personal Identification Compliant Driving Licence (ISO1801.3).
tgt: Ikhadi elitsha elicetywayo liya kwenza ilayisenisi yokuqhuba yeli lizwe ihambelane ne-International Information Technology Personal Identification Compliant Driving License (i-ISO1801.3).

src: Expanded Public Works Programme (EPWP) Policy.
tgt: UMgaqo-nkqubo weNkqubo eYandisiweyo yeMisebenzi kaRhulumente (i-EPWP).

src: Cabinet approved the gazetting of the draft EPWP Policy for public consultation.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kwiphephandaba likarhulumente loMgaqo-nkqubo oyilwayo we-EPWP ukuze uluntu lubonisane ngawo.

src: The EPWP is one of government's key programmes aimed at providing poverty and income relief by creating temporary work opportunities, particularly for youth and women.
tgt: I-EPWP yenye yeenkqubo eziphambili zikarhulumente ezijolise ekuboneleleni ukuthomalalisa intlupheko kunye nokuzisa ingeniso ngokudala amathuba emisebenzi ethutyana, ingakumbi kulutsha kunye nabasetyhini.

src: The draft new policy will strengthen the programme and provide clarity on aspects such as wages, funding model and social protection, and also align the EPWP with modern labour practices.
tgt: Uyilo lomgaqo-nkqubo omtsha luza komeleza le nkqubo kwaye lunike ingcaciso kwimiba efana nemivuzo, imodeli yenkxaso-mali kunye nokhuseleko loluntu, kwaye lulungelelanise i-EPWP neendlela zokusebenza zale mihla.

src: It will promote partnerships between government and the private sector toward ensuring the EPWP contributes massively towards the creation of decent work and alleviation of poverty.
tgt: Luza kukhuthaza intsebenziswano phakathi kukarhulumente kunye necandelo labucala ukuqinisekisa ukuba i-EPWP inegalelo elikhulu ekudalweni kwemisebenzi endilisekileyo kunye nokuphelisa intlupheko.

src: The policy will also promote innovation in the implementation of public works programmes across the country.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo uza kukhuthaza ukusungulwa kwezinto ezintsha ekuphunyezweni kweenkqubo zemisebenzi yoluntu kwilizwe liphela.

src: Amendments to the Fourth Decimal Coin Series of South Africa.
tgt: Izilungiso kuLuhlu lweSine kwiMali eziNkozo zaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Cabinet has approved the dimension, design and compilation of the year 2023 Fourth Decimal Coin Series of South Africa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwamkele umyinge, uyilo kunye noqulunqo lonyaka wama-2023 lweSine kwiMali eziNkozo zoMzantsi Afrika.

src: It approved the annual rotational system of the usage of the official languages on the fourth decimal coin series.
tgt: Ivume inkqubo ejikelezayo qho ngonyaka yokusetyenziswa kweelwimi ezisemthethweni kuluhlu lwesine lweemali ezinkozo.

src: The word “South Africa” will be inserted on the one side of the coins and printed in all the official languages.
tgt: Igama elithi “uMzantsi Afrika” liya kufakwa kwelinye icala kwimali eyinkozo ze libhalwe ngazo zonke iilwimi ezisemthethweni.

src: Three languages will be used in the R5 coin two languages R2 50c, 20c and 10c coins and the R1 will be in one language.
tgt: Iilwimi ezintathu ziya kusetyenziswa kwi-R5 iilwimi ezimbini kwi-R2 i-50c, i-20c, i-10c kunye ne-R1 ziya kuba ngolwimi olunye.

src: All these languages will be used on an annual rotational basis over the next 10 years.
tgt: Zonke ezi lwimi ziya kusetyenziswa ngendlela ejikeleziswayo rhoqo ngonyaka kule minyaka ili-10 izayo.

src: Draft Integrated Water Quality Management (IWQM) Policy of 2022.
tgt: UMgaqo-nkqubo oYilwayo oDityanisiweyo woLawulo loMgangatho waManzi (i-IWQM) wowama-2022.

src: Cabinet approved the gazetting of the Draft IWQM Policy for public consultation.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kwiphephandaba likarhulumente koMgaqo-nkqubo oYilwayo we-IWQM ukuze uluntu lubonisane.

src: The proposed policy will replace the outdated WQM Policy of 1991 and its strategy that was put in place in 2006.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ucetywayo uya kuthatha indawo yoMgaqo-nkqubo we-WQM ophelelwe lixesha wama-1991 kunye nesicwangciso-qhinga sawo esamiselwa ngo-2006.

src: The policy outlines a set of principles that will form the basis for water quality management.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo uchaza uluhlu lwemigaqo eya kuba sisiseko solawulo lomgangatho wamanzi.

src: It provides an alignment to all the relevant water-related legislation and the country’s global commitments to the provision and conservation of water as a scarce resource.
tgt: Uzobonelela ngolungelelwaniso kuyo yonke imithetho efanelekileyo enxulumene namanzi kunye nezibophelelo zelizwe ekuboneleleni nasekulondolozweni kwamanzi njengomthombo onqabileyo.

src: Draft Next Generation Radio Frequency Spectrum Policy.
tgt: Uyilo loMgaqo-nkqubo weSizukulwana esiLandelayo seTeknoloji yezoNxibelelwano eSebenza ngaMaza oMoya.

src: Cabinet approved the publication of the draft Next Generation Radio Frequency Spectrum Policy for public comment.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa koyilo loMgaqo-nkqubo weSizukulwana esiLandelayo soMgaqo-nkqubo seTeknoloji yezoNxibelelwano eSebenza ngaMaza oMoya ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: Radio frequency spectrum is a finite natural resource that is vital to the growth of South Africa’s digital economy and communication infrastructure.
tgt: Iteknoloji yezonxibelelwano esebenza ngamaza omoya sisixhobo sendalo esibalulekileyo kuhlumo loqoqosho lwedijithali yoMzantsi Afrika kunye nakwisiseko sonxibelelwano.

src: The proposed policy intends to support the spectrum allocation and licensing for fixed mobile broadcasting aeronautical and marine research and development community access, and other relevant industries.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ucetywayo ujonge ukuxhasa ulwabiwo lwamaza omoya kunye nokukhutshwa kweelayisenisi ezisisigxina zeselula zosasazo zenqwelomoya nezaselwandle zophando nophuhliso zokufikelela koluntu, kunye nezamanye amashishini afanelekileyo.

src: The policy also seeks to promote equity and fair allocation to contribute towards the transformation of the sector and accessibility of digital connectivity even in outlying parts of the country.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ukwajonge ukukhuthaza ulingano kunye nolwabiwo olungenamkhethe ukuze lwenze igalelo kwinguqu yeli candelo kunye nakufikeleleka kuqhagamshelwano lwedijithali nakwiindawo ezikude zelizwe.

src: South Africa’s Candidature for the International Telecommunication Union ( ITU) Council and Radio Regulations Board Cabinet approved South Africa’s candidature of Mr Mandla Samuel Mchunu to the ITU Radio Regulations Board (Region D).
tgt: Umgqatswa woMzantsi Afrika weManyano yoNxibelelwano lweZizwe ngeZizwe (i-ITU) kunye neBhodi yoLawulo kaNomathotholo IKhabhinethi imamkele umgqatswa woMzantsi Afrika uMnu Mandla Samuel Mchunu kwiBhodi yeMimiselo kaNomathotholo (kwiNgingqi D) ye-ITUMnu Mchunu ulilungu lebhodi esebenzayo ngoku.

src: He is proposed for re-election to the ITU Council for the term 2023 to 2026.
tgt: Kwaye kucetywa ukuba aphinde onyulwe kwiBhunga ye-ITU kwixesha lowama-2023 ukuya kowama-2026.

src: The elections will take place during the ITU Plenipotentiary Conference to be held in Bucharest, Romania from 26 September to 14 October 2022.
tgt: Unyulo luya kuqhubeka ngexesha leNkomfa yoNozakuzaku ye-ITU eya kubanjelwa e-Bucharest, e-Romania ukusuka ngomhla wama-26 kweyoMsintsi ukuya kowe-14 kweyeDwarha 2022.

src: South Africa remains committed to the goals and objectives of the ITU of bridging the digital divide and connecting all the people of the world.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika usazibophelele kwiinjongo ze-ITU zokuvala ukwahlukana kwedijithali kunye nokudibanisa bonke abantu behlabathi.

src: Upcoming event.
tgt: Imisitho ezayo.

src: Heritage Month Heritage Month in September will this year be commemorated under the theme: “Celebrating the Legacy of Solomon Linda and South Africa’s Indigenous Music”.
tgt: INyanga yaMafa kweyoMsintsi iza kukhunjulwa phantsi komxholo othi: “UkuBhiyozela ilifa lika-Solomon Linda kunye noMculo weMveli waseMzantsi Afrika”.

src: Cabinet urges all South Africans to use Heritage Month to celebrate our rich cultural heritage and diversity that has the power to unite our nation.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba basebenzise iNyanga yaMafa ukubhiyozela inkcubeko yethu etyebileyo kunye neyantlukwano enamandla okumanya isizwe sethu.

src: We must all be committed to working together to eradicate the divisions and injustices of the past and promote a conscious sense of being proudly South African.
tgt: Sonke kufuneka sizibophelele ekusebenzeni kunye nokuphelisa iyantlukwano nokungabikho kobulungisa obenzeka kwixesha eladlulayo kwaye sikhuthaze ukuzingca ngokuba ngummi waseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Messages.
tgt: Imiyalezo.

src: CongratulationsCabinet extended its congratulations and well-wishes to: All winners, medallists and competitors who participated in the 95th Comrades Marathon, popularly known as the “Ultimate Human Race”, on Sunday, 28 August 2022.
tgt: Uvuyiswano IKhabhinethi idlulise amazwi ombulelo kunye neminqweno emihle kwaba balandelayo:Bonke abaphumeleleyo, abaphumelele imbasa kunye nabakhuphisanayo abathathe inxaxheba kumdyarho we-Comrades wama-95, owaziwa njenge “Ultimate Human Race”, ngeCawe, umhla wama-28 kweyeThupha 2022.

src: The men's race was won by Tete Dijana (5 hrs, 30 min, 38 sec) from Mahikeng in North West while Russian runner Alexandra Morozova (6 hrs, 17 min, 47 sec) won the women’s race.
tgt: Ugqatso lwamadoda lwaphunyelelwa ngu-Tete Dijana (kwiiyure ezi-5, imizuzu engama-30, imizuzwana engama-38) osuka e-Mahikeng, eMntla Ntshona ngelixa imbaleki yase-Russia u-Alexandra Morozova (kwiiyure ezi-6, imizuzu eli-17, imizuzwana engama-47) ephumelele ugqatso lwabasetyhini.

src: Condolences Cabinet expressed condolences to the family and friends of: Mama Rita Alice Ndzanga (88), the Struggle veteran and pioneering trade unionist who was also the recipient of the National Order of Luthuli in 2004 for “her lifetime contribution to the struggle for workers’ rights and to the realisation of a non-racial, non-sexist, free and democratic South Africa”.The five South African Police Service (SAPS) officers who were passengers onboard the SAPS aircraft that crashed at Rand Airport, Germiston on Tuesday, 30 August 2022.
tgt: Amazwi Ovelwano IKhabhinethi ivakalise amazwi ovelwano kusapho nezihlobo zika:Mama Rita Alice Ndzanga (88), igqala loMzabalazo nokwanguvulindlela wemanyano yabasebenzi owafumana imbasa ye-National Order of Luthuli ngowama-2004 “ngegalelo lakhe kumzabalazo wamalungelo abasebenzi kunye nasekufezekiseni uMzantsi Afrika ongenabuhlanga, ongacaluli ngokwesini, okhululekileyo nonentando yesininzi”.Amagosa amahlanu eNkonzo yesiPolisa yaseMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPS) ebekhwele kwinqwelo-moya ye-SAPS eye yantlitheka kwisikhululo seenqwelo-moya i-Rand Airport, e-Germiston ngoLwesibini, umhla wama-30 kweyeThupha 2022.

src: The SAPS are investigating the crash.
tgt: I-SAPS iyaphanda ngale ngozi.

src: Cabinet wished the critically injured pilot a speedy recovery.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inqwenelele umqhubi wenqwelomoya owenzakeleyo kakhulu ukuba achache ngokukhawuleza.

src: All appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.
tgt: UkuqeshwaZonke izithuba zengqesho zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamaphepha ezemfundo kunye nokunye ukuqinisekiswa okafanelekileyo.

src: a. Ms Gugulethu Abigail Thimane as Deputy Director-General (DDG): Public Sector Monitoring and Capacity Development at the Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation.
tgt: Gugulethu Abigail Thimane njengeSekela Mlawuli-Jikelele (i-DDG): ukuHlolwa kweCandelo loLuntu kunye noPhuhliso lweZakhono kwiSebe loCwangciso, uHlolo kunye noVavanyo.

src: Cabinet was briefed by Public Enterprises Minister Pravin Gordhan on the capacity of Eskom to mitigate the intermittent load-shedding and also received a progress report from the Technical Committee of the National Energy Crisis Committee.
tgt: Amandla ombane IKhabhinethi inikwe ingxelo emfutshane nguMphathiswa wamaShishini kaRhulumente u-Pravin Gordhan malunga namandla ka-Eskom okunciphisa ukucinywa kombane okwethutyana kwaye ikwafumene nengxelo yenkqubela-phambili evela kwiKomiti yobuGcisa yeKomiti yeSizwe yeNgxaki yezaMandla.

src: Further announcements will be made following the conclusion of the intensive deliberations of these reports.
tgt: Ezinye izibhengezo ziza kwenziwa emva kokuqukunjelwa kweengxoxo ezinzulu zezi ngxelo.

src: Cabinet expressed regret at the disruption and inconvenience caused by load-shedding to businesses and households, particularly happening at the time when government is engaged with the interventions announced by the President in July 2022.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise ukudana ngokuphazamiseka kunye nengxaki ebangelwe kukucima kombane koosomashishini nakumakhaya, ingakumbi okwenzeka ngeli xesha urhulumente eqalisa ukusebenza kwizithembiso ezazenziwe nguMongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa kweyeKhala yowama-2022.

src: Investment Cabinet welcomed the launch of the new Sandvik Khomanani Manufacturing Site in Kempton Park, which was part of the R350-million investment pledged at the fourth South Africa Investment Conference (SAIC) held at the Sandton Convention Centre in Johannesburg on 24 March 2022.
tgt: Utyalo-mali IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukusungulwa kwe-Sandvik Khomanani Manufacturing Site e-Kempton Park, eyinxalenye yotyalo-mali oluzizigidi ezingama-350 zeerandi obeluthenjiswe kwiNkomfa yesine yoTyalo-mali yaseMzantsi Afrika (i-SAIC) ebibanjelwe kwiZiko leNgqungquthela laseSandton eRhawutini ngomhla wama-24 kweyoKwindla yowama-2022.

src: The new 62 000 square-metre facility consolidates operations previously undertaken at five separate sites and accommodates about 550 employees.
tgt: Eli ziko litsha elizizikwere zeemitha ezingama-62 000 lidibanisa imisebenzi ebiqhutywa ngaphambili kwiindawo ezintlanu ezahlukeneyo kwaye lingangena abasebenzi abamalunga nama-550.

src: It is one of Sandvik’s biggest and most advanced facilities globally, and has the ability to produce underground loaders with over 60% South African content.
tgt: Lelinye lawona maziko e-Sandvik amakhulu kwihlabathi jikelele nanobuxhaka-xhaka bale mihla kwaye lizawuvelisa iiloli zokulayisha emigodini.

src: Cabinet further welcomed the oversight visit by President Ramaphosa in KwaZulu-Natal during the launch of the Hesto Harnesses manufacturing facility in Stanger, KwaDukuza on 13 September 2022.
tgt: Umyinge ongaphezulu kwama-60% wezi ntsimbi ziza kusetyenziswa xa kusenziwa ezi loli uza kuveliswa apha eMzantsi Afrika.

src: This facility is one of five capital investment projects that form part of a R.4-billion commitment by Metair Investments Limited to support the expansion and localisation of the new Ford Ranger.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilwamkele utyelelo lukaMongameli Ramaphosa lokuya kuhlola KwaZulu-Natal ngethuba kusungulwa komzi-mveliso wakwa-Hesto Harnesses e-Stanger, KwaDukuza ngomhla we-13 kweyoMsintsi yowama-2022.

src: The President also attended the opening of the Sappi Saiccor Mill upgrade and expansion project worth R7,7 billion in Umkomaas, which is aimed at increasing the capacity and global competitiveness of the company while also creating short- and long-term employment opportunities.
tgt: Eli ziko lelinye leeprojekthi ezintlanu zotyalo-mali oluyinkunzi eliyinxalenye yebhiliyonii eyi-1.4 yeerandi eyathenjiswa ngabakwa-Metair Investments Limited kumalinge okuxhasa umsebenzi wokwandiswa kunye nokuveliswa apha ekhaya kwe-Ford Ranger etsha.

src: These investments form part of pledges made by industrialists at the SAIEvery new investment into our country assists in the reconstruction and recovery of our economy, and continues to profile South Africa as an investment destination of choice.
tgt: UMongameli ukwazimase ukuvulwa kweprojekthi yokuphucula nokwandisa i-Sappi Saiccor Mill exabisa iibhiliyoni eziyi-7,7 zeerandi e-Umkomaas, ejolise ekwandiseni nasekuphuculeni le nkampani itsho ikwazi ukukhuphisana kumgangatho wehlabathi ngelixa ikwadala imisebenzi ezizingxungxo kunye nesisigxina.

src: Cabinet welcomed the opening of the new section of the Musina Ring Road in Limpopo that will make it easier for people to move around Musina, and also allow for increased trade and economic activity between South Africa and the Southern African Development Community countries.
tgt: Olu tyalo-mali luyinxalenye yezithembiso ezenziwe ngoosomashishini kwi-SAILonke utyalo-mali olutsha elizweni lethu lunceda ekwakhiweni ngokutsha nasekuvuseleleni uqoqosho lwethu, kwaye luyaqhubeka nokungqina ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ulilizwe elunamathuba amaninzi otyalo-mali.

src: The R640-million project created over 275 full-time jobs for locals and provided opportunities for local communities and small, medium and micro enterprises (SMMEs).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuvulwa kwecandelo elitsha le-Musina Ring Road e-Limpopo eliza kwenza kube lula ukuba abantu bahamba-hambe eMusina, likwavumele ukwandiswa kwemisebenzi yorhwebo neyoqoqosho phakathi koMzantsi Afrika kunye namazwe oMbutho woPhuhliso lwaMazantsi e-Afrika (i-SADC).

src: The construction of the Musina Ring Road is part of government’s infrastructure programme, through the ERRP, that seeks to create inclusive growth and employment opportunities across various sectors and communities.
tgt: Le projekthi yezigidi ezingama-640 zeerandi idale imisebenzi esisigxina engama-275 yabahlali bale ngingqi yaze yabonelela ngamathuba kuluntu lwasekuhlaleni nakumashishini amancinane, aphakathi namancinane kakhulu (ii-SMME).

src: Jagersfontein disaster.1 Cabinet expressed its sincere condolences to the families of those who lost their lives after the tailings of an abandoned local mine in Jagersfontein in the Free State burst open and released a disastrous mudslide around dawn on Sunday, 11 September 2022.
tgt: Ukwakhiwa kwe-Musina Ring Road yinxalenye yenkqubo karhulumente yeziseko zophuhliso, ngokusebenzisa i-ERRP, ejonge ukudala uhlumo oluza kuxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke kunye namathuba engqesho kumacandelo ahlukeneyo nakuluntu.

src: The disaster also left the local infrastructure, personal properties such as vehicles and several homes severely damaged.
tgt: Intlekele yaseJagersfontein.1 IKhabhinethi ithi mazilale ngenxeba iintsapho zabo bathe basutywa kukufa emva kokugqabhuka kwedama lodaka lomgodi owavalwayo wase-Jagersfontein e-Freystata lakhupha udaka olwenze umonakalo omkhulu ngentseni yangeCawa, umhla we-11 kweyoMsintsi ngowama-2022.

src: During his visit to the disaster area on Monday, 12 September 2022, President Ramaphosa expressed appreciation for the rescue and recovery efforts being undertaken in the area.
tgt: Le ntlekele iphinde yashiya izakhiwo zendawo, izinto zabantu ezifana nezithuthi kunye nezindlu ezininzi zonakaliswe kakhulu.

src: He also pledged that government will provide the necessary support to the affected residents of Jagersfontein.
tgt: Ukwathembise ukuba urhulumente uzakubonelela ngenkxaso efanelekileyo kubahlali abachaphazelekayo baseJagersfontein.

src: Cabinet is encouraged that the owners of the mine have said that they are ready to provide technical assistance and support to the government should it be requested by the Minerals Council South Africa.3 The mining industry remains a significant contributor to the economy through direct and indirect employment, export earnings, and foreign direct investment, and plays a crucial role in improving the lives of people in mining communities.4 Government and some non-governmental organisations intervened urgently by providing emergency shelter, trauma counselling and basic provisions such as blankets, mattresses and food parcels.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthazekile kukuba abanini balo mgodi bathe bakulungele ukunika uncedo lobugcisa nenkxaso kurhulumente ukuba banokucelwa benze njalo liBhunga lezeZimbiwa laseMzantsi Afrika.3 Ishishini lezemigodi lisahleli linegalelo elibalulekileyo kuqoqosho ngokuqeshwa ngokuthe ngqo nangokungathanga ngqo, iingeniso evela kurhwebo namazwe angaphandle, kunye notyalo-mali oluthe ngqo lwangaphandle, kwaye lidlala indima ebalulekileyo ekuphuculeni ubomi babantu kwiindawo ezinemigodi.4 Urhulumente kunye neminye imibutho engekho phantsi kukarhulumente baye bangenelela ngokungxamisekileyo ngokubonelela ngeendawo zokuhlala ezingxamisekileyo, ululeko lwengqondo nangezibonelelo ezingundoqo ezifana neengubo, oomatrasi kunye nokutya.

src: Water supply and electricity in the area have since been restored.
tgt: Ubonelelo lwamanzi nombane kulo mmandla sele lubuyele esiqhelweni.

src: Once the disaster site has been cleaned up, technicians are expected to undertake structural assessments of houses.
tgt: Nje ukuba indawo yentlekele icociwe, amagcisa alindeleke ukuba enze uhlolo lweendonga zezindlu.

src: Cabinet thanked emergency services, civil-society organisations and members of the public for their generous contributions and assistance.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibulele iinkonzo zikaxakeka, imibutho yoluntu kunye namalungu oluntu ngeminikelo yesisa noncedo lwabo.

src: Economy Cabinet deliberated on the state of the economy in the country after Statistics South Africa’s (Stats SA) recent figures showed that the gross domestic product (GDP) for the second quarter of 2022 decreased by 0,7%.
tgt: Uqoqosho IKhabhinethi ixoxe ngobume boqoqosho beli lizwe emva kokuba amanani akutshanje eZiko leeNkcukacha-manani loMzantsi Afrika (i-Stats SA) abonise ukuba ingeniso yemveliso yelizwe (i-GDP) yekota yesibini yowama-2022 yehle ngo-0,7%.

src: Factors which influenced this decrease included load-shedding, the Russia-Ukraine conflict, and the high cost of living and inflation.
tgt: Izinto eziphembelele oku kwehla ziquka ukucinywa kombane, ungquzulwano lwaseRashiya ne-Ukraine, kunye neendleko eziphezulu zokuphila kunye nokunyuka kwamaxabiso.

src: The interventions made by the Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan (ERRP) have largely cushioned the country from the international headwinds, and also protected jobs and livelihoods.
tgt: Amanyathelo okungenelela enziwe siSicwangciso soKwakha ngokutsha kunye noVuselelo loQoqosho (i-ERRP) ubukhulu becala sithintele ilizwe kubunzima amashishini ajamelane nabo kwihlabathi, kwaye sakhusela imisebenzi kunye neendlela zokuphila.

src: Government’s strong economic interventions are beginning to bear fruit, as evidenced in Stats SA’s recent Quarterly Labour Force Survey results, which showed that over 648 000 jobs were gained between the first and second quarters of 2022.
tgt: Amanyathelo okungenelela ezoqoqosho aluqilima karhulumente aqalisa ukuvelisa iziqhamo, njengoko kungqinwe kwiziphumo zakutshanje ze-Stats SA zeKota zoVavanyo lwaBasebenzi, ezibonise ukuba kudalwe imisebenzi engaphezulu kwama-648 000 phakathi kwekota yokuqala neyesibini yowama-2022.

src: Cabinet Decisions.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) Framework for the National Youth Policy (NYP).
tgt: Isicwangciso-nkqubo soBeko-liso noVavanyo (i-M&E) soMgaqo-nkqubo woLutsha lweSizwe (i-NYP).

src: Cabinet approved the M&E framework that will enable the effective monitoring and impact assessment of the pillars of the NYP 2020-2030.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume isicwangciso-nkqubo se-M&E esiza kunceda ukubeka iliso okusebenzayo kunye novavanyo lweempembelelo zeentsika ze-NYP yowama-2020 ukuya kowama-2030.

src: The framework provides five high-level indicators which are aligned with the pillars of the NYThe indicators were developed with the relevant stakeholders who have an interest in the development and empowerment of youth in the country.
tgt: Isicwangciso-nkqubo sibonelela ngezalathisi ezintlanu ezikwinqanaba eliphezulu ezihambelana neentsika ze-NYEzi zalathisi zaqulunqwa kubanjiswene namahlakaniafanelekileyo anomdla kuphuhliso nasekuxhotyisweni kolutsha kweli lizwe.

src: The data collection will be disaggregated in terms of age, gender, disability, racial grouping and the geographic setting of these interventions.
tgt: Iinkcukacha eziza kuqokelelwa ziza kujonga iminyaka yobudala, isini, ukukhubazeka, uhlanga ngokwebala kunye nendawo yokuhlala ngokwemimmandla yala mangenelelo.

src: The monitoring will be done in all spheres of government, entities and the private sector.
tgt: Ukubeka iliso kuza kwenziwa kuwo onke amanqanaba karhulumente, kumaqumrhu nakumacandelo abucala.

src: The reports will be generated quarterly and published twice a year.
tgt: Iingxelo ziza kwenziwa ngekota kwaye zipapashwe kabini ngonyaka.

src: Policy Framework for Integrated Planning.
tgt: Isicwangciso-nkqubo soMgaqo-nkqubo woCwangciso oluDityanisiweyo.

src: Cabinet has approved the Policy Framework for Integrated Planning in government, which seeks to address the identified policy planning gaps in the current planning system.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isivumile Isicwangciso-nkqubo soMgaqo-nkqubo woCwangciso oluDityanisiweyo kurhulumente, esijonge ukulungisa izikhewu eziboniweyo zocwangciso lomgaqo-nkqubo kwinkqubo yocwangciso yangoku.

src: The proposed interventions will amongst others deal with the lack of planning alignment within the three spheres of government.
tgt: Amanyathelo okungenelela acetywayo phakathi kwezinye izinto aza kujongana nokunqongophala kolungelelwaniso locwangciso phakathi kwamanqanaba amathathu karhulumente.

src: The interventions will introduce an evidence-based monitoring mechanism.
tgt: Amanyathelo okungenelela azo kuqalisa indlela yokubeka iliso esekelwe kubungqina.

src: The policy framework also introduces easier predictability with long to medium and short-term planning across government.
tgt: Isicwangciso-nkqubo somgaqo-nkqubo sikwazisa ukuqikelelwa lula ngocwangciso lwexesha elide ukuya kwixesha eliphakathi kunye nelexesha elifutshane kurhulumente wonke.

src: It will work towards introducing legislative reforms to improve coherency and predictability in government planning and monitoring.
tgt: Siza kusebenzela ukwazisa uhlaziyo lwemithetho ukuze kuphuculwe ukuhambelana nokuqikelelwa kucwangciso kunye nokubekwa kweliso kukarhulumente.

src: Ratification of the Treaty for the Establishment of the African Medicines Agency (AMA).
tgt: Ukuvunywa kweSivumelwano sokuSekwa kwe-Arhente yaMayeza ase-Afrika (i-AMA).

src: Cabinet approved the signing of the Treaty for the Establishment of the AMA and its submission to Parliament for ratification.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukutyikitywa kweSivumelwano sokuSekwa kwe-AMA kunye nokungeniswa kwaso ePalamente ukuze sivunywe.

src: This will give effect to the treaty that was adopted by the African Union Assembly in 2019.
tgt: Oku kuza kuzalisekisa isivumelwano esamkelwa yiNdibano yeManyano ye-Afrika ngowama-2019.

src: The treaty formally establishes the AMA for the continent.
tgt: Esi sivumelwano siseka ngokusesikweni i-AMA yeli lizwekazi.

src: The agency will regulate medical products, and improve the safety and efficacy of the medical products for the continent.
tgt: I-arhente iza kulawula amayeza onyango, kwaye iphucule ukhuseleko kunye nokusebenza kwamayeza onyango kweli lizwekazi.

src: The signing and ratifying of this treaty will advance South Africa’s global and continental commitment toward strengthening the continental regulatory system on its health products.
tgt: Ukutyikitya kunye nokuvunywa kungqina ukuba uMzantsi Afrika uzibophelele kwizivumelwano zeli lizwekazi nezehlabathi malunga nokuphucula imithetho yeli lizwekazi elawula iimveliso zalo zempilo.

src: Report on the Performance of the Research and Development (R&D) Tax Incentive Programme – 2019/20 and 2020/2.
tgt: Ingxelo ngokuSebenza kweNkqubo yesiBonelelo seRhafu yoPhando noPhuhliso (i-R&D) – yowama-2019/20 kunye neyowama-2020/21.

src: Cabinet approved the submission to Parliament of the R&D Tax incentive Programme for the past two years (2019/20 and 2020/21).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalamente kweNkqubo yesiBonelelo seRhafu ye-R&D kule minyaka mibini idlulileyo (ngowama-2019/20 kunye neyowama-2020/21).

src: This is in line with section 11D (17) of the Income Tax Act, 1962 (Act 58 1962), which requires the tabling of these reports in Parliament.
tgt: Oku kuhambelana necandelo 11D (17) loMthetho weRhafu yeNgeniso, wowe-1962 (uMthetho wama-58 wowe-1962), elifuna ukuba ezi ngxelo zandlalwe ePalamente.

src: The tax incentive programme seeks to encourage private companies to invest in R&D so as to stimulate investment growth.
tgt: Inkqubo yesibonelelo serhafu ijonge ukukhuthaza iinkampani zabucala ukuba zityale imali kwi-R&D ukuze zikhuthaze ukukhula kotyalo-mali.

src: It enables the advancement of science and innovation towards economic growth, and promotes competitiveness.
tgt: Ivumela ukuqhubela-phambili kwenzululwazi kunye nobuchule bokuyilaobuza kunceda ekukhuleni koqoqosho, kwaye ikhuthaza ukhuphiswano.

src: Cabinet is pleased that the report shows that new companies have applied for the tax incentive.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ichulumancile kukuba le ngxelo ibonisa ukuba iinkampani ezintsha zifake izicelo zokufumana isibonelelo serhafu.

src: It encourages more companies to access this scheme as part of growing their respective investment and stimulating economic growth.
tgt: Ikhuthaza iinkampani ezininzi ukuba zifake izicelo zokuxhamla esi sibonelelo njengenxalenye yokukhulisa utyalo-mali lwazo kunye nokukhwezela ukukhula koqoqosho.

src: The top-four companies that accessed the tax incentive are in agro-processing mining beneficiation chemicals, cosmetics, pharmaceutical and electro-technical and Information Technology sectors that Cabinet endorsed as priority areas in the Industrial Policy Action Plan.
tgt: Iinkampani ezine eziphezulu ezithe zasifumana esi sibonelelo serhafu zikwicandelo lokucola iimveliso zolimo elezokuxhamlisa kwizimbiwa elezamichiza, elezithambiso, elezamayeza kunye nelezobugcisa bezombane kunye nelezobuchwepheshe bolwazi ethe iKhabhinethi yawamkela njengemacandelo ekufuneka akhokeliswe phambili kwisiCwangciso sokuSebenza soMgaqo-nkqubo wezoShishino.

src: The full report can be accessed through the Department of Science and Innovation website: WEBTOKEAfrican Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) Forum – 2023.
tgt: Ingxelo epheleleyo inokufumaneka kwiwebhusayithi yeSebe lezeNzululwazi kunye noBuchule bokuYila: WEBTOKEIQonga loMthetho lokuKhula kunye namaThuba ase-Afrika (i-AGOA) – yowama-2023.

src: Cabinet has approved the hosting of the AGOA Forum in 2023.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukusingathwa kweQonga le-AGOA ngowama-2023.

src: AGOA was enacted by the United States of America (USA) in 2000 to provide unilateral trade preferential access for most of the sub-Saharan African countries and the USA domestic market.
tgt: I-AGOA yaphunyezwa yiMelika (i-USA) ngowama-2000 ukuze yenze kube lula kumazwe amaninzi ase-Afrika akumazantsi e-Sahara ukurhweba ne-USIimveliso zorhwebo zoMzantsi Afrika ezithunyelwa e-USA phantsi kwe-AGOA ziquka iziqhamo ezityiwayo, amandongomane, izithuthi, iintsimbi zemoto, intsimbi, isinyithi kunye neemveliso zemichiza.

src: The actual date and venue are still to be announced.
tgt: Owona mhla nendawo zisaza kubhengezwa.

src: Group on Earth Observations (GEO) Ministerial Summit – 2023.
tgt: Ingqungquthela yaBaphathiswa ye-Group on Earth Observations (i-GEO) – 2023.

src: Cabinet approved that South Africa hosts the GEO Ministerial Summit in Cape Town in 2023.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba uMzantsi Afrika usingathe iNgqungquthela yaBaphathiswa ye-GEO eKapa ngowama-2023.

src: The GEO is an intergovernmental body set up in 2003 after the 2002 World Summit on Sustainable Development.
tgt: I-GEO liqumrhu eliphakathi koorhulumente elasekwa ngowama-2003 emva kweNgqungquthela yeHlabathi yowama-2002 yoPhuhliso oluZinzileyo.

src: It serves as a multilateral platform where countries voluntarily contribute towards a common goal of building the GEO systems.
tgt: Isebenza njengeqonga lamazwe ngamazwe apho amazwe anikela ngokuzithandela kwinjongo enye yokwakha iinkqubo ze-GEI-GEO ngoku inoorhulumente bamazwe abangaphezulu kwe-113, abangama-30 kubo bavela e-Afrika kunye nemibutho ethatha inxaxheba emalunga ne-140, kwaye i-11 lale mibutho livela e-Afrika.

src: South Africa has been an active Executive Committee member since 2005 and our scientists are currently participating in a number of research initiatives led through the GEOctober Transport Month (OTM) – 2022.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika ube lilungu leKomiti Elawulayo elisebenzayo ukusukela ngowama-2005 kwaye iinzululwazi zethu ngoku zithatha inxaxheba kumaphulo ophando amaninzi akhokelwa yi-GEInyanga yezoThutho yeDwarha (i-OTM) – 2022.

src: Cabinet approved the launching of the OTM campaign on Saturday, 1 October 2022, under the theme: “Sishov’ingolovane: together building transport infrastructure that builds and sustains livelihoods”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukusungulwa kwephulo le-OTM ngoMgqibelo, umhla woku-1 kweyeDwarha yowama-2022, phantsi komxholo othi: “Sishov’ingolovane: sisonke sakha iziseko zophuhliso zezothutho ezakha nezigcina indlela yokuphila”.

src: The annual OTM is used to raise awareness on transport as one of the critical elements in economic growth and spatial development.
tgt: I-OTM yonyaka isetyenziselwa ukwazisa ngezothutho njengenye yezinto ezibalulekileyo ekukhuleni koqoqosho kunye nophuhliso lweendawo ezihlala uluntu.

src: A number of activities will take place to showcase the various aspects of transport infrastructure in aviation, maritime, public transport and roads.
tgt: Imisebenzi emininzi iza kwenziwa ukubonisa imiba eyahlukeneyo yeziseko zophuhliso lothutho kwezophapho, kwezaselwandle, kwezothutho lukawonke-wonke kunye neendlela.

src: The activities will also raise awareness regarding transport safety and security.
tgt: Le misebenzi iza kwazisa uluntu malunga nokhuseleko kunye nokhuselo lwezothutho.

src: Stakeholder engagements will also be held to discuss various challenges in the transport sector.
tgt: Iindibano zokubonisana namahlakani abachaphazelekayo nazo ziza kubanjwa ukuze kuxoxwe ngemiceli-mngeni eyahlukeneyo kwicandelo lezothutho.
