tgt: Uye wafumana ezihlaziyiweyo malunga nenyathelo loQoqosho lwaMazwe aseNtshona Afrika elikhokelwa lubhukuqo-mbuso e-Niger kunye neenzame ngokubanzi zokubuyisela ulawulo lwentando yesininzi e-Sahel.

src: President Emmerson Mnangagwa of the Republic of Zimbabwe, on initiatives by the government of Zimbabwe to consolidate the rebuilding of that country after the recent harmonised elections.
tgt: Mongameli Emmerson Mnangagwa weRiphabhlikhi yaseZimbabwe, kumalinge karhulumente waseZimbabwe okuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa ngokutsha kwela lizwe emva kolonyulo olunemvisiswano lwakutsha nje.

src: President Ramaphosa also participated in the United States (US)-South Africa Trade and Investment Business Roundtable, which included South African and American business leaders.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa ukwathathe inxaxheba kwiNgxoxo yoShishino ngezoRhwebo kunye noTyalo-mali lweMelika (i-US) noMzantsi Afrika, equka iinkokeli zoshishino zaseMzantsi Afrika kunye nezaseMelika.

src: With more than 600 US companies operating from South Africa, this engagement was critical in the ongoing strengthening of relations between South Africa and the UDuring the period, a formal announcement was made that the 20th US-Sub-Saharan Africa Trade and Economic Cooperation Forum, (AGOA Forum) will take place in Johannesburg from 2 to 4 November 2023.
tgt: Ngeenkampani ezingaphezu kwama-600 zase-US ezisebenza eMzantsi Afrika, olu thethathethwano lwalubalulekile ekuqiniseni ubudlelwane phakathi koMzantsi Afrika kunye ne-UNgeli xesha, kwenziwa isaziso esisesikweni sokuba iForam yama-20 ye-US-Sub-Saharan Africa Trade and Economic Cooperation Forum, (iForam ye-AGOA) iza kubanjelwa eRhawutini ukusuka ngomhla wesi-2 ukuya kowesi-4 kweyeNkanga wama-2023.

src: The forum will also feature the ‘Made in Africa Exhibition’ that will showcase regional value chains on the continent.
tgt: Le foram iza kuphinda ibe nomboniso othi ‘Made in Africa Exhibition’ oza kubonisa amakhonkco ewonke eemveliso zommandla kwilizwekazi.

src: President Ramaphosa also witnessed the announcement of the collaboration between Novo Nordisk and Aspen.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa uphinde wangqina isibhengezo sentsebenziswano phakathi kwe-Novo Nordisk kunye ne-Aspen.

src: The collaboration will see the production of insulin at the Aspen’s facilities in Gqeberha, Eastern Cape.
tgt: Le ntsebenziswano iza kubona ukuveliswa kweyeza leswekile (i-insulin) kwiziko le-Aspen eGqeberha, eMpuma Koloni.

src: The collaboration aims to supply over 16 million doses of insulin in 2024, which will be up scaled by 2026.
tgt: Le ntsebenziswano ijolise ekuboneleleni ngamathamo eyeza leswekile angaphezulu kwe-16 lezigidi ngowama-2024, neza kunyuswa ngowama-2026.

src: This will significantly enhance access to insulin treatment not just in South Africa, but also across the continent.
tgt: Oku kuya kuphucula kakhulu ufikelelo kunyango lweswekile, kungapheleli nje eMzantsi Afrika, kodwa nakwilizwekazi liphela.

src: Energy.
tgt: Ezamandla.

src: Cabinet welcomed the National Energy Regulator of South Africa’s granting of trading and import/export license applications to the National Transmission Company of South Africa, paving the way for procurement of power from across the region.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukunikwa koMlawuli wezaMandla weSizwe woMzantsi Afrika izicelo zempepha-mvume zokurhweba kunye nokungenisa/ukuthumela ngaphandle kwiNkampani yeSizwe yoThumelo lwezaMandla yoMzantsi Afrika, kuvulwa indlela yokuthengwa kwamandla kuwo wonke ummandla.

src: The return to service of the Kusile Power Station’s Unit 4 from planned maintenance has brought back 800 megawatts to our power grid.
tgt: Ukusebenza kwakhona kwesiKhululo soMbane saseKusile Yunithi yesi-4 kulungiso olucwangcisiweyo noluthe lwabuyisa iimegawathi ezingama-800 kuthungelwano lwethu lombane.

src: This milestone is central to improving generation capacity for the national grid and addressing the frequency of load-shedding.
tgt: Esi siganeko singundoqo ekuphuculeni umthamo wokuvelisa uthungelwano lwesizwe kunye nasekukhawulelaneni namaxesha okucinywa kombane.

src: Cabinet was further briefed about progress to return Units 1, 2 and 3 of the Kusile Power Station ahead of schedule.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yachazelwa ngenkqubela yokubuyisela iYunithi yoku-1, yesi-2 kunye neyesi-3 kwiSikhululo soMbane iKusile phambi kwexesha elimiselweyo.

src: Cabinet welcomed Eskom’s stable rating by Moody’s Investors Service, which will improve the power utility’s credit worthiness and enable it to plan ahead in implementing planned maintenance on its generation fleet.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele izinga elizinzileyo lika-Eskom elenziwe yi-Moody’s Investors Service, nto leyo eza kuphucula ukufaneleka kwetyala leli ziko lombane lize likwazi ukucwangcisa kwangaphambili ukuphumeza ulungiso olucetyiweyo lwezithuthi zalo zokuvelisa.

src: Water security.
tgt: Ukufumaneka kwamanzi.

src: Cabinet was briefed about efforts to address water challenges affecting a number of areas across the country.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi malunga namalinge okujongana nemingeni yamanzi nechaphazela iindawo ezininzi kwilizwe liphela.

src: The Minister of Water and Sanitation, Mr Senzo Mchunu and executive mayors of some of the cities in Gauteng will provide an update on ongoing interventions to stabilise water supply in the province.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezaManzi noGutyulo, uMnu Senzo Mchunu kunye noosodolophu abalawulayo kwezinye zezixeko zaseRhawutini baza kubonelela ngohlaziyo longenelelo oluqhubekayo lokuzinzisa ukuhanjiswa kwamanzi kweli phondo.

src: Cabinet wishes to remind everyone that South Africa is a water-scarce country.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inqwenela ukukhumbuza wonke umntu ukuba uMzantsi Afrika lilizwe elinqongophelelwe ngamanzi.

src: All South Africans and everyone in this country must save and use water sparingly.
tgt: Bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika kunye naye wonke umntu okweli lizwe kufuneka onge kwaye asebenzise amanzi ngononophelo.

src: Trade matters.
tgt: Imiba yezorhwebo.

src: The South Africa-Lesotho Binational Commission (BNC) and Ministerial Cluster Meeting.
tgt: IKomishoni yeZizwe eziManyeneyo eziMbini yoMzantsi Afrikane-Lesotho (i-BNC) kunye neNtlanganiso yeQela laBaphathiswa.1 INtlanganiso ye-BNC yoMzantsi Afrika ne-Lesotho kunye neQela laBaphathiswa ebibanjwe ukusuka ngomhla wama-25 ukuya kowama-28 kweyoMsintsi 2023 igxile kwintsebenziswano yezoqoqosho, kwimiba yokuwela imida, kunye nokuhamba ngokukhululekileyo kwabantu, iimpahla neenkonzo phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.2 UMongameli Ramaphosa kunye neNkulumbuso u-Samuel Ntsokoane Matekane baza kujongana neSeshoni yokuQalwa kwe-BNC phakathi koMzantsi Afrika ne-Lesotho ngoLwesine, umhla wama-28 kweyoMsintsi 2023.

src: The South Africa-Lesotho BNC and Ministerial Cluster Meeting held from 25 to 28 September 2023 is focussing on economic cooperation, cross-border issues, and the free movement of people, goods and services between the two countries.
tgt: I-BNC iza kubandakanya ubudlelwane kwezozakuzo, kukhuselo nokhuseleko, amanzi, ezothutho, umbane kunye nakwezorhwebo.2 UPhando lweNtengiso kwiQonga elikwi-Intanethi.1IKhabhinethi ifumene ingxelo evela kwiKomishoni yoKhuphiswano malunga neziphumo kunye namanyathelo okulungisa malunga noPhando lweNtengiso kwiQonga elikwi-Intanethi.

src: President Ramaphosa and Prime Minister Samuel Ntsokoane Matekane will co-chair the Inaugural Session of the BNC between South Africa and Lesotho on Thursday, 28 September 2023.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwuncomile umsebenzi wekhomishini ekujonganeni neenkxalabo kumaqonga edijithali, kubandakanywa urhwebo lwe-ecommerce, ii-arhente zokuhamba ezikwi-intanethi, ukuhanjiswa kokutya, iivenkile ze-app, ababoneleli abakhethiweyo kunye neenjini zokukhangela.2 IKhabhinethi iyalele abaPhathiswa bamasebe karhulumente achaphazelekayo ukuba aqhubele phambili athethathethane ngezindululo zokuphucula, baqwalasele iziphumo zomgaqo-nkqubo baze benze utshintsho oluyimfuneko kumgaqo-nkqubo, oluya kunceda abantu baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba bathathe inxaxheba ngokufanelekileyo kunye namashishini amancinci naphakathi kushishino olukhulayo olenziwa nge-intanethi.

src: The BNC will cover diplomatic relations, defence and security, water, transport, electricity and trade.
tgt: Umkhuhlane weentaka IKhabhinethi iqaphele uqhambuko lwangoku loMkhuhlane obangela izifo (i-HPAI) H5 kunye ne-H7 kushishino lweenkukhu eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Cabinet commended the work of the commission in addressing monopoly concerns in digital intermediation platforms, including ecommerce, online travel agencies, food delivery, app stores, classifieds providers and search engines.
tgt: INtshona Koloni kunye neKwaZulu-Natal ziye zafumana ukuqhambuka kwe-HPAI H5 ngelixa i-HPAI H7 iye yachazwa kumaphondo iRhawutini, i-Limpopo, iMpumalanga kunye naseMntla Ntshona.

src: Cabinet has directed Ministers of relevant government departments to further engage with the recommendations for improvement, consider the policy implications and undertake necessary policy reforms that will facilitate meaningful participation of South Africans and small, medium and micro enterprises on the growing online business.
tgt: Amanyathelo okulawula ukusasazeka koku kuqhambuka akhona kwaye amafama ayakhuthazwa ukuba athathele ingqalelo amanyathelo amiselweyo okhuseleko lwendalo.

src: The Western Cape and KwaZulu-Natal experienced outbreaks of HPAI H5 while HPAI H7 has been reported in the provinces of Gauteng, Limpopo, Mpumalanga and North West.
tgt: ISebe lezoLimo, uHlengahlengiso loMhlaba noPhuhliso lwasemaPhandleni, uGunyaziwe woLawulo lweeMveliso zezeMpilo eMzantsi Afrika kunye noshishino baphonononga izicelo zokubhaliswa kwamayeza okugonya anokubakho, ezi namanyathelo okuthotyelwa kwezinto ezinxulumene nokhuseleko, ukusebenza kakuhle kunye nomgangatho zezona zinto zibalulekileyo ekubhalisweni kwezitofu zokugonya.

src: The outbreaks pose food security risks and trade measures in the form of imports to manage availability of fertile eggs, table eggs and poultry meat may be implemented.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele ingxelo yakutsha yokulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho, nethe yanikwa isizwe nguMphathiswa wamaPolisa, uNjengele Bheki Cele, kunye neCandelo leSizwe lokuSebenza okuDityanelweyo nobuNtlola.

src: The Department of Agriculture, Land Reform and Rural Development, South African Health Products Regulatory Authority and the industry are exploring applications for the registration of possible vaccines, with compliance measures relating to safety, efficacy and quality being paramount for registration of such vaccines.
tgt: Iphulo leendidi ngeendidi malunga nokombiwa kwemigodi ngokungekho mthethweni kunye nofuduko eMntla Koloni kukhokelele ekubanjweni kwabantu abangama-867, uninzi lwabo lusuka e-Lesotho, e-Zimbabwe, e-Mozambique kunye nabemi abathile boMzantsi Afrika.

src: Integrated fight against crime Cabinet welcomed the update on the fight against crime, which was also provided to the nation by the Minister of Police, General Bheki Cele, and the National Joint Operational and Intelligence Structure.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise uluvo lwee-arhente zogcino-mthetho lokuba abemi boMzantsi Afrika abagcine abaphuli-mthetho ababandakanyeka kwizenzo zokombiwa kwemigodi ngokungekho mthethweni baya kujongana nengalo yomthetho.

src: Extreme weather.
tgt: Imozulu embi kakhulu.

src: The country’s extreme weather patterns underscore the impact climate change is having in our lives and the need for sustained action to decarbonise our economy while pursuing sustainable development.
tgt: Iimeko zemozulu ezimbi kakhulu zelizwe zigxininisa ifuthe lokutshintsha kwemozulu kubomi bethu kunye nesidingo sokuthatha amanyathelo azinzileyo okuphelisa ikhabhoni kuqoqosho lwethu ngelixa sizama uphuhliso oluzinzileyo.

src: Cabinet is being kept abreast on the devastation caused by severe storms and flooding in the Eastern Cape, Western Cape and Gauteng, with indications that this will likely spread to other provinces.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaziswa ngomonakalo obangelwe zizaqhwithi ezimandla kunye nezikhukula ezise Mpuma Koloni, eNtshona Koloni kunye naseRhawutini, nto leyo ebonisa ukuba oku kunganwenwa nakwamanye amaphondo.3 IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuluntu ukuba luhlale luphaphile kwaye lujonge izilumkiso ezingakumbi zemozulu, nezinokuzisa umonakalo ongakumbi kwilizwe liphela.

src: Cabinet calls on communities to remain on high alert for further extreme weather warnings, which could bring further devastation across the country.
tgt: Urhulumente usaqhubeka nokuxhasa iinkonzo zongxamiseko kunye namaziko olawulo lweentlekele ukulungiselela imisebenzi yokuhlangula kunye nokubonelela ngenkxaso kuluntu.

src: Government continues to support emergency services and disaster management centres for rescue operations and to provide humanitarian support.
tgt: I-Winnie Mandela Avenue IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukuthiywa ngokutsha kwe-William Nicol Drive e-Sandton ukuba ibe yi-Winnie Mandela Avenue njengenyathelo elibalulekileyo lokubhala ngokutsha imbali yoMzantsi Afrika ukuze ibonise igalelo labo babesilwela inkululeko yethu.

src: Winnie Mandela Avenue Cabinet noted the renaming of William Nicol Drive in Sandton to Winnie Mandela Avenue as an important step in rewriting the history of South Africa to reflect the contribution of those who fought for our freedom.
tgt: Lo mnyhadala ubungqamene nomhla wokuzalwa kuka-Winnie Madikizela-Mandela ngomhla wama-26 kweyoMsintsi 2023.Izigqibo zeKhabhinethiISicwangciso-qhinga esiHlaziyiweyo seNyama yeeNyamakazi eMzantsi Afrika.

src: The event coincided with what would have been Winnie Madikizela-Mandela’s 87th birthday on 26 September 2023.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukuphunyezwa kwesiCwangciso-qhinga esiHlaziyiweyo seNyama yeeNyamakazi eMzantsi Afrika, esijonge ukumisela ngokusesikweni kunye nokuguqula ishishini lenyama yenyamakazi.

src: Cabinet decisions Revised Game Meat Strategy for South Africa Cabinet approved for implementation of the Revised Game Meat Strategy for South Africa, which seeks to formalise and transform the game meat industry.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sijolise ekuqiniseni icandelo lenyama yenyamakazi njengomboneleli wokufumaneka kokutya kunye necandelo lohlumo kuqoqosho elinokunceda ekudaleni imisebenzi.

src: The strategy aims to strengthen the game meat sector as both a provider of food security and an economic growth sector that can help create jobs.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika ubekwe kwindawo yokuqala kwilizwekazi i-Afrika ngenxa yemveliso yenyama yenyamakazi.

src: South Africa is ranked number one on the African continent for game-meat production.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sijonge ukuqinisekisa ukudalwa kwemisebenzi engama-202 666 ezinzileyo kushishino lwenyama yenyamakazi ngowama-2030.

src: The strategy will be published on the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment’s website: WEBTOKETourism Sector Master Plan Cabinet has approved the alignment of the Tourism Sector Recovery Plan to a new Tourism Master Plan.
tgt: Isicwangciso-qhinga siya kupapashwa kwiwebhusayithi yeSebe lamaHlathi, ezokuLoba nokusiNgqongileyo ku: www.

src: Whereas the Tourism Sector Recovery Plan was developed to facilitate the recovery of the sector, preserve jobs and protect livelihoods, the Master Plan will take this work to another level and facilitate new opportunities in the sector.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukulungelelaniswa kwesiCwangciso sokuBuyisela iCandelo lezoKhenketho kwisiCwangciso esiPhambili soKhenketho esitsha.

src: The plan proposes seven intervention strategies to ensure the tourism sector returns to its glory days, and that it becomes the centre of job creation and entrepreneurship.
tgt: Inxalenye nebalulekileyo yesiCwangciso esiPhambili kukunciphisa iimpembelelo zobhubhani we-COVID-19 kwicandelo lezokhenketho.

src: South African Broadcasting Corporation (SABC) Bill of 2023.
tgt: Imithetho eYilwayoUMthetho oYilwayo weQumrhu loSasazo laseMzantsi Afrika (i-SABC) wama-2023.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the SABC Bill of 2023 to Parliament.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho oYilwayo we-SABC wama-2023.

src: Once passed into law, the Bill will result in the repeal of the current Broadcasting Act, 1999 (Act 4 of 1999).
tgt: Wakuba upasisiwe ube ngumthetho, lo Mthetho uYilwayo uya kukhokelela ekurhoxisweni koMthetho woSasazo okhoyo ngoku, we-1999 (uMthetho wesi-4 we-1999).

src: The amendments will strengthen the efficiency of the operations of the public broadcaster.
tgt: Ezi zihlomelo ziza kuqinisa ukusebenza kakuhle kosasazo loluntu.

src: The Bill further proposes reforms in the SABC’s funding model and the TV-licensing system.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ukwaphakamisa iinguqu kwindlela yenkxaso-mali ye-SABC kunye nenkqubo yokukhutshwa kweelayisenisi zikamabonakude.

src: Draft Water Services Amendment Bill Cabinet approved the publication of the Water Services Amendment Bill for public comments.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa koMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo weeNkonzo zaManzi ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: The key aims of the Bill are to strengthen accountability for water services providers and to introduce transparency.
tgt: Iinjongo eziphambili zalo Mthetho uYilwayo kukuqinisa ukuphendula kwababoneleli ngeenkonzo zamanzi kunye nokwazisa ukungafihlwa kwezinto.

src: The amendments to the Water Services Act, 1997 (Act 108 of 1997) will ensure that water-service providers deliver high-quality water as part of their licensing conditions.
tgt: Izihlomelo kuMthetho weeNkonzo zaManzi, wowe-1997 (uMthetho we-108 wowe-1997) ziza kuqinisekisa ukuba ababoneleli ngeenkonzo zamanzi bahambisa amanzi akumgangatho ophezulu njengenxalenye yemiqathango yabo yokufumana iimpepha-mvume.4Ezi zihlomelo ziza kujongana nobuthathaka obuthe bachongwa kwicandelo leenkonzo zamanzi.

src: The amendments will also address weaknesses that have been identified in the water services sector.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ubeka imigangatho emincinane yokusebenza kwababoneleli ngeenkonzo zamanzi, nekufuneka inyanzeliswe ngabasemagunyeni beeNkonzo zaManzi.

src: Draft National Water Amendment Bill.
tgt: UMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo waManzi weSizwe.

src: Cabinet approved the publication of the draft National Water Amendment Bill for public comments.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa koMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo waManzi weSizwe ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: The Bill amends the National Water Act, 1998 (Act 36 of 1998).
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhlomela uMthetho waManzi weSizwe, we-1998 (uMthetho wama-36 we-1998).

src: These amendments will improve regulations and will ensure that the country’s water resources are well managed, protected and conserved.
tgt: Ezi zihlomelo ziza kuphucula imimiselo kwaye ziza kuqinisekisa ukuba imithombo yamanzi yelizwe ilawulwa kakuhle, iyakhuselwa kwaye iyongiwa.

src: The Bill also makes proposals to eliminate the imbalances of the past relating to water allocation, and provides for effective and quicker internal dispute resolution mechanisms.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo wenza izindululo zokuphelisa ukungalingani kwangaphambili ngokunxulumene nokwabiwa kwamanzi, kwaye ubonelela ngeendlela ezisebenzayo nezikhawulezayo zokusombulula iingxabano zangaphakathi.

src: Appointments All appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and relevant clearance.
tgt: IzikhundlaZonke izithuba zengqesho zixhomekeke ekungqinisisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuseleko.

src: Mr Kuberndran Moodley as General Manager: Manufacturing and Engineering at the Government Printing Works.
tgt: UMnu Kuberndran Moodley njengoMphathi Jikelele: Ukwenziwa kweMveliso nobuNjineli kwi-Government Printing Works.

src: Mr Sihle Ngubane as General Manager: Operations Management at the Government Printing Works.
tgt: UMnu Sihle Ngubane njengoMphathi Jikelele: uLawulo lweMisebenzi kwi-Government Printing Works.

src: Ms Mmolaeng Mooki as General Manager: Corporate Services at the Government Printing Works.
tgt: UNksz Mmolaeng Mooki njengoMphathi Jikelele: IiNkonzo zeShishini kwi- Government Printing Works.

src: Appointment of non-executive directors to the Board of the South African Special Risk Insurance Association.
tgt: Ukuqeshwa kwabalawuli abangekho kwisigqeba seBhodi ye-South African Special Risk Insurance Association.

src: Ms Deshnie Subbiah and.
tgt: UNksz Deshnie Subbiah kunye.

src: Mr Jannie Venter.
tgt: noMnu Jannie Venter.

src: Appointment of non-executive directors to the Board of the Development Bank of Southern Africa.
tgt: Ukuqeshwa kwabalawuli abangekho kwisigqeba seBhodi ye-Development Bank of Southern Africa.

src: Mr Bongani Nqwabana (reappointment).
tgt: UMnu Bongani Nqwabana (uqeshiwe kwakhona).

src: Mr Petrus Matji (reappointment).
tgt: UMnu Petrus Matji (uqeshiwe kwakhona).

src: Ms Pinkie Nqeto (reappointment).
tgt: UNksz Pinkie Nqeto (uqeshiwe kwakhona).

src: Mr Jonathan Muthige.
tgt: UMnu Jonathan Muthige.

src: Ms Chantal Naidoo.
tgt: UNksz Chantal Naidoo.

src: Ms Disebo Moephuli.
tgt: UNksz Disebo Moephuli.

src: Mr Barry Hore.
tgt: UMnu Barry Hore.

src: Mr Joel Netshitenzhe ProfEdgar Pieterse and.
tgt: UMnu Joel Netshitenzhe .UNjingalwazi Edgar Pieterse kunye.

src: Ms Zodwa Mbele.
tgt: noNksz Zodwa Mbele.

src: Upcoming Events.
tgt: Imisitho ezayoINyanga yezoThutho.

src: Transport Month This year’s Transport Month will be commemorated under the theme: “Siyakha - Building better infrastructure to grow South Africa”.
tgt: INyanga yezoThutho yalo nyaka iza kukhunjulwa phantsi komxholo othi: “Siyakha - Sakha iziseko ezingundoqo ezingcono ukukhulisa uMzantsi Afrika”.

src: Transport Month 2023 will focus on major investments in transport infrastructure, and a call to action to protect transport infrastructure from theft and vandalism.
tgt: INyanga yezoThutho yowama-2023 iza kugxila kutyalo-mali olukhulu kwiziseko ezingundoqo zezothutho, kwaye ihlaba ikhwelo lokuba kukhuselwe iziseko ezingundoqo zezothutho kubusela kunye nasekonakalisweni.

src: World Teachers’ Day South Africa will join the rest of the world in commemorating World Teachers’ Day on Thursday, 5 October 2023, under the theme: “The teachers we need for the education we want: The global imperative to reverse the teacher shortage”.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uza kujoyina ihlabathi liphela ekubhiyozeleni uSuku looTitshala lweHlabathi ngoLwesine, umhla wesi-5 kweyeDwarha 2023, phantsi komxholo othi: “Ootitshala esibadingayo kwimfundo esiyifunayo: Kunyanzelekile kwihlabathi jikelele ukunciphisa ukunqongophala kootitshala”.

src: The day aims to raise awareness, understanding and appreciation for the vital contribution that teachers make to education and development across the globe.
tgt: Olu suku lujolise ekukhuliseni ulwazi, ukuqonda kunye nokuxabisa igalelo elibaluleke kakhulu elenziwa ngootitshala kwimfundo nakuphuhliso kwihlabathi jikelele.

src: This day has been declared jointly by the International Labour Organization and the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization to celebrate the critical work that our teachers do.
tgt: Olu suku lubhengezwe ngokubambisene noMbutho weHlabathi wezaBasebenzi kunye noMbutho weZizwe eziManyeneyo wezeMfundo, ezeNzululwazi kunye neNkcubeko ukubhiyozela umsebenzi obalulekileyo owenziwa ngootitshala bethu.

src: CongratulationsCabinet extended its congratulations and well-wishes to: General Bheki Cele, the Minister of Police, who received the Great Wall Commemorative Medal from the People’s Republic of China for the South African Police Service’s contribution to the broader law-enforcement cooperation between the two countries.
tgt: ImiyalezoAmazwi okuvuyisanaIKhabhinethi idlulise amazwi okuvuyisana kunye neminqweno emihle kwaba:UNjengele Bheki Cele, uMphathiswa wamaPolisa, ofumene iMbasa ye-Great Wall Commemorative evela e-People’s Republic of China ngegalelo leNkonzo yamaPolisa oMzantsi Afrika kwintsebenziswano ebanzi yokuthotyelwa komthetho phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.

src: Ms Angie Motshekga, the Minister of Basic Education, on being selected by the Secretary-General of the UN, Mr Antonio Guterres, to serve on a Global High-Level Panel to advise him on how countries can transform their education systems.
tgt: UNks Angie Motshekga, uMphathiswa weMfundo esiSiseko, ekukhethweni kwakhe nguNobhala-Jikelele we-UN, uMnu Antonio Guterres, ukuba asebenze kwi-Global High-Level Panel ukumcebisa ngendlela amazwe angaziguqula ngayo iinkqubo zawo zemfundo.

src: The selection of Minister Motshekga into the high-level panel reflects her level of expertise in the field of education and is an expression of confidence on South Africa’s education trajectory.
tgt: Ukukhethwa kukaMphathiswa u-Motshekga kwiphaneli yomgangatho ophezulu kubonisa inqanaba lobuchule bakhe kwinkalo yezemfundo kwaye kubonakalisa ukuthemba indlela eqhuba ngayo imfundo yaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: The panel includes representatives from the International Labour Organization, the UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization’s Teacher Task Force, Global Teacher Unions and three education Ministers.
tgt: Le phaneli ibandakanya abameli abavela kuMbutho weHlabathi wezaBasebenzi, uMbutho waMazwe aManyaneyo ezeMfundo, ezeNzululwazi kunye nezeNkcubeko, i-Teacher Task Force, uManyano looTishala kwiHlabathi jikelele (i-Global Teachers Union) kunye nabaPhathiswa abathathu bezemfundo.

src: The panel was co-chaired by two former Presidents.
tgt: Eli gqiza belichotshelwe ngooMongameli ababini bangaphambili.

src: Cape Town Film Studios, local actors and stunt performers, for their work on the Netflix series, One Piece, that rocketed to number one worldwide on the online streaming platform.
tgt: Izitudiyo zemiboniso bhanyabhanya zaseKapa, ​​abadlali beqonga bengingqi kunye nabadlali bemidlalo yeqonga, ngomsebenzi wabo kuthotho lwe-Netflix, i-One Piece, ethe yankqenkqeza kwindawo yokuqala kwihlabathi jikelele kwiqonga le-intanethi.

src: Van Ryn's Distillery, for being awarded the World's Best Brandy trophy for its 12-year-old potstill brandy at the 2023 International Spirits Challenge in London.
tgt: I-Van Ryn's Distillery, ngokuwongwa ngeyona ndebe ye-Brandy eBalaseleyo kwiHlabathi liphela ngebranti yayo ye-potstill eneminyaka eli-12 kukhuphiswano lwe-2023 International Spirits Challenge e-London.

src: Condolences Cabinet expressed condolences to the family and friends of: Mr Aziz Goolam Hoosein Pahad (82), the former anti-apartheid activist who was the first South African democratic government Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs from 1994 to 2008.Lieutenant Commander Gillian Elizabeth Hector, Master Warrant Officer William Masela Mathipa, and Warrant Officer Class One Mmokwapa Lucas Mojela, who died in the line of duty while aboard the submarine, SAS Manthatisi, off Kommetjie in the Western Cape.
tgt: UvelwanoIKhabhinethi igqithise amazwi ovelwano kusapho nabahlobo:bakaMnu Aziz Goolam Hoosein Pahad (82), owayesakuba litshantliziyo elichasene nocalucalulo nowayenguSekela Mphathiswa weSebe leMicimbi yezaNgaphandle kurhulumente wokuqala waseMzantsi Afrika wentando yesininzi ukususela kowe-1994 ukuya kowama-2008.baka-Lieutenant Commander Gillian Elizabeth Hector, u-Master Warrant Officer William Masela Mathipa, kunye no-Warrant Officer Class One Mmokwapa Lucas Mojela, abasweleke besemsebenzini ngelixa bekhwele inkwili, i-SAS Manthatisi, kude neKommetjie eNtshona Koloni.

src: the 22 mineworkers from the Venetia Diamond Mine in Limpopo, who died in a road accident in Musina (Vhembe District).Ms Zoleka Mandela (43), author and activist, and the granddaughter of anti-apartheid heroes Nelson Mandela and Winnie Madikizela-Mandela.
tgt: babasebenzi-mgodini abangama-22 boMgodi weDayimane wase-Venetia eLimpopo, abasweleke kwingozi yendlela eMusina (kwiSithili sase-Vhembe).bakaNksz Zoleka Mandela (43), umbhali kunye netshantliziyo, kwaye nongumzukulwana wamaqhawe awayechasene nocalucalulo u-Nelson Mandela kunye no-Winnie Madikizela-Mandela.

src: Eleven people who lost their lives in the extreme weather conditions that hit several parts of our country in the past week.
tgt: babantu abalishumi elinanye abathe baphulukana nobomi babo kwiimeko ezimbi kakhulu zemozulu ezithwaxe iindawo ezininzi zelizwe lethu kule veki iphelayo.

src: Issues in the environment 2023 Rugby World Cup Champions Cabinet congratulated the Springboks on their 2023 Rugby World Cup victory that made South Africa the only country to win the Rugby World Cup four (4) times and second to win the title back-to-back.
tgt: Imiba enguNdaba-mlonyeni IiNtshatsheli zeNdebe yoMhlaba yeBhola yoMbhoxo yama-2023 IKhabhinethi ivuyisene neqela lama-Springboks kwimpumelelo yalo yeNdebe yoMhlaba yeBhola yoMbhoxo yama-2023 eyenze ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ube lilizwe ekukuphela kwalo ukuphumelela iNdebe yoMhlaba yeBhola yoMbhoxo amaxesha amane (4) kunye nelesibini ukuyiphumelela amaxesha elandelelana.

src: In the history of rugby in South Africa, this Springboks team is the most diverse in terms of the demographics representation of South Africa.
tgt: Kwimbali yebhola yombhoxo eMzantsi Afrika, eli qela le-Springboks lelona lineyantlukwano ngokwentlanga eMzantsi Afrika.

src: The composition of such a diverse team was not an act of coincidence, but a deliberate effort by the management and coaching staff of the Springboks to select an inclusive team.
tgt: Ukwakhiwa kweqela elineyantlukwano enjalo ibingesosenzo sebhaqo, kodwa ibingumzamo wangabom wabaphathi kunye nabasebenzi abaqeqeshayo be-Springboks abaye bakhetha iqela eliquka zonke iintlanga.

src: That bold decision by then coach Rassie Erasmus and his team continues to demonstrate to South Africans and the rest of the world, that everyone with skill, if given a chance and support, can become great – an affirmation that we are Stronger Together.
tgt: Eso sigqibo sokuthatha umngcipheko somqeqeshi welo xesha u-Rassie Erasmus kunye neqela lakhe sisaqhuba ukubonisa abantu baseMzantsi Afrika kunye nehlabathi ngokubanzi, ukuba wonke umntu onesakhono, xa enikwe ithuba nenkxaso, angagqwesa – oku kusisiqiniseko sokuba soMelele xa Sikunye.

src: Most importantly, the resilience and determination of the Springboks in the field of play is an embodiment of a true essence of being South African, that which makes this great nation rise against all odds and adversities to emerge victorious.
tgt: Okubaluleke kakhulu, ukunyamezela kunye nokuzimisela kwe-Springboks kwibala lezemidlalo ngumfuziselo wokuba ngumNtu waseMzantsi Afrika wokwenene, oko okwenza ukuba esi sizwe sikhulu kangaka silwe noloyiso nangona sijongene neenzingo, ekugqibeleni siphume soyisile.

src: Some of the best players of this Springboks team have had to overcome personal adversities on their path to greatness.
tgt: Abathile kwabona badlali bagqwesileyo beli qela le-Springboks kuye kwafuneka endleleni yabo ebhekise empumelelweni boyise iinzingo zobomi babo.

src: Cabinet expressed its congratulations to Siyamtanda “Siya” Kolisi, the Springboks double World Cup-winning captain for leading the team to the Greatest of All Time (GOAT) status and the celebrations must go-on.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise ukuvuyisana kwayo noSiyamthanda “Siya” Kolisi, ikapteni ebikhokele i-Springboks iqela eliphumelele iNdebe yeHlabathi kabini ngokulandelelana de labe lifikelela kwiwonga lokuba liqela eliphambili elake Laba liKhulu ngeXesha lalo i-Greatest of All Time (i-GOAT) mayiqhube ke imibhiyozo.

src: AGOA Forum Cabinet had welcomed the confirmation by both the United States administration and congress on the intention to extend AGOA, which brings certainty to the investment community in the AGOA-eligible countries.
tgt: I-Forum ye-AGOA IKhabhinethi isamkele isiqinisekiso esisuka kulawulo lwase-United States kunye nenkongolo esimalunga nenjongo yokolula i-AGOA, nto leyo izisa isiqinisekiso kuluntu lotyalomali kumazwe afanelekileyo ukuxhamla kwi-AGOKanajalo iKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukusingathwa kwe-forum ye-AGOA yama-2023 ebibanjelwe e-Johannesburg ngomhla we-2 ukuya mhla we-4 kweyeNkanga 2023 nebizinyaswe ngabathathi nxaxheba abavela kumazwe ase-Afrika angama-32 avela kurhulumente, uShishino, uluntu ngokubanzi kunye nabezemisebenzi ebebehambele lo msitho okokuqala kuquka kunye nabameli bakarhulumente wase-United States.

src: Cabinet had also welcomed the hosting of the 2023 AGOA Forum in Johannesburg from the 2nd – 4th November 2023 with participants from 32 Africa countries from government, Business, civil society and organised labour for the first time and representatives of the United States government.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isoloko ikuqinisekisa ukuba i-AGOA ibonelela i-United States of America ngethuba lokomeleza ubudlelwane bayo bezoqoqosho ne-Afrika yiloo nto ke kufuneka le AGOA yolulwe ukuze ibenethuba eloneleyo lokuthela iziqhamo, kwaye yenziwe luqilima ukuze ibe neempembelelo ezintle kananjalo ibenawo nomtsalane.

src: Cabinet has always asserted that AGOA provides an opportunity for the United States of America to strengthen its economic relationship with Africa and thus it must be extended for a meaningful period, enhanced to make it impactful and attractive.
tgt: INtlanganiso yobaPhathiswa bezoKhenketho be-BRICS IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuqukunjelwa ngempumelelo kweNtlanganiso yabaPhathiswa bezoKhenketho be-BRICS yama-2023 ebibanjelwe eKapa, apho amazwe angamalungu azibophelele kwintsebenziswano enzulu kunye nasekukhuthazeni ukhenketho phakathi kwi-BRICS, ukuphuhlisa iindlela zokuhamba nonxulumano phakathi kwamazwe angamalungu.

src: This will further strengthen South Africa’s tourism sector which is already showing signs of recovery.
tgt: Oku kuza komeleza nangakumbi icandelo lezokhenketho laseMzantsi Afrika esele libonisa iimpawu zokuvuka ke noko.

src: For the first 8 months of 2023, the country saw million arrivals which represented a 63.4% increase from the same period in 2022.
tgt: Kwiinyanga ezisi-8 zokuqala zika-2023, ilizwe lamkele i-5.5 yezigidi zabantu abafikayo oko okubonakalise ukonyuka ngama-63.4% xa kuthelekiswa neli thuba linye lango-2022.

src: Voter Registration The IEC has announced the 18th and 19th of November 2023 as a first voter registration weekend for the 2024 General Elections.
tgt: UkuBhalisela ukuVota I-IEC yabhengeza umhla we-18 nowe-19 kweyeNkanga 2023 njengempelaveki yokuqala yokubhalisela ukuvota kuNyulo Jikelele luka-2024.

src: Cabinet is calling on all eligible voters to register to vote for the 2024 General Elections at your nearest voting stations.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abavoti abafanelekileyo ukuba babhalisele ukuvota kuNyulo Jikelele luka-2024 kwizikhululo zokuvota ezikufutshane nabo.

src: Online voter registration has been opened since February 2023 and citizens are urged to use the facility to register or update their details.
tgt: Ukubhalisela ukuvota nge-intanethi kuvulwe ukususela ngeyoMdumba wama-2023 kwaye abemi bayabongozwa ukuba basebenzise esi sibonelelo ukubhalisa okanye ukuhlaziya iinkcukacha zabo.

src: South Africans who have applied for their IDs are encouraged to visit their local Home Affairs office to collect them.
tgt: Abantu baseMzantsi Afrika abafake izicelo zabo zee-ID bayakhuthazwa ukuba bazilande ngokuthi batyelele i-Ofisi yeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya.

src: There are more than 500 000 smart ID cards still to be collected atHome Affairs offices across the country.
tgt: Angaphezulu kwama-500 000 amakhadi ee-ID ekusafuneka ukuba ayolandwa kwii-ofisi zeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya elizweni ngokubanzi.

src: Electricity The Minister in the Presidency responsible for Electricity has provided a comprehensive briefing on electricity situation in the country.
tgt: Umbane UMphathiswa kwi-Ofisi kaMongameli onoxanduva lokujonga imicimbi yezoMbane unike amagqabantshintshi abanzi ngemeko yombane elizweni.

src: Cabinet applauded efforts by the Gauteng Provincial Government working with Eskom to restore electricity to areas in Gauteng that have been hit by black-outs due to the theft or damage to transformers.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iziqhwabele izandla iinzame zikaRhulumente wePhondo lase-Gauteng zokusebenza ne-Eskom ukubuyisela umbane kwimimandla yase-Gauteng ebithwaxwa kukucima kombane ngenxa yokwebiwa okanye umonakalo kwizixhobo ezihambisa amandla ombane.

src: Last night, six new electrical transformers were switched in Kagiso, in the West Rand area after communities were left without power for more than 3 years.
tgt: Izolo ebusuku, kuye kwalayitwa izixhobo ezihambisa amandla ombane ezithandathu eKagiso, kummandla weNtshona Randi emva kokuba uluntu lwashiyeka lungenambane isithuba esingaphezulu kweminyaka emithathu.

src: Cabinet calls on these communities to protect the critical infrastructure from theft, vandalism and damage that is caused by illegal connections.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema olu luntu ukuba luzikhusele iziseko zophuhliso ezibalulekileyo ekwebiweni, ekonakalisweni kunye nomonakalo obangelwa luqhagamshelo olungekho mthethweni.

src: Food Poisoning Cabinet is concerned by the spate of food poisoning of children from eating expired and contaminated foodstuff from spaza shops and street vendors.
tgt: UkuTyhefeka kokuTya IKhabhinethi ixhalabile yindlela ekonyuke ngayo iziganeko zabantwana abatya ityhefu ngenxa yokutya ukutya okuphelelwe lixesha kunye nokutya okungcolisekileyo kwasespaza kunye nokwabathengisi basesitalatweni.

src: Cabinet is encouraged by the law enforcement efforts to enforce food safety compliance.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthazwa ziinzame ezenziwa ngabanyanzelisi bomthetho zokunyanzelisa ukuthotyelwa kokhuseleko ekutyeni.

src: International Migration Workshop with Mayors and Traditional leaders Cabinet was briefed about the international migration workshop hosted by the Department of Home Affairs with the participation of the DSBD, COGTA, Human Settlements and traditional leaders and mayors from metro and district municipalities that focused on curbing effects of illegal immigration, including the operations of spaza shops.
tgt: INtlanganiso yeeNgxoxo nooSodolophu kunye neenkokeli zeMveli ngeMfuduko yeHlabathi IKhabhinethi yanikwa amagqabantshintshi malunga nentlanganiso yeengxoxo ngemfuduko yehlabathi eyayisingethwe liSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya ngothatho nxaxheba lwe-DSBD, i-COGTA, iSebe leeNdawo zokuHlaliswa kwabaNtu kunye neenkokeli zemveli noosodolophu abavela koomasipala abambhaxa kunye nabezithili eyayijolise ekunqandeni iziphumo zemfuduko engekho mthethweni, kuquka noshishino lwezipaza.

src: Key outcomes include the introduction of omnibus by-laws to address challenges relating to the enforcement of business by-laws by municipalities and traditional authorities.
tgt: Iziphumo ezingundoqo ziquka ukwaziswa kwemithetho equka konke kamasipala ukuze ithathele ingqalelo imingeni enxulumene nokunyanzeliswa kokusetyenziswa kwemithetho yendawo inyanzeliswa ngoomasipala kunye nabasemagunyeni kulawulo lwemveli.

src: There will be immediate joint inspections of businesses, in particular spaza shops by the departments of labour, health, small business development and the Home Affairs immigration inspectorate teams, to enforce compliance with applicable laws An audit of spaza shops in villages and townships, and mechanisms to register them by both traditional leaders and municipalities will be undertaken.
tgt: Kuza kubakho uhlolo nophando olukhawulezileyo oluza kuqhutywa ngokuhlanganyelweyo lokujonga ukusetyenziswa kwemithetho yamashishini, ingakumbi izipaza lisebe lezemisebenzi, elezempilo, elophuhliso lwamashishini amancinci kunye namaqela ahlola imfuduko eSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya, ukunyanzelisa ukuthotyelwa kwemithetho elindelekileyo kumashishini.

src: There are also efforts to support traditional authorities to keep a record of foreign nationals in their communities.
tgt: Ukuphicothwa kwezipaza ezilalini nasezilokishini, kunye neendlela zokuzibhalisa ezingasetyenziswa ziinkokeli zemveli kunye noomasipala nako kuza kwenziwa.

src: Business licencing legislation is being amended to support all those who wish to trade in the informal sector.
tgt: Kukwakho neenzame zokuxhasa oogunyaziwe bemveli ukuba bagcine uluhlu lwamagama abemi bangaphandle kwiindawo abahlala kuzo.

src: Integrated Crime Fighting Cabinet commends the SAPS for dealing a massive blow to international drug syndicates following the discovery of cocaine valued at R80 million which were seized on 20 October 2023 at a warehouse at the Dube Trade Port within the King Shaka International Airport.
tgt: Kulungiswa umthetho wokunikwa kwelayisenisi kumashishini ngelo kuxhasa bonke abo banqwenela ukurhweba kwicandelo lweshishini elingekho sikweni.

src: Two days prior the seizure, another R70 million worth of cocaine was also seized from a container at the Durban Harbour.
tgt: UMlo woLwaphulomthetho oHlanganyelweyo IKhabhinethi iyincomile i-SAPS ngokufumana iqela elithubelezisa iziyobisi kumazwe angaphandle kulandela ukufunyanwa kwe-cocaine exabisa ama-R80 ezigidi ebanjwe ngowama-20 kweyeDwarha 2023 kumzi wokugcina impahla i-Dube Trade Port kwisikhululo seenqwelomoya i-King Shaka International Airport.

src: Cabinet applauds the SAPS for their work in disrupting and dismantling transnational organised crime that poses a significant threat to our communities and the nation.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqhwabela izandla i-SAPS ngomsebenzi wayo ekuphazamiseni kunye nasekunqandeni ulwaphulomthetho oluququzelelweyo lwamazwe amaninzi olusisigrogriso esikhulu kwiindawo zethu esihlala kuzo nakwisizwe siphela.

src: Operation Safer Festive Season is already yielding results with police arresting over 140 suspects, including an alleged illegal mining kingpin, and seizing unlicensed firearms.
tgt: IPhulo le-Operation Safer Festive Season sele liveza iziphumo ngamapolisa abambe ngaphezulu kwe-140 yabarhanelwa, kuquka norhanelwa ngokuba ngungqondongqondo ekumbiweni kwemigodi okungekho mthethweni, kunye nokuthathwa kwemipu engenazilayisenisi.

src: Presidential Oversight Visit Cabinet welcomed the Presidential Oversight Visit to the Emfuleni Municipality, which followed-up on engagements with the community during the District Development Model visit of 2022.
tgt: UTyelelo lukaMongameli lokuyoKhangela Ukuqhubekeka koMsebenzi IKhabhinethi ilwamkele uTyelelo lukaMongameli lokuyoKhangela Ukuqhubekeka koMsebenzi kuMasipala wase-Emfuleni, obelulandelela ukujonga iziphumo zothetha-thethwano zendibano noluntu elalibanjwe ngo-2022 kwiNkqubo yoPhuhliso lweZithili.

src: The 2022 visit to Emfuleni identified issues of poor infrastructure maintenance by the municipality Through the intervention of the Department of Water and Sanitation, there has been notable progress in addressing water and sanitation infrastructure challenges that had resulted in the collapse of the Vaal Waste Water system.
tgt: Utyelelo luka-2022 Emfuleni lwachonga imiba yokungalungiswa kakuhle kweziseko zophuhliso ngumasipala.

src: Work has been undertaken to improve water supply, the proper functioning of the waste water infrastructure and thus eliminating the problem of the sewer effluent that run running on the streets and people’s yards.
tgt: Ngongenelelo lweSebe lezaManzi noGutyulo, kube khona inkqubela ebonakalayo ekuthatheleni ingqalelo imingeni yeziseko zophuhliso zamanzi nezogutyulo ekhokelele ekuweni kwenkqubo ye-Vaal Waste Water.

src: Noted progress during the visit include improvements in critical bulk pipelines and water pump stations, resurfacing and resealing of roads, and a massive rollout of streetlights to improve lighting and safety.
tgt: Sowuqalile umsebenzi wokuphukcula unikezelo lwamanzi, ukusebenza ngokufanelekileyo kweziseko zophuhliso zamanzi amdaka kwaye oko kuphelisa ingxaki yemibhobho ehambisa amanzi amdaka ebesele egxagxaza ezitalatweni nakwiiyadi zabantu.

src: Roadmap for the Freight Logistics System in South Africa The Department of Transport has commenced consultations on the Roadmap for the Freight Logistics System in South Africa, as part of measures to address the challenges facing the freight and logistics sector and the strengthening of South Africa’s economic recovery efforts.
tgt: Inkqubela eqatshelweyo kolu tyelelo iquka uphuculo kwimibhobho yamanzi emininzi kunye nakwizikhululo zeempompo zamanzi, ukulungiswa ngaphezulu kunye nokutywinwa kweendlela, kunye nokufakwa ngobuninzi kwezibane zasesitalatweni ngelokuphucula ukukhanya nokhuseleko.

src: Infrastructure Development and Maintenance Cabinet welcomed the progress being made with infrastructure development and maintenance with the completion of 36 rural bridges under the Welisizwe Rural Bridges, and the construction underway on 20 projects in human settlements, roads, and water.
tgt: ISicwangciso seNkqubo yoThutho lweMpahla eMzantsi Afrika ISebe lezoThutho liqalise iindibano kwiSicwangciso seNkqubo yoThutho lweMpahla eMzantsi Afrika, njengenxenye yamanyathelo okuthathela ingqalelo imingeni ejongene necandelo lokuthuthwa kwempahla kunye nokomelezwa kweenzame zokubuyiselwa koqoqosho eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Relaunch of South African Airways (SAA) international routes Cabinet welcomed the relaunch of SAA international routes with the re-introduction of its intercontinental flight to São Paulo, Brazil, which also marked the return of the long-haul service out of Cape Town and Johannesburg.
tgt: UPhuhliso nokuGcinwa kweziSeko zoPhuhliso IKhabhinethi iyamkele inkqubela eyenziweyo ngophuhliso kunye nokugcinwa kweziseko zophuhliso ngokugqitywa kweebhulorho zasezilalini ezingama-36 phantsi kwenkqubo yeWelisizwe Rural Bridges, kunye nokwakhiwa okuqalayo kweeprojekthi ezingama-20 kwiindawo zokuhlaliswa kwabantu, iindlela, namanzi.

src: The return of SAA in the international routes will contribute directly in driving growth in international travel to the country, and growth of the tourism sector after the ravages of the Covid-19 pandemic.
tgt: UkuPhehlelelwa ngokuTsha kweendlela zehlabathi zeQumrhu leeNqwelomoya loMzantsi Afrika (i-SAA) IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuphehlelelwa ngokutsha kweendlela zehlabathi ze-SAA ngokubuyiswa ngokutsha kwehambo yayo yenqwelomoya ehamba phakathi kwamazwekazi eya e-São Paulo, e-Brazil, ephawule kananjalo ukubuya kwenkonzo ehamba ihambo ende esuka eKapa nase-Johannesburg.

src: South Africa launches the largest drone in Africa Cabinet congratulated the Defence and aerospace company Milkor on their successful launch of the Milkor 380 unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), which places South Africa among the countries that continue to make strides in drone technology.
tgt: Ukubuyela kwe-SAA kwiindlela zehlabathi kuza kufaka isandla ngqo ekuqhubeni ukukhula kokusetyenziswa kwezithuthi ezihamba kweli lizwe, kunye nokukhula kwecandelo lezokhenketho emva kokuba ligqugqiswe ngubhubhane we-COVID-19.

src: The Milkor 380 is the largest drone built in Africa and it will be used by the defence industry for combat, border control, conservation efforts including to combat poaching.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uphehlelela eyona drone inkulu e-Afrika IKhabhinethi ivuyisene noMkhosi kunye nenkampani yobuchwepheshe bokubhabha emoyeni kweenqwelomoya i-Milkor ngokuphehlelela kwabo ngempumelelo i-Milkor 380 okusisithuthi esizihambelayo emoyeni (i-UAV), oku kubeka uMzantsi Afrika phakathi kwamazwe aqhubayo ukwenza imitsi emide kubuchwepheshe beenqwelomoya ezizihambela emoyeni ii-drone.

src: Matric and Year-end schools examinations Cabinet welcomed the smooth start to the 2023 National Senior Certificate (matric) exams, which commenced on 30 October 2023.
tgt: I-Milkor 380 yeyona drone inkulu eyakhiwe e-Afrika kwaye iza kusetyenziswa licandelo lezokhuselo ngeenjongo zokulwa, ulawulo lomda, ulondolozo lwendalo kuquka nokulwa ukuzingela okungekho mthethweni.

src: Parents and guardians are encouraged to continue to support learners during this critical period.
tgt: Iimviwo zeMatriki kunye nezokuphela konyaka ezikolweni IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuqala kakuhle kweemviwo zeSatifiketi esiPhezulu seSizwe (iMatriki) zama-2023, eziqale ngowama-30 kweyeDwarha 2023.

src: Cabinet also sends its well wishes to all the learners who will be sitting for their year-end exams.
tgt: Abazali nabagcini babantwana bayakhuthazwa ukuba baqhubeleke nokuxhasa abafundi ngeli xesha libaluleke kangaka.

src: Cabinet decisions The Situation in Palestine Cabinet is disappointed by the refusal of the Israeli government to respect international law and its continued undermining of the United Nations resolutions for the implementation of a ceasefire with impunity.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi IMeko yase-Palestine Idanile iKhabhinethi kukwala kukarhulumente wakwaSirayeli ukuthobela umthetho wehlabathi kunye nokuqhubeka kwayo ijongela phantsi izigqibo zeZizwe eziManyeneyo zigqibo ezo ezifuna kubekwe phantsi izikhali ngaphandle kokohlwaywa.

src: The humanitarian corridors for the people of Palestine remain closed with dire consequences for children, women and innocent civilians.
tgt: Iindlela zokunika uncedo kubantu base-Palestine zisavaliwe kuza neziphumo ezimbi ebantwaneni, abasetyhini nabemi abangenatyala.

src: The genocidal airstrikes by the government of Israel on the people of Palestine, continue with rising death toll that include women and children.
tgt: Uhlaselo lwasemoyeni olubulala abantu ngobuninzi olwenziwa ngurhulumente wakwaSirayeli ebantwini base-Palestine, luyaqhuba lubonakala ngamanani okusweleka kwabantu anyukayo aquka abasetyhini nabantwana.

src: In the last two days, the world have sat helplessly and watched as intensifying airstrikes on Gaza and the West Bank have destroyed schools, health facilities, ambulances and civilian infrastructure and supposedly safe roads travelling to the South of Gaza.
tgt: Kwiintsuku ezimbini ezidlulileyo, ihlabathi liye lahlala lijongile nje kungekhonto linokuyenza, njengoko uhlaselo lwasemoyeni olonyukayo lwase-Gaza nase-West Bank lutshabalalise izikolo, izibonelelo zempilo, iinqwelo zezigulane neziseko zophuhliso zabantu kunye nezo ndlela kuthiwa zikhuselekile eziya kuMzantsi we-Gaza.

src: For these, the Cabinet has decided to recall all South African diplomats from Tel Aviv for consultation.
tgt: Ngenxa yoku, iKhabhinethi igqibe ekubeni ibuyise bonke oonozakuzaku baseMzantsi Afrika abase-Tel Aviv ukuze kudityanwe nabo.

src: Cabinet has also noted with disquiet the continuing disparaging remarks of the Israeli’s ambassador to South Africa, Mr. Eliav Belotsercovsky, against South Africans, the leadership of South Africa both in and outside government including civil society who are speaking against the holocaust being committed by the Israeli government against the Palestinians.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iziqaphele kananjalo ngokukhathazeka izimvo ezinyhatshayo ezenziwa ngunozakuzaku wakwaSirayeli eMzantsi Afrika, uMnu Eliav Belotsercovsky, ezibhekisele kubantu baseMzantsi Afrika, ubunkokeli baseMzantsi Afrika kuquka uluntu ekuhlaleni oluthetha phandle ngokubulawa ngobuninzi kwabantu okwenziwa ngurhulumente wakwaSirayeli ebantwini base-Palestine.

src: The disparaging remarks of Ambassador Belotsercovsky are contrasted by the statements of two former Israeli ambassadors to South Africa (Illan Baruch and Dr. Alon Liel) who have been consistent in describing the actions of their government against Palestinians as Apartheid.
tgt: Ezi zimvo zinyhatshayo zikaNozakuzaku Belotsercovsky ziyaphikiswa ziingxelo zabo babengoonozakuzaku bakwaSirayeli eMzantsi Afrika ababini (u-Illan Baruch noGqr Alon Liel) abo babengangungqi ekuchazeni izenzo zikarhulumente wabo ezichasene nabantu base-Palestine njengezenzo zengcindezelo.

src: The disparaging remarks against those speaking up against the atrocities and the country’s leaders make ambassador Belotsercovsky position more and more untenable.
tgt: Izimvo ezinyhatshayo ezibhekiswe kwabo bathethela phandle kunye nakwiinkokeli zelizwe zenza isikhundla sikanozakuzaku Belotsercovsky singakhuseleki okanye angafumani khuseleko.

src: As such Cabinet has directed the Department of International Relations and Cooperation to convey the South African government displeasure with the ambassador formally through diplomatic channels.
tgt: Ke ngoko iKhabhinethi iyalele iSebe lezobuDlelwane beHlabathi neNtsebenziswano ukuba livakalise ukungoneliseki kukarhulumente waseMzantsi Afrika ngalo nozakuzaku oko kuzakwenziwa kulandelwa amajelo ozakuzo afanelekileyo.

src: Medium Term Budget Policy Statement Cabinet welcomed the 2023 Medium Term Budget Policy Statement (MTBPS), which provided a frank assessment of the current economic climate and demonstrated government’s firm hold on our nation’s finances amid tough revenue constraints.
tgt: INgxelo yoMgaqonkqubo woHlahlo Lwabiwomali leXesha eliPhakathi IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNgxelo yoMgaqonkqubo yoHlahlo Lwabiwomali yeXesha eliPhakathi (i-MTBPS) yama-2023, enike uvavanyo olucacileyo lwemo yezoqoqosho ekhoyo ngoku kwaye yabonisa ukugcinwa kakuhle kwemali yethu yelizwe ngurhulumente nangona ephakathi kwemiqobo enzima.

src: The decisions in the MTBPS improve our fiscal framework stimulate economic growth while balancing our social commitments that support the vulnerable in our nation.
tgt: Izigqibo ezikwi-MTBPS ziphucula inkqubosikhokelo yethu yezemali zivuselela ukukhula koqoqosho ngexa ingqinelanisa izibophelelo zethu zasekuhlaleni ezixhasa abo basesichengeni elizweni lethu.

src: The Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan has contributed to many green shoots in our economy.
tgt: ISicwangciso soKwakha ngokuTsha eMva kweNtlekele sibe negalelo kwiimpawu zokuqala zokuphucuka kuqoqosho lwethu.

src: High Speed Rail Development Cabinet approved the High Speed Rail Development Framework and the financial implications for implementation will be discussed between the Ministers of Transport and Finance Cabinet approved the prioritisation of the Johannesburg to Durban corridor for a detailed feasibility study, and the Johannesburg-Polokwane to Musina, and the Johannesburg to Mbombela will be put to the market.
tgt: UPhuhliso loMzila wooLoliwe abaHamba ngeSantya esiPhezulu IKhabhinethi ivume iNkqubosikhokelo yoPhuhliso loMzila wooLoliwe abaHamba ngeSantya esiPhezulu kwaye iimpembelelo zemali ekuphunyezweni koku kuza kuxoxwa ngazo phakathi kwabaPhathiswa owezoThutho nowezeMali.

src: Draft White Paper on Citizenship, Immigration and Refugee Protection Cabinet approved the publication of the White Paper on Citizenship, Immigration and Refugee Protection for public comments.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukubekwa phambili komzila osuka e-Johannesburg uya eThekwini ngophononongo olucazululiweyo loko kunokwenzeka, kwaye osuka e-Johannesburg nase-Polokwane uya eMusina, kunye nosuka e-Johannesburg uya eMbombela ziza kubekwa emarikeni.

src: The draft Policy aims to provide a framework to guide the granting of residency and citizenship to foreign nationals, as well as the protection of refugees and asylum seekers in South Africa, cognisant of the Republic’s national security interests and in compliance with international agreements and protocols on migration that South Africa is party to.
tgt: IPhepha leNgcaciso-Nkqubo eliQulunqwayo ngoBumi, iMfuduko kunye noKhuselo lweeMbacu IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kwePhepha leNgcaciso-Nkqubo ngoBumi, iMfuduko kunye noKhuselo lweeMbacu ukuze ulunike izimvo uluntu.

src: The 6th Annual Progress Report on the implementation of the White Paper on the Rights of People with Disabilities Cabinet has approved for publication in the government gazette the 6th Annual Progress Report on the implementation of the White Paper on the Rights of People with Disabilities.
tgt: INgxelo yeNkqubela yoNyaka yesi-6 ngokuphunyezwa kwePhepha leNgcaciso-Nkqubo ngamaLungelo abaNtu abanokuKhubazeka

src: The publication of the progress report will coincide with the international commemoration of the Disability Rights Awareness Month from 3 November to 3 December.
tgt: .IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kwigazethi karhulumente kweNgxelo yeNkqubela yoNyaka yesi-6 ngokuphunyezwa kwePhepha leNgcaciso-Nkqubo ngamaLungelo abaNtu abanokuKhubazeka.

src: The progress report also signals an increase of the minimum employment equity target from 2% to 3% for persons with disabilities as from the 2024/2025 financial year, towards a minimum 7% employment equity target for persons with disabilities by 2030.
tgt: Ukupapashwa kwengxelo yenkqubela kuza kudibana nokukhunjulwa kwihlabathi kweNyanga yokuQondwa kwamaLungelo okuba nokuKhubazeka ukusukela ngowe-3 kweyeNkanga ukuya kowe-3 kweyoMnga.

src: Bills Draft African Renaissance and International Cooperation Fund (ARF) Bill Cabinet approved the submission of the ARF Amendment Bill to Parliament.
tgt: ImiThetho eYilwayo UmThetho oYilwayo weNgxowamali yokuZalwa ngokuTsha kwe-Afrika kunye neNtsebenziswano (i-ARF) IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa komThetho oYilwayo oTshintshiweyo we-ARF ePalamente.

src: The Bill seeks to amend the ARF Act (Act 51 of 2000) and establish the South African Development Partnership Agency that will serve as a mechanism to support South Africa’s development and cooperation with sister countries through the promotion of democracy, good governance, the prevention and resolution of conflict, socio-economic development and integration.
tgt: UmThetho oYilwayo ufuna ukutshitsha umThetho we-ARF (umThetho wama-51 ka-2000) kwaye useka i-Arhente yeNtsebenziswano yoPhuhliso loMzantsi Afrika, eza kusebenza njengendlela yokuxhasa uphuhliso loMzantsi Afrika kunye nentsebenziswano namazwe osebenzisana nawo oko kusenziwa ngokukhuthazwa kwentando yesininzi, ulawulo olululo, uphuhliso kunye nokuhlanganisa okunxulumene nezentlalo nezoqoqosho.

src: All appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and relevant clearance.
tgt: Abaqeshiweyo Zonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo Ukuqeshwa kukaMnu.

src: Appointment of Mr Ebrahim Rasool as Chairperson of the Development Bank of Southern Africa.
tgt: Ebrahim Rasool njengoSihlalo weBhanki yoPhuhliso yamaZantsi e-Afrika.

src: Appointment of Ms Margaret Mosibudi Phiri as a member to the National Nuclear Regulator Board
tgt: Margaret Mosibudi Phiri njengelungu le-National Nuclear Regulator Board.

src: Upcoming Events Anti-Corruption Dialogue The Anti-Corruption Dialogue will be held on 8 and 9 November 2023 at Birchwood Hotel in Ekurhuleni to mobilise society in the fight against corruption in line with the country’s National Anti-Corruption Strategy Cabinet, in November 2020, approved the National Anti-Corruption Strategy (NACS 2020-2030).
tgt: IMisitho Ezayo INgxoxo emayelana nokuLwa noRhwaphilizo INgxoxo emayelana nokuLwa noRhwaphilizo iza kubanjwa ngowe-8 nowe-9 kweyeNkanga 2023 kwiHotele i-Birchwood Ekurhuleni ukuhlanganisa uluntu kumlo ochasene norhwaphilizo ngokungqinelana neSicwangciso esiLwa uRhwaphilizo seSizwe.

src: This is a country strategy that is aimed at creating a corruption-free society while also encouraging citizens to have zero-tolerance for corruption and abide by the rule of law.
tgt: IKhabhinethi, ngeyeNkanga 2020, yasivuma iSicwangciso esiLwa uRhwaphilizo seSizwe (i-NACS 2020-2030).

src: 16 Days of Activism Campaign for No Violence Against Women and Children 2023 This year marks the 25th anniversary of South Africa’s participation in the 16 Days of Activism for No Violence against Women and Children Campaign which will be observed under the theme: “Accelerating actions to end Gender-Based Violence and Femicide (GBVF): Leaving no one behind”.
tgt: Esi sisicwangciso selizwe esijolise ekudaleni indawo yoluntu engenalo urhwaphilizo ngexa kananjalo sikhuthaza abemi ukuba bangalunyamezeli kwaphela urhwaphilizo kwaye bathobele ulawulo lomthetho.

src: This global campaign runs from 25 November, the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women to 10 December, International Human Rights Day.
tgt: IiNtsuku ezili-16 zePhulo lobuTshantliziyo lokuChasa ubuNdlobongela obuBhekiswe kwabaseTyhini nabaNtwana lika-2023 Lo nyaka uphawula isikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-25 sothatho nxaxheba loMzantsi Afrika kwiiNtsuku ezili-16 zePhulo lobuTshantliziyo ekuChaseni ubuNdlobongela obubhekiswe kwabaseTyhini nabaNtwana eliza kuqwalaselwa phantsi komxholo: “Ukukhawulezisa amanyathelo okuphelisa ubuNdlobongela obuSekelwe kwiSini nokuBulawa kwabaseTyhini (i-GBVF): Kungashiywa mntu emva”.

src: It aims to combat violence against women whilst upholding human rights.
tgt: Lijolise ekulweni ubundlobongela obubhekiswe kwabasetyhini ngexa lisagcine amalungelo oluntu.

src: 3 14th Policy Dialogue Forum South Africa will co-host the 14th Policy Dialogue Forum in collaboration with the UNESCO International Teacher Task Force for Education (TTF) in January 2024 under the theme “Addressing teacher shortages and making the profession more attractive”.
tgt: IQonga leNgxoxo yoMgaqosiseko ye-14 UMzantsi Afrika uza kusingatha iQonga leNgxoxo yoMgaqosiseko ye-14 idibene noMsebenzi oWenziwa ngooTitshala kwiMfundo weHlabathi (i-TTF) we-UNESCO ngeyoMqungu ka-2024 phantsi komxholo “Ukuthathela ingqalelo ukunqongophala kootitshala kunye nokuwenza ube nomtsalane ngakumbi umsebenzi lo”.

src: The forum will bring together government officials, NGOs, teachers and education experts to discuss critical issues pertaining to the conditions of service for teachers, issues of teacher autonomy and accountability as well as how to make teaching an attractive profession.
tgt: Iqonga liza kuhlanganisa kunye amagosa karhulumente, ii-NGO, ootitshala kunye nengcali zemfundo ukuxoxa ngemiba ebalulekileyo ephathelene neemeko zengqesho kootitshala, imiba yokuzimela nokuthatha uxanduva kootitshala ngokunjalo nendlela yokwenza ube nomtsalane umsebenzi wokufundisa.

src: Messages Congratulations
tgt: Imiyalezo Amazwi Okuvuyisana

src: Cabinet extended its congratulations and well wishes to: The Proteas for securing a place in the semi-finals of the the ICC World Cup 2023 in India.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana kwaye idlulisa iminqweno emihle kwaba:

src: Moto GP racing star Brad Binder who is now the outright premier class podium record holder for South Africa after his top three finish at the Thailand Grand Prix.
tgt: Ii-Proteas ngokuzifumanela indawo kwimidlalo eyandulela eyokugqibela kwindebe yeHlabathi ye-ICC ka-2023 e-Indiya.

src: South Africa’s first pro-wheelchair bodybuilder Macethandile Kulati for defending his title at the 2023 International Federation of Body Builders and Fitness World Championship in Slovenia.
tgt: Nangona zingakhange ziphumelele kumdlalo wazo ne-Indiya izolo, ilizwe lisahleli libaxhasa ngamandla kwaye linethemba lokuba ziza kuqhuba ukwakha kwaye zisenze sibe nebhongo.

src: South African Chartered Accountants for earning the top position in the Edelman global professional trust survey.
tgt: Umqhubi wemoto yomdyarho ye-Moto GP u-Brad Binder waseMzantsi Afrika ngoku onerekhodi yodidi oluphezulu kwiphodiyam emva kokugqiba kwakhe ephezulu ekwindawo yesithathu kuMdyarho weeMoto wase-Thailand.

src: Dr Claude Mashego for winning the inaugural Miss World South Africa and she will now represent South Africa at the Miss World in New Delhi, India in December this year.
tgt: USozinyama wokuqala ohamba ngesitulo esinamavili waseMzantsi Afrika u-Macethandile Kulati ngokukhusela isitsaba sakhe kwiQumrhu leHlabathi looSozinyama leHlabathi kunye nobuNtshatsheli ekuziLolongeni kwiHlabathi ngo-2023 e-Slovenia.

src: Advocate Kholeka Gcaleka following her appointment as the new Public Protector for a term of seven years with effect from 1 November 2023.
tgt: I-South African Chartered Accountants ngokufumana isikhundla esiphezulu kuphando lwehlabathi lokwenza umsebenzi ngokwethembeka olwenziwe yi-Edelman.

src: Condolences Cabinet expressed condolences to the family and friends of: Paralympic gold medallist Zanele Situ who was the first black South African female athlete to win a gold medal at the Paralympic Games in Sydney in 2000.
tgt: UGqr Claude Mashego ngokuphumelela ukhuphiswano lokuba nguNkosazana Mzantsi Afrika okokuqala kwaye ke ngoku uza kumela uMzantsi Afrika kuNkosazana Mzantsi Afrika kwiNkosazana yeHlabathi e-New Delhi, e-Indiya ngeyoMnga kulo nyaka.

src: Economic Recovery and Growth Quarterly Labour Force Survey (QLFS) Cabinet welcomes the 2023, 3rd quarter, QLFS results as released by Statistics South Africa that indicated employment figures have surpassed the pre-COVID-19 employment levels.
tgt: UVuselelo noHlumo loQoqosho UPhando lweKota lwezeMisebenzi (i-QLFS) IKhabhinethi iyazamkela iziphumo ze-QLFS, zekota yesithathu yowama-2023 ezikhutshwe liziko lezeeNkcukacha-manani loMzantsi Afrika (i-StatsSA) ezibonise ukuba inani labantu abaphangelayo lingaphezulu kwelo labo babephangela phambi kokufika kwe-COVID-19.

src: Cabinet is pleased that all provinces but one have contributed to the 399 000 increase to the number of employed people to a total of 16,7 million people in employment in the 3rd quarter, compared to 16,3 million in the 2nd quarter of 2023.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyiswa zindaba zokuba linye nje kuphela iphondo elingakhange libe negalelo kweli nani lingama-399 000 lilinani elinyuke ngalo inani labantu abaphangelayo laya kutsho kwizigidi ezili-16.7 kwikota yesithathu, xa lithelekiswa nabo bazizigidi ezili-16.3 bekota yesibini yowama-2023.

src: The strong contributions to additional jobs of KwaZulu-Natal (up by 152 000), Limpopo (up by 70 000), North West (up by 61 000) and Mpumalanga, indicate the gradual but steady realisation of the goal of the Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan of rebuilding better, stronger and inclusively.
tgt: Amaphondo abe nabantu abaninzi abathe bafumana imisebenzi yiKwaZulu-Natal (ebenabantu abangama-152 000), iLimpopo (abangama-70 000), uMntla Ntshona (abangama-61 000) kunye neMpumalanga, abonisa ukuba ziya zizalisekiseka iinjongo zesiCwangciso zokuVuselelwa nokuHlaziywa koQoqosho zokwakha ngokutsha ngcono, ngqingqwa nangokuquka wonke umntu.

src: Cabinet appreciates the continued and consistent contribution of the following sectors and industries: The formal sector employment increased by 287 000 whereas informal sector increased by 29 000 jobs Finance (this includes business services) up by 237 000 jobs Community and social services up by 119 000 jobs and agriculture by 61 000 jobs.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalibulela igalelo elenziwe ngala macandelo kumalinge okudala imisebenzi: Inani labantu abafumene imisebenzi kwicandelo lamashishini abhaliswe ngokusesikweni ngama-287 000 lize lona eli linamashishini angabhaliswanga ngokusesikweni libe ngama-29 000.

src: Cabinet is also pleased that despite remaining challenges, youth unemployment is gradually declining (a decrease of 1.9% from the previous quarter), and a 237 000 increase in the number of employed youth, rising to a total of six (6) million youth in employment.
tgt: Icandelo leenkonzo zoluntu nezentlalo lidale imisebenzi engama-119 000 lize lona elezolimo lidale engama-61 000.

src: Investments In the same trajectory of a recovering and growing economy, Cabinet welcomed the additional R5-billion investment by the Ford Motor Company for its new plug-in hybrid electric Ford Ranger that is earmarked for export to Europe, New Zealand and Australia.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele nomonakalo owenziwa zingxaki zombane nokuthuthwa kwemithwalo kwimizi-mveliso, kwicandelo lemigodi, elezothutho kunye nelezeenkonzo.

src: The P&G cumulative investment since totals approximately R900 million since 2018 and currently employed over 4000 direct and indirect jobs throughout its value chain.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ichulumancile kuba nangona nje kukho iingxaki inani labantu abatsha abangaphangeliyo lithe ngcembe lisihla (lehle ngo-1.9% kule kota ingaphambili), laze elabantu abatsha abafumene imisebenzi lenyuka ngama-237 000, laya kutsho kwizigidi ezithandathu zabantu abatsha bebonke.

src: Both The Ford Motor Company and P&G project launches are testament of the valuable contribution of President Cyril Ramaphosa’s investment drive through the South Africa Investment Conference, and a reaffirmation of South Africa as an investment destination of choice.
tgt: Amaphulo otyalo-mali Ezi ndaba zincumisayo azibonakali nje kuphela kumba wokuvuseleleka kunye nokuhluma koqoqosho, koko iKhabhinethi iphinde yavuyiswa lolunye utyalo-mali oluxabise imali ezibhiliyoni ezintlanu zerandi ngu-Ford Motor Company lokwenza imoto yabo eluhlobo lwe-Ford Ranger ehamba ngombane namafutha, eyenzelwe ukuba ithunyelwe kumazwe angaphandle ase-Europe kwakunye nase-New Zealand nase-Australia.

src: Cabinet congratulated Ministers Thoko Didiza and Ebrahim Patel for the work done to ensure the opening of this market for South African red meat products.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalwamkela notyalo-mali olwenziwa ngabakwa-Procter & Gamble (u-P&G) kumzi-mveliso wale nkampani wale mihla ose-Ekurhuleni e-Gauteng oza kuvelisa i-Pampers Premium Care.

src: Deliberate distortions of the Agri-Black Economic Empowerment (BEE) requirements for agricultural exports Cabinet condemned deliberate distortions by some sections of the media of the Agri-BEE requirements for agricultural exports to stoke racial tensions, and reminded the media that its freedom equally comes with responsibility.
tgt: Imali esele ityalwe ngu-P&G iyonke ukususela kowama-2018 ngoku izizigidi ezingama-900 zeerandi kwaye iqeshe abantu abasebenza kuyo ngqo kunye nakwamanye amashishini asebenzisana naye abangaphezulu kuma-4 000.

src: Cabinet expressed its appreciation to the agricultural industry, in particular the SA Wine and Agricultural Chamber of Business, commonly known as Agbiz, for rejecting attempts to plunge the country and the sector into racial tensions by publicly clarifying the distortions as soon as they were published.
tgt: Olu tyalo-mali lwenziwe zezi nkampani zimbini, u-Ford Motor Company no-P&G, lububungqina obubonisa igalelo olwenziwa liphulo likaMongameli Cyril Ramaphonsa lokutsalela utyalo-mali kweli lizwe esebenzisa iNkomfa yoTyalo-mali yoMzantsi Afrika, futhi lubonakalisa nokuba uMzantsi Afrika ngenene unamathuba otyalo-mali amahle.

src: Your posture on this matter, demonstrated that indeed you have embraced the spirit canvassed by the Springboks of Stronger Together.
tgt: Inyama ebomvu yoMzantsi Afrika iza kuthunyelwa e-Kingdom of Saudi Arabia IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukutyikitywa kwesivumelwano senyama ebomvu kunye ne-Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, ngethuba leNgqugquthela yoTyalo-mali ye-Afrika ne-Saudi Arabia.

src: Tourism Cabinet noted the partnership established between the Department of Tourism and Google as a game changer that will assist in promoting South Africa as a prime tourist destination.
tgt: Esi sivumelwano silinyathelo elibalulekileyo lokuqinisekisa ukuba iimveliso ezenziwe ngenyama ebomvu zoMzantsi Afrika zithunyelwa kweliya lizwe, size futhi siphucule nangakumbi igalelo lecandelo lezolimo kuhlumo loqoqosho nakumalinge okudala imisebenzi.

src: The partnership aims, amongst others, to facilitate the use of digital tools to enhance tourism experiences and sustainability, including the commitment that Google Maps will use technology to avoid crime hotspots.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imqhwabele izandla uMphathiswa uThoko Didiza kunye noMphathiswa u-Ebrahim Patel ngomsebenzi omhle abawenzileyo wokuqinisekisa ukuba inyama ebomvu yoMzantsi Afrika ngoku iza kukwazi ukuya kuthengiswa kweliya lizwe.

src: Fight against crime and corruption Integrated Crime Fighting Cabinet welcomed the deployment of 3 300 members of the South African National Defence Force (SANDF), from 28 October 2023 until 28 April 2024, to support the South African Police Service (SAPS) and other law-enforcement agencies to deal with illegal mining in the country.
tgt: Iingxelo zangabom ezingeyonyani malunga nezinto ezifunwayo kwiCandelo lezoLimo ngokuMgaqo-nkqubo wokuXhotyiswa kwabaNtsundu ngezoQoqosho (i-Agri-BEE) xa kuthunyelwa iimveliso zolimo kumazwe angaphandle IKhabhinethi izigxibha kabukhali iindaba zangabom ezingeyonyani ezisasazwe ngamajelo eendaba athile zokuba izinto ezifunwayo ngokwe-Agri-BEE xa kuthunyelwa iimveliso zolimo kumazwe angaphandle ngeenjongo zokuthelekisa iintlanga ezahlukeneyo zeli, futhi ifuna nokukhumbuza amajelo eendaba ukuba amalungelo ayo nawo ahamba noxanduva.

src: This deployment affirms government’s commitment to put an end to illegal mining and create conditions for inclusive growth and transformation of the economy.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilibulela kakhulu icandelo lezolimo, ingakumbi i-SA Wine kunye ne-Agricultural Chamber of Business, ebizwa ngokuba yi-Agbiz, ngokuwakhaba la malinge okudala ujamelwano phakathi kweentlanga ezahlukeneyo zeli ngokuthi lize ngaphambili libuphikise obu buxoki lakububona bupapashwe kumajelo eendaba.

src: The Ministers of the Justice, Crime Prevention and Security Cluster have provided progress with work underway to fight against crime, and the Minister of Police last week provided an update on the quarterly crime statistics.
tgt: Ngokuthatha eli nyathelo eli candelo lilandelele kanye lo moya ububethelwa liqela lesizwe loMboxo leli, i-Springboks, lokuba uManyano ngenene ngaMandla (Stronger Together).

src: National Anti-Corruption Advisory Council’s (NACAC) National Dialogue Cabinet welcomed the successful hosting of the NACAC’s National Dialogue, which deliberated on progress in implementing the National Anti-Corruption Strategy and recommendations of the Judicial Commission of Inquiry into Allegations of State Capture.
tgt: Ezokhenketho IKhabhinethi isiqaphele isivumelwano sentsebenziswano esikhoyo phakathi kweSebe lezoKhenketho kunye no-Google futhi ithi siza kunceda kakhulu ukuthengisa uMzantsi Afrika njengelizwe elinomtsalane kakhulu kubakhenkethi.

src: These Bills cover areas such as public procurement, administrative reform, conduct of public servants, reform of intelligence services, money laundering and electoral reform.
tgt: Esi sivumelwano sineenjongo, phakathi kwezinye izinto, zokukhuthaza ukuba kusetyenziswe ubuxhaka-xhaka bale mihla kuze kuphuculwe icandelo lezokhenketho futhi kuze nozinzo kulo, kuquka nesithembiso esenziweyo sokuba u-Google Maps, uza kusebenzisa ubuxhaka-xhaka bakhe akhombe iindawo ezinamazinga aphezulu olwaphulo-mthetho.

src: The Asset Forfeiture Unit has been granted freezing orders worth R14 billion for state capture related cases and has recouped R.4 billion of the ill-gotten gains.
tgt: IDabi lokuLwa uLwaphulo-mthetho noRhwaphilizo Idabi eliHlangeneyo lokuLwa uLwaphulo-mthetho IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukutyalwa kwamalungu angama-3 300 oMkhosi wezoKhuselo weSizwe woMzantsi Afrika (i-SANDF), ukususela ngomhla wama-28 kweyeDwarha 2023 ukuya kutsho kumhla wama-28 kuTshazimpunzi 2024, apho eza kuncedisa uMbutho wamaPolisa woMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPS) kunye nezinye ii-arhente zogcino-mthetho ukulwa ingxaki yokwembiwa kwemigodi ngokungekho mthethweni kweli lizwe.

src: In addition, the Investigating Directorate has taken 34 state capture and corruption cases to court, involving 205 accused persons.
tgt: Ukutyalwa kwala majoni kungqina ukuzibophelela kukarhulumente kwidabi lokulwa umkhuba wokombiwa kwemigodi ngokungekho mthethweni kunye nokudalwa kweemeko eziza kukhuthaza uhlumo oluza kuxhanyulwa nguye wonke umntu kunye nokwenza iinguqu kuqoqosho.

src: Fight against gender-based violence and femicide Cabinet condemned in the strongest terms the stabbing of a female Cape Peninsula University of Technology student, by her husband.
tgt: AbaPhathiswa abayinxalenye yeNtlanganisela yezoBulungisa, ukuLwa uLwaphulo-mthetho noKhuseleko banike ingxelo ngomsebenzi osele wenziwe ukuza kuthi ga ngoku kwidabi lokulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho, waze yena uMphathiswa wezamaPolisa wanika ingxelo ngeenkcukacha-manani zolwaphulo-mthetho zakutsha nje.

src: Cabinet calls on society to work together with government to eliminate gender-based violence whilst law-enforcement agencies continue to bring perpetrators of such callous acts to justice.
tgt: INgqungquthela ye-National Anti-Corruption Advisory Council’s (NACAC) National Dialogue IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukusingathwa ngempumelelo kwe-Ngqugquthela yeSizwe ye-NACAC, ebigwadla umsebenzi osele wenziwe malunga nokuphunyezwa kwesiCwangciso-qhinga seSizwe sokuLwa uRhwaphilizo kunye nezindululo zeKhomishini eKhokelwa yiJaji yokuPhanda iziTyholo zokuBanjwa ngoBhongwane koMbuso.

src: Cabinet wishes to remind members of the community about government support programmes such as the Child Support Grant which is aimed at assisting families to meet the basic needs of children.
tgt: ICandelo lokuThinjwa kweMpahla likhutshelwe imiyalelo yokuthimba kumatyala anxulumene nokubanjwa ngobhongwane kombuso axabisa imali ezibhiliyoni zerandi ezili-14 kwaye sele likwazile nokubuyisela kurhulumente imali efunyenwe ngondlela mnyana ezibhiliyoni zeerandi eziyi-.

src: This is in addition to the comprehensive Social Assistance Programme through which government provides healthy meals to vulnerable households through the National School Nutrition Programme and Community Nutrition and development centres.
tgt: Ukongeza, iCandelo lezophando sele lise ezinkundleni amatyala angama-34 anxulumene nokubanjwa ngobhongwane kombuso, la matyala abandakanya abantu abatyholwayo abangama-205.

src: Voter Registration Cabinet reiterated its call to all eligible voters to register to vote at their nearest voting station, including to update their details during the Voter Registration Weekend of 18 to 19 November 2023.
tgt: Idabi lokulwa ubundlobongela obusekelwe kwisini nokubulawa kwamanina IKhabhinethi ikugxibhe kabukhali ukuhlatywa komfundi wase-Cape Peninsula University of Technology ngumyeni wakhe.

src: To assist voters who need to collect IDs they have applied for or to apply for Temporary Identification certificates, the Department of Home Affairs had aligned its operating hours with those of the IEC during the voter registration weekend.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela isizwe ukuba sisebenzisane norhulumente ukusiphula neengcambu ubundlobongela obusekelwe kwisini ngelithuba ii-arhente zogcino-mthetho ziza kubamba abenzi bale mikhuba mibi.

src: Cabinet has reminded Citizens can also use the online voter registration facility (WEBTOKEN) which has been operating since February 2023, to register or update their details.
tgt: Ukusweleka kwabantwana ngenxa yokungondleki IKhabhinethi ikhathazekile zingxelo zeKhomishini yamaLungelo oLuntu yaseMzantsi Afrika (i-SAHRC) ezingokusweleka kwabantwana ngenxa yokungondleki.

src: Infrastructure development Energy The Minister in The Presidency responsible for Electricity has provided a comprehensive public briefing on the status and progress with ensuring electricity security.
tgt: Oku kongeza kwiNkqubo yeziBonelelo zeNtlalo athi urhulumente aqinisekise ukuba amakhaya asokolayo afumana ukutya okuya egazini ngeNkqubo yeSizwe yokuTyiswa kwaBantwana eziKolweni kunye neNkqubo yoLuntu yokuTya kunye namaziko ophuhliso.

src: Water Security Cabinet is pleased with reports that the disputes that resulted in delays towards implementation of the Mzimvubu Dam project have been resolved and site establishment commenced in early November, whilst consultations with traditional leaders on social issues is underway.
tgt: Ukubhalisela uNyulo IKhabhinethi ibongoza kwakhona abantu abanelungelo lokuvota ukuba bayekubhalisela unyulo kwizitishi zokuvota ezikufutshane kubo, kuquka nokunikezela ngeenkcukacha zabo ezintsha ngeMpelaveki yokuBhalisela uVoto ukususela ngomhla we-18 ukuya kowe-19 kweyeNkanga 2023.

src: Cabinet was updated that the raising of the Clanwilliam Dam wall to increase storage capacity to 344 million cubic metres for the benefit of the people of the West Coast District Municipality, Cederberg Local Municipality and Matzikama Local Municipality is underway.
