tgt: Oku kwenzelwe ukusebenzisa iqonga le-G20 ukuphakamisa nokubeka ngokutsha uMzantsi Afrika njengendawo ubani angayikhetha yotyalo-mali kwezokhenketho kunye nokhenketho buqu.

src: The following G20 meetings were held in South Africa in preparation for the G20 Summit The third Digital Economy Working Group (DEWG) meeting held on 9 to 11 June 2025 in Limpopo, focused on advancing a set of shared priorities designed to make the digital economy more inclusive, more accountable and more enabling of sustainable development.
tgt: Ezi ntlanganiso ze-G20 zilandelayo zibanjwe eMzantsi Afrika ukulungiselela iNgqungquthela ye-G20:2.

src: The third International Financial Architecture Working Group meeting held from 9 to 10 June 2025 in Limpopo, discussed the monitoring and reporting framework of the G20 Roadmap towards better, bigger and more effective Multilateral Development Banks (MDBs).
tgt: Intlanganiso yesithathu yeQela eliSebenzayo loQoqosho lweDijithali (i-DEWG) ebibanjwe ngomhla we-9 ukuya kowe-11 kweyeSilimela 2025 eLimpopo, ibigxile ekuqhubeleni phambili uluhlu lwemiba ephambili ekwabelwana ngayo eyilelwe ukwenza uqoqosho lwedijithali lubandakanyeke ngakumbi, lukwazi ukuphendula kwaye luvumele uphuhliso oluzinzileyo.

src: The G20 Provincial Education Indaba held in KZN on 10 June 2025 explored opportunities that will enable member countries to deliver quality early childhood care and education as well as produce capable learners for the future.
tgt: Intlanganiso yesithathu yeQela laMazwe ngaMazwe eliSebenzayo loBume bezeMali ebibanjwe ukusuka ngomhla we-9 ukuya kowe-10 kweyeSilimela 2025 eLimpopo, ixoxe ngenkqubo-sikhokelo yokubeka iliso neyokunika ingxelo ye-G20 ebhekisa kwiiBhanki zoPhuhliso eziManyeneyo (ii-MDB) ezingcono, ezinkulu nezisebenzayo.

src: The U20 Sherpa Summit and African Mayors’ Assembly that is being held from 12 to 14 June 2025 in the City of Tshwane, brought together mayors from different countries to deliberate on priorities such as economic opportunities, climate action, social equity and digital transformation.
tgt: INkomfa yezeMfundo yePhondo ye-G20 ebibanjelwe e-KZN ngomhla we-10 kweyeSilimela 2025 iphonononge amathuba angenza amazwe angamalungu akwazi ukubonelela ngemfundo esemgangathweni kubantwana abasaqalayo ukufunda, kananjalo ikwazi nokuvelisa abafundi bangomso abanobuchule bexesha elizayo.

src: The fourth Health Working Group meeting took place from 10 to 13 June 2025 in Gauteng, and deliberated on opportunities for technology transfer, sustainable financing and regulatory alignment to ensure timely and equitable access to life-saving tools during health emergencies.
tgt: INkomfa ye-U20 Sherpa kunye neNdibano yooSodolophu base-Afrika ebibanjwe ukusuka ngomhla we-12 ukuya kowe-14 kweyeSilimela 2025, idibanise oosodolophu abavela kumazwe ahlukeneyo ukuze baxoxe ngezinto eziphambili ezifana namathuba ezoqoqosho, intshukumo yemozulu, ukulingana kwezentlalo kunye neenguqu kwidijithali.

src: The third Task Force meeting on Artificial Intelligence (AI), Data Governance and Innovation for Sustainable Development took place in Limpopo from the 12 to 13 June 2025, provides an opportunity for the G20 member countries to shape the future of AI development and use for global public interest.
tgt: Intlanganiso yesine yeQela eliSebenzayo lezeMpilo yona ibibanjwe e-Gauteng, ukusuka ngomhla we-10 ukuya kowe-13 kweyeSilimela 2025, nalapho bekuxoxwa ngamathuba okudluliselwa ithekhnoloji, inkxaso-mali ezinzileyo kunye nolungelelwaniso lolawulo ukuqinisekisa ukufikelela kwangethuba nangokulinganayo kwizixhobo zezempilo ezisindisa ubomi ngexesha likaxakeka.

src: CABINET DECISIONS Report of the Inter-Ministerial Committee on Foodborne Illnesses Cabinet received a report of the IMC on Food-borne Illnesses with a special focus on organophosphate pesticides.
tgt: Intlanganiso yesithathu yeQela elijongene noMsebenzi woBukrelekrele obungeyonyani (i-AI), uLawulo lweeNkcukacha kunye noPhuhliso oluZinzileyo lokuSungulwa kwezinto ezintsha, yona iqhutyelwe eLimpopo ukusuka ngomhla we-12 ukuya kowe-13 kweyeSilimela 2025, inike iqonga kumazwe angamalungu e-G20 ukuze akwazi ukubumba ikamva lophuhliso lwe-AI nokusetyenziswa kwayo luluntu jikelele.

src: The IMC was advised by the Ministerial Advisory Council (MAC) on food born illnesses as appointed by the Minister of Health, Dr Aaron Motsoaledi.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi Ingxelo yeKomiti yabaPhathiswa ngeZigulo eziSuka ekuTyeni.

src: The MAC comprises of experts from various health disciplines and they will provide guidance on the prevention of future outbreaks.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ifumene ingxelo ye-IMC emalunga nezigulo eziSuka ekuTyeni, le ngxelo ibigxile ngokukodwa kwizitshabalalisi ze-organophosphate.

src: The MAC conducted work on the availability and use of Terbufos, (commonly known as Galiphirimi), a highly hazardous product that caused the death of six children in Naledi, Soweto.
tgt: I-IMC iye yacetyiswa liBhunga leeNgcebiso zaBaphathiswa (i-MAC) malunga nezigulo ezisuka ekutyeni njengoko yayonyulwe nguMphathiswa wezeMpilo, uGq Aaron Motsoaledi.

src: The Department of Agriculture will lead the consultation process on the ban in line with its 2010 Plan to eradicate poisonous insecticides and pesticides over a period of time and also work on identifying safer alternatives to Terbufos.
tgt: I-MAC ibandakanya iingcali ezivela kumacandelo ezempilo ahlukeneyo kwaye iza kunika isikhokelo ngothintelo loqhambuko kwixesha elizayo.

src: APPOINTMENTSAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and relevant security clearances.
tgt: I-MAC yenze umsebenzi wophando wokujonga indlela yokufumaneka nokusetyenziswa kwe-Terbufos, (eyaziwa njenge-Galiphirimi), le yimveliso eyingozi kakhulu ebangele ukubhubha kwabantwana abathandathu eNaledi, eSoweto.

src: Mr Ndumiso Kubheka as the Chief Executive Officer of the National Youth Development Agency.
tgt: Nangona zingachanekanga ncakasana iingxelo zokuba aba bantwana bafikelele njani na kule mveliso, kodwa amathuba okuba aba bantwana batye ukutya okunethyefu ye-Terbufos ebekuthengwe kwivenkile yespaza yasekuhlaleni yeyona ngcaciso iphathekayo.

src: Members of the Export Credit Insurance Corporation of South Africa Boarda.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukuvalwa kokungeniswa kwe-Terbufos eMzantsi Afrika, le yingxubevange yemichiza ebizwa ngokuba yi-organophosphate, edla ngokusetyenziswa njengesibulali-zinambuzane nesibulali-zitshabalalisi.

src: Ms Philisiwe Mthethwa and g. Ms Siobhain O’Mahony.
tgt: a. Nksk Delia Ndlovu (uSihlalo)b. UMnu Willem van der Spuyc.

src: Members of the South African National Accreditation System Board Dr Tshengedzeni Demana (Chairperson) Dr Dharmarai Naicker Dr Pulane Elsie Molokwane Mr Bruce Christopher Gordon Ms Nolitha Ntobongwana
tgt: UMnu Andile Mabizelad.

src: Mr Griffith Zabala.
tgt: UMnu Bheki Ishmael Mkhizef.

src: The Summit brings together African Energy ministers, policymakers, and investors to explore opportunities in green hydrogen production, infrastructure development and export potential.2 The country’s hydrogen sector is rapidly emerging as a cornerstone of the nation's strategy for transitioning to a low-carbon economy, creating sustainable jobs and positioning itself as a global leader in green energy.
tgt: UNksz Lebogang Ameliah Matlala UNksz Anele Zukiswa Vutha UGq Nandi Malumbazo UNksz Slindile Nomathemba Ndwandwe UMnu John Mayiwane Vusumuzi Mazibuko kunye

src: This year’s main event will be held at the Reckfarm Stadium in Tlokwe, JB Marks Local Municipality in the North West, and will focus on promoting education and skills development for the youth, which are linked to economic opportunities.
tgt: Mzubanzi Bismark Tyobeka (uSihlalo) UMnu Garfield Mario Bergstedt UMnu Mavela Alford Velamuva Dlamini UGq Reabetswe Kgoroeadira UNksz Tshepiso Tinyiko Matlapeng UNksz Kgotatso Mohulatsi UNksz Deidre Penfold kunye

src: The National Youth Day marks an important historic event when African learners fought the Apartheid regime against the imposition of Afrikaans as a language of instruction.
tgt: Imisitho Ezayo INkomfa yase-Afrika yeHayidrojini Ecocekileyo.1 IKhabhinethi iqaphele ukuba uMzantsi Afrika usindleke iNkomfa yase-Afrika yeHayidrojini Ecocekileyo eKapa ngomhla we-12 nowe-13 kweyeSilimela 2025.

src: It is for that, that the Basic Education Laws Amendment Act (BELA) insists on the introduction of indigenous language instruction including across the STEM and other core subjects.
tgt: Le Nkomfa idibanisa abaphathiswa bezaMandla base-Afrika, abaqulunqi bemigaqo-nkqubo, kunye nabatyali-mali ukuze baphonononge amathuba okuvelisa umoya ococekileyo, uphuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo kunye nokukwazi ukuthumela izinto kumazwe angaphandle.2 Icandelo lelizwe lehayidrojini livela ngokukhawuleza njengelitye lembombo lesicwangciso sesizwe sokutshintshela kuqoqosho lwekhabhoni ephantsi, ukudala imisebenzi ezinzileyo kunye nokuzibeka njengenkokeli yehlabathi ekuphehleni amandla ombane ococekileyo.

src: This work started in the 6th Administration with the introduction of indigenous languages teaching (isiXhosa) in the Eastern Cape and this drastically improved the EC matric results.
tgt: Inyanga yoLutsha (uSuku lweSizwe loLutsha lwama-2025) IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika, ingakumbi abantu abatsha ukuba bazibandakanye ekubhiyozeleni uSuku lweSizwe loLutsha ngomhla we-16 kweyeSilimela phantsi komxholo othi “Izakhono zelizwe elitshintshayo, ukuxhobisa ulutsha ukuze luthabathe inxaxheba ngokubonakalayo kwezoqoqosho”.

src: Indigenous language includes Afrikaans which is the language of the Africans who Apartheid classified as Coloureds.
tgt: Ulwimi lwesintu lwesiBhulu, lulwimi lwabantu base-Afrika abacalucalulwa ngurhulumente wengcindezelo njenga bantu bebala amakhaladi ukutsho.

src: Messages.
tgt: Imiyalezo.

src: CondolencesCabinet expressed condolences to the friends and family of:a) Cabinet expressed its condolences to the Government of the Republic of Zambia and the nation, following the passing away of former President, His Excellency Edgar Chagwa Lungu of Zambiab) Renowned photographer, cultural activist and jazz organizer, Rashid Lombard.
tgt: Amazwi ovelwanoIKhabhinethi ivakalise amazwi ovelwano kubahlobo nosapho lwaba:

src: Lombard was an esteemed member of the National Order of Ikhamanga (Silver), which he received in 2014 for his contribution to arts and culture and his dedication to promoting jazz music in the country andc) Former Judge President of the Eastern Cape Division of the High Court, Justice Clement Temba Sangoni, a jurist of towering intellect and a firm upholder of unwavering principle of justice, who was also a senior traditional leader of the Qokolweni-Zimbane Traditional Council in Mthatha.
tgt: a) IKhabhinethi ivakalise amazwi ovelwano kuRhulumente weRiphabliki yase-Zambia nesizwe ngokubanzi, emva kokusweleka kowayesakuba nguMongameli, oBekekileyo u-Edgar Chagwa Lungu wase-Zambiab) Umfoti owaziwayo, umlweli wenkcubeko kunye nomququzeleli we-jazz, u-Rashid Lombard.

src: CongratulationsCabinet extends its congratulations and well wishes to:a) Tete Dijana for winning the 2025 Comrades Marathon for the third time, having previously won in 2022 and 2023b) Gerda Steyn for defending her Comrades Marathon title by winning the Women’s 2025 Comrades Marathon and becoming the first South African runner to win the ultimate human race four times.
tgt: U-Lombard wayelilungu elibekekileyo leMbasa yeSizwe ye-Ikhamanga (yeSilivere), awayifumana ngonyaka wama-2014 ngenxa yegalelo lakhe kubugcisa nenkcubeko nokuzinikela kwakhe ekukhuthazeni umculo we-Jazz kweli lizwe c) Owayesakuba yiJaji enguMongameli weCandelo leNkundla ePhakamileyo yaseMpuma Koloni, u-Justice uClement Temba Sangoni, igqwetha elikrelekrele kunye ebelibambelele ngokuqinileyo kumthetho-siseko wobulungisa, owayekwayinkokeli yemveli ephezulu yeBhunga leMveli laseQokolweni-Zimbane eMthatha.

src: Issues in the environment Economy National Freight Rail Network.
tgt: Imiba engundabamlonyeni EzoQoqosho ImiZila yooLoliwe beMithwalo yeSizwe IKhabhinethi isamkele isibhengezo esenziwe ngu-Transnet Rail Infrastructure Manager (icandelo likaTransnet) seeNkampani eziza kuSebenza ngooLoliwe (ii-TOC) ezintsha.

src: Cabinet welcomed the announcement by the Transnet Rail Infrastructure Manager (a division of Transnet) of the new Train Operating Companies (TOCs).
tgt: Eli nyathelo likhulu kangaka linxulumene nesiCwangciso seCandelo lezokuThuthwa nokuHanjiswa kweMithwalo kunye nokufezekiswa koMgaqonkqubo wezooLoliwe woMzantsi Afrika, libalukeke kakhulu kumsebenzi wokwenza iinguqu kwindlela olumi ngayo uqoqosho into leyo iza kukhokelela kuphuhliso loqoqosho.

src: This major development in the Freight and Logistics Roadmap and the implementation of South Africa’s Rail Policy, marks a significant milestone in the advancement of the identified structural reforms which are key in unlocking economic development.
tgt: Ukuvunyelwa kwezinye iinkampani ukuba zisebenzise iziporo zikaloliwe kuza kwenza ukuba zibe ninzi izinto eziza kuhanjiswa kwiziporo zikaloliwe lo nto izenze iziporo zisebenze kakuhle kuze kuphunguke neendleko zokuzisebenzisa ngokuthi kuvunyelwe iinkampani ezininzi ukuba zisebenzise (iziporo) ezi ziporo zisetyenziswe kunyuke ingeniso yona ke eza kunceda kwiindleko zokulungisa nokuphucula imizila yonke kaloliwe, kuphunguke neendleko zangaphandle zokuhanjiswa kwemithwalo kunye nokwenza iindleko zizonke zokuhambisa iinkonzo kwimizila okanye iziporo zikaloliwe zingaxhomi kakhulu.

src: The third-party access to the rail network will improve the utilisation of the network and thus increasing rail efficiency reduce network unit costs by involving more operators increase revenue that will contribute to investment in the maintenance and modernisation of the network and reducing the external costs of freight logistics and improving the competitiveness of rail.
tgt: Kwisigaba sokwabiwa kwemizila, kwimizila engama-41 iyonke kunye nemimandla emi-6, kwabiwe ngolu hlobo: UMmandla waseMantla: kukho iinkampani ezifikayo ezintandathu, imizila eli-15 yokuhambisa amalahle ne-chrome.

src: The initial allocations, on a total of 41 routes and six (6) corridors, are as follows: North Corridor: six new entrants, 15 routes for transportation of coal and chrome.
tgt: Kumzila we-Iron Ore: kungene inkampani entsha enye, umzila omnye wokuhambisa i-iron ore. KuMzila waseKapa: iinkampani ezimbini ezintsha ezingenileyo, imizila emibini yokuhambisa i-manganese.

src: Iron Ore Corridor: one new entrant, one route for transportation of iron ore. Cape Corridor: two new entrants, two routes for transportation of manganese.
tgt: Kumzila waseMntla Mpuma: iinkampani ezintandathu ezintsha, imizila eli16 yokuhambisa amalahle, i-chrome, i-magnetite, amafutha ezithuthi, iikhonteyina.

src: Northeast Corridor: six new entrants, 16 routes for transportation of coal, chrome, magnetite, fuel, containers.
tgt: UMzila oseMbindini: inkampani enye entsha engenileyo, imizila emibini yokuhambisa amalahle, iikhonteyina (i-manganese).

src: Central Corridor: one new entrant, two routes for transportation of coal, containers (manganese).
tgt: UMzila weeKhonteyina: iinkampani ezine ezintsha ezingenileyo, imizila emihlanu yokuhambisa iikhonteyina, amalahle, iswekile.4 U-Transnet Rail Infrastructure Manager (TRIM) uqikelela ukuba ezi TOC ziza kulayisha umthwalo ozitoni ezizigidi ezingama-20 ngonyaka ukususela kunyakamali wama-2026/27.

src: Container Corridor: four new entrants, five routes for transportation of containers, coal, sugar.4 The Transnet Rail Infrastructure Manager (TRIM) estimates that the new Train Operating Companies (TOCs) will carry an additional 20 million tonnes of freight per annum from the 2026/27 financial year.
tgt: Oku kuza kongeza kulo mthamo uqikelelwayo uthwalwa yi-Transnet Freight Rail (ii-TFR) futhi oku kunegalelo kulo mbono kaRhulumente wokonyusa umthamo ohanjiswa kwiziporo zikaloliwe ufikelele kwiitoni ezizigidi ezingama-250 ngonyaka ngowama2029.

src: This will supplement Transnet Freight Rail’s (TFR’s) forecasted volumes and contribute to Government’s target of increasing freight moved by rail to 250m tons per annum by 2029.5 This development is also part of the progress Transnet is making towards becoming a more efficient and agile enterprise.
tgt: .5 Eli phulo liyinxalenye yomsebenzi owenziwa nguTransnet ukuzama ukuzenza ukuba abe yinkampani esebenza ngobunono nekwaziyo ukumelana neemeko zala maxesha.

src: New Mining Investment .1 Cabinet welcomed the opening of the Qala Shallows project by West Wits Mining Ltd in the Witwatersrand Basin at an investment of $90 million.
tgt: Utyalomali olutsha kwezemigodi.1 IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuvulwa kweprojekthi ye-iQala Shallows ngu-West Wits Mining Ltd e-Witwatersrand Basin apho le nkampani ityale imali ezizigidi ezingama-90 zeedola zase-ULe yinkampani yokuqala eMzantsi Afrika eyomba igolide phantsi komhlaba kwisithuba seminyaka eli-15.

src: This is South Africa’s first new underground gold mine in 15 years.
tgt: Olu tyalomali lubonisa ukuba iinkampani ngoku ziyawuthemba uMzantsi Afrika ngokuba ulilizwe elinamathuba amaninzi okutyala imali kwezemigodi.

src: This investment signals renewed confidence in the potential of new gold projects and reaffirms South Africa as a mining investment country of choice.
tgt: Njengoko kulindeleke ukuba le nkampani iqalise ukuvelisa ngowama-2026, uqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika luza kuzuza kakhulu kumalinge walo okudala imisebenzi emitsha, uphuhliso lwezakhono noqoqosho.

src: With production scheduled to begin in 2026, the South African economy will receive a major boost in new jobs, skills development, and economic development.
tgt: Ukuxhotyiswa kwamanina ngezoqoqosho.3 IKhabhinethi isamkele isivumelwano sikarhulumente necandelo labucala esiphakathi kweSebe lamaNina, uLutsha naBantu abaKhubazekileyo (i-DWYPD) kunye noStandard Bank.

src: Women economic empowerment.3 Cabinet welcomed the strategic public-private partnership between the Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities (DWYPD) and Standard Bank of South Africa.
tgt: Esi sivumelwano sentsebenziswano siza kuqhubela phambili amalinge okuphuhlisa amanina futhi siquka utyalomali oluyimali ezizigidi ezili-10 zeedola zase-US eza kuya kwi-African Women Impact Fund.

src: The partnership will advance women empowerment and includes an investment of US$10 million towards the African Women Impact Fund.
tgt: .4 I-African Women Impact Fund iza kuxhasa abaPhathi beeNgxowamali abangamanina anamashishini e-Afrika ngeenjongo zokuncedisa kwimali engaphantsi ngeebhiliyoni ezingama-42 zeedola zase-US kwale ifunekayo yokuxhasa amanina angoosomashishini kwilizwekazi le-Afrika.

src: Cabinet decisions Hosting of the 2027 ICC Cricket World Cup.
tgt: Ukusingatha iNdebe yeHlabathi yeQakamba ye-ICC yowama-2027.

src: Cabinet received an update on the decision of the International Cricket Council (ICC) to grant South Africa the rights to host the 2027 Cricket World Cup.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe ingxelo ngezintsha malunga nesigqibo seBhunga leHlabathi leQakamba (i-ICC) sokunika uMzantsi Afrika ilungelo lokusingatha iNdebe yeHlabathi yeQakamba yowama-2027.

src: This is another confirmation of South Africa’s international standing as both a host country and home of sports and entertainment.
tgt: Oku kungomnye umzekelo obonisa indlela ohlonitshwa ngayo uMzantsi Afrika njengelizwe elikwaziyo ukusingatha imisitho kunye nelidumileyo ngezemidlalo nolonwabo.

src: South Africa has an impeccable history of hosting successful world sporting events – and hosted the first soccer world cup on an African soil in 2010 and the Cricket World Cup in 2001.
tgt: Imbali yoMzantsi Afrika engenachaphaza yokusingatha ngempumelelo iminyhadala yezemidlalo – kuba ngowama-2010 yayisingathe itumente yendebe yehlabathi yebhola ekhatywayo okokuqala e-Afrika kunye neNdebe yeHlabathi yeQakamba ngowama-2001.

src: These world sporting events were catalytic to the massive infrastructure development projects in the country.
tgt: Ezi tumente zehlabathi zemidlalo zadlala indima enkulu ngokuba kuqaliswe iiprojekthi zokwakhiwa kweziseko ezingundoqo ezinkulu kweli lizwe.

src: Similarly, the preparations for the 2027 ICC Cricket World Cup will contribute to economic development of the country through infrastructure upgrades and tourism growth.
tgt: Nakwesi isihlandlo, amalungiselelo okusingatha iNdebe yeHlabathi yeQakamba ye-ICC yowama-2027 aza kuba negalelo kuphuhliso loqoqosho kweli lizwe ngamaphulo okuphuculwa kweziseko ezingundoqo kunye nokukhula kwezokhenketho.

src: South Africa’s Bid to Host the Formula One Grand Prix in Kyalami commencing in 2027.
tgt: IsiCelo soMzantsi Afrika sokuSingatha i-Formula One Grand Prix eKyalami ukususela kowama2027.

src: Cabinet approved the request to Bid to Host the Formula One Grand Prix in Kyalami for a three (3) year period commencing in 2027.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isivumile isicelo sokufaka isiCelo sokuSingatha i-Formula One Grand Prix eKyalami isithuba seminyaka emithathu (3) ukusuka kowama-2027.

src: The Bid is fully financially supported by reputable South African private sector and if successful will contribute to job creation and economic development.
tgt: Esi sicelo sixhaswa ngokupheleleyo ngemali licandelo labucala loMzantsi Afrika elihlonitshwa jikelele kwaye ukuba siphumelele siza kuba negalelo ekudaleni imisebenzi nasekuphuhliseni uqoqosho.

src: The mere granting of an opportunity for South Africa to bid for the prestigious Formula One Grand Prix is an affirmation of South Africa as an important world actor and confidence in the country.
tgt: Ukunikwa nje ithuba koMzantsi Afrika lokufaka isicelo sokusingatha i-Formula One Grand Prix elangazelelwa ngabomvu ngabaninzi kungqina ukuba uMzantsi Afrika lilizwe elihlonitshwayo lihlabathi futhi elithenjiweyo.

src: Incubation and Business Development Services (IBDS) Policy Framework.
tgt: IsiCwangcisosikhokelo soMgaqonkqubo weeNkonzo zokuKhulisa nokuPhuhlisa amaShishini (i-IBDS).

src: Cabinet approved the publication of the IBDS Policy Framework for public comment.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kwesiCwangcisosikhokelo soMgaqonkqubo we-IBDS ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: This is led by the Department of Small Business Development to provide regulatory reform for the small enterprise ecosystem by clarifying the roles of various stakeholders and promoting coordinated efforts.
tgt: Lo msebenzi ukhokelwa liSebe lokuPhuhliswa kwamaShishini amaNcinci ukuze lenze iinguqu kwimithetho elawula icandelo lamashishini asakhasayo ngokucacisa iindima ezidlalwa ngabadlalindima abahlukeneyo kunye nokukhuthaza ukuba kubekho intsebenziswano emandla.

src: This forms part of the broader National Integrated Small Enterprise Development Masterplan, which serves as the guiding framework for all role-players involved in accelerating Micro, Small and Medium Enterprise (MSMEs) growth through measurable programmes, products and services.
tgt: Oku kuyinxalenye yesiCwangciso esiBanzi seSizwe sokuPhuhliswa kwamaShishini asaKhasayo, esi sisicwangcisosikhokelo sabo bonke abadlalindima abachaphazelekayo kuhlumo lamaShishini amaNcinci, amaNcinane naPhakathi (ii-SMME) ngokusetyenziswa kweenkqubo ezihlolekayo, iimveliso kunye neenkonzo.

src: Key objectives include enhancing the quality and standards of business development services, ensuring better access to support for MSMEs especially in townships and rural areas, and fostering innovation and entrepreneurship.
tgt: Iinjongo ezingundoqo ziquka ukuphucula umgangatho weenkonzo zokuphuhliswa kwamashishini, kuqinisekiswe ukuba ziyifumana lula inkxaso ii-SMME ingakumbi ezo zisezilokishini nasemaphandleni, futhi kuphuculwe nezakhono zokuyila nokungoyiki ukuzivulela ishishini.

src: The framework places mentorship and incubation at the centre of MSME development and support for small businesses.
tgt: Esi sicwangcisosikhokelo sikhokelisa umba wokufundisa kunye nokuncediswa xa kuthethwa ngophuhliso lwe-MSME kunye nenkxaso yamashishini asakhasayo.

src: Business incubators play a critical role in nurturing the growth of early-stage businesses by providing structured support, resources and a conducive environment to secure sustainability.
tgt: Iinkampani ezixhasa amashishini asakhasayo zidlala indima ebalulekileyo ekuqinisekiseni ukuba kukho amashishini asakhasayo aqalisa uhlumo ngoku asanda kusekwa ngokunikwa inkxaso ehlelekileyo, izixhobo eziluncedo kunye neemeko ezifanelekileyo zokuqinisekisa ukuba kukho uzinzo.

src: Airfreight Strategy for South Affrica Cabinet approved the publication of the draft Air Freight Strategy for South Africa for public comment.
tgt: IsiCwangcisoqhinga soMzantsi Afrika sokuHanjiswa kwemiThwalo ngoMoya IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kwesiCwangcisoqhinga soMzantsi Afrika esiluyilo sokuHanjiswa kwemiThwalo eMoyeni ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: The strategy aims to address current challenges such as fragmented cargo corridors and high entry barriers and improve competition and infrastructure connections with other markets.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso sineenjongo zokulungisa ezi ngxaki zikhoyo ngoku zifana nemizila engahlangenanga ndawonye yokuhanjiswa kwemithwalo kunye nemiqobo enzima ethintela ukungena kwamashishini kweli candelo kunye nokonyusa izinga lokhuphiswano kunye nokuqinisekisa ukuba zikhona iziseko zokudibanisa nezinye iindawo zorhwebo.

src: Furthermore, the strategy will benefit exporters, importers and logistics companies by fostering economic growth and facilitating global trade through a more integrated air cargo network.
tgt: Ukongenza, esi sicwangciso siza kuba lulutho kwabo bathumela iimpahla ngaphandle, bathenga iimpahla ngaphandle kunye neenkampani ezihambisa imithwalo ngokukhuthaza uhlumo loqoqosho nokuvula amathuba orhwebo kwihlabathi ngokuhlanganisa iinkampani ezihambisa imithwalo emoyeni.

src: National intervention at Ditsobotla Local Municipality Cabinet received an update on the status of Ditsobotla Local Municipality in the North-West.
tgt: Ukungenelela kukazwelonke kuMasipala weNgingqi wase-Ditsobotla.

src: To restore stability in the municipality, Cabinet has approved that Ditsobotla be placed under administration in terms of section 139 (7) of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe ingxelo ngezakutsha malunga nokwenzeka kuMasipala weNgingqi wase-Ditsobotla eMntla Ntshona.

src: This intervention is done in accordance with the Municipal Finance Management Act of 2003.
tgt: Ukubuyisela uzinzo kulo masipala, iKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba umasipala wase-Ditsobotla abekwe phantsi kolawulo ngokwecandelo 139 (7) loMgaqosiseko woMzantsi Afrika wowe-1996.

src: A Recovery Plan will be instituted under the stewardship of the Department of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs and the National Treasury.
tgt: Eli nyathelo lokungenelela lenziwa ngokoMthetho woLawulo lweziMali zooMasipala wowama-2003.

src: Further, the Department of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs will coordinate Inter-Governmental Relations structures to facilitate restoration of administrative functions to assist the municipality in fulfilling its legislative mandate.
tgt: IsiCwangciso sokuVuselela siza kusetyenziswa sikhokelwa liSebe loLawulo ngeNtsebenziswano neMicimbi yeMveli kunye noNondyebo weSizwe.

src: A Joint Operations Task Team will also focus on criminal activities that are besieging the municipality.
tgt: Ukongeza, iSebe loLawulo ngeNtsebenziswano neMicimbi yeMveli liza kukhokela amaqumrhu obuDlelwane kooRhulumente ukuze kwenziwe umsebenzi wokubuyiselwa kwisimo esifanelekileyo kolawulo ukunceda umasipala enze imisebenzi yakhe ayigunyaziswe ngumthetho.

src: Bills South African Judicial Education Institute Amendment (SAJEI) Bill Cabinet approved the submission of the SAJEI Bill to Parliament for further processing.
tgt: UMthethosihlomelo oYilwayo weZiko loMzantsi Afrika leMfundo yezeJaji (i-SAJEI).

src: The main purpose of the Bill is to amend the current SAJEI Act of 2008, to achieve the necessary restructuring of the governance model of the Institute.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho osaYilwayo oyi-SAJEI ukuze uphicothwe.

src: The Act established the Institute to provide education and training for judicial officers to promote the independence, impartiality and effectiveness of the courts.
tgt: Eyona njongo iphambili yalo Mthetho uYilwayo kukwenza izilungiso kulo Mthetho we-SAJEI wama2008 ukhoyo, ukuze kwenzeke iinguqu ezifunekayo kulawulo lweli Ziko.

src: The envisaged restructuring entails the appointment of a Dean and clarification of the appointment and the functioning of the Director of the Institute.
tgt: Lo Mthetho umisela eli Ziko ukuze liqhube iinkqubo zokufundisa nokuqeqesha amagosa eenkundla zomthetho ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuzimela, ukungabi namkhethe kunye nokusebenza ngokufanelekileyo kweenkundla.

src: Business Licensing Bill, 2025.
tgt: UMthetho oYilwayo wokuKhutshelwa kwamaShishini iiLayisenisi, wowama-2025.

src: Cabinet considered and approved the publication of the Business Licensing Bill for public comments.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwuqwalasele yaze yawuvuma umba wokupapashwa koMthetho oYilwayo wokuKhutshelwa kwamaShishini iiLayisenisi ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: The aim of the Bill is to amend the Business Act of 1991, and the amendments seek to establish a modern and efficient business licensing framework that fosters economic growth and regulatory efficiency and also protect the participation of South Africans in the informal sector.
tgt: Injongo yalo Mthetho uYilwayo kukwenza izilungiso kuMthetho wamaShishini wowe-1991, kwaye ezi zineenjongo zokuqulunqa isicwangciso senkqubo yale mihla nesebenzayo yokukhupha iilayisenisi ekhuthaza uhlumo loqoqosho nemithetho engasokolisiyo kwaye ikwakhusela nelungelo labemi boMzantsi Afrika lokuthatha inxaxheba kwicandelo lamashishini angabhaliswanga ngokusesikweni.

src: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and relevant security clearances.
tgt: IzikhundlaZonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo.

src: Updates to Cabinet Phase Two (2) of the Lesotho Highlands Water Project.
tgt: Ezintsha eziya kwiKhabhinethi.

src: Cabinet received an update on the progress with the implementation of Phase 2 of the Lesotho Highlands Water Project.
tgt: IsiGaba sesiBini (2) se-Lesotho Highlands Water Project.

src: This project on completion will ensure water security for the province of Gauteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe ingxelo ngomsebenzi osele wenziwe malunga nokuqaliswa kwesiGaba 2 se-Lesotho Highlands Water Project.

src: The project completion schedule is estimated to be the end of 2029 with construction progress on both the Polihali Dam and the Polihali-Katse Transfer Tunnel.
tgt: Ukuqukunjelwa kwale projekthi kuza kuqinisekisa ukuba iphondo lase-Gauteng linamanzi oneleyo.

src: The impoundment of water in the dam is expected to commence in 2028 to enable the Department of Water and Sanitation to allow Rand Water to start extracting more water from the Vaal River System to supply the Gauteng municipalities by 2028.
tgt: Le projekthi kuqikelelwa ukuba iza kugqitywa ekupheleni kowama2029 kuba uyaqhuba umsebenzi wokwakhiwa kwe-Polihali Dam kunye nePolihali-Katse Transfer Tunnel ngoku.

src: Cabinet received an update on G20 preparations and welcomed the launch of G20 Experts Taskforce by President Cyril Ramaphosa.
tgt: Amanzi kulindeleke ukuba aqalise ukungena kweli dama ngowama-2028 ukwenzela ukuba iSebe lezaManzi noGutyulo likwazi ukunika ithuba iRand Water ukuba iqalise ukutsala amanzi amaninzi kumlambo iLigwa aza kuthunyelwa koomasipala baseGauteng ngowama-2028.

src: The G20 Experts Taskforce will examine global wealth inequality and its impact on economic growth, poverty and multilateralism.
tgt: I-IKhabhinethi ifumene ingxelo ngamalungiselelo e-G20 kwaye iyakwamkela nokusekwa kweQela leeNgcali le-G20 nguMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa.

src: This initiative which is the first of its kind for the G20 is in line with South Africa’s commitment to use its G20 Presidency to address issues that affect low-income countries, such as rising inequality and high sovereign debt burdens.
tgt: Eli Qela leeNgcali le-G20 liza kuphonononga ukungalingani kobutyebi behlabathi kunye negalelo lwale ngxaki kuhlumo loqoqosho, indlala kunye nokusebenzisana kwamazwe ehlabathi.

src: The G20 Expert Taskforce will deliver the first ever-report on global inequality to G20 world leaders at the G20 Leaders Summit in South Africa in November 2025.
tgt: Eli qela, elelilokuqala le-G20 liyahambelana nombono woMzantsi Afrika wokusebenzisa isikhundla sawo sokuba nguMongameli we-G20 ukulwa iingxaki ezichaphazela amazwe anabantu abamkela imivuzo ephantsi ezifana nokunyuka kwengxaki yokungalingani kunye neyamatyala amakhulu anawo amazwe.

src: The Sixth Health Working Group Meeting held virtually from 1 – 2 September 2025 which discussed the strengthening of global health systems and preparing for future challenges.
tgt: IQela leeNgcali le-G20 liza kunikezela ngengxelo yayo yokuqala emalunga nokungalingani kwihlabathi kwiinkokeli ze-G20 kwiNgqungquthela yeeNkokeli ze-G20 eMzantsi Afrika ngeyeNkanga 2025.

src: The Third Task Force 2 Meeting: Food Security held from 1 – 3 September 2025 in Egypt to address the main outcomes of the G20 Food Security Task Force and discussed the Ministerial Statement on global food security, which is expected to be adopted during the G20 Ministerial Meeting to be held in South Africa on 19 September 2025 Global Small and Medium Enterprises (SME’s) Ministerial meeting Cabinet received a report on the successful Global SME Ministerial meeting held in collaboration with the International Trade Centre (ITC) and the StartUp20 in Johannesburg on 21 to 24 July 2025.
tgt: Njengoko sele kumbovu phambi kokuba ifike iNgqungquthela yeeNkokeli ze-G20, uMzantsi Afrika uyaqhuba nokusingatha kunye nokuququzelela iintlanganiso zamalungiselelo kunye nokwamkelwa kwezibhengezo ngamaQela aQhuba uMsebenzi nalawo ajongene nemicimbi eyahlukeneyo ye-Ezi Ngqungquthela ze-G20 zamalungiselelo zilandelayo bezibanjiwe kwezi veki zimbalwa zidlulileyo:2.

src: The meeting served as a vital platform for fostering partnerships and setting a collaborative agenda aimed at propelling Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) towards a more sustainable, inclusive and prosperous future.
tgt: INtlanganiso yesiThathu yeQela 2: UkuQinisekisa ngoKutya oKwaneleyo ibibanjwe ukususela ngomhla woku-1 ukuya kowesi-3 kweyoMsintsi 2025 e-Egypt ukusabela kwiziphumo ezingundoqo zeQela eliJongene nokuQinisekisa ngokuTya oKwaneleyo laze laxoxa igxelo yabaPhathiswa emalunga nokuqinisekisa ngokutya okwaneleyo, ekulindeleke ukuba yamkelwe kwiNtlanganiso yabaPhathiswa ye-G20 eza kubanjelwa eMzantsi Afrika ngomhla we19 kweyoMsintsi 2025.

src: Outcomes Of the Inaugural Africa Water Investment Summit Held In Cape Town From 13 To 15 August 2025.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ifumene ingxelo ngentlanganiso yeHlabathi yabaPhathiswa beze-SME ebibanjwe ngentsebenziswano ne-International Trade Centre (i-ITC) kunye ne-StartUp20 eRhawutini ukususela ngomhla wama-21 ukuya kowama-24 kweyeKhala 2025.

src: Cabinet received an update on the outcomes of the Inaugural Africa Water Investment Summit held in Cape Town from 13 to 15 August 2025, which was officially opened by President Cyril Ramaphosa.
tgt: Le ntlanganiso isebenze njengeqonga elibalulekileyo lokwakha ubudlelwane bentsebenziswano kunye nokuqulunqa iinkqubo ekuza kusetyenziswana ngazo ezenzelwe ukuqhubela ii-SME kwikamva elizinzileyo, eliquka wonke nelinempumelelo.

src: Held under the auspices of the African Union Summit and the High-level Panel on Water Investment for Africa.
tgt: Iingxoxo bezimalunga nemixholo engundoqo efana nokuphucula amathuba wawo okufumana imali, ukukhuthaza ukutshintshelwa kubuchwepheshe bale mihla kunye nakwiintlobo zokurhweba ezingenangozi kokusingqongileyo kwicandelo lee-SMLo msitho ubuzinyaswe ngabathunywa abangama-750 abaphuma kumazwe angama-66 (abaPhathiswa kunye namaSekela abaPhathiswa angama52).

src: The Summit showcased 80 bankable water and sanitation projects from 38 countries, including 36 from South Africa.
tgt: Iziphumo zeNgqungquthela yokuQala yoTyalomali kwezaManzi ebiBanjelwe eKapa ukususela kumhla we-13 ukuya kowe-15 kweyeThupha 2025.

src: A significant outcome was the launch of the Global Outlook Council on Water Investment, a G20 Legacy initiative aimed at elevating water investment within global diplomacy.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ifumene ingxelo ngeziphumo zeNgqungquthela yokuQala yoTyalomali kwezaManzi ebiBanjelwe eKapa ukususela kumhla we-13 ukuya kowe-15 kweyeThupha 2025, eyavulwa ngokusesikweni nguMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa.

src: The Summit secured approximately US$12 billion in commitments, making significant progress towards closing Africa’s US$30 billion annual water investment gap.
tgt: Le ntlanganiso ibibanjwe phantsi kweNgqungquthela yeMbumba yeAfrika kunye neGqiza eliPhezulu ngezoTyalomali kwezaManzi eAfrika.

src: The Summit aligns closely with our national priorities as outlined in the MTDP, the NDP and the AU Water Vision and the outcomes reinforces South Africa’s leadership in shaping continental water security and infrastructure development.
tgt: Kule Ngqungquthela kuboniswe ngeeprojekthi ezinokutsala lula utyalomali ezingama-80 zezamanzi nogutyulo ezivela kumazwe angama-38, kuquka nezingama-36 ezivela eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Cabinet received an update on the implementation of the 2025 to 2026 government-wide and year-long Integrated Public Service Focus programme, to be launched in September 2025 as a structured platform to advance professionalism and rebuild public trust.
tgt: Enye into ibinkulu kakhulu ibe kukusekwa kwe-Global Outlook Council on Water Investment, iphulo lemiSebenzi ye-G20 enjongo yazo ikukukhokelisa phambili utyalomali kwezamanzi kwizivumelwano zentsebenziswano zamazwe ehlabathi.

src: The Integrated Public Service programme serves as a platform to acknowledge and showcase public sector excellence and to recognise civil servants who serve the nation with pride and distinction.
tgt: Kule Ngqungquthela kwenziwe izithembiso ezixabisa imali ezibhiliyoni ezili-12 zeedola zase-US, into leyo ilinyathelo elikhulu kakhulu kumalinge okuqokelela le mali isafunwayo izibhiliyoni ezingama-30 zeedola zase-US ngonyaka iza kusebenza kutyalomali kwezamanzi.

src: It is being commemorated under the theme “Profssionalising the Public Service to Build Trust and Restore Confidence in Government”.
tgt: Le Ngqungquthela ihambelana kakhulu nezinto ezikhokeliswa phambili leli lizwe ezicaciswe kwi-MTDP, NDP kunye noMbono wezaManzi we-AU kwaye iziphumo zayo zibonisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika uphambili ekukhokeleni amaphulo okuqinisekisa ukuba kukho amanzi oneleyo kweli lizwekazi nawophuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo.

src: The programme is anchored on five strategic pillars that include the visibility of the Executive in communities, responsiveness, professionalism and ethical conduct of public servants, trust and citizen participation.
tgt: INyanga eHlanganeyo yeeNkonzo zikaRhulumente (i-IPSM).

src: Cabinet also supported the establishment of an Inter-Governmental Relations Forum to coordinate the annual IPSM calendar of activities and promote cross-Government collaboration.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ifumene ingxelo zakutsha nje malunga nokuqalisa ukusetyenziswa kwenkqubo karhulumente wonke yonyaka wonke yowama-2025 ukuya kuma-2025 yoGxininiso kwiiNkonzo zikaRhuluemnte, eza kumiselwa ngokusesikweni ngeyoMsintsi 2025 njengeqonga elineenkqubo ezihlelekileyo zokuphucula izakhono kubasebenzi neenkonzo zikarhulumente kunye nokuvuselela ukuthenjwa kukarhulumente luluntu.

src: The visit is part of the President’s initiative to strengthen support to provincial governments and improve coordination in efforts to unlock provincial economic growth and improve service delivery.
tgt: Iza kubhiyozelwa phantsi komxholo othi “Ukuphucula izinga lezakhono zabaSebenzi bakaRhulumente ngeenjongo zoKwakha ukuThenjwa nokoHlonitshwa kukaRhulumente”.

src: The Deputy President will also lead a Clean Cities and Towns campaign at the Zwelihle Township, in the Overstrand Local Municipality, as part of fostering cleaner, healthier and more sustainable urban and rural environment.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuxhasile ukusekwa kweQumrhu lobuDlelwano phakathi kwamaQoqo kaRhulumente eliza kukhokela inkqubo nesicwangciso sezinto eziza kwenziwa ngonyaka ye-IPSM ize ikhuthaze intsebenziswano phakathi kwamaqoqo ahlukeneyo karhulumente.

src: The Department of Correctional Services will host the South African Parole Review Summit on 22 and 23 September 2025 in Pretoria.
tgt: UMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa kunye neKhabhinethi baza kutyelela eRustenburg kwiPhondo laseMntla Ntshona ngoLwesihlanu, umhla we-12 kweyoMsintsi 2025.

src: The summit will take place during Corrections Week, which focuses on the department's role in rehabilitation and community reintegration of offenders.
tgt: Olu tyelelo luyinxalenye yephulo likaMongameli lokunyusa izinga lenkxaso enikwa oorhulumente bamaphondo nokuphucula amalinge okusebenzisana ngeenjongo zokuvulela uhlumo loqoqosho lwamaphondo kunye nokuphucula ukuhanjiswa kweenkonzo.

src: Deputy President Paul Mashatile is scheduled to lead the official Heritage Day celebration that will take place on 24 September 2025 at the Bridgton Stadium in Oudtshoorn, in Western Cape.
tgt: ISebe leeNkonzo zoLuleko liza kusingatha iNgqungquthela yokuHlaziya iNkqubo yeNgqawule yoMzantsi Afrika ngomhla wama-22 nowama-23 kweyoMsintsi 2025 ePitoli.

src: Tourism Month is commemorated under the theme: "Tourism and Sustainable Tourism", which celebrates South Africa’s rich culture, heritage, and travel experiences.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela iza kubanjwa ngethuba leVeki yezoLuleko, eza kugxininisa kwindima yesebe kumsebenzi wokoluleka nokubuyisela kwamabanjwa eluntwini.

src: Tourism Month shines a spotlight on the importance of the industry in community empowerment and job creation.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela iza kuzinyanswa zingcali, abasebenzi kunye namahlakani apho kuza kuxoxwa ngezinto eziyimpumelelo, imingeni kunye neenkqubo zale mihla ezisetyenziswayo kwiinkqubo zengqawule.

src: SAPS National Commemoration Day is commemorated on the first Sunday of September every year as the nation pays tribute to men and women of the South African Police Service who lost their lives in the line of duty – paying the ultimate price in the service and securing the people of South Africa.
tgt: Le misitho ilandelayo iza kubhiyozelwa kule nyanga yoMsintsi: iNyanga yamaFa, iNyanga yezoKhenketho, uSuku lweSizwe olusiSikhumbuzo le-SAPS kunye neNyanga yeeNkonzo zikaRhulumente eziHlangeneyo,.

src: Cabinet calls on everyone to support the police as they go about the difficult task of ensuring a safe and crime free South Africa.
tgt: Ngemibhiyozo yeNyanga yamaFa, uMzantsi Afrika uhlonipha futhi uzikhumbuza ngenkcubeko etyebileyo, amafa kunye namasiko esizwe sethu esineentlanga ezahlukeneyo.

src: Messages CondolencesCabinet expressed condolences to the friends and family of: Former Chairperson of the NCOP and Ambassador to Kenya, Mr Mninwa Johannes Mahlangu affectionately known as "MJ" and one of the first generation of MPs to be elected to Parliament in 1994.
tgt: Umxholo walo nyaka uthi: UkuCamngca ngokuTsha ngamaZiko aliliFa ethu ukwenzela iXesha eliTsha.

src: He was part of the group that drafted the constitution and further represented South Africa with distinction internationally.
tgt: USekela Mongameli uPaul Mashatile uza kukhokela imibhiyozo karhulumente yoSuku lwamaFa eza kubanjwa ngomhla wama-24 kweyoMsintsi 2025 e-Bridgton Stadium, eTsorweni, eNtshona Koloni.

src: Tshidi Madia, renowned journalist and broadcaster, who stood as a beacon of integrity and voice of reason.
tgt: INyanga yezoKhenketho iza kubhiyozelwa phantsi komxholo othi: “EzoKhenketho noKhenketho oluZinzileyo”, ibhiyozela inkcubeko etyebileyo yoMzantsi Afrika, kunye nezinto abantu abadibana nazo xa betyelela iindawo ngeendawo zeli lizwe.

src: Jazz legend ‘Bra’ Stompie Manana whose trumpet carried the heartbeat of the people of South Africa from the streets of Sophiatown to the world stage and became one of the respected trumpeters and flugelhorn players.
tgt: Ikwakhuthaza abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba batyelele iindawo zeli lizwe babone izinto neendawo ezintle zeli lizwe (#Sho’t Left).

src: Anti-apartheid activist and former national security advisor to Nelson Mandela, Mr Neil de Beer who contributed immensely to the history and politics of our country through the various roles he played in a number of formations.
tgt: USuku lweSizwe olusiSikhumbuzo le-SAPS lukhunjulwa ngosuku lweCawa lokuqala lenyanga yoMsintsi rhoqo minyaka le kwaye lelokuhlonipha amagorha namagorhakazi oMbutho wamaPolisa oMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPS) athi aphulukana nobomi bawo esemsebenzini – athe asutywa kukufa esenza umsebenzi onzima wokukhusela abantu boMzantsi Afrika.

src: Entrepreneur and founder of the popular and South Africa’s first black-owned craft beer brand Soweto Gold Beer, Mr Ndumiso Madlala.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuye wonke umntu ukuba axhase amapolisa xa esenza umsebenzi wawo wokuqinisekisa ukuba kukho ukhuseleko nowokulusiphula neengcambu ulwaphulomthetho eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Issues in the environment Economy.
tgt: Imiba enguNdaba-mlonyeni Ezoqoqosho.

src: Economic Growth.
tgt: Ezohlumo loqoqosho.

src: Cabinet welcomed the latest GDP figures, which show that the economy has grown 0.8% in the second quarter of 2025, an improvement from the 0.1% growth in the first quarter.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izamkele ezi nkcukacha-manani ze-GDP zakutsha nje, ezibonisa ukuba uqoqosho lukhule nge-0.8% kwikota yesibini yowama-2025, linyuka kulaa 0.1% wekota yokuqala.

src: The 0.8% GDP growth reflects a broad-based recovery across key sectors.
tgt: Olu hlumo lwe-GDP luyi-0.8% luhambelana kanye nesantya sokukhula esikhoyo kuwo onke amacandelo oqoqosho.

src: Eight industries recorded growth in the second quarter, with key sectors like manufacturing, mining, and trade returning to growth territory.
tgt: Amacandelo asibhozo abonise ukukhula ngekota yesibini, amacandelo abalulekileyo afana nelezemveliso, ezemigodi nelorhwebo nawo abonise uhlumo.

src: Rising household consumption also reflects an improvement in disposable income and this is confirmed through improved reported inflation figures.
tgt: Ukunyuka komthamo wemali echithwa ngamakhaya kubonisa ukunyuka kwemivuzo yabantu, oku kuqinisekiswe yingxelo enika emanani kunye nomyinge wonyuko-maxabiso.

src: Cabinet further welcomed Fitch’s decision to affirm South Africa’s long-term foreign and local currency debt ratings and maintain the stable outlook.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yasamkela nesigqibo sika-Fitch sokungayitshintshi indawo obekwa kuyo uMzantsi Afrika ngokwendlela obhatala ngayo amatyala exesha elide usebenzisa imali yangaphandle kunye nerandi, yaze yawugcina kwinqanaba elibonisa uzinzo.

src: The ratings are supported by a favourable government debt structure that is mostly local currency denominated, with long maturities and strong institutions and a credible monetary policy framework.
tgt: Le ndawo eli lizwe libekwa kuyo ihambelana nendlela ityala likarhulumente elihlelwe ngayo elibalwe ngokwemali yalapha ekhaya, kwaye aza kubhatalwa kudala kunye namaziko angqingqwa nomgaqo-nkqubo wezimali ongenazikroba.

src: According to Fitch, the progress being made under government’s Operation Vulindlela phase 2 reforms focused on fixing network infrastructures (electricity, logistics, and water) have alleviated load shedding and ended the decline in freight volume transported, contributing to Fitch’s forecast of a modest increase in real GDP growth.
tgt: Ngokuka-Fitch, umsebenzi oselwe wenziwe ngurhulumente kumalinge okwenza iinguqu phantsi kwesigaba 2 se-Operation Vulindlela esigxininisa ekulungiseni iziseko ezingundoqo ezinxulumene nezixokolelwano (umbane, ukuhanjiswa kwemithwalo, kunye nezamanzi) ayiphungule ingxaki kacimi-cimi wombane kwanqandeka nengxaki yokuhla komthamo wemithwalo ehanjiswayo, into leyo ebenefuthe kwisigqibo sika-Fitch sokwenza uqikelelo lokuba iza kukhula i-GDEsi sigqibo sika-Fitch sibonisa ukuba abatyali-mali bayavumelana neendlela ezilawulwa ngayo izimali zikarhulumenete kunye nasebenza ngayo amaqumrhu.

src: The Fitch’s affirmation signals continued investor confidence in the country’s fiscal management and institutional strength.
tgt: IPhulo likaMongameli lokuQesha uLutsha.

src: Presidential Youth Employment Initiative Cabinet welcomed the latest Quarterly Progress Report of the Presidential Youth Employment Intervention for April to June 2025, which highlights significant strides in creating pathways to earning for young South Africans.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNgxelo yeKota yeNkqubela yePhulo likaMongameli lokuQesha uLutsha, yesithuba esisuka kwekaTshazimpunzi ukuya kweyeSilimela 2025, ebonise ukuba iyabonakala indima kumalinge okuzamela abantu abatsha boMzantsi Afrika imisebenzi.

src: More than 5.64 million young people registered on the National Pathway Management Network (NPMN), surpassing the initial target of 5 million.
tgt: Abantu abatsha abangaphezulu kwezigidi eziyi-5.64 babhalise kwi-National Pathway Management Network (i-NPMN), inani elo lingaphezulu kwelo belilindelwe lizizigidi ezihlanu.

src: Over 1.91 million young people have accessed temporary earning opportunities, reflecting government’s sustained efforts to tackle youth unemployment are gaining traction.
tgt: Abantu abatsha abangaphezulu kwesigidi esiyi-1.91 bafumane izingxungxo zethutyana, into leyo ebubungqina bokuba amalinge karhulumente aqhubayo okulwa ingxaki yentswela-ngqesho kulutsha enza umahluko.

src: In this quarter alone, more than 234 000 opportunities were accessed by young people through the NPMThese include work experiences, skills development programmes, and income-generating opportunities that are equipping young people to transition into the labour market.
tgt: Kule kota nje yodwa, abantu abatsha baxhamle kumathuba angaphezulu kwama-234 000 ebebewafumana ngokusebenzisa i-NPMLa mathuba aquka ukufumana amava okusebenza, iinkqubo zokuphuhlisa izakhono, kunye nalawo angenisa imali wona axhobisa abantu abatsha ngezakhono ezifuneka emisebenzini.

src: Cabinet expressed appreciation to all partners for their continued contributions and reaffirms government’s commitment to tackling youth unemployment through innovative and scalable interventions.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibamba ngazibini kuwo onke amahlakani ngegalelo lawo kwaye ikwaqinisekisa nokuba urhulumente usazibophelele kumba wokulwa ingxaki yentswela-ngqesho kulutsha ngokusebenzisa amanyathelo ayilayo nanokuhlenga-hlengiswa.

src: International Relations The 80th Session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA 80)2.
tgt: ISeshoni yama-80 yeNdibano Jikelele yeNtlanganiso eNkulu yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UNGA 80)2.

src: South Africa will participate at the 80th session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA-80) will convene under the theme “Better together: 80 years and more for peace, development and human rights” from 23 - 29 September 2025 in New York, USPresident Cyril Ramaphosa will lead a South African delegation.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uza kuthatha inxaxheba kwiseshoni yama-80 yeNdibano Jikelele yeNtlanganiso eNkulu yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UNGA 80) eza kubanjwa phantsi komxholo othi: “Singcono xa sibambisene: iminyaka engama-80 nangaphezulu yoxolo, uphuhliso kunye namalungelo oluntu ukususela ngomhla wama-23 ukuya kowama-29 kweyoMsintsi 2025 e-New York, e-USUMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa uza kukhokela igqiza loMzantsi Afrika.

src: South Africa will use this platform to reinforce its commitment to global multilateralism, human rights for all, sustainable development as a collective responsibility, and peaceful resolution of conflicts with special emphasis on the conflicts in the eastern DRC, the Sudans, and Palestine.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uza kusebenzisa eli qonga ukubonisa ukuba usazibophelele ukuba yinxalenye yemibutho yamazwe ehlabathi, amalungelo oluntu kuye wonke umntu, uphuhliso oluzinzileyo njengokokuba iluxanduva lwethu sonke, kunye nokusonjululwa ngoxolo kongquzulwano ingakumbi izixholo-xholo ezikwimpuma ye-DRC, kwii-Sudan zombini nase-Palestine.

src: In addition, South Africa will use the UNGA -80 to promote South Africa’s G20 Presidency Agenda.
tgt: Ukongeza, uMzantsi Afrika uza kusebenzisa i-UNGA 20 ukutyebisa kabanzi i-Ajenda yoMzantsi Afrika ngoku unguMongameli we-UMongameli uza kubamba iintlanganiso kunye nabanye oogxa bakhe aze abambe iindibano kunye nee-CEO zeenkampani ezinkulu zehlabathi.

src: The President will hold bilateral meetings with several of his counterparts and meet with CEOs of major international companies.
tgt: UMphathiswa u-Tau yena sele ekhokele ukuya kugwadla imiba enxulumene nesivumelwano sorhwebo phakathi koMzantsi Afrika ne-US, ngokunjalo noMphathiswa uLamola yena oye kuzimasa iiseshoni ezikhethekileyo ze-UAbanye abaphathiswa baza kunika ingxelo zabo ngethuba kubanjwe i-UNGEzoBulungisa nokuThintela uLwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Cabinet welcomed the commencement of the hearings of the Judicial Commission of Inquiry into Criminality, Political Interference and Corruption in the Criminal Justice System – commonly known as the Madlanga Commission.
tgt: IKhomishini kaKhampepe.1 IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuqalisa ukuhlala kweKhomishini kaKhampepe engeKhomishini yoXolo noXolelwaniso (i-TRC).2 Le Khomishini sele iqalisile ukubamba iintlanganiso nabo bebefake izikhalazo kunye nabamele urhulumente.

src: National Executive Meeting with the North-West Provincial Executive Council.
tgt: INtlanganiso nabaPhathiswa namaSekela kunye neBhunga lesiGqeba soLawulo sePhondo laseMntla Ntshona.

src: Cabinet welcomed the outcomes of the meeting between the National Executive with the Provincial Executive Council of the North-West.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izamkele iziphumo zentlanganiso ebiphakathi kwabaPhathiswa namaSekela kunye neBhunga lesiGqeba soLawulo sePhondo laseMntla Ntshona.

src: This is the 7th engagement between national executive and provincial executive councils aimed at strengthening intergovernmental coordination and improving service delivery in line with the priorities of the 7th Administration.
tgt: Ibiyindibano yesixhenxe le phakathi kwabaphathiswa namasekela kunye namabhunga ezigqeba zolawulo zamaphondo, eneenjongo zokuqinisa intsebenziswano phakathi kwamaqoqo karhulumente ngokuhambelana nezinto ezikhokeliswe phambili ngulo Mbuso wesi-.

src: This meeting underscored a renewed commitment to improving service delivery in the province.
tgt: Le ntlanganiso igxininise umba wokuzibophelela kwakhona ekuphuculeni ukuhanjiswa kweenkonzo kweli phondo.

src: It affirmed the close cooperation across spheres of government to deliver critical infrastructure such as the rebuilding of roads, provision of water infrastructure and energy availability for powering the province’s industrial ambitions.
tgt: Ibonise ukusebenzisana kakhulu kuwo onke amaqoqo karhulumente kumsebenzi wokuzisa iziseko zophuhliso ezingundoqo ezifana nokuvuselelwa kweendlela, ukufakelwa kwamanzi kunye nokuqinisekisa ukuba ukhona umbane wokuncedisa kumalinge okuphuhlisa iphondo.

src: The meeting committed to work closely with the North-West provincial government to ensure the resolution of challenges currently plaguing municipalities in the province.
tgt: Le ntlanganiso igqibe kwelokuba kusetyenziswane ngamandla norhulumente wephondo laseMntla Ntshona ukuqinisekisa ukuba ziyasonjululwa ezi ngxaki zombethe eli phondo.

src: Cabinet decisions Draft National Entrepreneurship Strategy Cabinet approved publication of the draft National Entrepreneurship Strategy (NES) and Implementation Plan for public comment.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa koYilo lwesiCwangciso-qhinga seSizwe soShishino (i-NES) kunye nesiCwangciso sokuPhumeza ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: The strategy aims to promote participation of young people and historically disadvantaged businesses in the economy by incentivising entrepreneurship and ensuring sustainability of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs).
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga senzelwe ukukhuthaza amashishini abantu abatsha nawabantu ababehlelelekile kwixesha langaphambili ukuba athathe inxaxheba kuqoqosho ngokunikezela ngezibonelela kumashishini asakhasayo nokuqinisekisa ukuba awatshoni amaShishini, amaNcinane, akwindawo ephakathi ngobuNcinci (ii-MSME).Ukongeza, i-NES yenza iingcebiso ngezinto ezinokwenziwa ukukhuthaza ukuba siziqhelanise nokuziqalela awethu amashishini eMzantsi Afrika ngokuvula iimeko eziza kuba luncedo kwabo bafuna ukuziqalela amashishini, kwakunye nokuzinika inkxaso ii-MSME ukuba zizinze futhi ziqhube kakuhle.

src: This will be achieved by focusing on five key critical pillars of the strategy namely:
tgt: Oku kuza kwenzeka ngokuthi kugxininiswe kwiintsika ezingundoqo ezintlanu ezizezi

src: Enhancing entrepreneurship education and skills development (ii) Facilitating technology exchange and innovation (iii) Improving access to finance and markets (iv) Optimising the business regulatory environment and
tgt: Ukuphucula imfundo ngezoshishino nokuphuhliswa kwezakhono (ii) Ukuququzelela ukuba kufundiswane ngobuchwepheshe nobuchule bokuyila (iii) Ukwenza lula ukufumana inkxaso-mali nabathengi (vi) Ukuphucula imithetho elawula amashishini kunye

src: Promoting awareness and networking.
tgt: Nokufundisa ngokubaluleka kolwazi kunye nokwakha ubudlelwane nabanye abantu.

src: Overall, the strategy aims to increase formal economic participation, address high youth unemployment by promoting youth entrepreneurship and providing strategic direction and roadmap that integrate the work of other key departments and strategic partners.
tgt: Lilonke, esi sicwangciso-qhinga senzelwe ukunyusa inani labo bathatha inxaxheba kuqoqosho, ukulungisa ingxaki yabantu abatsha abaninzi abangaphangeliyo ngokubakhuthaza ukuba baziqalele awabo amashishini kunye nokunika ingcaciso kunye nesicwangciso esidibanisa imisebenzi yamanye amasebe aphambili namanye amahlakani abalulekileyo.

src: In addition, the strategy aims to coordinate the ecosystem for entrepreneurship development in the country, including recommendations for entrepreneurship to be incorporated into the curricula of the departments of Basic and Higher Education as a viable career choice.
tgt: Ukongeza, esi sicwangciso-qhinga senzelwe ukudibanisa bonke oosomashishini abasakhasayo ukuze baphuhliswe kwezoshishino, kuquka nezindululo zokuba izifundo ngezoshishino zifakwe kwikharityhulam yeSebe leMfundo esisiSeko kunye neSebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo njengezifundo ezinokukhethwa njengekhondo.

src: National Economic Development and Labour Council Bill.
tgt: UMthetho oYilwayo weBhunga leSizwe loPhuhliso lwezoQoqosho nezaBasebenzi.

src: Cabinet approved for public comments, the draft National Economic Development and Labour Council (Nedlac) Bill, 2025.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba uMthetho oYilwayo weBhunga leSizwe loPhuhliso lwezoQoqosho nezaBasebenzi, wowama-2025, upapashwe ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: The draft Bill will repeal the NEDLAC Act of 1994 and proposes alignment of NEDLAC’s institutional arrangements to changes in the constitutional legal order that have occurred since 1994.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo usaqulunqwa, uza kuguzula uMthetho we-NEDLAC wowama-1994 kwaye uphakamisa ukuba i-NEDLAC ilungelelaniswe notshintsho olwenzekayo kumgaqo-siseko ukususela ngowe-1994.

src: The draft Bill also provides for the Minister to make Regulations on admission and membership thresholds through a process that includes consultation and public admissions, making the system more transparent.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo usaqulunqwayo unika uMphathiswa igunya lokuqulunqa imiGaqo engokwamkelwa kunye nomyinge wamalungu ngenkqubo equka ukufakana imilomo kunye nokwamkelwa esidlangalaleni, lo nto yenze le nkqubo yenzele izinto elubala.

src: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to verification of qualifications and relevant security clearances.
tgt: IzikhundlaZonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo.

src: Mr Ashley Latchu and k. Ms Goitsemang Mathebula Upcoming events Honouring Ex-Political Prisoners.1 The Department of Sport, Arts and Culture, in partnership with the Association for Ex-Political Prisoners and the Robben Island Museum, will host a reunion of ex-political prisoners on 27 September on Robben Island.2 The gathering pays tribute to over 1 700 political prisoners who were held on Robben Island and other facilities across the country.
tgt: Mnu Ashley Latchu kunye k. noNks Goitsemang Mathebula Imisitho ezayo UkuWonga abo babengamaBanjwa ezoPolitiko.1 ISebe lezeMidlalo, ubuGcisa neNkcubeko, lisebenzisana ne-Association of Ex-Political Prisoners kunye ne-Robben Island Museum, liza kubamba intlanganiso yokudibanisa abo babengamabanjwa ezopolitiko ngomhla wama-27 kweyoMsintsi eRobben Island.2 Le ndibano yeyokuhlonipha amabanjwa ezopolitiko angaphezulu kwe-1 700 ayevalelwe eRobben Island nakwezinye iintolongo zeli lizwe.

src: The reunion is part of preserving the history of the struggle for freedom and remembering that the freedom that South Africans enjoy today was not for free.
tgt: Le ntlanganiso iyinxalenye yokulondoloza imbali yomzabalazo wenkululeko kunye nokuzikhumbuza ukuba le nkululeko ixhanyulwa ngabemi boMzantsi Afrika namhlanje yeza kabuhlungu.

src: There are men and women who sacrificed their freedom for South Africa to be free.
tgt: Amagorha namagorhakazi ancama yonke into esilwela ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ukhululeke.3 Le ndibano iza kuquka namagqala aphuma eNamibia, Lesotho, naseBotswana, into leyo ebonisa ukuba idabi lokulwa inkqubo yobukholoniyali lalisiliwa yi-Afrika esemazantsi iphela.

src: The reunion will also include veterans from Namibia, Lesotho, and Botswana, reflecting the interlinks in the southern African liberation struggle against colonialisation.
tgt: INkqubo yokuFundisa uLuntu ngezoBulungisa, ukuThintelwa koLwaphulo-mthetho nezoKhuseleko.1 INtlanganisela yezoBulungisa, ukuThintela uLwaphulo-mthetho nezoKhuseleko (i-JCPS) iza kubamba iNkqubo yokuFundisa uLuntu ngomhla we-18 kweyoMsintsi 2025, kumabala ezemidlalo e-2010 Mthatha Stadium, eMthatha, eMpuma Koloni, njengenxalenye yesiCwangciso-qhinga esiHlangeneyo sokuThintela uLwaphulo-mthetho nobuNdlobongela (i-ICVPS).2 Eli Phulo lokuFundisa uLuntu lenzelwe ukwakha ubudlelwane obungqingqwa kunye nokukhokelisa phambili izisombululo ezihlala ixesha elide ezikhokelwa luluntu ukuze kwenziwe iindawo ezihlala uluntu zikhuseleke futhi zibe nozinzo, ingakumbi eMthatha, yona ichongwe njengendawo enezinga eliphezulu lolwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Justice, Crime Prevention and Security Community Outreach Programme.1 The Justice, Crime Prevention and Security (JCPS) Cluster is hosting a Community Outreach Programme on the 18 September 2025 at the 2010 Mthatha Stadium in Mthatha, Eastern Cape, as part of the Integrated Crime and Violence Prevention Strategy (ICVPS).
tgt: IiNtlanganiso zokuLungiselelo iNgqungquthela yeeNkokeli ze-G203.1 Ezi ntlanganiso zilandelayo zokulungiselela iNgqungquthela ye-G20 bezibanjiwe kwezi veki zimbalwa zidlulileyo:.1 INtlanganiso yesiThathu yeQela eliJongene nezoKhenketho ibibanjwe ngomhla we-11 kweyoMsintsi 2025 eMpumalanga idibanise zonke izimvo kunye nezinto ekufuneka zenziwe ukulungiselala intlanganiso yabaPhathiswa bezoKhenketho be-G20 engomhla we-12 kweyoMsintsi 2025.2 Intlanganiso yabaPhathiswa bezoKhenketho be-G20 ibibanjwe ngomhla we-12 kweyoMsintsi 2025 eMpumalanga ibizinyaswe ngabaPhathiswa bezoKhenketho ukuza kuqukumbela isicwangciso sokusebenza esiza kuqhuba uphuhliso oluzinzileyo lwezokhenketho phakathi kwamazwe angamalungu e-G.3 INtlanganiso yesiThathu yeNtsebenziswano kwiHlabathi maLunga nokuQukwa koMntu Wonke kwezeziMali ibibanjwe ngomhla we-11 ukuya kowe-12 kweyoMsintsi 2025 eNtshona Koloni ngeenjongo zokupheka izisombululo ezibambekayo, ezinobuchule kunye neziquka wonke umntu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba uhlumo luquka wonke umntu, alushiyi mntu ngasemva.

src: The Outreach is intended to forge stronger partnerships and drive lasting, community-driven solutions to create safer and more resilient communities, with a particular focus on Mthatha, which has been identified as a crime hotspot.
tgt: .4 IsiXeko saseRhawutini kunye nesaseTshwane bezibambe i-Urban 20 Mayoral Summit ukususela ngomhla we-12 ukuya kowe-14 kweyoMsintsi 2025 eRhawutini.

src: G20 Leaders’ Summit Preparatory Meetings.1 The following G20 Summit preparatory meetings were held over the past few weeks:.1The Third Tourism Working Group meeting held on 11 September 2025 in Mpumalanga consolidated inputs and deliverables in preparation for the G20 Tourism Ministers’ meeting on 12 September 2025.2 The G20 Tourism Ministers’ meeting held on 12 September 2025 in Mpumalanga brought together Tourism Minister’s to finalise the action plan that is poised to drive sustainable tourism development among the G20 member countries.3 The Third Global Partnership for Financial Inclusion Meeting met on 11 – 12 September 2025 in the Western Cape to develop practical, innovative and inclusive solutions to ensure that growth includes everyone and leaves no one behind.4 The Cities of Johannesburg and Tshwane co-hosted the Urban 20 (U20) Mayoral Summit from 12–14 September 2025 in Johannesburg.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ibizinyaswe ngoosodolophu bezixeko ze-G20 ukuze zonke zisabele kwiingxaki ezijamele izixeko ngelithuba ziqinisekisa ukuba izinto eziphambili zezixeko ziyafakwa kwi-ajenda ye-G.5 I-Global SME Finance Forum ebibanjwe ukususela ngomhla we-15 ukuya kowe-17 kweyoMsintsi 2025 eGauteng ibizinyaswe ngabathunywa abali-1 200 abavela kumazwe angaphezulu kwama-60 nakumaziko ezimali engama-240.

src: It brought together mayors from G20 cities to collectively address pressing urban challenges while ensuring that the priorities of cities are elevated within the G20 agenda.5 The Global SME Finance Forum which took place from 15 - 17 September 2025 in Gauteng brought together 1 200 participants from over 60 countries and 240 financial institutions.
tgt: Njengomsitho osesikweni ohamba noBongameli boMzantsi Afrika be-G20, eli qonga beligwadla iindlela ezihlakanipheliyo zenkxaso-mali, eziquka ukusebenzisa iintlobo ezahlukeneyo zenkxaso-mali kunye nenkqubo yokumelwa xa uboleka imali ezinokuthi zisetyenziswe ukuvulela amathuba okufumana inkxaso-mali ngamashishini asekuhlaleni.

src: Students in the higher education sector and those in matric are invited to apply for National Students Financial Aid Scheme support for 2026 academic year that opened on Monday, 15th September and close on 15th November 2025.b.
tgt: Abafundi abakwibanga lemfundo ephakamileyo kunye nabo bakwibanga le-12 bayamenywa ukuba bangenise izicelo zokufumana inkxaso-mali kwiSikimu seSizwe sokuXhasa abaFundi ngeMali yokuFunda (i-NSFAS) sonyaka wama-2026.

src: Parents, teachers, neighbours and communities to support learners to apply for the NSFAS support.
